local function _try(fn, ...)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
    return ok, err
end

pcall(function()
    local _abs = math.abs
    math.abs = function(x)
        if type(x) ~= "number" then
            x = tonumber(x)
        end
        if type(x) ~= "number" then
            return 0
        end
        return _abs(x)
    end
end)

pcall(function()
    local function patchNumberUtils(mod)
        if type(mod) ~= "table" then return end
        for _, key in ipairs({ "ToString", "toString", "Format", "format", "Abbreviate", "abbreviate" }) do
            local fn = mod[key]
            if type(fn) == "function" then
                mod[key] = function(n, ...)
                    if n == nil then n = 0 end
                    if type(n) ~= "number" then
                        n = tonumber(n) or 0
                    end
                    return fn(n, ...)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local utils = rs:FindFirstChild("Utils")
    local nu = utils and utils:FindFirstChild("NumberUtils")
    if nu then
        local ok, mod = pcall(require, nu)
        if ok then patchNumberUtils(mod) end
    end
    
    pcall(function()
        local ok, mod = pcall(function()
            return require(rs:WaitForChild("Utils"):WaitForChild("NumberUtils"))
        end)
        if ok then patchNumberUtils(mod) end
    end)
end)


pcall(function()
    local function sanitizeClaim(inst)
        if not inst then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, attr in ipairs({
                "Generation", "generation", "Income", "Gen",
                "BaseGeneration", "BaseIncome", "Claim", "Money",
                "Rate", "Multiplier", "Offline", "Time",
            }) do
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttribute(attr) end)
                if ok and v == nil then
                    
                elseif ok and type(v) ~= "number" and v ~= nil then
                    local n = tonumber(v)
                    if n then
                        pcall(function() inst:SetAttribute(attr, n) end)
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, ch in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("NumberValue") or ch:IsA("IntValue") or ch:IsA("NumberConstraint") then
                    if ch.Value == nil then
                        pcall(function() ch.Value = 0 end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function scanPlots()
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if pods then
                for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                    local claim = pod:FindFirstChild("Claim")
                    if claim then sanitizeClaim(claim) end
                    sanitizeClaim(pod)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            task.wait(0.5)
            pcall(scanPlots)
        end
        
        while not rawget(_G, "_FH_SHUTDOWN") do
            task.wait(5)
            pcall(scanPlots)
        end
    end)
end)

local _cloneref_safe = (type(cloneref) == "function") and cloneref or function(o) return o end
Services = setmetatable({}, {
    __index = function(self, name)
        local success, cache = pcall(function()
            return _cloneref_safe(game:GetService(name))
        end)
        if success then
            rawset(self, name, cache)
            return cache
        else
            error("Invalid Service: " .. tostring(name))
        end
    end
})

do
    local _BUILD = LPH_ENCSTR("v3-a1")
    local _req = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (http and http.request)
    local function _dead()
        if type(_req) ~= "function" then return false end
        local ok, res = pcall(_req, { Url = LPH_ENCSTR("https://auth.smvll.xyz/ks?b=") .. _BUILD, Method = LPH_ENCSTR("GET") })
        if ok and type(res) == "table" and type(res.Body) == "string" then
            return string.find(res.Body, LPH_ENCSTR('"k":1'), 1, true) ~= nil
        end
        return false
    end
    local function _halt()
        pcall(function() game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:Kick("\226\128\139") end)
        while true do task.wait(1e9) end
    end
    if _dead() then _halt() end
    task.spawn(function() while task.wait(45) do if _dead() then _halt() end end end)
end

do
    local function each(fn)
        for _, entry in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_SYNCS or {}) do
            if entry.key and entry.setter then pcall(fn, entry) end
        end
    end

    _G.SMVLL_LIST = function()
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        local out = {}
        each(function(e)
            out[#out + 1] = e.key .. "=" .. tostring(S and S[e.key])
        end)
        table.sort(out)
        local txt = table.concat(out, "  ")
        return txt
    end

    _G.SMVLL_ALLOFF = function()
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        each(function(e)
            e.setter(false, true, true)
            if S then S[e.key] = false end
        end)
        return "all off"
    end

    _G.SMVLL_SOLO = function(key)
        _G.SMVLL_ALLOFF()
        local hit = false
        each(function(e)
            if e.key == key then
                local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
                if S then S[key] = true end
                e.setter(true, true, true)
                hit = true
            end
        end)
        return hit and ("solo " .. key) or ("no such key: " .. tostring(key))
    end
end

        holder = Instance.new("Folder")

        holder.Parent = workspace
        return holder
    end
end

do
    local last = {}
    _G.SMVLL_FIRE_GATE = function(key, minInterval) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local now = os.clock()
        local prev = last[key]
        if prev and (now - prev) < minInterval then return false end
        last[key] = now
        return true
    end
end

_G.SMVLL_THEME = _G.SMVLL_THEME or {
    preset = 1,
    listeners = {},
}
local THEME = _G.SMVLL_THEME
local function _themeGetPreset()
    return THEME_PRESETS[THEME.preset] or THEME_PRESETS[1]
end
local _tp = _themeGetPreset()
THEME.accent = _tp.accent
THEME.bg = _tp.bg

local function THEME_apply(presetIdx)
    local prev = _themeGetPreset()
    THEME.preset = presetIdx
    local p = _themeGetPreset()
    THEME.accent = p.accent
    THEME.bg = p.bg
    for _, fn in ipairs(THEME.listeners) do
        pcall(fn, p, prev)
    end
end
THEME.set = THEME_apply
local function THEME_listen(fn) table.insert(THEME.listeners, fn) end
THEME.listen = THEME_listen

local GREEN      = _tp.accent
local GREEN_DIM  = _tp.dim
local GREEN_SOFT = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 200)
local WHITE      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local GREY_STR   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
local CARD_STR   = _tp.accent
local OFF_COLOR  = _tp.off

local _allSmvllStrokes = {}

THEME.livePal    = _tp
THEME.simpleLive = (_tp.simpleMode == true)
local function _smvllStrokeSeq() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local pal = THEME.livePal or _tp
    if THEME.simpleLive and pal.stkDim then
        return ColorSequence.new(pal.stkDim)
    end
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(pal.accent)
    local dark = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.55, math.max(v * 0.30, 0))
    return ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   pal.accent),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, dark),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   pal.accent),
    })
end
_G.SMVLL_STROKE_REFRESH = function()
    local seq = _smvllStrokeSeq()
    for i = #_allSmvllStrokes, 1, -1 do
        local pair = _allSmvllStrokes[i]
        if not (pair and pair.grad and pair.grad.Parent) then
            table.remove(_allSmvllStrokes, i)
        else
            pcall(function() pair.grad.Color = seq end)
        end
    end
end
local function addSmvllStroke(parent, thickness) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", parent)
    stk.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."Stroke")
    stk.Color = WHITE
    stk.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stk.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", stk)
    grad.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."Grad")
    grad.Color = _smvllStrokeSeq()
    grad.Rotation = 0
    table.insert(_allSmvllStrokes, {grad = grad, stk = stk, parent = parent})
    return stk, grad
end

local _roleSlot = {
    accentText="SmvllRoleText", whiteText="SmvllRoleText", dimText="SmvllRoleText",
    onBg="SmvllRoleBg", offBg="SmvllRoleBg", tabBg="SmvllRoleBg",
    panelBg="SmvllRoleBg", accentBg="SmvllRoleBg",
    scrollBar="SmvllRoleScroll",
    accentStroke="SmvllRoleStroke",
    textStroke="SmvllRoleTextStroke",
}
local function _paintAs(obj, role) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end
    local slot = _roleSlot[role] or "SmvllRole"
    obj:SetAttribute(slot, role)
end
_G.SMVLL_PAINT = _paintAs

local function _applyRole(obj, role, p)
    if role == "accentText" then
        obj.TextColor3 = p.accent
    elseif role == "whiteText" then
        obj.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    elseif role == "dimText" then
        obj.TextColor3 = p.dim
    elseif role == "onBg" then
        obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.on
    elseif role == "offBg" then
        obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.off
    elseif role == "tabBg" then
        obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.tabAct
    elseif role == "panelBg" then
        obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.bg
    elseif role == "accentBg" then
        obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.accent
    elseif role == "scrollBar" then
        obj.ScrollBarImageColor3 = p.accent
    elseif role == "accentStroke" then
        obj.Color = p.accent
    elseif role == "textStroke" then
        obj.TextStrokeColor3 = p.dim
    end
end

do
    local PROPS = {
        "TextColor3", "BackgroundColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3",
        "TextStrokeColor3", "ImageColor3", "PlaceholderColor3",
        "Color",
        "Color3",
    }
    local KEYS = {"accent","dim","text","bg","on","off","knobOff","tabAct","stkDim"}

    local _classProps = {}

    function ENG._propsFor(obj)
        local cn = obj.ClassName
        local cached = _classProps[cn]
        if cached then return cached end
        local list = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(PROPS) do
            local ok, cur = pcall(function() return obj[name] end)
            if ok and typeof(cur) == "Color3" then list[#list + 1] = name end
        end
        _classProps[cn] = list
        return list
    end

    function ENG._remapOne(obj, name, map)
        local cur = obj[name]
        if typeof(cur) == "Color3" then
            local hit = map[tostring(cur)]
            if hit then obj[name] = hit end
        end
    end

    _G.SMVLL_THEME_REMAP = function(root, p, prev)
        if not prev or prev == p then return end
        local map = {}
        for _, k in ipairs(KEYS) do
            local from, to = prev[k], p[k]
            if from and to and from ~= to then map[tostring(from)] = to end
        end
        if next(map) == nil then return end
        local mark = os.clock()
        for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            local names = ENG._propsFor(obj)
            for i = 1, #names do
                pcall(ENG._remapOne, obj, names[i], map)
            end

            if os.clock() - mark >= 0.004 then
                task.wait()
                mark = os.clock()
            end
        end
    end
end

THEME_listen(function(p, prev)
    GREEN = p.accent; GREEN_DIM = p.dim; CARD_STR = p.accent
    ON_COLOR = p.on; OFF_COLOR = p.off; KNOB_OFF = p.knobOff
    TAB_ACTIVE = p.tabAct; BG = p.bg; TEXT_COLOR = p.text

    local simple = (_G.SMVLL_HUB and _G.SMVLL_HUB.SIMPLE_THEME == true) or (p.simpleMode == true)
    THEME.livePal, THEME.simpleLive = p, simple
    _G.SMVLL_STROKE_REFRESH()

    function ENG._applyAttrOne(obj, pal)
        local attrs = obj:GetAttributes()
        local rScroll = attrs.SmvllRoleScroll
        if next(attrs) ~= nil then
            local rText = attrs.SmvllRoleText
            local rBg = attrs.SmvllRoleBg
            local rStroke = attrs.SmvllRoleStroke
            local rTS = attrs.SmvllRoleTextStroke
            local rOld = attrs.SmvllRole
            if rText then _applyRole(obj, rText, pal) end
            if rBg then _applyRole(obj, rBg, pal) end
            if rScroll then _applyRole(obj, rScroll, pal) end
            if rStroke then _applyRole(obj, rStroke, pal) end
            if rTS then _applyRole(obj, rTS, pal) end
            if rOld then _applyRole(obj, rOld, pal) end
        end
        if obj:IsA("Highlight") then
            obj.FillColor = pal.accent
            obj.OutlineColor = pal.accent
        elseif obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and not rScroll then
            obj.ScrollBarImageColor3 = pal.accent
        end
    end

    local function applyByAttr(root)
        local mark = os.clock()
        for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            pcall(ENG._applyAttrOne, obj, p)
            if os.clock() - mark >= 0.004 then
                task.wait()
                mark = os.clock()
            end
        end
    end

    THEME.repaintGen = (THEME.repaintGen or 0) + 1
    local myGen = THEME.repaintGen
    task.spawn(function()
        if THEME.repaintGen ~= myGen then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, sg in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_UI_ROOTS or {}) do
                if sg and sg.Parent then
                    pcall(_G.SMVLL_THEME_REMAP, sg, p, prev)
                    pcall(applyByAttr, sg)
                end
            end
        end)
        if THEME.repaintGen ~= myGen then return end

        pcall(function()
            local pg = _G_Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            if pg then for _, sg in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
                if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    pcall(_G.SMVLL_THEME_REMAP, sg, p, prev)
                    pcall(applyByAttr, sg)
                end
            end end
        end)
        if THEME.repaintGen ~= myGen then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, sg in ipairs(game:GetService("CoreGui"):GetChildren()) do
                if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                    pcall(_G.SMVLL_THEME_REMAP, sg, p, prev)
                    pcall(applyByAttr, sg)
                end
            end
        end)
        if THEME.repaintGen ~= myGen then return end

        pcall(function()
            local mark = os.clock()
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Highlight") then
                    obj.FillColor = p.accent
                    obj.OutlineColor = p.accent
                elseif obj:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") and obj.Name:find("_PlrHitbox", 1, true) then
                    obj.Color3 = p.accent
                elseif obj:IsA("SelectionBox") and obj:GetAttribute("SmvllMineBox") then
                    obj.Color3 = p.accent
                elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
                    local rt = obj:GetAttribute("SmvllRoleText")
                    if rt then _applyRole(obj, rt, p) end
                end
                if os.clock() - mark >= 0.004 then
                    task.wait()
                    mark = os.clock()
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local char = _G_Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    for _, b in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                        if b:IsA("Beam") and b.Name:find("PlotBeam") then
                            b.Color = ColorSequence.new(p.accent)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if _G.SMVLL_TAB_BTNS then
            for _, b in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_TAB_BTNS) do
                local c = b.TextColor3
                local isGray = (math.abs(c.R - 120/255) < 0.05 and math.abs(c.G - 120/255) < 0.05)
                if not isGray then
                    b.TextColor3 = p.accent
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

do
    local _lastT = tick()
    local _nextSpin = 0
    game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local now = tick()
        if now < _nextSpin then return end
        local dt = now - _lastT
        _lastT = now
        _nextSpin = now + 0.05
        if #_allSmvllStrokes == 0 then return end
        local curP = THEME_PRESETS[(_G.SMVLL_HUB and _G.SMVLL_HUB.THEME_PRESET) or 1] or THEME_PRESETS[1]
        if curP.simpleMode then return end
        local d = 240 * dt
        for _, pair in ipairs(_allSmvllStrokes) do
            local g = pair.grad
            if g and g.Parent then
                local host = g:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("LayerCollector")
                if host and host.Enabled then
                    g.Rotation = (g.Rotation + d) % 360
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

local function wireToggle(pill, knob, btn, onEnable, onDisable)
    local enabled = false
    local function setEnabled(state, fireCallback, force)
        if state == enabled and not force then return end
        enabled = state
        btn:SetAttribute("SmvllOn", enabled)
        if enabled then
            pill:SetAttribute("SmvllRoleBg", "onBg")
            _G_Tween:Create(pill, TW_FAST,   {BackgroundColor3 = ON_COLOR}):Play()
            _G_Tween:Create(knob, TW_SPRING, {Position = UDim2.new(1,-18,.5,-8), BackgroundColor3 = KNOB_ON}):Play()
            if fireCallback ~= false and onEnable then
                local ok, err = pcall(onEnable)
                if not ok then warn("[SMVLL] toggle enable error:", err) end
            end
        else
            pill:SetAttribute("SmvllRoleBg", "offBg")
            _G_Tween:Create(pill, TW_FAST,   {BackgroundColor3 = OFF_COLOR}):Play()
            _G_Tween:Create(knob, TW_SPRING, {Position = UDim2.new(0,2,.5,-8), BackgroundColor3 = KNOB_OFF}):Play()
            if fireCallback ~= false and onDisable then
                local ok, err = pcall(onDisable)
                if not ok then warn("[SMVLL] toggle disable error:", err) end
            end
        end
    end
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not enabled, true)
    end)
    return setEnabled
end

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

do
    local KB = {
        actions = {},
        keyToAction = {},
        capturing = nil,
    }
    _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND = KB

    function KB.updateLabel(actionId)
        local act = KB.actions[actionId]
        if act and act.relabel then pcall(act.relabel) end
        if not act or not act.label then return end
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        local kb = S and S.KEYBINDS and S.KEYBINDS[actionId]
        if act.baseLabelText == nil then
            act.baseLabelText = act.label.Text or ""
        end
        if kb then
            act.label.Text = act.baseLabelText .. "  [" .. kb .. "]"
        else
            act.label.Text = act.baseLabelText
        end
    end

    function KB.rebuild() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        KB.keyToAction = {}
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        if not S or not S.KEYBINDS then return end
        for actionId, keyName in pairs(S.KEYBINDS) do
            KB.keyToAction[keyName] = actionId
        end
        for actionId in pairs(KB.actions or {}) do pcall(KB.updateLabel, actionId) end
    end
    
    
    local function hookRefresher()
        if KB.hooked then return end
        local S = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
        if type(S) ~= "table" then return end
        KB.hooked = true
        S.UI_REFRESHERS = S.UI_REFRESHERS or {}
        table.insert(S.UI_REFRESHERS, KB.rebuild)
    end
    pcall(hookRefresher)

    function KB.setKey(actionId, keyName)
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        if not S then return end
        if not S.KEYBINDS then S.KEYBINDS = {} end
        for kn, aid in pairs(KB.keyToAction) do
            if aid == actionId then KB.keyToAction[kn] = nil end
        end
        for aid, kn in pairs(S.KEYBINDS) do
            if kn == keyName then S.KEYBINDS[aid] = nil; KB.updateLabel(aid) end
        end
        if keyName then
            S.KEYBINDS[actionId] = keyName
            KB.keyToAction[keyName] = actionId
        else
            S.KEYBINDS[actionId] = nil
        end
        KB.updateLabel(actionId)
        if KB.listBody then KB.refreshList() end
        if S.SaveConfig then S.SaveConfig() end
    end

    function KB.register(actionId, fireFunc, labelInstance, displayName)
        KB.actions[actionId] = {
            fire = fireFunc,
            label = labelInstance,
            displayName = displayName or actionId,
        }
        pcall(hookRefresher)
        local S = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
        local saved = type(S) == "table" and S.KEYBINDS and S.KEYBINDS[actionId]
        if saved then KB.keyToAction[saved] = actionId end
        KB.updateLabel(actionId)
        if saved and KB.listBody then KB.refreshList() end
    end

    function KB.refreshList() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local body = KB.listBody
        if not body then return end
        for _, c in ipairs(body:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("TextLabel") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        local n = 0
        if S and S.KEYBINDS then
            for actionId, keyName in pairs(S.KEYBINDS) do
                n = n + 1
                local act = KB.actions[actionId]
                local name = (act and act.displayName) or actionId
                local row = Instance.new("TextLabel", body)
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
                row.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; row.TextSize = 12; row.RichText = true
                row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; row.LayoutOrder = n
                row.Text = '<font color="rgb(235,235,240)">[' .. keyName .. ']</font> <font color="rgb(200,200,208)">- ' .. name .. '</font> <font color="rgb(120,120,128)">(Toggle)</font>'
            end
        end
        if n == 0 then
            local row = Instance.new("TextLabel", body)
            row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
            row.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; row.TextSize = 11; row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            row.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 128); row.Text = ""
            n = 1
        end
        if KB.listFrame then
            KB.listFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, KB.listFrame.Size.X.Offset, 0, 40 + n * 18)
        end
    end

    function KB.setListVisible(v) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if v then KB.refreshList() end
        if KB.listFrame then KB.listFrame.Visible = v and true or false end
    end

    function KB.attachLongPress(btn, actionId)
        if not btn then return end
        btn:SetAttribute("SmvllKB", true)
        local holding = false
        local holdStart = 0
        local holdTask = nil
        local function startHold(inputType)
            if KB.capturing then return end
            holding = true
            holdStart = tick()
            holdTask = task.delay(3, function()
                if not holding then return end
                holding = false
                
                local id = actionId
                if type(id) == "function" then id = id() end
                if not id then return end
                KB.capturing = id
                local act = KB.actions[id]
                local n = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_NOTIFY")
                if n then pcall(n, "Keybind", "press a key for " .. tostring(act and act.displayName or id) .. "  (Esc = clear)", "info", 6) end
            end)
        end
        local function stopHold()
            holding = false
            if holdTask then task.cancel(holdTask); holdTask = nil end
        end
        
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                startHold(input.UserInputType)
            end
        end)
        
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                stopHold()
            end
        end)
    end

    
    
    local function btnPath(b, root)
        local parts, node = {}, b
        while node and node ~= root do
            local par = node.Parent
            if not par then return nil end
            local idx = 0
            for _, s in ipairs(par:GetChildren()) do
                if s.Name == node.Name and s.ClassName == node.ClassName then
                    idx = idx + 1
                    if s == node then break end
                end
            end
            table.insert(parts, 1, node.Name .. "#" .. idx)
            node = par
        end
        return node == root and table.concat(parts, "/") or nil
    end
    local function btnName(b)
        local t = b:IsA("TextButton") and b.Text or ""
        if t == "" and b.Parent then
            for _, s in ipairs(b.Parent:GetChildren()) do
                if s:IsA("TextLabel") and s.Text ~= "" then t = s.Text break end
            end
        end
        return t ~= "" and t or b.Name
    end
    local function clickBtn(b)
        for _, sig in ipairs({ b.MouseButton1Click, b.Activated, b.MouseButton1Down }) do
            local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, sig)
            if ok and type(conns) == "table" and #conns > 0 then
                for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Fire() end) end
                return
            end
        end
        if type(firesignal) == "function" then pcall(firesignal, b.MouseButton1Click) end
    end
    function KB.attachTree(root, tag)
        local function try(b)
            if not (b.Parent and b:IsA("GuiButton")) or b:GetAttribute("SmvllKB") then return end
            local path = btnPath(b, root)
            if not path then return end
            local id = "kb_btn_" .. tostring(tag) .. "/" .. path
            KB.register(id, function() clickBtn(b) end, nil, btnName(b))
            KB.attachLongPress(b, function()
                if KB.actions[id] then KB.actions[id].displayName = btnName(b) end
                return id
            end)
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do task.defer(try, d) end
        root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d) task.defer(try, d) end)
    end

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
        local keyName = input.KeyCode.Name
        if KB.capturing then
            local actionId = KB.capturing
            KB.capturing = nil
            local act = KB.actions[actionId]
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                KB.setKey(actionId, nil)
            else
                KB.setKey(actionId, keyName)
            end
            local n = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_NOTIFY")
            if n then
                local nm = tostring(act and act.displayName or actionId)
                pcall(n, "Keybind", input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and (nm .. " cleared") or (nm .. "  \u{2192}  [" .. keyName .. "]"), "info", 3)
            end
            return
        end
        if processed then
            local focused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
            if focused then return end
        end
        local actionId = KB.keyToAction[keyName]
        if actionId then
            local act = KB.actions[actionId]
            if act and act.fire then
                pcall(act.fire)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos, clickStartPos, isDragging = false, nil, nil, nil, false
    local dragInput = nil
    handle.Active = true

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            clickStartPos = input.Position
            startPos = target.Position
            isDragging = false
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    handle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
            if dragging and clickStartPos and (input.Position - clickStartPos).Magnitude > 5 then
                isDragging = true
            end
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging and isDragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            target.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

local function trackPos(frame, key)
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    if S and S[key] and type(S[key]) == "table" and #S[key] == 4 then
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(S[key][1], S[key][2], S[key][3], S[key][4])
    end
    frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
        local S2 = _G.SMVLL_HUB
        if not S2 then return end
        S2[key] = {frame.Position.X.Scale, frame.Position.X.Offset, frame.Position.Y.Scale, frame.Position.Y.Offset}
        if S2.SaveConfig then S2.SaveConfig() end
    end)
end

local function makeSnow(parent)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while parent.Parent do
            if rawget(_G, "SMVLL_SNOW_OFF") == true or not parent.Visible then
                task.wait(0.5)
                continue
            end
            local s = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
            s.Size = UDim2.new(0,math.random(2,3),0,math.random(2,3))
            s.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(),0,-0.05,0)
            s.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            s.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(3,7)/10
            s.BorderSizePixel = 0; s.ZIndex = 1
            Instance.new("UICorner",s).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
            local dur = math.random(15,30)/10
            _G_Tween:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                Position = UDim2.new(s.Position.X.Scale+math.random(-2,2)/10,0,1.1,0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(s, dur)
            task.wait(0.08)
        end
    end)
end

do
    local function _stripHub()
        pcall(function()
            local _tag = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_NAME_TAG")
            for _, r in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_UI_ROOTS or {}) do
                pcall(function() r.Archivable = false end)
            end
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                local ok2, nm = pcall(function() return obj.Name end)
                if ok2 and (obj:IsA("Highlight") or obj:IsA("BillboardGui")
                    or obj:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") or obj:IsA("SelectionBox")
                    or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Attachment")
                    or (type(nm) == "string" and (nm:find("SMVLL", 1, true)
                        or (_tag and nm:find(_tag, 1, true))))) then
                    pcall(function() obj.Archivable = false end)
                end
            end
            for _, cont in ipairs({ game:GetService("CoreGui") }) do
                for _, sg in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
                    if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") then pcall(function() sg.Archivable = false end) end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

end

function S.LoadConfig() end
    local STEAL_DELAY = 1.30
    local stealBarFrame, stealBarFill = nil, nil

    local function isMyPlot(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not plot then return false end
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        if sign then
            local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
            if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isValidStealPrompt(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not p or not p.Parent or not p.Enabled then return false end
        local st = p:GetAttribute("State")
        local at = p.ActionText
        return st == "Steal" or st == "Grab" or at == "Steal" or at == "Grab"
    end
    local function getNearestStealable()
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        if not root then return nil end
        local nearest, minD = nil, 150
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            if not isMyPlot(plot) then
                local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if pods then
                    for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                        local base = pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
                        local sp = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                        local att = sp and sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                        if att then
                            for _, c in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                                if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and isValidStealPrompt(c) then
                                    local d = (root.Position - c.Parent.WorldPosition).Magnitude
                                    if d < minD then minD = d; nearest = c end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end

    function ENG._parseIncome(s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not s then return 0 end
        s = tostring(s)
        local num = s:match("([%d%.]+)")
        if not num then return 0 end
        local n = tonumber(num) or 0
        if s:find("[Kk]") then n = n * 1e3
        elseif s:find("[Mm]") then n = n * 1e6
        elseif s:find("[Bb]") then n = n * 1e9
        elseif s:find("[Tt]") then n = n * 1e12
        end
        return n
    end

    local function getAllStealables() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        do
            local ok, scanList = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                return S.getScanList and S.getScanList()
            end)
            if ok and type(scanList) == "table" and #scanList > 0 then
                local out = {}
                for _, a in ipairs(scanList) do
                    local model = S.getAgModel and S.getAgModel(a)
                    local prompt = a.getPrompt and a.getPrompt()
                    local pod = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                    pod = pod and pod:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.plot))
                    pod = pod and pod:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    pod = pod and pod:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.slot))
                    local gen = 0
                    if type(S.getFinalGeneration) == "function" then
                        local okg, g = pcall(S.getFinalGeneration, a)
                        if okg and type(g) == "number" then gen = g end
                    end
                    if gen <= 0 then gen = tonumber(a.gen) or 0 end
                    out[#out + 1] = {
                        prompt = prompt, name = a.name or "?", model = model,
                        income = "$" .. tostring(gen) .. "/s", incomeN = gen, value = gen,
                        mutation = a.mutation or "None", pod = pod, uid = a.uid,
                        index = a.index, traits = a.traits, plot = a.plot, slot = a.slot,
                    }
                end
                if #out > 0 then return out end
            end
        end
        
        return {}
    end

    local function getBestStealable()
        local list = getAllStealables()
        local best, bestN = nil, -1
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.incomeN > bestN then bestN = item.incomeN; best = item.prompt end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function getSelectedStealable()
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        if not root then return nil end
        local list = getAllStealables()
        local nearest, minD = nil, math.huge
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if S.QG_SELECTED[item.name] and item.prompt.Parent then
                local d = (root.Position - item.prompt.Parent.WorldPosition).Magnitude
                if d < minD then minD = d; nearest = item.prompt end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end

    local function getBestBrainrot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local list = getAllStealables()
        if #list == 0 then return nil end
        table.sort(list, function(a, b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local aVal = (a.value or 0)
            local bVal = (b.value or 0)
            return aVal > bVal
        end)
        return list[1].name
    end
    local function autoSelectBestBrainrot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.AUTO_SELECT_BEST_BR then return end
        local best = getBestBrainrot()
        if best then
            S.QG_SELECTED = {[best] = true}
            warn("[AUTO] Selected best brainrot: " .. best)
            S.SaveConfig()
        end
    end
    local _lastBestBR = nil
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while true do
            task.wait(2)
            if S.AUTO_SELECT_BEST_BR then
                local best = getBestBrainrot()
                if best and best ~= _lastBestBR then
                    _lastBestBR = best
                    autoSelectBestBrainrot()
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        pcall(function() autoSelectBestBrainrot() end)
        pcall(function() if S._refreshQuickGrabList then S._refreshQuickGrabList() end end)
    end)

    local function firePromptConn(prompt, signalName)
        if not getconnections then return end

        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if c.Function then task.spawn(c.Function) end
        end
    end

    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

    local lp = player

    local ResetPlayer, StopResetSequence
    do

        
        
        
        
        
        
        local CAM_BIND  = "SmvllInstaResetCam"
        local resetting = false

        ResetPlayer = function()
            if resetting then return false end
            local char = lp and lp.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return false end
            resetting = true
            rawset(_G, "__SMVLL_RESETTING", os.clock() + 8)

            pcall(function() hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end)
            pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true) end)
            pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
            local hipHeight = hum.HipHeight

            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if S.suspendStretch then S.suspendStretch(8) end
                end)

                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local frozen = cam and cam.CFrame
                local oldType = cam and cam.CameraType
                pcall(function()
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
                    RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAM_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
                        cam.CFrame = frozen
                    end)
                end)

                local newChar
                local conn
                conn = lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    newChar = c
                    if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
                end)

                local ticks, gone = 0, false
                while char.Parent and hum.Health > 0 and lp.Character == char and ticks < 40 do
                    pcall(function()
                        hum.HipHeight = 1e30
                        hum.AutoRotate = true
                        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("BasePart") then child.CanCollide = false end
                        end
                    end)
                    if not char.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 or lp.Character ~= char then
                        gone = true
                        break
                    end
                    ticks = ticks + 1
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if not gone and char.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum.HipHeight = hipHeight
                        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("BasePart") then child.CanCollide = true end
                        end
                    end)
                end

                local waited = os.clock()
                while not newChar and os.clock() - waited < 5 do task.wait(0.05) end
                if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end

                if newChar then
                    local until_ = os.clock() + 1
                    while os.clock() < until_ do
                        local r = newChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if r and r.Parent then break end
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                end

                pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND) end)
                pcall(function()
                    if newChar then
                        local newHum = newChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            or newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
                        if newHum then cam.CameraSubject = newHum end
                    end
                    cam.CameraType = (oldType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable)
                        and Enum.CameraType.Custom or oldType
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if S.suspendStretch then S.suspendStretch(0.05) end
                end)

                resetting = false
                rawset(_G, "__SMVLL_RESETTING", 0)
            end)
            return true
        end

        StopResetSequence = function()
            resetting = false
            rawset(_G, "__SMVLL_RESETTING", 0)
            pcall(function()
                RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND)
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam and cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                    cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local _antiGummyGraceUntil = 0
    function ENG._clearGummyState(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if ENG._agGateHit then
            for _, inst in ipairs({player, char}) do
                local b, w = inst and inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools"), inst and inst:GetAttribute("Web")
                if (b ~= nil and b ~= false) or (w ~= nil and w ~= false) then
                    ENG._agGateHit("gummy")
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        for _, inst in ipairs({player, char}) do
            if inst then
                if inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools") ~= nil and inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools") ~= false then
                    inst:SetAttribute("BlockTools", false)
                end
                if inst:GetAttribute("Web") ~= nil and inst:GetAttribute("Web") ~= false then
                    inst:SetAttribute("Web", false)
                end
            end
        end
        if char and char:GetAttribute("BackpackReady") == false then
            char:SetAttribute("BackpackReady", true)
        end
    end
    function ENG._deleteGummyBears()
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "GummyBear" then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        _antiGummyGraceUntil = tick() + 1.5
    end)
    workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if S.ANTI_GUMMY_BEAR and child.Name == "GummyBear" then
            if ENG._agGateGummy then pcall(ENG._agGateGummy, child) end
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while task.wait(0.1) do
            if not S.ANTI_GUMMY_BEAR then continue end
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not hrp then continue end
            if tick() >= _antiGummyGraceUntil then
                ENG._clearGummyState(char)
            end
        end
    end)
    S.deleteGummyBears = ENG._deleteGummyBears

    function S.startAntiLogger()
        if _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive then return end
        _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive = true
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            local tradeLive   = pg:WaitForChild("TradeLiveTrade",  10)
            local tradeList   = pg:WaitForChild("TradePlayerList", 10)
            local tradePrompt = pg:WaitForChild("TradePrompts",    10)
            if not (tradeLive and tradeList and tradePrompt) then _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive = false; return end
            local detections = 0
            while _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive and task.wait(0.05) do
                tradeLive.Enabled   = true
                tradeList.Enabled   = true
                tradePrompt.Enabled = true
                task.wait(0.03)
                if not tradeLive.Enabled or not tradeList.Enabled or not tradePrompt.Enabled then
                    detections = detections + 1
                    if detections >= 3 then
                        local other = "Unknown"
                        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); other = tradeLive.TradeLiveTrade.Other.Username.Text end)
                        player:Kick("SMVLL HUB — Logger détecté | User: "..other)
                        break
                    end
                else
                    detections = 0
                end
            end
            _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive = false
        end)
    end
    function S.stopAntiLogger()
        _G._SMVLL_LoggerActive = false
    end

    do
        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local resolved = {}
        local NetFolder

        local NAME_HASH = {
            UseItem = "068a62948a73ec6c61f9f22ada765e9fc2add9b70cb9e2da5732837444a3f862",
        }
        local NAME_SUFFIX = {
            ["QuantumCloner/OnTeleport"] = "OnTeleport",
        }

        local function isRemote(v) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            return typeof(v) == "Instance"
                and (v:IsA("RemoteEvent") or v:IsA("RemoteFunction") or v:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent"))
        end

        local function getNetFolder() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if NetFolder and NetFolder.Parent then return NetFolder end
            local pkgs = RS:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            NetFolder = (pkgs and pkgs:FindFirstChild("Net")) or nil
            return NetFolder
        end

        local function lookupInFolder(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local folder = getNetFolder(); if not folder then return nil end
            local hash = NAME_HASH[name]
            local suf  = NAME_SUFFIX[name]
            for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
                if isRemote(d) then
                    local dn = tostring(d.Name or "")
                    if dn == name or (hash and dn == hash) then return d end
                    if suf and (dn == suf or dn:sub(-#suf) == suf or dn:find(suf, 1, true)) then
                        return d
                    end
                end
            end
            if hash then
                local hit = folder:FindFirstChild(hash, true)
                if isRemote(hit) then return hit end
            end
            local hit2 = folder:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if isRemote(hit2) then return hit2 end
            return nil
        end

        local function markerNeighbour(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local folder = getNetFolder(); if not folder then return nil end
            local logical = name:match("^R[EF]/(.+)$") or name
            local kids = folder:GetChildren()
            for i, obj in ipairs(kids) do
                local nm = tostring(obj.Name or "")
                if nm == "RE/" .. logical or nm == "RF/" .. logical then
                    for j = i + 1, math.min(i + 3, #kids) do
                        if isRemote(kids[j]) then return kids[j] end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function dualHash() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local nf = getNetFolder(); if not nf then return nil end
            local reH, rfH = {}, {}
            for _, ch in ipairs(nf:GetChildren()) do
                local nm = ch.Name
                if type(nm) == "string" then
                    local pfx, rest = nm:match("^(R[EF])/(.+)$")
                    if pfx and rest and #rest >= 32 and rest:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x") then
                        if pfx == "RE" then reH[rest] = ch else rfH[rest] = ch end
                    end
                end
            end
            local found, count = nil, 0
            for h, ch in pairs(reH) do
                if rfH[h] then count = count + 1; found = ch end
            end
            if count == 1 then return found end
            return nil
        end

        S.NetResolve = function(logical, ...) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if type(logical) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local cached = resolved[logical]
            if cached and typeof(cached) == "Instance" and cached.Parent then return cached end
            local ok, hit = pcall(lookupInFolder, logical)
            if not (ok and hit) then
                local ok2, h2 = pcall(markerNeighbour, logical)
                hit = (ok2 and h2) or nil
            end
            if not hit then
                local ok3, dh = pcall(dualHash)
                hit = (ok3 and dh) or nil
            end
            if hit then resolved[logical] = hit; return hit end
            return nil
        end
    end

    local function _agIsMyBase(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not a or not a.plot then return false end
        if a.mine == true then return true end
        local nox = ENG._nox
        return nox ~= nil and nox.isMyPlotByName(a.plot) == true
    end

    local function _agSpawnOf(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if typeof(a.spawn) == "Instance" and a.spawn.Parent then return a.spawn end
        if a.slot == nil then return nil end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(a.plot)
        local pods = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        local pod = pods and pods:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.slot))
        local base = pod and (pod:FindFirstChild("Base") or pod)
        return base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn") or nil
    end

    local function _agAnimalPos(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local sp = _agSpawnOf(a)
        return sp and sp.Position or nil
    end

    local function _agFindPrompt(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not a then return nil end
        local cached = _agPromptMem[a.uid]
        if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
        local nox = ENG._nox
        if not nox or a.slot == nil then return nil end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(a.plot)
        local p = plot and nox.getPromptForPodium(plot, tonumber(a.slot) or a.slot)
        if p then _agPromptMem[a.uid] = p end
        return p
    end

    local _agModelMem = {}
    local function _agFindModel(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not a then return nil end
        local mem = _agModelMem[a.uid]
        if mem then
            if mem.m and mem.m.Parent and mem.n == a.name then return mem.m end
            if not mem.m and mem.n == a.name and os.clock() - mem.t < 2 then return nil end
        end
        local nox = ENG._nox
        if not nox then return nil end
        local m = nox.findModelForName(a.name, _agSpawnOf(a))
        _agModelMem[a.uid] = { m = m, n = a.name, t = os.clock() }
        return m
    end
    S.getAgModel = function(item) return _agFindModel(item and item._a or item) end

    local function _agDistTo(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return math.huge end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if not hrp then return math.huge end
        local pos = _agAnimalPos(a)
        if not pos then return math.huge end
        return (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
    end

    local function _agGenOf(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return tonumber(a and a.gen) or 0
    end
    S.getFinalGeneration = _agGenOf

    local _AG_RARITY_RANK = {
        og = 8, secret = 7, brainrotgod = 6, mythic = 5,
        legendary = 4, epic = 3, rare = 2, common = 1,
    }

    local function _agRarityOf(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not a then return 0 end
        local r = a.rarity
        if r == nil then
            local info = _agAnimalsData and a.index and _agAnimalsData[a.index]
            if type(info) == "table" then
                r = rawget(info, "Rarity") or rawget(info, "rarity") or rawget(info, "Tier")
            end
        end
        if type(r) ~= "string" then return 0 end
        return _AG_RARITY_RANK[(r:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", ""))] or 0
    end

    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    do
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local AU_SCAN_GAP = 1

        local function isMyPlot(plot)
            if not plot then return false end
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            if sign then
                local yourBase = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                if yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function isMyPlotByName(plotName)
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return false end
            local plot = plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
            return isMyPlot(plot)
        end

        local function isValidStealPrompt(prompt)
            if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return false end
            local state = prompt:GetAttribute("State")
            local actionText = prompt.ActionText
            return state == "Steal" or state == "Grab"
                or actionText == "Steal" or actionText == "Grab"
        end

        local function getPromptForPodium(plot, slot)
            if not plot or not slot then return nil end
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if not pods then return nil end
            local podium = pods:FindFirstChild(tostring(slot))
            if not podium then return nil end
            local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
            if base then
                local spawn = base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                if spawn then
                    local att = spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                    if att then
                        for _, pr in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                            if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and string.find(pr.ActionText, "Steal") then
                                return pr
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for _, pr in ipairs(spawn:GetDescendants()) do
                        if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and string.find(pr.ActionText, "Steal") then
                            return pr
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, pr in ipairs(base:GetDescendants()) do
                    if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and string.find(pr.ActionText, "Steal") then
                        return pr
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, pr in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
                if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and pr.ActionText and string.find(pr.ActionText, "Steal") then
                    return pr
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function isStructuralModel(v)
            if not v or not v:IsA("Model") then return true end
            local n = string.lower(v.Name or "")
            local banned = {
                "plot", "plots", "podium", "animalpodium", "animalpodiums", "base", "spawn",
                "purchases", "plotblock", "plotsign", "yourbase", "channel", "decoration",
                "floor", "wall", "fence", "door", "part", "model", "folder", "workspace",
            }
            for i = 1, #banned do
                if n == banned[i] or n:find(banned[i], 1, true) then

                    if n == banned[i] then return true end
                end
            end

            local p = v.Parent
            if p and (p.Name == "AnimalPodiums" or p.Name == "Plots" or p.Name == "Purchases") then
                return true
            end
            if v:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums") or v:FindFirstChild("PlotSign") or v:FindFirstChild("Purchases") then
                return true
            end
            return false
        end

        local function modelScore(v, name, spawnPos)
            if isStructuralModel(v) then return nil end
            local playerNames = {}
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do playerNames[p.Name] = true end
            if playerNames[v.Name] then return nil end

            local hasMesh = false
            local partCount = 0
            for _, d in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    partCount = partCount + 1
                    if d:IsA("MeshPart") or d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then hasMesh = true end
                end
            end
            if partCount < 1 then return nil end
            local rp = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if not rp then return nil end
            local dist = spawnPos and (rp.Position - spawnPos).Magnitude or 0
            if spawnPos and dist > 18 then return nil end
            local score = 100 - dist
            if v.Name == name then score = score + 50 end
            if name and v.Name:lower():find(tostring(name):lower(), 1, true) then score = score + 25 end
            if hasMesh then score = score + 10 end

            local ok, cf, size = pcall(function() return v:GetBoundingBox() end)
            if ok and size then
                local mag = size.Magnitude
                if mag > 40 then score = score - 40 end
                if mag < 15 then score = score + 15 end
            end
            return score, rp
        end

        local function findModelForName(name, preferSpawn)
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            local spawnPos = preferSpawn and preferSpawn.Position or nil
            local best, bestScore = nil, -1e9

            for _, v in ipairs(plots:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name == name then
                    local sc = modelScore(v, name, spawnPos)
                    if sc and sc > bestScore then bestScore = sc; best = v end
                end
            end
            if best then return best end

            if spawnPos then
                for _, v in ipairs(plots:GetDescendants()) do
                    if v:IsA("Model") then
                        local sc = modelScore(v, name, spawnPos)
                        if sc and sc > bestScore then bestScore = sc; best = v end
                    end
                end
            end
            return best
        end

        local function plotOwnerName(plot)
            local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
            local lbl = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame") and sg.Frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
            return lbl and (lbl.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", "")) or "?"
        end

        local function formatMoney(n)
            if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
            local abs = math.abs(n)
            if abs >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.1fT", n / 1e12):gsub("%.0T", "T")
            elseif abs >= 1e9 then return string.format("%.1fB", n / 1e9):gsub("%.0B", "B")
            elseif abs >= 1e6 then return string.format("%.1fM", n / 1e6):gsub("%.0M", "M")
            elseif abs >= 1e3 then return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3):gsub("%.0K", "K")
            else return tostring(math.floor(n + 0.5)) end
        end

        local MUTATION_MULT = {
            ["gold"] = 1.25, ["golden"] = 1.25,
            ["diamond"] = 1.5,
            ["bloodrot"] = 2, ["blood"] = 2, ["bloodmoon"] = 2,

        local TRAIT_MULT = {
            ["strawberry"] = 9, ["meowl"] = 8, ["john pork"] = 7.5, ["skibidi"] = 7,
            ["pink egg"] = 6.5, ["rainbow balloon"] = 6.5, ["nyan"] = 5, ["nyan cat"] = 6,
            ["fireworks"] = 5, ["firework"] = 5, ["fire"] = 5, ["lightning"] = 5,
