        local function lookupMult(map, text)
            if not text or text == "" then return nil, nil end
            local low = string.lower(tostring(text)):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if map[low] then return map[low], low end

            local bestK, bestV, bestLen = nil, nil, 0
            for k, v in pairs(map) do
                if #k > bestLen and low:find(k, 1, true) then
                    bestK, bestV, bestLen = k, v, #k
                end
            end
            return bestV, bestK
        end

        local function getMutationInfo(prompt, spawn, plot, pod)
            local mut = nil
            local function tryAttr(inst)
                if not inst then return end
                for _, a in ipairs({"Mutation", "mutation", "Variant", "variant", "Rarity", "rarity", "Skin", "skin"}) do
                    local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttribute(a) end)
                    if ok and v ~= nil and tostring(v) ~= "" and tostring(v) ~= "None" and tostring(v) ~= "nil" and tostring(v) ~= "Default" then
                        return tostring(v)
                    end
                end
            end
            mut = tryAttr(prompt) or tryAttr(spawn)
            if pod then mut = mut or tryAttr(pod) end
            local playerNames = {}
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do playerNames[p.Name] = true end
            local nearModel = nil
            if spawn and plot then
                local best, bestD = nil, 12
                for _, v in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                    if v:IsA("Model") and not playerNames[v.Name] then
                        local rp = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if rp then
                            local d = (rp.Position - spawn.Position).Magnitude
                            if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = v end
                        end
                    end
                end
                nearModel = best
                if best then
                    mut = mut or tryAttr(best)
                    for _, d in ipairs(best:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text and #d.Text > 0 and #d.Text < 40 then
                            local t = d.Text
                            local mv = lookupMult(MUTATION_MULT, t)
                            if mv then mut = mut or t end
                        end
                        if not mut then mut = tryAttr(d) end
                        if mut then break end
                    end
                end
            end

            if not mut and prompt and prompt.ObjectText then
                local mv, mk = lookupMult(MUTATION_MULT, prompt.ObjectText)
                if mk then mut = mk end
            end
            return mut, nearModel
        end

        local function detectTraits(prompt, spawn, model)
            local traits = {}
            local function addTrait(text)
                local mult, key = lookupMult(TRAIT_MULT, text)
                if mult and key and not traits[key] then
                    traits[key] = mult
                end
            end
            local function scanInst(inst)
                if not inst then return end
                for _, a in ipairs({"Trait", "trait", "Traits", "traits", "Trait1", "Trait2", "Trait3"}) do
                    local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst:GetAttribute(a) end)
                    if ok and v ~= nil and tostring(v) ~= "" then

                        if type(v) == "table" then
                            for _, x in pairs(v) do addTrait(tostring(x)) end
                        else
                            for part in string.gmatch(tostring(v), "[^,;/|]+") do
                                addTrait(part)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            scanInst(prompt)
            scanInst(spawn)
            scanInst(model)
            if model then
                for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    scanInst(d)
                    if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text then addTrait(d.Text) end
                    if d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                        for _, l in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                            if l:IsA("TextLabel") and l.Text then addTrait(l.Text) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if spawn then
                for _, attName in ipairs({"PromptAttachment", "Attachment"}) do
                    local att = spawn:FindFirstChild(attName)
                    if att then
                        for _, d in ipairs(att:GetDescendants()) do
                            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text then addTrait(d.Text) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return traits
        end

        local function parseMoneyNumber(t)
            if type(t) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local s = t:gsub("%s+", ""):gsub("%$", ""):gsub("/s", ""):gsub("/S", "")
            local num, suf = s:match("^([%d%.]+)([KkMmBbTt]?)$")
            if not num then return nil end
            local n = tonumber(num)
            if not n then return nil end
            local f = string.lower(suf or "")
            if f == "k" then n = n * 1e3
            elseif f == "m" then n = n * 1e6
            elseif f == "b" then n = n * 1e9
            elseif f == "t" then n = n * 1e12 end
            return n
        end

        local function isMoneyText(t)
            if type(t) ~= "string" or t == "" then return false end
            return t:find("%$") ~= nil or t:find("/s") ~= nil
                or t:find("M/s") ~= nil or t:find("K/s") ~= nil
                or t:find("B/s") ~= nil or t:find("T/s") ~= nil
        end

        local function collectMoneyFromGui(gui)
            local best = ""
            for _, label in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
                if label:IsA("TextLabel") then
                    local t = label.Text
                    if isMoneyText(t) then
                        best = t:gsub("%s+", "")
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            return best
        end

        local function getBaseGeneration(prompt, name)
            local gen = 0
            pcall(function()
                local Animals = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Datas.Animals)
                if not Animals then return end
                local entry = Animals[name]
                if not entry and name then
                    local base = name:match("^([^%[%(%|]+)")
                    if base then
                        base = base:gsub("%s+$", "")
                        entry = Animals[base]
                    end
                end
                if entry then
                    gen = entry.Generation or entry.generation or entry.Income or entry.Gen or 0
                end
            end)
            if (not gen or gen == 0) and prompt then
                for _, a in ipairs({"Generation", "generation", "Income", "Gen", "BaseGeneration", "BaseIncome"}) do
                    local ok, v = pcall(function() return prompt:GetAttribute(a) end)
                    if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then gen = v break end
                end
            end
            return type(gen) == "number" and gen or 0
        end

        local function computeFinalIncome(baseGen, mutName, traits)
            if not baseGen or baseGen <= 0 then return 0 end
            local mutMult = 1
            if mutName then
                local m = lookupMult(MUTATION_MULT, mutName)
                if m then mutMult = m end
            end
            local traitSum = 0
            if traits then
                for _, m in pairs(traits) do
                    if type(m) == "number" then traitSum = traitSum + m end
                end
            end
            local totalMult = mutMult + traitSum
            if totalMult < 0.01 then totalMult = 1 end
            return baseGen * totalMult
        end

        local function getBrainrotMoney(prompt, spawn, mutName, traits, petName)

            local money = ""
            if spawn then
                for _, attName in ipairs({"PromptAttachment", "Attachment"}) do
                    local att = spawn:FindFirstChild(attName)
                    if att then
                        for _, child in ipairs(att:GetDescendants()) do
                            if child:IsA("BillboardGui") or child.Name == "AnimalOverhead" then
                                local m = collectMoneyFromGui(child:IsA("BillboardGui") and child or child)
                                if m ~= "" then money = m break end
                            end
                        end
                        local overhead = att:FindFirstChild("AnimalOverhead")
                        if money == "" and overhead then
                            money = collectMoneyFromGui(overhead)
                        end
                    end
                    if money ~= "" then break end
                end
                if money == "" then
                    for _, child in ipairs(spawn:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                            local m = collectMoneyFromGui(child)
                            if m ~= "" then money = m break end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            if money ~= "" then
                if not money:find("%$") then money = "$" .. money end
                if not money:find("/s") then money = money .. "/s" end
                return money
            end

            local name = petName or (prompt and prompt.ObjectText) or ""
            local base = getBaseGeneration(prompt, name)
            if base <= 0 then return "" end
            local final = computeFinalIncome(base, mutName, traits)
            if final <= 0 then return "" end
            money = "$" .. formatMoney(final) .. "/s"
            return money
        end


        local function collectAllBrainrots()
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return {} end
            local playerNames = {}
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do playerNames[p.Name] = true end
            local list = {}
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if plot:IsA("Model") and not isMyPlotByName(plot.Name) then
                    local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                    if pods then
                        for _, pod in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                            local slot = tonumber(pod.Name:match("%d+")) or 0
                            local base = pod:FindFirstChild("Base") or pod
                            local sp = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                            if not sp then continue end
                            local prompt = nil
                            local att = sp:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                            if att then
                                for _, pr in ipairs(att:GetChildren()) do
                                    if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and isValidStealPrompt(pr) then prompt = pr break end
                                end
                            end
                            if not prompt then
                                for _, pr in ipairs(sp:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if pr:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and isValidStealPrompt(pr) then prompt = pr break end
                                end
                            end
                            if not prompt then continue end
                            local petName = tostring(prompt.ObjectText or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                            if petName == "" or petName == "Pet" then
                                local best, bestD = nil, 12
                                for _, v in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if v:IsA("Model") and not playerNames[v.Name] and not v:IsDescendantOf(pod) then
                                        local rp = v.PrimaryPart or v:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                        if rp then
                                            local d = (rp.Position - sp.Position).Magnitude
                                            if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = v end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if best then petName = best.Name end
                            end
                            if not petName or petName == "" or petName == "Pet" then continue end
                            local mut, nearModel = getMutationInfo(prompt, sp, plot, pod)
                            local traits = detectTraits(prompt, sp, nearModel)
                            local display = petName
                            if mut and mut ~= "" and not petName:lower():find(tostring(mut):lower(), 1, true) then
                                display = petName .. " [" .. tostring(mut) .. "]"
                            end
                            local traitNames = {}
                            for k, _ in pairs(traits) do table.insert(traitNames, k) end
                            if #traitNames > 0 then
                                table.sort(traitNames)
                                display = display .. " {" .. table.concat(traitNames, ",") .. "}"
                            end
                            local money = getBrainrotMoney(prompt, sp, mut, traits, petName)
                            local key = plot.Name .. "|" .. tostring(slot) .. "|" .. petName .. "|" .. tostring(mut or "") .. "|" .. table.concat(traitNames, ",")
                            local disp = display
                            if money ~= "" then
                                disp = display .. "\n" .. money
                            end
                            table.insert(list, {
                                key = key,
                                name = petName,
                                display = display,
                                label = disp,
                                money = money,
                                mutation = mut,
                                traits = traits,
                                prompt = prompt,
                                spawn = sp,
                                plot = plot,
                                plotName = plot.Name,
                                slot = slot,
                            })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            table.sort(list, function(a, b)
                if a.name:lower() == b.name:lower() then
                    return (a.mutation or "") < (b.mutation or "")
                end
                return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
            end)
            return list
        end

        ENG._nox = {
            isMyPlotByName = isMyPlotByName,
            getPromptForPodium = getPromptForPodium,
            findModelForName = findModelForName,
        }

        function ENG._ovParse(t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if type(t) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local s = t:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("[,%s]", "")
            local num, suf = s:match("^%$?([%d%.]+)([KkMmBbTtQq]?)")
            local n = tonumber(num)
            if not n then return nil end
            local m = ({ k = 1e3, m = 1e6, b = 1e9, t = 1e12, q = 1e15 })[(suf or ""):lower()] or 1
            return n * m
        end
        function ENG._ovKey(tbl, s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if type(tbl) ~= "table" or type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local want = s:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("[%s_%-]", ""):lower()
            if want == "" or want == "none" then return nil end
            for k in pairs(tbl) do
                if type(k) == "string" and k:gsub("[%s_%-]", ""):lower() == want then return k end
            end
            return nil
        end
        function ENG._ovIcons() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if ENG._traitByIcon then return ENG._traitByIcon end
            local td = ENG._traitData
            if type(td) ~= "table" then return nil end
            local map = {}
            for name, t in pairs(td) do
                local ic = type(t) == "table" and (rawget(t, "Icon") or rawget(t, "Image"))
                local id = ic and tostring(ic):match("%d+")
                if id then map[id] = tostring(name) end
            end
            ENG._traitByIcon = map
            return map
        end
        function ENG._ovCollect() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local out = {}
            local debris = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
            if not debris then return out end
            for _, o in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do
                if o.Name == "FastOverheadTemplate" and o:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local bb = o:FindFirstChild("AnimalOverhead")
                    if bb then out[#out + 1] = { p = o.Position, bb = bb } end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        function ENG._ovMatch(ovs, sp, name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not (typeof(sp) == "Instance" and sp:IsA("BasePart")) then return nil end
            local base = sp.Position
            local lname = tostring(name or ""):lower()
            local best, bestD, named, namedD = nil, 7, nil, 7
            for _, o in ipairs(ovs) do
                local p = o.p
                local dxz = Vector3.new(p.X - base.X, 0, p.Z - base.Z).Magnitude
                if dxz < 7 and p.Y > base.Y - 2 and p.Y < base.Y + 25 then
                    if dxz < bestD then best, bestD = o.bb, dxz end
                    local dn = o.bb:FindFirstChild("DisplayName", true)
                    if dn and dn:IsA("TextLabel") and dn.Text:lower() == lname and dxz < namedD then
                        named, namedD = o.bb, dxz
                    end
                end
            end
            return named or best
        end
        function ENG._ovText(bb, nm) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local l = bb and bb:FindFirstChild(nm, true)
            if l and l:IsA("TextLabel") and l.Visible and l.Text ~= "" then return l.Text end
            return nil
        end
        function ENG._ovTraits(bb) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local tf = bb and bb:FindFirstChild("Traits", true)
            local map = ENG._ovIcons()
            if not (tf and map) then return nil end
            local out = nil
            for _, c in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("ImageLabel") and c.Visible and c.Name ~= "Template" then
                    local id = tostring(c.Image):match("%d+")
                    local tn = id and map[id]
                    if tn then out = out or {}; out[#out + 1] = tn end
                end
            end
            return out
        end
        function ENG._ovMult(mut, traits) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local mult, sleepy = 1, false
            local md = ENG._mutData
            local m = type(md) == "table" and mut and rawget(md, mut)
            if type(m) == "table" then mult = mult + (tonumber(rawget(m, "Modifier")) or 0) end
            local td = ENG._traitData
            for _, tn in ipairs(traits or {}) do
                local t = type(td) == "table" and rawget(td, tn)
                if type(t) == "table" then mult = mult + (tonumber(rawget(t, "MultiplierModifier")) or 0) end
                if tostring(tn):lower() == "sleepy" then sleepy = true end
            end
            return mult * (sleepy and 0.5 or 1)
        end

        local auLastScan = 0
        ENG._agScanWorld = function(force) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = os.clock()
            if not force and now - auLastScan < AU_SCAN_GAP then return end
            auLastScan = now
            local ok, list = pcall(collectAllBrainrots)
            if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then return end
            local ovs = ENG._ovCollect()
            local fresh = {}
            for _, d in ipairs(list) do
                local slot = tostring(d.slot)
                local mut = (d.mutation and d.mutation ~= "") and tostring(d.mutation) or "None"
                if mut == "Yin Yang" then mut = "YinYang" end
                local traits = nil
                for k in pairs(d.traits or {}) do
                    traits = traits or {}
                    traits[#traits + 1] = k
                end
                local info = _agAnimalsData and _agAnimalsData[d.name]
                local gen = parseMoneyNumber(d.money) or 0
                local genText = d.money
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    local md, td = ENG._mutData, ENG._traitData
                    local bb = ENG._ovMatch(ovs, d.spawn, d.name)
                    local om = bb and ENG._ovText(bb, "Mutation")
                    local omc = om and (om:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) or nil
                    local mk = ENG._ovKey(md, omc) or ENG._ovKey(md, mut)
                    if mk then mut = mk
                    elseif omc and omc ~= "" and omc:lower() ~= "none" then mut = omc
                    elseif type(md) == "table" then mut = "None" end
                    local ot = bb and ENG._ovTraits(bb)
                    if not ot and traits then
                        for _, k in ipairs(traits) do
                            local tk = ENG._ovKey(td, k)
                            if tk then ot = ot or {}; ot[#ot + 1] = tk
                            elseif type(td) ~= "table" then ot = ot or {}; ot[#ot + 1] = k end
                        end
                    end
                    traits = ot
                    local gt = bb and ENG._ovText(bb, "Generation")
                    local gv = gt and ENG._ovParse(gt)
                    if gv and gv > 0 then
                        gen, genText = gv, (gt:gsub("<[^>]->", ""):gsub("%s", ""))
                    else
                        local base = type(info) == "table" and tonumber(rawget(info, "Generation"))
                        if base and base > 0 then
                            gen = base * ENG._ovMult(mut ~= "None" and mut or nil, traits)
                            genText = "$" .. formatMoney(gen) .. "/s"
                        end
                    end
                end)
                fresh[#fresh + 1] = {
                    name = d.name, index = d.name, plot = d.plotName, slot = slot,
                    uid = d.plotName .. "_" .. slot,
                    mutation = mut, traits = traits, owner = plotOwnerName(d.plot),
                    gen = gen, genText = genText, fusing = false,
                    rarity = type(info) == "table" and info.Rarity or "Common", spawn = d.spawn,
                }
            end
            table.sort(fresh, function(x, y) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                return (tonumber(x.gen) or 0) > (tonumber(y.gen) or 0)
            end)
            
            table.clear(_agAllCache)
            for i, a in ipairs(fresh) do _agAllCache[i] = a end
        end
    end

    local function _agScan(force) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        pcall(ENG._agScanWorld, force)
    end

    function S.getScanList() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        pcall(_agScan)
        local out = {}
        for _, a in ipairs(_agAllCache) do
            if not _agIsMyBase(a) then
                out[#out+1] = {
                    name = a.name, uid = a.uid, plot = a.plot, slot = a.slot,
                    gen = _agGenOf(a), income = a.genText, mutation = a.mutation or "None",
                    rarity = _agRarityOf(a),
                    rarityName = (function()
                        local info = _agAnimalsData and a.index and _agAnimalsData[a.index]
                        return type(info) == "table" and tostring(rawget(info, "Rarity") or "") or ""
                    end)(),
                    traits = a.traits, owner = a.owner,
                    getPrompt = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return _agFindPrompt(a) end,
                    _a = a,
                }
            end
        end

        
        local pri = S.PRIORITY or {}
        for _, it in ipairs(out) do
            local sg = S.getAgSig and S.getAgSig(it) or ""
            it._pri = pri[sg] and 1 or 0
        end
        table.sort(out, function(x, y) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if x._pri ~= y._pri then return x._pri > y._pri end
            local xg, yg = tonumber(x.gen) or 0, tonumber(y.gen) or 0
            if xg ~= yg then return xg > yg end
            return tostring(x.name) < tostring(y.name)
        end)
        return out
    end

    function ENG._agPickClosest() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, a in ipairs(_agAllCache) do
            if not _agIsMyBase(a) and (_agNoPrompt[a.uid] or 0) <= os.clock() then
                local pos = _agAnimalPos(a)
                if pos then
                    local d = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
                    if d <= AG_NEAREST_RADIUS and d < bestDist then
                        bestDist = d; best = a
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function _agSig(a) return tostring(a and a.plot or "").."::"..tostring(a and a.slot or "").."::"..tostring(a and a.name or "") end
    S.getAgSig = function(item) return _agSig(item and item._a or item) end

    function ENG._agPickPriority() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, a in ipairs(_agAllCache) do
            if S.PRIORITY[_agSig(a)] and not _agIsMyBase(a)
                and (_agNoPrompt[a.uid] or 0) <= os.clock()
                and _agAnimalPos(a) then
                return a
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function ENG._agPickBest() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if not hrp then return nil end

        for _, a in ipairs(_agAllCache) do
            if not _agIsMyBase(a) and (_agNoPrompt[a.uid] or 0) <= os.clock() then
                local pos = _agAnimalPos(a)
                if pos and (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude <= AG_PRIME_RANGE then
                    return a
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function ENG._agBuildCallbacks(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

        local prev = _agCache[prompt]
        if prev and (#prev.hold > 0 or #prev.trig > 0) then return end

        if prev and prev.ready == false then return end
        local data = {hold={}, trig={}, holdEnd={}, ready=true}
        local ok1, c1 = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
        if ok1 and type(c1)=="table" then
            for _, c in ipairs(c1) do
                if type(c.Function)=="function" then table.insert(data.hold, c.Function) end
            end
        end
        local ok2, c2 = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
        if ok2 and type(c2)=="table" then
            for _, c in ipairs(c2) do
                if type(c.Function)=="function" then table.insert(data.trig, c.Function) end
            end
        end
        local ok3, c3 = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded)
        if ok3 and type(c3)=="table" then
            for _, c in ipairs(c3) do
                if type(c.Function)=="function" then table.insert(data.holdEnd, c.Function) end
            end
        end

        _agCache[prompt] = data
    end

    local AG_START_RANGE = 9e9

    function ENG._agHoldRange(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return AG_START_RANGE
    end

    function ENG._agPetStillLive(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if type(a) ~= "table" or not a.plot or a.slot == nil then return false end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        local plot  = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.plot))
        if not plot then return false end

        local model = S.getAgModel and S.getAgModel(a)
        if model and model.Parent then return true end

        local p = _agFindPrompt(a)
        if p and p.Parent and tostring(p.ObjectText or "") ~= "" then return true end

        local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        local podium  = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.slot))
        if not podium then return false end
        for _, child in ipairs(podium:GetDescendants()) do
            if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function _agCanSteal() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ok, blocked = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            return player:GetAttribute("Stealing")
                or player:GetAttribute("IsTrading")
                or player:GetAttribute("IsDuelSelecting")
                or player:GetAttribute("Web")
        end)
        if ok and blocked then return false end
        return true
    end

    local _agHoldStart, _agHoldActive, _agHoldPrompt = 0, false, nil

    local function _agPotionOK(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if type(S.isStealPrompt) ~= "function" then return true end
        local ok, v = pcall(S.isStealPrompt, prompt)
        return ok and v == true
    end

    do
        local GRAB_AT      = 1.8
        local EFFECT_SPAN  = 3.0
        local EFFECT_CAP   = 10
        local SPAWN_GRACE  = 1.5
        local TECH_SHOW    = 1.2
        local TECH_GRACE   = 0.3
        local GUMMY_RADIUS = 6
        local RAG_STATES = {
            [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
        }
        local serial, kind, holdAt, techSerial = 0, nil, 0, 0
        local gateFrom, gateKind, techUntil = 0, nil, 0
        local techLabel, bypassUntil, bypassName = "Ragdoll Tech", 0, nil
        local effUntil = { ragdoll = 0, gummy = 0 }
        local lastEnd, spawnedAt = {}, 0
        local wasRag, wasGummy = false, false
        local charConns = {}

        local function onset(k, endsIn, src) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = tick()
            if k == "ragdoll" and S.ANTI_RAGDOLL and ENG._kbGuard then ENG._kbGuard() end
            if k == "ragdoll" then
                local okG, giant = false, false
                if type(S._isGiant) == "function" then okG, giant = pcall(S._isGiant) end
                if src == "FakeRagdollEndTime" or (okG and giant == true) then
                    techSerial = techSerial + 1
                    return
                end
            end
            local span = endsIn and math.min(endsIn, EFFECT_CAP) or EFFECT_SPAN
            effUntil[k] = math.max(effUntil[k] or 0, now + span)
            serial = serial + 1
            kind   = k
            local at = now + GRAB_AT
            if endsIn then at = math.max(at, now + span - AG_HOLD_MIN) end
            if at > holdAt then
                gateFrom, holdAt, gateKind = now, at, k
            end
        end

        function ENG._agGateHit(k) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = tick()
            if now <= (effUntil[k] or 0) then return end
            if k == "gummy" and now - spawnedAt < SPAWN_GRACE then return end
            onset(k)
        end

        function ENG._agGateRagdollEnd(v, src) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            src = src or "RagdollEndTime"
            if type(v) ~= "number" or v == lastEnd[src] then return end
            lastEnd[src] = v
            local endsIn = v - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            if endsIn > 0.2 then onset("ragdoll", endsIn, src) end
        end

        local function carpetRiding(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool") then return false end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return false end
            for _, o in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
                if o:IsA("BodyVelocity") or o:IsA("BodyPosition") or o:IsA("BodyGyro") then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function gummyAttr(inst) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local b, w = inst:GetAttribute("BlockTools"), inst:GetAttribute("Web")
            return (b ~= nil and b ~= false) or (w ~= nil and w ~= false)
        end

        local function bindChar(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, c in ipairs(charConns) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); c:Disconnect() end) end
            charConns = {}
            spawnedAt = tick()
            holdAt, techUntil = 0, 0
            effUntil.ragdoll, effUntil.gummy = 0, 0
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                if not hum or player.Character ~= char then return end
                charConns[#charConns + 1] = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
                    if RAG_STATES[new] and not carpetRiding(char) then ENG._agGateHit("ragdoll") end
                end)
            end)
        end

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            ENG._agGateRagdollEnd(player:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"))
            ENG._agGateRagdollEnd(player:GetAttribute("FakeRagdollEndTime"), "FakeRagdollEndTime")
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then return end
            ENG._agGateRagdollEnd(char:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime"), "charRagdollEndTime")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local rag = hum ~= nil and RAG_STATES[hum:GetState()] == true
            if rag and not wasRag and not carpetRiding(char) then ENG._agGateHit("ragdoll") end
            wasRag = rag
            local gum = gummyAttr(player) or gummyAttr(char)
            if gum and not wasGummy then ENG._agGateHit("gummy") end
            wasGummy = gum
        end)

        function ENG._agGateGummy(m) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local char = player.Character
            local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local okP, at = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return m:GetPivot().Position end)
            if not okP or not at then return end
            local mine = (at - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if mine > GUMMY_RADIUS then return end
            for _, other in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if other ~= player then
                    local oc = other.Character
                    local oh = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if oh and (at - oh.Position).Magnitude < mine then return end
                end
            end
            ENG._agGateHit("gummy")
        end
        workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child.Name == "GummyBear" and not S.ANTI_GUMMY_BEAR then ENG._agGateGummy(child) end
        end)

        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindChar)
        if player.Character then bindChar(player.Character) end

        function ENG._agGateSerial() return serial end
        function ENG._agGateTechSerial() return techSerial end
        function ENG._agGateOpen() return tick() >= holdAt end
        function ENG._agGateTech() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if kind ~= "ragdoll" or type(S._isGiant) ~= "function" then return false end
            local deadline = tick() + TECH_GRACE
            while true do
                local ok, giant = pcall(S._isGiant)
                if ok and giant == true then return true end
                if kind ~= "ragdoll" or tick() >= deadline then return false end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        function ENG._agGateFlash(label) techUntil, techLabel = tick() + TECH_SHOW, label end
        function ENG._agBypassMark(name) bypassUntil, bypassName = tick() + 0.25, name end

        function S._agGateView() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = tick()
            if now < techUntil then return "tech", techLabel end
            if now >= holdAt then
                if now < bypassUntil then return "bypass", bypassName end
                return nil
            end
            local span = holdAt - gateFrom
            return "gate", gateKind, holdAt - now, (span > 0) and math.clamp((now - gateFrom) / span, 0, 1) or 1
        end
    end

    do
        local PlayersSvc = game:GetService("Players")
        local armedOwner, armedFire = nil, nil

        local function toPlayer(o) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if typeof(o) == "Instance" then
                if o:IsA("Player") then return o end
                o = o.Name
            end
            if type(o) == "table" then
                local uid = rawget(o, "UserId")
                if type(uid) == "number" then
                    local byId = PlayersSvc:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
                    if byId then return byId end
                end
                o = rawget(o, "Name")
            end
            if type(o) == "number" then return PlayersSvc:GetPlayerByUserId(o) end
            if type(o) ~= "string" or o == "" then return nil end
            local name = o:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", "")
            local byName = PlayersSvc:FindFirstChild(name)
            if byName and byName:IsA("Player") then return byName end
            local match = nil
            for _, q in ipairs(PlayersSvc:GetPlayers()) do
                if q.DisplayName == name then
                    if match then return nil end
                    match = q
                end
            end
            return match
        end

        function ENG._agOwnerPlayer(a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not a then return nil end
            local p = toPlayer(a.owner)
            if not p or p.UserId == player.UserId then return nil end
            return p
        end

        -- armed state now holds the animal record (not a resolved Player), so the bypass still
        -- works when the owner name can't be resolved at grab start (dup display names, odd sign text)
        local armedA = nil
        local leftAt = {}   -- userId -> tick() of the last PlayerRemoving, survives hold-cycle gaps

        local function ownerKey(a)
            local o = a and a.owner
            if typeof(o) == "Instance" then o = o.Name end
            if type(o) == "table" then o = rawget(o, "Name") end
            if type(o) ~= "string" then return nil end
            o = o:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if o == "" or o == "?" then return nil end
            return o:lower()
        end

        local function dbg(...)
            if _G.SMVLL_BYPASS_DEBUG ~= false then warn("[bypass]", ...) end
        end
        ENG._agDbg = dbg

        local function liveOwnerLabel(a)
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            local plot = plots and a and plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(a.plot))
            local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
            local fr = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            return fr and fr:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
        end

        local function liveOwnerKey(a)
            local lbl = liveOwnerLabel(a)
            if not lbl then return nil end
            local t = tostring(lbl.Text or ""):gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if t == "" or t == "?" then return nil end
            return t:lower()
        end

        function ENG._agOwnerLabel(a)
            local p = ENG._agOwnerPlayer(a)
            if p then return p.DisplayName end
            return ownerKey(a) or "owner"
        end

        function ENG._agOwnerIs(a, plr, keyOverride)
            if not a or not plr then return false end
            local o = a.owner
            if typeof(o) == "Instance" and o:IsA("Player") then return o == plr end
            if type(o) == "table" then
                local uid = rawget(o, "UserId")
                if type(uid) == "number" then return uid == plr.UserId end
            end
            if type(o) == "number" then return o == plr.UserId end
            local k = keyOverride or ownerKey(a)
            if not k then return true end   -- owner unknown: any leaver counts (better than never firing)
            if plr.Name:lower() == k then return true end
            if plr.DisplayName:lower() == k then
                -- display names aren't unique: only accept if nobody else shares it
                for _, q in ipairs(PlayersSvc:GetPlayers()) do
                    if q ~= plr and q.DisplayName:lower() == k then return false end
                end
                return true
            end
            return false
        end

        function ENG._agOwnerLeftWithin(a, window)
            local now = tick()
            local o = a and a.owner
            local uid = (type(o) == "table" and rawget(o, "UserId")) or (type(o) == "number" and o) or nil
            if uid and leftAt[uid] and now - leftAt[uid] <= window then return true end
            return ENG._agRecentLeaverMatches(a, window)
        end

        -- name-based memory (the leaving Player object is gone later, so keep name + display name)
        local leftNames = {}   -- { n = lowername, d = lowerdisplay, t = tick }
        function ENG._agRecentLeaverMatches(a, window)
            local k = ownerKey(a) or liveOwnerKey(a)
            if not k then return false end
            local now = tick()
            for i = #leftNames, 1, -1 do
                local e = leftNames[i]
                if now - e.t > window then table.remove(leftNames, i)
                elseif e.n == k or e.d == k then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local armedKey, signConn, signStart = nil, nil, nil
        local function leaveFire(reason)
            if not armedA or not armedFire then return end
            local fire = armedFire
            dbg("owner leave detected via", reason)
            ENG._agBypassDisarm()
            task.spawn(fire)   -- never run the grab inside the signal thread
        end
        function ENG._agBypassArm(a, fire)
            ENG._agBypassDisarm()
            armedA, armedFire = a, fire
            armedKey = ownerKey(a) or liveOwnerKey(a)
            dbg("armed | owner =", tostring(a.owner), "| key =", tostring(armedKey), "| plot =", tostring(a.plot))
            -- 2nd signal: the plot sign changes when the owner is gone (works even if name matching fails)
            local lbl = liveOwnerLabel(a)
            if lbl then
                signStart = tostring(lbl.Text)
                signConn = lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                    if tostring(lbl.Text) ~= signStart then leaveFire("plot sign changed") end
                end)
            end
        end
        function ENG._agBypassDisarm()
            armedA, armedFire, armedKey, signStart = nil, nil, nil, nil
            if signConn then pcall(function() signConn:Disconnect() end); signConn = nil end
        end

        PlayersSvc.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(leaving)
            leftAt[leaving.UserId] = tick()
            leftNames[#leftNames + 1] = { n = leaving.Name:lower(), d = leaving.DisplayName:lower(), t = tick() }
            if #leftNames > 16 then table.remove(leftNames, 1) end
            if not armedA or not armedFire then
                dbg("player left (", leaving.Name, ") but nothing armed")
                return
            end
            if not ENG._agOwnerIs(armedA, leaving, armedKey) then
                dbg("player left (", leaving.Name, "/", leaving.DisplayName, ") is NOT the owner, key =", tostring(armedKey))
                return
            end
            leaveFire("PlayerRemoving " .. leaving.Name)
        end)
    end

    local function _agExecute(prompt, a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local data = _agCache[prompt]
        if not data or not data.ready then return false end
        if not _agCanSteal() then return false end
        if not ENG._agGateOpen() then return false end
        if _agHoldActive and (tick() - _agHoldStart) < (_agHoldCap + 0.5) then return false end
        if not ENG._agPetStillLive(a) then return false end
        if _agDistTo(a) > ENG._agHoldRange(prompt) then return false end

        data.ready = false
        _agHasTarget  = true
        _agTargetName = a.name or "Animal"
        _agHoldStart, _agHoldActive, _agHoldPrompt = tick(), true, prompt
        local gateSerial = ENG._agGateSerial()
        if _G._SMVLL_StealBarStart then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarStart, AG_HOLD_MIN, a.name or "") end
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local function _agLive() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                return (_agBestEnabled or _agNearestEnabled or _agPriorityEnabled)
                    and ENG._agGateSerial() == gateSerial
                    and not _agIsMyBase(a)
            end
            local livePrompt = prompt
            local origDist
            local didFire = false
            local function _agRelease() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if origDist ~= nil and livePrompt and livePrompt.Parent then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); livePrompt.MaxActivationDistance = origDist end)
                end
                _agProgress   = 0
                _agHasTarget  = false
                _agHoldActive = false
                _agHoldPrompt = nil
                _agHoldCap    = AG_HOLD_MAX
                ENG._agBypassDisarm()
                if _G._SMVLL_StealBarReset then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarReset) end
                data.ready = true
            end

            local function _agLivePrompt() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if livePrompt and livePrompt.Parent then return livePrompt end
                local fresh = _agFindPrompt(a)
                if fresh and fresh.Parent then
                    livePrompt = fresh
                    return fresh
                end
                return nil
            end

            
            
            
            local function _agReach(lagged) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local p = _agLivePrompt()
                if not p or not p.Enabled then return math.huge end
                local char = player.Character
                local hrp  = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
                if not hrp then return math.huge end
                local pp  = p.Parent
                if pp:IsA("Attachment") and pp.Parent and pp.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then pp = pp.Parent end
                local pos = (pp:IsA("Attachment") and pp.WorldPosition)
                    or (pp:IsA("BasePart") and pp.Position) or nil
                if not pos then return math.huge end
                local d = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if lagged then
                    local okP, ping = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return player:GetNetworkPing() end)
                    local lag = math.min(0.12 + ((okP and tonumber(ping)) or 0.1) * 0.5, 0.35)
                    local back = hrp.Position - hrp.Velocity * lag
                    d = math.max(d, (back - pos).Magnitude) + 0.5
                end
                return d
            end

            -- target still has an enabled "Steal" prompt (someone else grabbed it / it changed)
            local function _agStealable() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local p = _agLivePrompt()
                if not p or not p.Enabled then return false end
                local t = tostring(p.ActionText or "")
                return t == "" or t:find("Steal", 1, true) ~= nil
            end

            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if #data.hold == 0 and #data.trig == 0 then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); local p = livePrompt or prompt; if p then p:InputHoldBegin() end end)
                    return
                end

                local fired, ownerLeft, holdDone = false, false, false

                local function doTrigger(ownerGone) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    if fired then return end
                    local p = _agLivePrompt()
                    if not p and not ownerGone then return end
                    fired = true
                    didFire = true
                    ENG._agDbg("doTrigger | ownerGone =", tostring(ownerGone), "| promptAlive =", tostring(p ~= nil),
                        "| samePrompt =", tostring(p == prompt), "| #trig =", #data.trig, "| #hold =", #data.hold)
                    local ran = false
                    local function blast()
                        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trig) do
                            task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end)
                        end
                    end
                    if #data.trig > 0 and (p == prompt or not p) then
                        ran = true
                        blast()   -- first thing, nothing yields before this
                        if ownerGone then
                            task.delay(0.04, blast)
                            task.delay(0.12, blast)
                        end
                    end
                    if ownerGone and p and p.Parent and type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
                        task.spawn(function() pcall(fireproximityprompt, p) end)
                    end
                    -- potion only AFTER the grab is already on the wire (it can yield)
                    if p and S.AUTO_POTION and not ownerGone and _agPotionOK(p) then
                        task.spawn(function() pcall(S.activatePotion) end)
                    end
                    if not ran then
                        -- no cached Triggered callbacks (or prompt got replaced): release the hold on
                        -- whatever prompt object we still have
                        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); local pp = p or prompt; if pp then pp:InputHoldEnd() end end)
                    end
                end

                -- Defender bypass: armed from the very start of the grab, so an owner who
                -- leaves during the minimum hold still counts. fires the moment the hold is done.
                local bypassOn = S.DEFENDER_BYPASS == true and not _agIsMyBase(a)
                if bypassOn then _agHoldCap = AG_BYPASS_MAX end
                local bypassLabel = bypassOn and ENG._agOwnerLabel(a) or nil
                if bypassOn then
                    ENG._agBypassArm(a, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        ownerLeft = true
                        if holdDone then doTrigger(true) end
                    end)
                    -- owner left in the tiny gap between two hold cycles -> don't lose it
                    if ENG._agOwnerLeftWithin(a, 1.0) then ownerLeft = true end
                end

                for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(fn) end

                local startedAt = tick()
                while tick() - startedAt < AG_HOLD_MIN do
                    if not _agLive() then break end
                    _agProgress = math.clamp((tick() - startedAt) / AG_HOLD_MIN, 0, 1)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                end
                if not _agLive() then return end
                _agProgress = 1
                holdDone = true
                if ownerLeft then doTrigger(true) end

                local reach = AG_FIRE_RANGE
                local alreadyInRange = _agReach() <= reach

                local techSeen = ENG._agGateTechSerial()
                while true do
                    if ownerLeft then break end
                    if not (_agBestEnabled or _agNearestEnabled or _agPriorityEnabled) then break end
                    if ENG._agGateSerial() ~= gateSerial then
                        if ENG._agGateTech() then
                            ENG._agGateFlash("Ragdoll Tech")
                            doTrigger()
                        end
                        break
                    end
                    if ENG._agGateTechSerial() ~= techSeen then
                        ENG._agGateFlash("Ragdoll Tech")
                        doTrigger()
                        break
                    end
                    if bypassOn and S.DEFENDER_BYPASS then
                        ENG._agBypassMark(bypassLabel)
                    elseif not _agStealable() then
                        break
                    elseif _agReach(true) <= reach then
                        if not alreadyInRange and AG_ENTRY_DELAY > 0 then
                            local settleFrom, held = tick(), true
                            while tick() - settleFrom < AG_ENTRY_DELAY do
                                if ownerLeft or not _agLive() or _agReach() > reach then held = false break end
                                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                            end
                            if not held or tick() - startedAt >= AG_HOLD_MAX then break end
                        end
                        doTrigger()
                        break
                    end
                    if tick() - startedAt > _agHoldCap then break end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
            end)

            if didFire then task.wait(AG_COOLDOWN) end
            _agRelease()
        end)
        return true
    end

    local _agConn = nil
    local function _agStartLoop()
        if _G._SMVLL_StealBarShow then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarShow) end
        if _agConn then return end
        _agConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not (_agBestEnabled or _agNearestEnabled or _agPriorityEnabled) then return end

            if _agHasTarget and (tick() - _agHoldStart) > (_agHoldCap + 1.5) then
                _agHoldCap = AG_HOLD_MAX
                local stuck = _agHoldPrompt and _agCache[_agHoldPrompt]
                if stuck then stuck.ready = true end
                _agProgress, _agHasTarget = 0, false
                _agHoldActive, _agHoldPrompt = false, nil
                if _G._SMVLL_StealBarReset then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarReset) end
            end
            if _agHasTarget then return end
            local nowc = os.clock()
            if nowc - (tonumber(_G._SMVLL_agStealScan or 0) or 0) < 0.067 then return end
            _G._SMVLL_agStealScan = nowc
            if not _agCanSteal() then return end
            
            pcall(_agScan)
            local target
            if _agPriorityEnabled then target = ENG._agPickPriority()
            elseif _agBestEnabled then target = ENG._agPickBest()
            else target = ENG._agPickClosest() end
            if not target then return end
            local prompt = _agPromptMem[target.uid]
            if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then prompt = _agFindPrompt(target) end
            if prompt then
                ENG._agBuildCallbacks(prompt)

                _agExecute(prompt, target)
            else

                _agNoPrompt[target.uid] = os.clock() + 3
            end
        end))
    end
    local function _agStopLoop()
        if not (_agBestEnabled or _agNearestEnabled or _agPriorityEnabled) then
            if _agConn then _agConn:Disconnect(); _agConn = nil end
            _agHasTarget = false
            if _G._SMVLL_StealBarHide then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarHide) end
        end
    end

    S.PRIORITY = S.PRIORITY or {}
    function S.togglePriority(sig) if S.PRIORITY[sig] then S.PRIORITY[sig]=nil else S.PRIORITY[sig]=true end return S.PRIORITY[sig]==true end
    function S.isPriority(sig) return S.PRIORITY[sig]==true end

    local function _v1ClearFlags() _agBestEnabled=false; _agNearestEnabled=false; _agPriorityEnabled=false end
    function S.startAutoGrabBest()
        S.__DEF_AUTO=false
        S.AUTO_STEAL=true
        _v1ClearFlags(); _agBestEnabled=true; pcall(_agScan, true); _agStartLoop()
    end
    function S.stopAutoGrabBest()
        S.AUTO_STEAL=false
        _agBestEnabled=false; _agStopLoop()
    end
    function S.defenderBypassStart()
        if _agBestEnabled or _agNearestEnabled or _agPriorityEnabled then return end
        S.startAutoGrabNearest()
        S.__DEF_AUTO = true
    end
    function S.defenderBypassStop()
        if not S.__DEF_AUTO then return end
        S.__DEF_AUTO = false
        S.stopAutoGrabNearest()
    end
    function S.startAutoGrabNearest()
        S.__DEF_AUTO=false
        S.AUTO_STEAL=true
        _v1ClearFlags(); _agNearestEnabled=true; pcall(_agScan, true); _agStartLoop()
    end
    function S.stopAutoGrabNearest()
        S.AUTO_STEAL=false
        _agNearestEnabled=false; _agStopLoop()
    end
    function S.startAutoGrabPriority()
        S.__DEF_AUTO=false
        S.AUTO_STEAL=true; S.AUTO_STEAL_PRIORITY=true
        _v1ClearFlags(); _agPriorityEnabled=true; pcall(_agScan, true); _agStartLoop()
    end
    function S.stopAutoGrabPriority()
        S.AUTO_STEAL=false; S.AUTO_STEAL_PRIORITY=false
        _agPriorityEnabled=false; _agStopLoop()
    end

    local _isRegions = {
        { min = Vector3.new(-337.448303, -3.898971, -122.397758), max = Vector3.new(-328.004578, -3.898971, 242.625626) },

    local IS_RADIUS = 12
    local _isSeen, _isLastFire, _isLastBurst, _isConns = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local _isBoostUntil = 0

    local function _isPollRate() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if os.clock() < _isBoostUntil then return 0.27 end
        return 0.1
    end
    _G.getSafePollRate = _isPollRate
    _G.triggerSafePollBoost = function() _isBoostUntil = os.clock() + 3 end

    local function _isRoot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ch = LP.Character
        return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function _isLane(pos) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for i, r in ipairs(_isRegions) do
            if pos.X >= math.min(r.min.X, r.max.X) and pos.X <= math.max(r.min.X, r.max.X)
                and pos.Z >= math.min(r.min.Z, r.max.Z) and pos.Z <= math.max(r.min.Z, r.max.Z) then
                return i
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function _isPromptPos(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local par = prompt.Parent
        if not par then return nil end
        if par:IsA("Attachment") and par.Parent then par = par.Parent end
        if par:IsA("BasePart") then return par.Position end
        if par:IsA("Model") then return par:GetPivot().Position end
        return nil
    end

    local function _isOwnPlot(prompt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return false end
        local node = prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
        while node and node.Parent ~= plots do node = node.Parent end
        if not node then return false end
        local sign = node:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        if not sign then return false end
        local gui = sign:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui", true)
        local lbl = gui and gui:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if not lbl then return false end
        local t = tostring(lbl.Text):lower()
        return t:find(LP.Name:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
            or t:find(tostring(LP.DisplayName):lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function _isEligible(prompt, at) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return false end
        local pos = _isPromptPos(prompt)
        if not pos then return false end
        if _isOwnPlot(prompt) then return false end
        local mine, theirs = _isLane(at), _isLane(pos)
        if not mine or mine ~= theirs then return false end
        local reach = (typeof(prompt.MaxActivationDistance) == "number"
            and prompt.MaxActivationDistance > 0 and prompt.MaxActivationDistance) or IS_RADIUS
        return (pos - at).Magnitude <= math.min(IS_RADIUS, reach)
    end

    local function _isFire(prompt, count, cooldown) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local last = _isLastFire[prompt]
        if last and now - last < cooldown then return end
        _isLastFire[prompt] = now
        if getconnections then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do if c.Function then task.spawn(c.Function) end end end)
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do if c.Function then task.spawn(c.Function) end end end)
        else
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); prompt:InputHoldBegin(); prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
        end
    end

    local function _isWatch(prompt)
        if _isSeen[prompt] then return end
        _isSeen[prompt] = true
        local function try() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.AUTO_STEAL then return end
            local hrp = _isRoot()
            if not hrp then return end
            if not _isEligible(prompt, hrp.Position) then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            local last = _isLastBurst[prompt]
            if last and now - last < 0.08 then return end
            _isLastBurst[prompt] = now
            
            
            
            
            _isFire(prompt, 1, 0)
        end
        task.defer(try)
        pcall(function()
            _isConns[#_isConns + 1] = prompt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                if prompt.Enabled then try() end
            end)
        end)
        _isConns[#_isConns + 1] = prompt.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
            if not prompt:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                _isSeen[prompt] = nil
                _isLastFire[prompt] = nil
                _isLastBurst[prompt] = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    local function _isSweep()
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if pods then
                for _, d in ipairs(pods:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then _isWatch(d) end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local _isLoop = nil

    function S.startAutoGrabV2()
        if S.AUTO_STEAL and _isLoop then return end
        S.AUTO_STEAL = true
        if _G._SMVLL_StealBarShow then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarShow) end
        _isSweep()
        _isConns[#_isConns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if S.AUTO_STEAL and d:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
                and d:FindFirstAncestor("AnimalPodiums") then
                _isWatch(d)
            end
        end)
        _isLoop = task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while S.AUTO_STEAL do
                task.wait(_isPollRate())
                local hrp = _isRoot()
                if hrp then
                    local at = hrp.Position
                    for prompt in pairs(_isSeen) do
                        if _isEligible(prompt, at) then _isFire(prompt, 1, 0.12) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    function S.stopAutoGrabV2()
        S.AUTO_STEAL = false
        _isLoop = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(_isConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        _isConns = {}
        table.clear(_isSeen)
        table.clear(_isLastFire)
        table.clear(_isLastBurst)
        if _G._SMVLL_StealBarHide then pcall(_G._SMVLL_StealBarHide) end
    end
    end)()

    local StealData = {}
    local STEAL_DURATION = STEAL_DELAY
    local function executeSteal(prompt)
        if isStealing or not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return end
        if not StealData[prompt] then
            StealData[prompt] = {hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true}
            if getconnections then
                local ok1, holdConns = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
                if ok1 and type(holdConns) == "table" then
                    for _, c in ipairs(holdConns) do
                        if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                            table.insert(StealData[prompt].hold, c.Function)
                        end
                    end
                end
                local ok2, trigConns = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
                if ok2 and type(trigConns) == "table" then
                    for _, c in ipairs(trigConns) do
                        if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                            table.insert(StealData[prompt].trigger, c.Function)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local data = StealData[prompt]
        if not data.ready then return end
        data.ready = false
        isStealing = true
        local startTime = tick()
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, f in ipairs(data.hold) do pcall(f) end
            if stealBarFill then
                stealBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
                _G_Tween:Create(stealBarFill, TweenInfo.new(STEAL_DURATION, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                    {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)}):Play()
            end
            while tick() - startTime < STEAL_DURATION do
                task.wait()
            end
            for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do pcall(f) end
            task.wait(0.05)
            if stealBarFill then stealBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0) end
            data.ready = true
            isStealing = false
        end)
    end

    _G._SMVLL_StealBarStart = function(dur, targetName)
        createStealBar()
        if _stealDotConn then _stealDotConn:Disconnect(); _stealDotConn = nil end
        local total = dur or 2.6
        if _stealBarName then
            local nm = (targetName and targetName ~= "") and targetName or "Brainrot"
            local dots = {"", ".", "..", "..."}
            local i = 1
            local dotAcc = 0
            local startT = tick()
            _stealBarName.Text = "Stealing " .. nm
            _stealDotConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if not (_stealBarName and _stealBarName.Parent) then
                    if _stealDotConn then _stealDotConn:Disconnect(); _stealDotConn = nil end
                    return
                end
                local raw = tick() - startT
                if _stealBarRightTime then
                    if raw > total then

                        _stealBarRightTime.Text = string.format("%.1fs <+%.1fs", total, raw - total)
                    else
                        _stealBarRightTime.Text = string.format("%.1fs / %.1fs", raw, total)
                    end
                    _stealBarRightTime.TextColor3 = GREEN
                end
                dotAcc = dotAcc + dt
                if dotAcc >= 0.3 then
                    dotAcc = 0
                    i = (i % #dots) + 1
                    _stealBarName.Text = "Stealing " .. nm .. dots[i]
                end
            end))
        end
        if stealBarFill then
            stealBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
            _G_Tween:Create(stealBarFill, TweenInfo.new(total, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)}):Play()
        end
    end
    _G._SMVLL_StealBarReset = function()
        if stealBarFill then
            _G_Tween:Create(stealBarFill, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)}):Play()
        end
        if _stealBarRightTime then _stealBarRightTime.Text = "searching..."; _stealBarRightTime.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130,130,130) end
        if _stealDotConn then _stealDotConn:Disconnect(); _stealDotConn = nil end
    end
    function S.startAutoSteal()
        if S.AUTO_STEAL_MODE == "best" then
            S.startAutoGrabBest()
        else
            S.startAutoGrabNearest()
        end
    end
    function S.stopAutoSteal()
        S.AUTO_STEAL = false
        S.stopAutoGrabBest()
        S.stopAutoGrabNearest()
        if stealBarFrame then stealBarFrame.Visible = false end
    end

    local playerEspConns = {}
    local function isPlayerInvisible(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not char then return false end
        local invisCount = 0
        local totalParts = 0
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                totalParts = totalParts + 1
                if part.Transparency > 0.8 then invisCount = invisCount + 1 end
            end
        end
        if totalParts < 2 or invisCount < totalParts * 0.5 then return false end
        for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                local n = item.Name:lower()
                if n:find("invisib") or n:find("cloak") or n:find("cupid") or n:find("wing") then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function clearEspMarks(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not char then return end
        local marks = {"_PlrName", "_PlrHL", "_PlrHitbox", "_PlrHitboxEdge"}
        for _, suffix in ipairs(marks) do
            local m = char:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. suffix)
            if m then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); m:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            for _, suffix in ipairs({"_PlrHitbox", "_PlrHitboxEdge"}) do
                local hb = hrp:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. suffix)
                if hb then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hb:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
    end
    local function createHighlightESP(plr, char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local n = PREFIX .. "_PlrName"
        local h = PREFIX .. "_PlrHL"
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = n; bb.Adornee = char.Head
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,110,0,26)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.MaxDistance = 250
        bb.Parent = char
        local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        txt.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        txt.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; txt.TextSize = 13
        txt.Text = plr.DisplayName .. " (@" .. plr.Name .. ")"; txt.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(txt, "accentText")
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = h
        hl.FillColor = GREEN; hl.OutlineColor = GREEN_DIM
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.35; hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = char
    end
    local function createHitboxESP(plr, char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local n = PREFIX .. "_PlrName"
        local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
        box.Name = PREFIX .. "_PlrHitbox"
        box.Adornee = hrp
        box.AlwaysOnTop = true
        box.ZIndex = 5
        box.Size = hrp.Size + Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
        box.Transparency = 0.45
        box.Color3 = GREEN
        box.Parent = hrp

        local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
        sb.Name = PREFIX .. "_PlrHitboxEdge"
        sb.Adornee = hrp
        sb.Color3 = GREEN
        sb.LineThickness = 0.03
        sb.SurfaceTransparency = 1
        sb.Transparency = 0
        sb:SetAttribute("SmvllMineBox", true)
        sb.Parent = hrp
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = n; bb.Adornee = hrp
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,160,0,26)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.MaxDistance = 250
        bb.Parent = char
        local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        txt.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        txt.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; txt.TextSize = 13
        txt.Text = plr.DisplayName .. " (@" .. plr.Name .. ") [INVIS]"
        txt.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(txt, "accentText")
    end
    local function addPlayerESP(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if plr == LP then return end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local char = plr.Character
            if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("Head") then return end
            clearEspMarks(char)
            if isPlayerInvisible(char) then
                createHitboxESP(plr, char)
            else
                createHighlightESP(plr, char)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function refreshPlayerESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local char = plr.Character
                if char then
                    local hasInv = isPlayerInvisible(char)
                    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local hl = char:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_PlrHL")
                    local hb = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_PlrHitbox")
                    if hasInv and not hb then
                        addPlayerESP(plr)
                    elseif (not hasInv) and not hl then
                        addPlayerESP(plr)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function S.startPlayerESP()
        refreshPlayerESP()
        playerEspConns.added = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
            plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(1)
                if S.PLAYER_ESP then addPlayerESP(plr) end
            end)
        end)
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP then
                local c = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.wait(1)
                    if S.PLAYER_ESP then addPlayerESP(plr) end
                end)
                table.insert(playerEspConns, c)
            end
        end
        playerEspConns.loop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.PLAYER_ESP then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - (playerEspConns._lastRefresh or 0) < 0.3 then return end
            playerEspConns._lastRefresh = now
            refreshPlayerESP()
        end))
    end
    function S.stopPlayerESP()
        for _, c in pairs(playerEspConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        playerEspConns = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local ch = plr.Character
            if ch then clearEspMarks(ch) end
        end
    end

    local petBB_, petName_, petVal_, petHL_, petHL_Outline
    local brainrotTask = nil
    local function initPetESP()
        if petBB_ and petBB_.Parent then return end
        local parent = ESP_TOP
        petBB_ = Instance.new("BillboardGui", parent)
        petBB_.Name = PREFIX .. "_PetBB"
        petBB_.Size = UDim2.new(0,110,0,30)
        petBB_.AlwaysOnTop = true; petBB_.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,4,0)
        petBB_.LightInfluence = 0; petBB_.Enabled = false
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame", petBB_)
        bg.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); bg.BackgroundColor3 = BG
        bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45; bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
        local stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", bg); stk.Thickness = 1; stk.Color = GREEN
        _paintAs(stk, "accentStroke")
        petName_ = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
        petName_.Size = UDim2.new(1,-6,0.52,0); petName_.Position = UDim2.new(0,3,0,1)
        petName_.BackgroundTransparency = 1; petName_.TextScaled = true
        petName_.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; petName_.TextColor3 = WHITE
        petVal_ = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
        petVal_.Size = UDim2.new(1,-6,0.44,0); petVal_.Position = UDim2.new(0,3,0.53,0)
        petVal_.BackgroundTransparency = 1; petVal_.TextScaled = true
        petVal_.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; petVal_.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(petVal_, "accentText")
        petHL_ = Instance.new("Highlight")
        petHL_.Name = PREFIX .. "_PetHL"
        petHL_.FillColor = GREEN; petHL_.FillTransparency = 0.25
        petHL_.OutlineColor = GREEN; petHL_.OutlineTransparency = 0
        petHL_.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        petHL_.Enabled = false
        petHL_Outline = Instance.new("Highlight")
        petHL_Outline.Name = PREFIX .. "_PetHL_Outline"
        petHL_Outline.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 200)
        petHL_Outline.FillTransparency = 0.4
        petHL_Outline.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 200)
        petHL_Outline.OutlineTransparency = 0
        petHL_Outline.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        petHL_Outline.Enabled = false
    end
    local function parseVal(text) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not text then return 0 end
        text = tostring(text):gsub("%s",""):gsub("/s","")
        local n, sfx = text:match("([%d%.]+)([KkMmBbTtQq]?)")
        if not n then return 0 end
        local m = {K=1e3,M=1e6,B=1e9,T=1e12,Q=1e15}
        return (tonumber(n) or 0) * (m[(sfx or ""):upper()] or 1)
    end
    function S.startBrainrotESP()
        initPetESP()
        if brainrotTask then return end
        brainrotTask = task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while S.BRAINROT_ESP do
                task.wait(0.5)
                local debris = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
                local bestPart, bestName, bestRaw, bestVal = nil, "Unknown", "0", -1
                if debris then
                    for _, item in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do
                        if item.Name == "FastOverheadTemplate" then
                            local sg = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
                            if sg and sg.Adornee then
                                local gen = sg:FindFirstChild("Generation", true)
                                if gen and gen:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                    local v = parseVal(gen.Text)
                                    if v > bestVal then
                                        local nl = sg:FindFirstChild("DisplayName", true)
                                        bestVal = v; bestPart = sg.Adornee
                                        bestName = nl and nl.Text or "Unknown"
                                        bestRaw = gen.Text
