                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if bestPart then
                    petBB_.Adornee = bestPart; petBB_.Enabled = true
                    petName_.Text = bestName:upper(); petVal_.Text = bestRaw

                    local model = nil
                    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
                    if plots then
                        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                            for _, c in ipairs(plot:GetChildren()) do
                                if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name == bestName then
                                    model = c; break
                                end
                            end
                            if model then break end
                        end
                    end
                    if not model then
                        local moving = workspace:FindFirstChild("RenderedMovingAnimals")
                        if moving then
                            for _, c in ipairs(moving:GetChildren()) do
                                if c:IsA("Model") and c.Name == bestName then
                                    model = c; break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not model then
                        model = bestPart
                        local par = bestPart.Parent
                        while par and par ~= workspace do
                            if par:IsA("Model") then model = par; break end
                            par = par.Parent
                        end
                    end

                    local _acc = (_G.SMVLL_THEME and _G.SMVLL_THEME.accent) or GREEN
                    petHL_.FillColor = _acc
                    petHL_.OutlineColor = _acc
                    petHL_Outline.OutlineColor = _acc
                    local _holder = _G.SMVLL_ESP_HOLDER and _G.SMVLL_ESP_HOLDER()
                    petHL_.Adornee = model
                    petHL_.Parent = _holder or model
                    petHL_.Enabled = true
                    petHL_Outline.Adornee = model
                    petHL_Outline.Parent = _holder or model
                    petHL_Outline.Enabled = true
                else
                    petBB_.Enabled = false
                    petHL_.Enabled = false
                    petHL_.Adornee = nil
                    petHL_Outline.Enabled = false
                    petHL_Outline.Adornee = nil
                end
            end
            brainrotTask = nil
        end)
    end
    function S.stopBrainrotESP()
        S.BRAINROT_ESP = false
        if petBB_ then petBB_.Enabled = false end
        if petHL_ then petHL_.Enabled = false end
        if petHL_Outline then petHL_Outline.Enabled = false end
    end

    local cloneEspConns = {}
    local function playerFromClone(clone) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not clone:IsA("Model") then return nil end
        local hum = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return nil end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                if p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").DisplayName == hum.DisplayName then
                    return p
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function highlightClone(clone) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if clone:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_CloneHL") then return end
        local plr = playerFromClone(clone)
        local label = plr and (plr.Name .. " CLONE") or "CLONE"
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight", clone)
        hl.Name = PREFIX .. "_CloneHL"
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0); hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(139,0,0)
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.35; hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        local head = clone:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
            bb.Name = PREFIX .. "_CloneLbl"; bb.Adornee = head
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,50); bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
            l.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.Text = label; l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
            l.TextSize = 16; l.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        end
    end
    function S.startCloneESP()
        cloneEspConns.added = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
            if c.Name:find("_Clone") and c:IsA("Model") then
                task.wait(0.1)
                if S.CLONE_ESP then highlightClone(c) end
            end
        end)
        cloneEspConns.hb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.CLONE_ESP then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - (cloneEspConns._lastRefresh or 0) < 0.5 then return end
            cloneEspConns._lastRefresh = now
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj.Name:find("_Clone") and obj:IsA("Model") and not obj:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_CloneHL") then
                    highlightClone(obj)
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopCloneESP()
        for _, c in pairs(cloneEspConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        cloneEspConns = {}
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Model") then
                local h = obj:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_CloneHL")
                if h then h:Destroy() end
                local head = obj:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head then
                    local lbl = head:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_CloneLbl")
                    if lbl then lbl:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local plotBeam, plotBeamA0, plotBeamA1 = nil, nil, nil
    local function _findMyPlot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            if plot:IsA("Model") then
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign then
                    local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                    if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled then return plot end
                    for _, d in ipairs(sign:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                            local txt = d.Text or ""
                            if txt:find(LP.DisplayName, 1, true) or txt:find(LP.Name, 1, true) then
                                return plot
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function _createPlotBeam() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.LINE_TO_BASE then return end
        local myPlot = _findMyPlot()
        if not myPlot then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        if plotBeam then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamA0 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); plotBeamA0:Destroy() end) end
        plotBeamA0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        plotBeamA0.Name = PREFIX .. "_BeamA0"
        plotBeamA0.Parent = hrp
        local plotPart = myPlot:FindFirstChild("MainRootPart") or myPlot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if not plotPart then return end
        plotBeamA1 = plotPart:FindFirstChild(PREFIX .. "_BeamA1") or Instance.new("Attachment")
        plotBeamA1.Name = PREFIX .. "_BeamA1"
        plotBeamA1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        plotBeamA1.Parent = plotPart
        plotBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        plotBeam.Name = PREFIX .. "_PlotBeam"
        plotBeam.Attachment0 = plotBeamA0
        plotBeam.Attachment1 = plotBeamA1
        plotBeam.FaceCamera = true
        plotBeam.LightEmission = 1
        plotBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(GREEN)
        plotBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
        plotBeam.Width0 = 0.5; plotBeam.Width1 = 0.5
        plotBeam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
        plotBeam.TextureSpeed = 0
        plotBeam.Parent = hrp
    end
    local function _resetPlotBeam()
        if plotBeam then pcall(function() plotBeam:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamA0 then pcall(function() plotBeamA0:Destroy() end) end
        if plotBeamA1 then pcall(function() plotBeamA1:Destroy() end) end
        plotBeam = nil; plotBeamA0 = nil; plotBeamA1 = nil
    end
    function S.startLineToBase()
        S.LINE_TO_BASE = true
        pcall(_createPlotBeam)
        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            if S.LINE_TO_BASE then pcall(_createPlotBeam) end
        end)
    end
    function S.stopLineToBase()
        S.LINE_TO_BASE = false
        _resetPlotBeam()
    end
    do
        local cnt = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.LINE_TO_BASE then return end
            cnt = cnt + 1
            if cnt >= 30 then
                cnt = 0
                if not plotBeam or not plotBeam.Parent then pcall(_createPlotBeam) end
            end
        end))
    end

    local timerEspData = {}
    local timerEspConn = nil
    local function getPlotBB(name, cf) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if timerEspData[name] then return timerEspData[name] end
        local anchor = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
        anchor.Name = PREFIX .. "_TmrA_" .. name
        anchor.Anchored = true; anchor.CanCollide = false
        anchor.CanQuery = false; anchor.CanTouch = false
        anchor.Transparency = 1; anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
        anchor.CFrame = cf
        local parent = ESP_TOP
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", parent)
        bb.Name = PREFIX .. "_TmrBB_" .. name
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,62,0,22); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Adornee = anchor; bb.LightInfluence = 0
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame", bb)
        bg.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); bg.BackgroundColor3 = BG
        bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45; bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
        local stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", bg); stk.Thickness = 1; stk.Color = GREEN
        _paintAs(stk, "accentStroke")
        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0.5,0); tl.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0,0)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tl.TextScaled = true
        tl.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; tl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        tl.Text = "60s"
        local al = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
        al.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0.5,0); al.Position = UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,0)
        al.BackgroundTransparency = 1; al.TextScaled = true
        al.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; al.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(al, "accentText")
        al.Text = "—"
        timerEspData[name] = {anchor=anchor, bb=bb, timerLbl=tl, allowLbl=al, lastAllow="—", lastColor=GREEN}
        return timerEspData[name]
    end
    local function updateTimerESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.TIMER_ESP then
            for _, d in pairs(timerEspData) do if d.bb then d.bb.Enabled = false end end
            return
        end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local main
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); main = plot.Purchases.PlotBlock.Main end)
            if main then
                local timerGui, prompt
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); timerGui = main.BillboardGui.RemainingTime end)
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); prompt = plot.FriendPanel.Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") end)
                local d = getPlotBB(plot.Name, main.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,8,0))
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d.anchor.CFrame = main.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,8,0) end)
                d.bb.Enabled = true
                if timerGui and timerGui.Text and timerGui.Text ~= "" then
                    d.timerLbl.Text = timerGui.Text
                else d.timerLbl.Text = "60s" end
                if prompt then
                    local act = (prompt.ObjectText or ""):lower()
                    if act:find("disallow") then
                        d.lastAllow = "ALLOW"; d.lastColor = GREEN
                    elseif act:find("allow") then
                        d.lastAllow = "DISALLOW"; d.lastColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,60,60)
                    end
                end
                d.allowLbl.Text = d.lastAllow
                d.allowLbl.TextColor3 = d.lastColor
                local _fam = _G.SMVLL_THEME and _G.SMVLL_THEME.fontFamily
                if _fam and d.fontFam ~= _fam then
                    d.fontFam = _fam
                    d.timerLbl.FontFace = Font.new(_fam, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
                    d.allowLbl.FontFace = Font.new(_fam, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function S.startTimerESP()
        if timerEspConn then return end
        timerEspConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.TIMER_ESP then pcall(updateTimerESP) end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopTimerESP()
        S.TIMER_ESP = false
        if timerEspConn then timerEspConn:Disconnect(); timerEspConn = nil end
        for _, d in pairs(timerEspData) do
            pcall(function() if d.bb then d.bb:Destroy() end end)
            pcall(function() if d.anchor then d.anchor:Destroy() end end)
        end
        timerEspData = {}
    end

    local mineEspData = {}
    local mineEspConn = nil
    local function getMineOwner(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local id = name:match("(%d+)$")
        if id then
            local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(id))
            if p then return p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")" end
            return "User " .. id
        end
        local o = name:match("SubspaceTripmine[_]?(.+)")
        if o then
            local fp = Players:FindFirstChild(o)
            return fp and (fp.DisplayName .. " (@" .. fp.Name .. ")") or o
        end
        return "Unknown"
    end
    local function createMineESP(mine, label) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox", mine)
        sb.Name = PREFIX .. "_MineBox"; sb.Adornee = mine
        sb.Color3 = GREEN; sb.LineThickness = 0.05
        sb:SetAttribute("SmvllMineBox", true)
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", mine)
        bb.Name = PREFIX .. "_MineLbl"; bb.Adornee = mine
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,250,0,50); bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        l.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.Text = label; l.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(l, "accentText")
        l.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; l.TextSize = 14
        return {sb = sb, bb = bb}
    end
    local function clearMineESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, d in pairs(mineEspData) do
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if d.sb then d.sb:Destroy() end end)
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if d.bb then d.bb:Destroy() end end)
        end
        table.clear(mineEspData)
    end
    local function refreshMineESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.MINE_ESP then clearMineESP(); return end
        local cur = {}
        local tf = workspace:FindFirstChild("ToolsAdds")
        if tf then
            for _, obj in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
                if obj.Name:lower():find("^subspacetripmine") then
                    local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if part then
                        cur[part] = true
                        if not mineEspData[part] then
                            local owner = getMineOwner(obj.Name)
                            mineEspData[part] = createMineESP(part, owner .. "'s Subspace Mine")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if obj.Name == "Trap" then
                local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if part then
                    cur[part] = true
                    if not mineEspData[part] then
                        mineEspData[part] = createMineESP(part, "Trap")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for m, d in pairs(mineEspData) do
            if not cur[m] or not m.Parent then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if d.sb then d.sb:Destroy() end end)
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if d.bb then d.bb:Destroy() end end)
                mineEspData[m] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    function S.startMineESP()
        if mineEspConn then return end
        local lastRefresh = 0
        mineEspConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.MINE_ESP then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - lastRefresh < 0.4 then return end
            lastRefresh = now
            pcall(refreshMineESP)
        end))
    end
    function S.stopMineESP()
        S.MINE_ESP = false
        if mineEspConn then mineEspConn:Disconnect(); mineEspConn = nil end
        clearMineESP()
    end

    do
        
        
        
        local deliveryEspData = {}
        local deliveryEspConn = nil

        local function _findMyPlot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return nil end
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local myName = lp and lp.DisplayName
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if plot:IsA("Model") then
                    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                    local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
                    local fr = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                    local tl = fr and fr:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                    if tl and myName and tl.Text == (myName .. "'s Base") then return plot end
                end
            end
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                if plot:IsA("Model") then
                    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                    local yb = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                    if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled then return plot end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function _myDeliveryParts() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local out = {}
            local plot = _findMyPlot()
            if not plot then return out end
            local ok, tagged = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                return game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("PlotDeliveryHitbox")
            end)
            if ok and tagged then
                for _, p in ipairs(tagged) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:IsDescendantOf(plot) then table.insert(out, p) end
                end
            end
            if #out == 0 then
                for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name:lower():find("delivery") then table.insert(out, d) end
                end
            end
            return out
        end

        local function _deliveryColour() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.DELIVERY_FOLLOW_THEME ~= false then
                local T = _G.SMVLL_THEME
                local pal = T and T.livePal
                return (pal and pal.accent) or (T and T.accent) or GREEN
            end
            return S.DELIVERY_COLOUR or GREEN
        end

        local function _deliveryFont(weight) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local T = _G.SMVLL_THEME
            local fam = (T and T.fontFamily) or "rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json"
            return Font.new(fam, weight, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        end

        local DLV = {
            tween = game:GetService("TweenService"),
            holder = nil,
            faces = { Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom, Enum.NormalId.Front,
                Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right },
        }

        function DLV.ramp(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local h, sat, v = Color3.toHSV(c)
            local dark = Color3.fromHSV(h, sat, math.max(v * 0.35, 0.05))
            return ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, dark),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c),
            })
        end

        function DLV.getHolder() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if DLV.holder and DLV.holder.Parent then return DLV.holder end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return nil end
            DLV.holder = Instance.new("Folder")
            DLV.holder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG or "S") .. "Dlv"
            DLV.holder.Parent = cam
            return DLV.holder
        end

        function DLV.part(parent, name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = PREFIX .. name
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = false
            p.CanTouch = false
            p.CastShadow = false
            p.Transparency = 1
            p.Massless = true
            p.Parent = parent
            return p
        end

        function DLV.dropVisuals(d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, tw in ipairs(d.tweens or {}) do pcall(function() tw:Cancel() end) end
            for _, a in ipairs(d.adorns or {}) do pcall(function() a.inst:Destroy() end) end
            for _, f in ipairs(d.faces or {}) do pcall(function() f.sg:Destroy() end) end
            if d.label then pcall(function() d.label:Destroy() end) end
            if d.pad then pcall(function() d.pad:Destroy() end) end
            d.tweens, d.adorns, d.faces = {}, {}, {}
            d.label, d.title, d.sub, d.bar, d.pad, d.sig = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
        end

        function DLV.drop(d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            DLV.dropVisuals(d)
            if d.box then pcall(function() d.box:Destroy() end) end
            d.box = nil
        end

        local function _clearDeliveryESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, d in pairs(deliveryEspData) do DLV.drop(d) end
            table.clear(deliveryEspData)
            if DLV.holder then pcall(function() DLV.holder:Destroy() end) end
            DLV.holder = nil
        end

        function DLV.bar(d, col, size, offset, transp, onTop) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local a = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
            a.Name = PREFIX .. "_DlvBar"
            a.Adornee = d.box
            a.Size = size
            a.CFrame = CFrame.new(offset)
            a.Color3 = col
            a.Transparency = transp
            a.AlwaysOnTop = onTop ~= false
            a.ZIndex = 6
            a.Parent = d.box
            table.insert(d.adorns, { inst = a, kind = "bar", base = transp })
        end

        function DLV.sel(d, col, thick, transp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local sb = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            sb.Name = PREFIX .. "_DlvBox"
            sb.Adornee = d.box
            sb.LineThickness = thick
            sb.Color3 = col
            sb.SurfaceColor3 = col
            sb.Transparency = transp
            sb.SurfaceTransparency = 1
            sb.Parent = d.box
            table.insert(d.adorns, { inst = sb, kind = "sel", base = transp })
        end

        function DLV.face(d, part, face, col, fillT, rot, glowOn, lvl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
            sg.Name = PREFIX .. "_DlvFace"
            sg.Face = face
            sg.AlwaysOnTop = true
            sg.LightInfluence = 0
            sg.Brightness = 1.5
            sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
            sg.PixelsPerStud = 20
            sg.Adornee = part
            local inset = glowOn and (2 + lvl) or 0
            local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
            fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            fr.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            fr.Size = UDim2.new(1, -inset * 2, 1, -inset * 2)
            fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
            fr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            fr.BackgroundTransparency = fillT
            fr.Parent = sg
            local gr = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            gr.Color = DLV.ramp(col)
            gr.Rotation = rot
            gr.Parent = fr
            local stroke = nil
            if glowOn then
                stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                stroke.Color = col
                stroke.Thickness = 2 + lvl
                stroke.Transparency = 0.1
                stroke.Parent = fr
            end
            sg.Parent = part
            table.insert(d.faces, { sg = sg, gr = gr, stroke = stroke })
        end

        function DLV.label(d, col, hy) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name = PREFIX .. "_DlvLbl"
            bb.Adornee = d.box
            bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 44)
            bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, hy + 2.5, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.LightInfluence = 0
            bb.MaxDistance = 2000
            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
            title.FontFace = _deliveryFont(Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
            title.Text = "DELIVERY"
            title.TextSize = 17
            title.TextColor3 = col
            title.Parent = bb
            local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            st.Thickness = 1.6
            st.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            st.Transparency = 0.15
            st.Parent = title
            local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
            bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 24)
            bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 2)
            bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            bar.Parent = bb
            local bg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            bg.Color = DLV.ramp(col)
            bg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            bg.Parent = bar
            local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
            sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
            sub.FontFace = _deliveryFont(Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
            sub.Text = ""
            sub.TextSize = 12
            sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
            sub.Parent = bb
            local st2 = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            st2.Thickness = 1.2
            st2.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            st2.Transparency = 0.25
            st2.Parent = sub
            bb.Parent = d.box
            d.label, d.title, d.sub, d.bar = bb, title, sub, bg
        end

        function DLV.build(d, col) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local style = tonumber(S.DELIVERY_STYLE) or 2
            local lvl = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(S.DELIVERY_THICK) or 3) + 0.5), 1, 10)
            local fillOn = S.DELIVERY_FILL ~= false
            local fillA = math.clamp(tonumber(S.DELIVERY_FILL_A) or 35, 0, 100) / 100
            local rot = tonumber(S.DELIVERY_FILL_ROT) or 90
            local glowOn = S.DELIVERY_GLOW ~= false
            local sz = d.box.Size
            local hx, hy, hz = sz.X / 2, sz.Y / 2, sz.Z / 2
            if style == 3 then
                local pad = DLV.part(d.box.Parent, "_DlvPad")
                pad.Size = Vector3.new(sz.X, 0.2, sz.Z)
                pad.CFrame = d.box.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -hy + 0.1, 0)
                d.pad = pad
                DLV.face(d, pad, Enum.NormalId.Top, col, 1 - math.max(fillOn and fillA or 0.3, 0.2), rot, glowOn, lvl)
                local t = 0.08 + lvl * 0.05
                local y = -hy + 0.2
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(sz.X, t, t), Vector3.new(0, y, hz), 0)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(sz.X, t, t), Vector3.new(0, y, -hz), 0)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(t, t, sz.Z), Vector3.new(hx, y, 0), 0)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(t, t, sz.Z), Vector3.new(-hx, y, 0), 0)
                local ix, iz, ti = sz.X * 0.62, sz.Z * 0.62, t * 0.6
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(ix, ti, ti), Vector3.new(0, y, iz / 2), 0.4)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(ix, ti, ti), Vector3.new(0, y, -iz / 2), 0.4)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(ti, ti, iz), Vector3.new(ix / 2, y, 0), 0.4)
                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(ti, ti, iz), Vector3.new(-ix / 2, y, 0), 0.4)
                local ph = math.min(sz.Y, 5)
                for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    for _, sz2 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                        DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(t, ph, t), Vector3.new(sx * hx, y + ph / 2, sz2 * hz), 0.2)
                    end
                end
            else
                if fillOn or glowOn then
                    for _, face in ipairs(DLV.faces) do
                        DLV.face(d, d.box, face, col, fillOn and (1 - fillA) or 1, rot, glowOn, lvl)
                    end
                end
                if style == 2 then
                    local t = 0.1 + lvl * 0.06
                    local lx = math.max(0.8, sz.X * 0.22)
                    local ly = math.max(0.8, sz.Y * 0.22)
                    local lz = math.max(0.8, sz.Z * 0.22)
                    for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                        for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                            for _, sz2 in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                                local p = Vector3.new(sx * hx, sy * hy, sz2 * hz)
                                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(lx, t, t), p - Vector3.new(sx * lx / 2, 0, 0), 0)
                                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(t, ly, t), p - Vector3.new(0, sy * ly / 2, 0), 0)
                                DLV.bar(d, col, Vector3.new(t, t, lz), p - Vector3.new(0, 0, sz2 * lz / 2), 0)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    local th = 0.03 + lvl * 0.03
                    DLV.sel(d, col, th, 0)
                    if glowOn then DLV.sel(d, col, th * 3.2, 0.75) end
                end
            end
            if S.DELIVERY_PULSE ~= false then
                local info = TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
                for _, a in ipairs(d.adorns) do
                    local ok, tw = pcall(function() return DLV.tween:Create(a.inst, info, { Transparency = math.min(1, a.base + 0.5) }) end)
                    if ok and tw then tw:Play(); table.insert(d.tweens, tw) end
                end
                for _, f in ipairs(d.faces) do
                    if f.stroke then
                        local ok, tw = pcall(function() return DLV.tween:Create(f.stroke, info, { Transparency = 0.6 }) end)
                        if ok and tw then tw:Play(); table.insert(d.tweens, tw) end
                    end
                end
            end
            if S.DELIVERY_SPIN ~= false then
                local sinfo = TweenInfo.new(3.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, false)
                for _, f in ipairs(d.faces) do
                    local ok, tw = pcall(function() return DLV.tween:Create(f.gr, sinfo, { Rotation = rot + 360 }) end)
                    if ok and tw then tw:Play(); table.insert(d.tweens, tw) end
                end
            end
            if S.DELIVERY_LABEL ~= false then
                DLV.label(d, col, hy)
            end
        end

        function DLV.sig() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            return table.concat({
                tostring(S.DELIVERY_STYLE), tostring(S.DELIVERY_THICK), tostring(S.DELIVERY_FILL),
                tostring(S.DELIVERY_FILL_A), tostring(S.DELIVERY_FILL_ROT), tostring(S.DELIVERY_SPIN),
                tostring(S.DELIVERY_GLOW), tostring(S.DELIVERY_PULSE), tostring(S.DELIVERY_LABEL),
                string.format("%.2f", tonumber(S.DELIVERY_SIZE) or 1),
            }, "|")
        end

        local function _refreshDeliveryESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.DELIVERY_ESP then _clearDeliveryESP(); return end
            local holder = DLV.getHolder()
            if not holder then return end
            local col = _deliveryColour()
            local mult = math.max(tonumber(S.DELIVERY_SIZE) or 1, 0.1)
            local sig = DLV.sig()
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            local myHrp = lp and lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local cur = {}
            for _, part in ipairs(_myDeliveryParts()) do
                cur[part] = true
                local d = deliveryEspData[part]
                if not d then
                    d = { tweens = {}, adorns = {}, faces = {} }
                    deliveryEspData[part] = d
                end
                if not d.box or not d.box.Parent then
                    DLV.drop(d)
                    d.box = DLV.part(holder, "_DeliveryAdornee")
                end
                d.box.Size = part.Size * mult
                d.box.CFrame = part.CFrame
                if d.sig ~= sig then
                    DLV.dropVisuals(d)
                    DLV.build(d, col)
                    d.sig = sig
                end
                if d.pad then
                    d.pad.CFrame = d.box.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -d.box.Size.Y / 2 + 0.1, 0)
                end
                for _, a in ipairs(d.adorns) do
                    pcall(function()
                        a.inst.Color3 = col
                        if a.kind == "sel" then a.inst.SurfaceColor3 = col end
                    end)
                end
                if #d.faces > 0 or d.bar then
                    local seq = DLV.ramp(col)
                    for _, f in ipairs(d.faces) do
                        f.gr.Color = seq
                        if f.stroke then f.stroke.Color = col end
                    end
                    if d.bar then d.bar.Color = seq end
                end
                if d.title then
                    d.title.TextColor3 = col
                    local fam = _G.SMVLL_THEME and _G.SMVLL_THEME.fontFamily
                    if d.fontFam ~= fam then
                        d.fontFam = fam
                        d.title.FontFace = _deliveryFont(Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
                        if d.sub then d.sub.FontFace = _deliveryFont(Enum.FontWeight.Bold) end
                    end
                end
                if d.sub and myHrp then
                    d.sub.Text = string.format("%dm", math.floor((myHrp.Position - d.box.Position).Magnitude + 0.5))
                end
            end
            for p, d in pairs(deliveryEspData) do
                if (not cur[p]) or (not p.Parent) then
                    DLV.drop(d)
                    deliveryEspData[p] = nil
                end
            end
        end

        function S.startDeliveryESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            S.DELIVERY_ESP = true
            if deliveryEspConn then return end
            local last = 0
            deliveryEspConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if not S.DELIVERY_ESP then return end
                local now = tick()
                if now - last < 0.25 then return end
                last = now
                pcall(_refreshDeliveryESP)
            end))
        end
        function S.stopDeliveryESP() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            S.DELIVERY_ESP = false
            if deliveryEspConn then deliveryEspConn:Disconnect(); deliveryEspConn = nil end
            _clearDeliveryESP()
        end

        
        
        
        
        
        
        local DELIVERY_SLOW_SPEED = 16
        local deliverySlowConn = nil
        local _dsParts, _dsPartsAt = {}, 0

        local function _carryingBrainrot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
            if not lp then return false end
            local ok, idx = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return lp:GetAttribute("StealingIndex") end)
            return ok and idx ~= nil and idx ~= ""
        end

        local function _dsGetParts() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = tick()
            if now - _dsPartsAt > 1 or #_dsParts == 0 then
                _dsParts = _myDeliveryParts()
                _dsPartsAt = now
            end
            return _dsParts
        end

        
        
        
        local function _dsInZone(hrp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local mult = tonumber(S.DELIVERY_SIZE) or 1
            if mult < 0.1 then mult = 0.1 end
            for _, part in ipairs(_dsGetParts()) do
                if part.Parent then
                    local rel = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
                    local half = (part.Size * mult) / 2
                    if math.abs(rel.X) <= half.X and math.abs(rel.Z) <= half.Z and math.abs(rel.Y) <= half.Y + 10 then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        function S.startDeliverySlow() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            S.DELIVERY_SLOW = true
            if deliverySlowConn then return end
            deliverySlowConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if not S.DELIVERY_SLOW then S.__DELIVERY_BRAKING = false; return end
                local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
                local char = lp and lp.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local braking = (hrp and _carryingBrainrot() and _dsInZone(hrp)) and true or false
                S.__DELIVERY_BRAKING = braking
                
                
                
                if braking then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local md = (hum and hum.MoveDirection) or Vector3.zero
                    local vy = hrp.Velocity.Y
                    if md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                        hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(md.X * DELIVERY_SLOW_SPEED, vy, md.Z * DELIVERY_SLOW_SPEED)
                    else
                        hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, vy, 0)
                    end
                end
            end))
        end
        function S.stopDeliverySlow() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            S.DELIVERY_SLOW = false
            S.__DELIVERY_BRAKING = false
            if deliverySlowConn then deliverySlowConn:Disconnect(); deliverySlowConn = nil end
        end
    end

    do

        local SLOT_COLOR   = Color3.fromRGB(55, 185, 255)
        local SLOT_FLOOR_TOL, SLOT_DEDUP_R = 8, 10
        local _slotHolder, _slotConns, _slotPending = nil, {}, false

        local function _slotClear()
            if _slotHolder then pcall(function() _slotHolder:Destroy() end) end
            _slotHolder = nil
        end

        local function _slotEnsureHolder()
            if _slotHolder and _slotHolder.Parent then return _slotHolder end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return nil end
            _slotHolder = Instance.new("Folder")
            _slotHolder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."SlotMarkers")
            _slotHolder.Parent = cam
            return _slotHolder
        end

        local function _slotBounds(slot)
            local target = slot:FindFirstChild("Base") or slot
            if target:IsA("Model") then
                local ok, cf, sz = pcall(function() return target:GetBoundingBox() end)
                if ok then return cf, sz end
            elseif target:IsA("BasePart") then
                return target.CFrame, target.Size
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function _slotMakeBox(cf, size)
            local holder = _slotEnsureHolder()
            if not holder then return end
            local a = Instance.new("Part")
            a.Anchored     = true
            a.CanCollide   = false
            a.CanQuery     = false
            a.CanTouch     = false
            a.Massless     = true
            a.Locked       = true
            a.Transparency = 1
            a.Size         = size
            a.CFrame       = cf
            a.Parent       = holder
            local b = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
            b.Adornee            = a
            b.Color3             = SLOT_COLOR
            b.SurfaceColor3      = SLOT_COLOR
            b.LineThickness      = 0.06
            b.Transparency       = 0
            b.SurfaceTransparency = 0.82
            b.Parent = a
        end

        local function _slotFloorOffsets(plots)
            local best
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if pods then
                    local ys = {}
                    for _, sl in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                        local cf = _slotBounds(sl)
                        if cf then ys[#ys + 1] = cf.Position.Y end
                    end
                    table.sort(ys)
                    local lv = {}
                    for _, y in ipairs(ys) do
                        local seen = false
                        for _, l in ipairs(lv) do
                            if math.abs(l - y) <= SLOT_FLOOR_TOL then seen = true; break end
                        end
                        if not seen then lv[#lv + 1] = y end
                    end
                    if not best or #lv > #best then best = lv end
                end
            end
            local offs = {}
            if best and #best >= 2 then
                for i = 2, #best do offs[#offs + 1] = best[i] - best[1] end
            end
            return offs
        end

        local function _slotBuild()
            if not S.SLOT_ESP then return end
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return end
            _slotClear()
            if not _slotEnsureHolder() then return end
            local offs = _slotFloorOffsets(plots)
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if pods then
                    local slots, live, minY = {}, {}, math.huge
                    for _, sl in ipairs(pods:GetChildren()) do
                        local cf, sz = _slotBounds(sl)
                        if cf then
                            slots[#slots + 1] = { cf = cf, sz = sz }
                            live[#live + 1] = cf.Position
                            minY = math.min(minY, cf.Position.Y)
                        end
                    end
                    for _, s in ipairs(slots) do _slotMakeBox(s.cf, s.sz) end
                    for _, s in ipairs(slots) do
                        if s.cf.Position.Y <= minY + SLOT_FLOOR_TOL then
                            for _, dy in ipairs(offs) do
                                local up = s.cf + Vector3.new(0, dy, 0)
                                local exists = false
                                for _, lp in ipairs(live) do
                                    if (lp - up.Position).Magnitude <= SLOT_DEDUP_R then exists = true; break end
                                end
                                if not exists then _slotMakeBox(up, s.sz) end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function _slotRebuild()
            if _slotPending or not S.SLOT_ESP then return end
            _slotPending = true
            task.delay(0.4, function()
                _slotPending = false
                if S.SLOT_ESP then pcall(_slotBuild) end
            end)
        end

        function S.startSlotESP()
            S.SLOT_ESP = true
            pcall(_slotBuild)
            if #_slotConns > 0 then return end
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return end
            local function watch(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if not pods then return end
                _slotConns[#_slotConns + 1] = pods.ChildAdded:Connect(_slotRebuild)
                _slotConns[#_slotConns + 1] = pods.ChildRemoved:Connect(_slotRebuild)
            end
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do pcall(watch, plot) end
            _slotConns[#_slotConns + 1] = plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plot)
                task.spawn(function() pcall(watch, plot) end)
                _slotRebuild()
            end)

            _slotConns[#_slotConns + 1] = workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
                _slotHolder = nil
                _slotRebuild()
            end)
        end

        function S.stopSlotESP()
            S.SLOT_ESP = false
            for _, c in ipairs(_slotConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            _slotConns = {}
            _slotClear()
        end
    end

    do

        local NB_POS = {
            Vector3.new(-342.439, 10.399, 113.107), Vector3.new(-342.439, 10.465, 6.107),
            Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.465, 114.107), Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.465, 7.107),
            Vector3.new(-342.440, 10.464, 220.107), Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.465, 221.107),
            Vector3.new(-342.439, 10.465, -100.893), Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.465, -99.893),
        }
        local _nbAnchor, _nbBB = nil, nil
        local _nbBases, _nbSeen, _nbConns = {}, {}, {}

        local function _nbRecompute()
            if not (_nbBB and _nbAnchor) then return end
            local target = nil
            for n = 1, #NB_POS do
                local b = _nbBases[n]
                if b and b.label and b.label.Parent then
                    local t = tostring(b.label.Text):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                    if t == "Empty Base" then target = n break end
                end
            end
            if target then
                _nbAnchor.CFrame = _nbBases[target].cf
                _nbBB.Enabled = true
            else
                _nbBB.Enabled = false
            end
        end

        local function _nbScan()
            if not S.NEXT_BASE_ESP then return end
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if not plots then return end
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                local model = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("Model")
                local gui = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
                local fr = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                local label = fr and fr:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                if model and label then
                    local cf = model:GetBoundingBox()
                    local q = model:GetPivot().Position
                    local best, bestD = nil, nil
                    for n, pv in ipairs(NB_POS) do
                        local d = math.sqrt((q.X - pv.X) ^ 2 + (q.Z - pv.Z) ^ 2)
                        if not bestD or d < bestD then best, bestD = n, d end
                    end
                    if bestD and bestD <= 6 then
                        _nbBases[best] = { label = label, cf = cf }
                        if not _nbSeen[label] then
                            _nbSeen[label] = true
                            _nbConns[#_nbConns + 1] =
                                label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(_nbRecompute)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            _nbRecompute()
        end

        function S.startNextBaseESP()
            if S.NEXT_BASE_ESP and _nbAnchor then return end
            S.NEXT_BASE_ESP = true
            local host = (ok and cg) or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            _nbAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
            _nbAnchor.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."NextBaseAnchor")
            _nbAnchor.Anchored = true
            _nbAnchor.CanCollide = false
            _nbAnchor.CanQuery = false
            _nbAnchor.CanTouch = false
            _nbAnchor.Transparency = 1
            _nbAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            _nbAnchor.Parent = host

            _nbBB = Instance.new("BillboardGui", _nbAnchor)
            _nbBB.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."NextBase")
            _nbBB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(32, 13)
            _nbBB.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
            _nbBB.MaxDistance = math.huge
            _nbBB.AlwaysOnTop = true
            _nbBB.Enabled = false

            local top = Instance.new("TextLabel", _nbBB)
            top.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            top.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.5)
            top.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.3)
            top.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            top.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
            top.Text = "\u{2193}  NEXT  \u{2193}"
            top.TextScaled = true
            top.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 95, 255)
            top.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            top.TextStrokeTransparency = 0

            local bottom = Instance.new("TextLabel", _nbBB)
            bottom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            bottom.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.42)
            bottom.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.72)
            bottom.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            bottom.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
            bottom.Text = "EMPTY BASE"
            bottom.TextScaled = true
            bottom.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            bottom.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            bottom.TextStrokeTransparency = 0

            _nbScan()
            local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
            if plots then
                _nbConns[#_nbConns + 1] = plots.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(x)
                    if x:IsA("TextLabel") then task.defer(_nbScan) end
                end)
                _nbConns[#_nbConns + 1] = plots.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.defer(_nbScan)
                end)
            end
        end

        function S.stopNextBaseESP()
            S.NEXT_BASE_ESP = false
            for _, c in ipairs(_nbConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            _nbConns, _nbBases, _nbSeen = {}, {}, {}
            if _nbAnchor then pcall(function() _nbAnchor:Destroy() end) end
            _nbAnchor, _nbBB = nil, nil
        end
    end

    do

        local _flOn, _flConns = false, {}
        local _flOldQuality, _flOldSky = nil, nil

        _G.SMVLL_FPS_UNLOCK = function()
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(setfpscap) == "function" then
                    setfpscap(240)
                elseif typeof(set_fps_cap) == "function" then
                    set_fps_cap(240)
                elseif getgenv and typeof(getgenv().setfpscap) == "function" then
                    getgenv().setfpscap(240)
                end
            end)
        end
        _G.SMVLL_FPS_UNLOCK()

        local function _flApplySettings()
            pcall(function()
                local st = settings()
                _flOldQuality = _flOldQuality or st.Rendering.QualityLevel
                st.Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
                st.Rendering.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level01
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local st = settings()
                st.Physics.AllowSleep = true
                st.Physics.PhysicsEnvironmentalThrottle = Enum.EnviromentalPhysicsThrottle.Skip
                st.Physics.ThrottleAdjustTime = 0
            end)
            _G.SMVLL_FPS_UNLOCK()
        end

        local function _flStrip(obj)
            local ch = player.Character
            if ch and obj:IsDescendantOf(ch) then return end
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                obj.CastShadow = false
                obj.Reflectance = 0
                if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then obj.TextureID = "" end
            elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam")
                or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
                obj.Enabled = false
            end
        end

        local function _flCleanChar(char)
            if char == player.Character then return end
            for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") or v:IsA("Shirt")
                   or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                    pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end

        local function _flBlackSky()
            for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("Sky") and v.Name ~= (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."FlSky") then pcall(function() v:Destroy() end) end
            end
            if Lighting:FindFirstChild((_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."FlSky")) then return end
            local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
            sky.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."FlSky")
            sky.SkyboxBk, sky.SkyboxDn, sky.SkyboxFt = "", "", ""
            sky.SkyboxLf, sky.SkyboxRt, sky.SkyboxUp = "", "", ""
            sky.SunTextureId, sky.MoonTextureId, sky.StarCount = "", "", 0
            _flOldSky = _flOldSky or true
            sky.Parent = Lighting
        end

        function S.startFastLoad()
            if _flOn then return end
            _flOn = true
            S.FAST_LOAD = true

            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst"):RemoveDefaultLoadingScreen()
            end)
            _flApplySettings()

            task.spawn(function()
                local mark = os.clock()
                for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not _flOn then return end
                    pcall(_flStrip, obj)
                    if os.clock() - mark >= 0.004 then
                        task.wait()
                        mark = os.clock()
                    end
                end
            end)

            _flConns[#_flConns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if _flOn then pcall(_flStrip, obj) end
            end)

            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr.Character then pcall(_flCleanChar, plr.Character) end
                _flConns[#_flConns + 1] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    if _flOn then pcall(_flCleanChar, c) end
                end)
            end
            _flConns[#_flConns + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
                _flConns[#_flConns + 1] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    if _flOn then pcall(_flCleanChar, c) end
                end)
            end)

            pcall(_flBlackSky)

            _flConns[#_flConns + 1] = Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
                if _flOn and c:IsA("Sky") and c.Name ~= (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."FlSky") then
                    task.defer(function() if _flOn then pcall(_flBlackSky) end end)
                end
            end)
        end

        function S.stopFastLoad()
            _flOn = false
            S.FAST_LOAD = false
            for _, c in ipairs(_flConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            _flConns = {}
            pcall(function()
                if _flOldQuality then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = _flOldQuality end
            end)
            local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild((_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."FlSky"))
            if sky then pcall(function() sky:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end

    local fpsConns = {}
    local fpsAnimatorConns = {}

    local function _fpsIsPlayerCharacter(model)
        return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
    end

    local function _fpsIsFollower(obj)
        local node = obj
        while node and node ~= workspace do
            if typeof(node) == "Instance" and type(node.Name) == "string"
               and (node.Name:sub(1,4) == "MBF_") then
                return true
            end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return false
    end

    function ENG._fpsHandleAnimator(animator)
        local model = animator:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and _fpsIsPlayerCharacter(model) then return end
        if _fpsIsFollower(animator) then return end
        for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
        end
        local conn = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end)
        end)
        table.insert(fpsAnimatorConns, conn)
    end

    local _fpsStripVisuals = (function(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _fpsIsFollower(obj) then return end
        local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local isPlayer = model and _fpsIsPlayerCharacter(model)

        if isPlayer then return end

        if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Clothing") then
            if obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or
           obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") or
           obj:IsA("Highlight") then
            pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end)
        end
        if obj:IsA("Explosion") then
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
        if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
            pcall(function()
                obj.TextureID = ""
                obj.RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Performance
            end)
        end
        if obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            pcall(function() obj.TextureId = "" end)
        end

        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                obj.Reflectance = 0
                obj.CastShadow = false
            end)
            pcall(function() obj.MaterialVariant = "" end)
        end

        if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
    end)

    local function _fpsRemoveMeshes(tool)
        if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle then return end
        local descendants = handle:GetDescendants()
        for i = 1, #descendants do
            local d = descendants[i]
            if d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("Mesh") or d:IsA("FileMesh") then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function _fpsOnCharacterAdded(character)
        local c = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("Tool") and S.FPS_BOOST then _fpsRemoveMeshes(child) end
        end)
        table.insert(fpsConns, c)
        local children = character:GetChildren()
        for i = 1, #children do
            if children[i]:IsA("Tool") then _fpsRemoveMeshes(children[i]) end
        end
    end

    local function _fpsOnPlayerAdded(plr)
        local c = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(_fpsOnCharacterAdded)
        table.insert(fpsConns, c)
        if plr.Character then _fpsOnCharacterAdded(plr.Character) end
    end

    local _fpsSaved = nil
    local function _fpsApplyGlobal()
        pcall(function()
            local st = settings()
            if not _fpsSaved then
                _fpsSaved = {
                    quality = st.Rendering.QualityLevel,
                    shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
                    fogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
                    fogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
                    diffuse = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
                    specular = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
                    brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
                }
            end
            st.Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        end)
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
            Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local t = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            if not t then return end
            t.WaterWaveSize = 0
            t.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
            t.WaterReflectance = 0
            t.WaterTransparency = 0
            t.Decoration = false
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(setfpscap) == "function" then setfpscap(240) end
        end)
    end

    function S.startFpsBoost()
        S.FPS_BOOST = true
        _fpsApplyGlobal()
        for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("BlurEffect") or v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or
               v:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or v:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") or v:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            _fpsStripVisuals(obj)
        end
        fpsConns.descAdded = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if S.FPS_BOOST then _fpsStripVisuals(obj) end
        end)
        local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
        for i = 1, #allPlayers do _fpsOnPlayerAdded(allPlayers[i]) end
        fpsConns.playerAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(_fpsOnPlayerAdded)
    end
    function S.stopFpsBoost()
        S.FPS_BOOST = false
        if _fpsSaved then
            pcall(function() settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = _fpsSaved.quality end)
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = _fpsSaved.shadows
                Lighting.FogEnd = _fpsSaved.fogEnd
                Lighting.FogStart = _fpsSaved.fogStart
                Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = _fpsSaved.diffuse
                Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = _fpsSaved.specular
                Lighting.Brightness = _fpsSaved.brightness
            end)
            _fpsSaved = nil
        end
        for _, c in pairs(fpsConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        fpsConns = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(fpsAnimatorConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        fpsAnimatorConns = {}
    end

    local animRmConns = {}
    local function handleAnimator(animator)
        local model = animator:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and LP.Character == model then return end
        for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
        end
        local c = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(t)
            if not S.REMOVE_ANIM_BR then return end
            local m = animator:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            if m and LP.Character == m then return end
            pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
        end)
        table.insert(animRmConns, c)
    end
    function S.startRemoveAnimBR()
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Animator") then handleAnimator(obj) end
        end
        animRmConns.desc = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not S.REMOVE_ANIM_BR then return end
            if obj:IsA("Animator") then handleAnimator(obj) end
        end)
    end
    function S.stopRemoveAnimBR()
        for _, c in pairs(animRmConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        animRmConns = {}
    end

    local noAnimConn = nil
    local function disableAllAnim()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local ac = char:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")
        if ac then pcall(function() ac:Destroy() end) end
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("AnimationTrack") then pcall(function() d:Stop(); d:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local a = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if a then pcall(function() a.Disabled = true; a:Destroy() end) end
    end
    function S.startNoAnim()
        disableAllAnim()
        if noAnimConn then return end
        noAnimConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(1)
            if S.NO_ANIMATION then disableAllAnim() end
        end)
    end
    function S.stopNoAnim()
        if noAnimConn then noAnimConn:Disconnect(); noAnimConn = nil end
    end

    local stretchConn = nil
    local _stretchSuspended = false
    function S.suspendStretch(duration)
        _stretchSuspended = true
        task.delay(duration or 1.5, function() _stretchSuspended = false end)
    end
    function S.startStretch()
        if stretchConn then return end
        stretchConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.STRETCH and not _stretchSuspended then

                if Cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                    Cam.CFrame = Cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0.65, 0, 0, 0, 1)
                end
                if not S.FOV_ENABLED then
                    Cam.FieldOfView = 65
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopStretch()
        if stretchConn then stretchConn:Disconnect(); stretchConn = nil end
    end

    do
    local antiBeeConns = {}
    local _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc = nil
    local _antiNegBeeUntil = 0
    local _antiNegBoogieUntil = 0
    local _realUseItem = nil

    local function _antiNegFindUseItem()
        if _realUseItem and _realUseItem.Parent then return _realUseItem end
        if S.NetResolve then
            local ok, r = pcall(S.NetResolve, "UseItem", "RemoteEvent")
            if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" then _realUseItem = r; return _realUseItem end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            net = net and net:FindFirstChild("Net")
            if net then
                local children = net:GetChildren()
                for i, obj in ipairs(children) do
                    if obj.Name == "RE/UseItem" then
                        _realUseItem = children[i + 1]
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        return _realUseItem
    end

    local function _antiNegGetMainHud()
        local pg = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        return pg and pg:FindFirstChild("Main")
    end
    local function _antiNegIsPaintballSplat(gui)
        local main = _antiNegGetMainHud()
        if not gui or gui.Parent ~= main then return false end
        if not (gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton")) then return false end
        if gui:GetAttribute("__SMVLLPaintballShrunk") then return false end
        return math.abs(gui.Rotation) > 0.01
    end
    local function _antiNegShrinkSplat(gui)
        if not gui or gui:GetAttribute("__SMVLLPaintballShrunk") then return end
        gui:SetAttribute("__SMVLLPaintballShrunk", true)
        gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)
    end
    local function _antiNegPaintballSweep()
        if not S.ANTI_BEE then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 8 do
                local main = _antiNegGetMainHud()
                if not main then break end
                for _, child in ipairs(main:GetChildren()) do
                    if _antiNegIsPaintballSplat(child) then _antiNegShrinkSplat(child) end
                end
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function _antiNegRestoreMove() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local pm = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 2) and LP.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if not pm then return end
            local Controls = require(pm):GetControls()
            if not Controls then return end
            if not _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc then
                _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc = Controls.moveFunction
            elseif Controls.moveFunction ~= _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc then
                Controls.moveFunction = _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc
            end
        end)
    end

    local function _antiNegClearLighting(names) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if names[child.Name] and (child:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or child:IsA("BlurEffect")) then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); child:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function _antiNegStopSound(controllerName, soundName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ic = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Controllers") and ReplicatedStorage.Controllers:FindFirstChild("ItemController")
        local ctrl = ic and ic:FindFirstChild(controllerName)
        local snd = ctrl and ctrl:FindFirstChild(soundName)
        if snd and snd:IsA("Sound") then snd:Stop() end
    end
    local function _antiNegClearEffects() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if S.ANTI_BEE and tick() <= _antiNegBeeUntil then
            _antiNegRestoreMove()
            _antiNegClearLighting({ BeeBlur = true, Flashbang = true })
            _antiNegStopSound("BeeLauncherController", "Buzzing")
        end
        if S.ANTI_BEE and tick() <= _antiNegBoogieUntil then
            _antiNegClearLighting({ DiscoEffect = true })
            _antiNegStopSound("BoogieBombController", "BOOM")
        end
    end

    function S.startAntiBee()
        if next(antiBeeConns) then return end
        local function _hookUseItem(re)
            table.insert(antiBeeConns, re.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(effectName)
                if not S.ANTI_BEE then return end
                if effectName == "PaintballHitted" then
                    _antiNegPaintballSweep()
                elseif effectName == "Bee Attack" then
                    _antiNegBeeUntil = tick() + 6
                    _antiNegClearEffects()
                elseif effectName == "Boogie" then
                    _antiNegBoogieUntil = tick() + 11
                    _antiNegClearEffects()
                end
            end))
        end
        local re = _antiNegFindUseItem()
        if re then
            _hookUseItem(re)
        else
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 15 do
                    task.wait(2)
                    if not S.ANTI_BEE then return end
                    local r2 = _antiNegFindUseItem()
                    if r2 then
                        if S.ANTI_BEE and next(antiBeeConns) then _hookUseItem(r2) end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        table.insert(antiBeeConns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.ANTI_BEE then return end
            _antiNegClearEffects()
            _antiNegRestoreMove()
            for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                local n = child.Name
                if n == "DiscoEffect" or n == "BeeBlur" or n == "Flashbang"
                   or n == "BeeEffect" or n == "Disco" or n == "BeeColorCorrection" then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); child:Destroy() end)
                elseif child:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") and child.Enabled then
                    local t = child.TintColor
                    if (t.R > 0.6 and t.G > 0.5 and t.B < 0.5)
                       or child.Saturation < -0.3 or child.Saturation > 0.3
                       or math.abs(child.Brightness) > 0.15 then
                        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); child:Destroy() end)
                    end
                elseif child:IsA("BlurEffect") and child.Enabled and child.Size > 2
                       and child.Name ~= "SMVLL" then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); child.Enabled = false end)
                end
            end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local bee = LP.PlayerScripts and LP.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Bee", true)
                if bee then
                    local buzz = bee:FindFirstChild("Buzzing")
                    if buzz and buzz:IsA("Sound") then buzz.Volume = 0 end
                end
            end)
            if Cam then
                if S.FOV_ENABLED then
                    Cam.FieldOfView = S.FOV_VALUE
                elseif Cam.FieldOfView ~= 70 then
                    Cam.FieldOfView = 70
                end
            end
        end)))
        table.insert(antiBeeConns, Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not S.ANTI_BEE then return end
            local n = obj.Name
            if n == "DiscoEffect" or n == "BeeBlur" or n == "Flashbang"
               or n == "BeeEffect" or n == "Disco" or n == "BeeColorCorrection" then
                task.defer(function() pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end)
            elseif obj:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                task.defer(function()
                    if not obj.Parent then return end
                    local t = obj.TintColor
                    if (t.R > 0.6 and t.G > 0.5 and t.B < 0.5)
                       or obj.Saturation < -0.3 or obj.Saturation > 0.3 then
                        pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
    end

    function S.stopAntiBee()
        for _, c in ipairs(antiBeeConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        antiBeeConns = {}
        pcall(function()
            if _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc and LP.PlayerScripts then
                local pm = LP.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                if pm then
                    local Controls = require(pm):GetControls()
                    if Controls then Controls.moveFunction = _antiBeeOrigMoveFunc end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    end

    local fovConn = nil
    function S.startFov()
        if fovConn then return end
        fovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.FOV_ENABLED and Cam then Cam.FieldOfView = S.FOV_VALUE end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopFov()
        if fovConn then fovConn:Disconnect(); fovConn = nil end
    end

    local antiRagConn = nil
    -- Anti Ragdoll: port of Aurora v2 (constraint cleanup + AnimationConstraint restore + net-handler guard)
    do
        local HST = Enum.HumanoidStateType
        local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
        local _AR = {
            gen = 0, conns = {}, charConns = {}, charRef = nil,
            rigBase = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), rigBaseChar = nil, rigBaseN = 0, rigDirty = true,
            acList = {}, acBase = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
            ragWindow = nil, ragDeep = false, ragDeepT = 0, ragUntil = 0, cleaned = false,
            net = {}, controls = nil, lastHit = 0,
        }

        local function snapshot(char)
            if not char or char ~= LP.Character then return end
            local same = _AR.rigBaseChar == char
            if same and ((not _AR.rigDirty) or _AR.rigBaseN >= 10) then return end
            if not same then _AR.acBase = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) end
            local base, n, acs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), 0, {}
            for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                local cn = d.ClassName
                if cn == "BallSocketConstraint" or cn == "HingeConstraint" then
                    base[d] = true; n = n + 1
                elseif cn == "AnimationConstraint" then
                    acs[#acs + 1] = d
                end
            end
            _AR.rigBase, _AR.rigBaseN, _AR.rigBaseChar, _AR.acList, _AR.rigDirty = base, n, char, acs, false
        end

        local function recordAC()
            for _, a in ipairs(_AR.acList) do
                if a.Parent and a.Enabled and a.MaxTorque > 0 then
                    _AR.acBase[a] = { t = a.MaxTorque, f = a.MaxForce }
                end
            end
        end
        local function acBroken()
            for _, a in ipairs(_AR.acList) do
                if a.Parent and ((not a.Enabled) or a.MaxTorque == 0) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function restoreAC()
            for _, a in ipairs(_AR.acList) do
                if a.Parent then
                    local b = _AR.acBase[a]
                    if not a.Enabled then a.Enabled = true end
                    if a.MaxTorque == 0 then a.MaxTorque = (b and b.t) or 3000 end
                end
            end
        end
        local function legit(c)
            if _AR.rigBase[c] then return true end
            local n = c.Name
            return n:sub(-10) == "BallSocket" or n:sub(-6) == "Socket"
        end

        local function getControls()
            if _AR.controls then return _AR.controls end
            local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if not pm then return nil end
            local ok, m = pcall(require, pm)
            if ok and m then
                local ok2, c = pcall(function() return m:GetControls() end)
                if ok2 and c then _AR.controls = c end
            end
            return _AR.controls
        end

        local function cleanup(deep)
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            pcall(restoreAC)
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if p.ClassName ~= "Humanoid" and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Anchored then p.Anchored = false end
            end
            if deep then
                for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    local cn = d.ClassName
