                    if cn == "BallSocketConstraint" or cn == "HingeConstraint" then
                        if not legit(d) then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
                    elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Anchored then
                        d.Anchored = false
                    end
                end
            end
            if hum then
                local st = hum:GetState()
                if hum.PlatformStand or st == HST.Physics or st == HST.Ragdoll
                    or st == HST.FallingDown or st == HST.PlatformStanding then
                    if hum.PlatformStand then hum.PlatformStand = false end
                    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(HST.GettingUp) end)
                    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(HST.Running) end)
                end
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                    if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom end
                    if cam.CameraSubject ~= hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
                end
                if LP.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then LP.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic end
                local c = getControls()
                if c then pcall(function() c:Enable() end) end
            end
        end

        -- game net handlers (RagdollController / CombatController) via getconnections
        local function netConns(key)
            local cached = _AR.net[key]
            if cached and #cached > 0 then
                local ok = true
                for _, c in ipairs(cached) do
                    local okF, f = pcall(function() return c.Function end)
                    if not (okF and f) then ok = false; break end
                end
                if ok then return cached end
            end
            local list = {}
            local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local pk = rs:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            pk = pk and pk:FindFirstChild("Net")
            if pk and type(getconnections) == "function" then
                for _, r in ipairs(pk:GetChildren()) do
                    if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        local okC, cs = pcall(getconnections, r.OnClientEvent)
                        if okC and type(cs) == "table" then
                            for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
                                local f = c.Function
                                if f then
                                    local okS, src = pcall(debug.info, f, "s")
                                    if okS and type(src) == "string" and src:find(key, 1, true) then
                                        list[#list + 1] = c
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            _AR.net[key] = list
            return list
        end
        local function setNet(key, enable)
            local list = netConns(key)
            if #list == 0 then return false end
            for _, c in ipairs(list) do
                pcall(function() if enable then c:Enable() else c:Disable() end end)
            end
            return true
        end
        local function combat()
            local ok, m = pcall(function()
                return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Controllers.CombatController)
            end)
            if ok and type(m) == "table" then return m end
        end
        local function guardOn()
            setNet("RagdollController", false)
            if setNet("CombatController", false) then return end
            local m = combat()
            if not m or type(m.ApplyImpulse) ~= "function" then return end
            if not genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub then genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub = function() end end
            if m.ApplyImpulse ~= genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub and type(genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseOrig) ~= "function" then
                genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseOrig = m.ApplyImpulse
            end
            pcall(function() m.ApplyImpulse = genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub end)
        end
        local function guardOff()
            setNet("RagdollController", true)
            setNet("CombatController", true)
            local m = combat()
            if m and genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub and m.ApplyImpulse == genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseStub
                and type(genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseOrig) == "function" then
                pcall(function() m.ApplyImpulse = genv.__SMVLL_ImpulseOrig end)
            end
        end

        local function hit()
            local t = tick()
            if t - _AR.lastHit < 0.25 then return end
            _AR.lastHit = t
            if ENG._agGateHit then pcall(ENG._agGateHit, "ragdoll") end
        end

        local function remaining()
            return math.max(0, _AR.ragUntil - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
        end
        local function isRagdolled(hum)
            if remaining() > 0 then return true end
            if LP:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == true then return true end
            local st = hum:GetState()
            if st == HST.Physics or st == HST.Ragdoll or st == HST.FallingDown then return true end
            return acBroken()
        end

        local function onSignal()
            if not S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local st = hum and hum:GetState()
            local endT = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or 0
            local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            if now < endT then _AR.ragUntil = math.max(_AR.ragUntil, endT) end
            if not (endT > now or LP:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == true or st == HST.Physics or st == HST.Ragdoll) then
                return
            end
            _AR.ragWindow = tick() + 2
            _AR.cleaned = false
            _AR.ragDeep = true
            hit()
            cleanup(true)
        end

        local function hookChar(char, gen)
            if _AR.gen ~= gen or not char or char ~= LP.Character then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not hum or _AR.gen ~= gen then return end
            if _AR.charRef == char then return end
            for _, c in ipairs(_AR.charConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            _AR.charConns = {}
            _AR.charRef = char
            _AR.ragWindow, _AR.cleaned, _AR.rigDirty = nil, false, true
            local function alive() return _AR.gen == gen and LP.Character == char end
            snapshot(char)
            task.delay(1, function() if alive() then snapshot(char) end end)
            task.delay(3, function() if alive() then snapshot(char) end end)

            local queued = false
            table.insert(_AR.charConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if not alive() then return end
                local cn = d.ClassName
                if cn == "BallSocketConstraint" or cn == "HingeConstraint" or cn == "AnimationConstraint" then
                    _AR.rigDirty = true
                end
                if not S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then return end
                local bad = cn == "VectorForce"
                    or ((cn == "BallSocketConstraint" or cn == "HingeConstraint") and not legit(d))
                if bad then
                    _AR.ragWindow = tick() + 2
                    _AR.ragDeep = true
                    if not queued then
                        queued = true
                        task.defer(function()
                            queued = false
                            if alive() and S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then hit(); cleanup(true) end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end))
            table.insert(_AR.charConns, char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
                if not alive() then return end
                local cn = d.ClassName
                if cn == "BallSocketConstraint" or cn == "HingeConstraint" or cn == "AnimationConstraint" then
                    _AR.rigDirty = true
                end
            end))
            table.insert(_AR.charConns, hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
                if not alive() then return end
                if new == HST.Physics or new == HST.Ragdoll then onSignal() end
            end))
        end

        function S.startAntiRagdoll()
            if antiRagConn then return end
            _AR.gen = _AR.gen + 1
            local gen = _AR.gen
            _AR.charRef = nil
            _AR.conns = {}

            table.insert(_AR.conns, LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal("RagdollEndTime"):Connect(onSignal))
            table.insert(_AR.conns, LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ragdoll"):Connect(onSignal))
            table.insert(_AR.conns, LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                task.wait(0.2)
                hookChar(char, gen)
            end))
            if LP.Character then task.spawn(hookChar, LP.Character, gen) end

            -- every 2s: keep the game's ragdoll / impulse handlers disabled
            task.spawn(function()
                while _AR.gen == gen do
                    if S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then pcall(guardOn) end
                    task.wait(2)
                end
            end)
            -- every 0.1s: eat RagdollEndTime and keep cleaning while the window is open
            task.spawn(function()
                while _AR.gen == gen do
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    if S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then
                        local e = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime") or 0
                        if workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < e then
                            _AR.ragUntil = math.max(_AR.ragUntil, e)
                            if ENG._agGateRagdollEnd then pcall(ENG._agGateRagdollEnd, e) end
                            pcall(function() LP:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", 0) end)
                            _AR.ragWindow = tick() + 2
                        end
                        if _AR.ragWindow and tick() < _AR.ragWindow then cleanup(false) end
                    end
                end
            end)

            antiRagConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then return end
                local char = LP.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not (hum and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then return end
                if _AR.charRef ~= char then task.spawn(hookChar, char, gen) end
                local now = tick()
                if isRagdolled(hum) then
                    _AR.ragWindow = now + 1
                    hit()
                end
                if _AR.ragWindow and now < _AR.ragWindow + 0.7 then
                    local deep = _AR.ragDeep == true or (now - _AR.ragDeepT) > 0.5
                    if deep then _AR.ragDeep = false; _AR.ragDeepT = now end
                    cleanup(deep)
                else
                    recordAC()
                    if not _AR.cleaned then
                        _AR.cleaned = true
                        snapshot(char)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        function S.stopAntiRagdoll()
            _AR.gen = _AR.gen + 1
            if antiRagConn then antiRagConn:Disconnect(); antiRagConn = nil end
            for _, c in ipairs(_AR.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            for _, c in ipairs(_AR.charConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            _AR.conns, _AR.charConns, _AR.charRef = {}, {}, nil
            _AR.ragWindow = nil
            pcall(guardOff)
        end
    end

    do
        local antiTrapConn = nil
        local _atSeat, _atTick, _atHeld = nil, 0, false

        local function _atRelease() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            _atHeld = false
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.Sit = false end)
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            end
            if _atSeat then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _atSeat:Destroy() end) end
            _atSeat = nil
        end

        local function _atForceSit() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not (hum and hrp) or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
            _atHeld = true
            if _atSeat and _atSeat.Parent and hum.SeatPart == _atSeat then return true end
            if _atSeat then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _atSeat:Destroy() end) end
            _atSeat = nil
            local okS = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
                seat.Name = "Seat"
                seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.2, 2)
                seat.Transparency = 1
                seat.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                seat.CastShadow = false
                seat.CanCollide = false
                seat.CanQuery = false
                seat.CanTouch = false
                seat.Anchored = true
                seat.Archivable = false
                seat.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0))
                seat.Parent = workspace
                _atSeat = seat
                seat:Sit(hum)
            end)
            if not okS then _atSeat = nil end
            return _atSeat ~= nil
        end

        local _atTraps, _atTrapsAt = {}, 0

        local function _atNearTrap(hrp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - _atTrapsAt > 1 then
                _atTrapsAt = now
                _atTraps = {}
                for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if obj.Name == "Trap" then
                        local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj
                            or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if part then _atTraps[#_atTraps + 1] = part end
                    end
                end
            end
            for _, part in ipairs(_atTraps) do
                if part.Parent and (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 10 then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function _atTrapped() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not (hrp and hum) then return false end
            if not _atNearTrap(hrp) then return false end
            return hum.WalkSpeed <= 0.1 or hrp.Anchored or hum.PlatformStand
        end

        function S.forceSit() return _atForceSit() end
        function S.releaseSit() _atRelease() end

        function S.startAntiTrap()
            if antiTrapConn then return end
            antiTrapConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if not S.ANTI_TRAP then return end
                _atTick = _atTick + dt
                if _atTick < 0.25 then return end
                _atTick = 0
                local char = LP.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
                if _atTrapped() then
                    if not (_atSeat and _atSeat.Parent and hum.SeatPart == _atSeat) then
                        _atForceSit()
                    end
                elseif _atSeat then
                    _atRelease()
                end
            end))
        end

        function S.stopAntiTrap()
            if antiTrapConn then antiTrapConn:Disconnect(); antiTrapConn = nil end
            _atRelease()
        end

        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() _atSeat, _atHeld = nil, false end)
    end


    local _antiAdminConn = nil
    local function _antiAdminRestore(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (hum and hrp) or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hrp.Velocity = Vector3.zero end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hrp.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.PlatformStand = false end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.Sit = false end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.AutoRotate = true end)
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d.Enabled = true end)
            elseif d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or d:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d.Enabled = true end)
            end
        end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum end)
        local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        local cm = pm and pm:FindFirstChild("ControlModule")
        if cm then
            local ok, mod = pcall(require, cm)
            if ok and type(mod) == "table" and mod.Enable then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); mod:Enable() end) end
        end
    end
    do
        local conns = {}

        local function killRocket(char, d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or d.Parent ~= hrp then return end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d:Destroy() end)
            if ENG._kbGuard then ENG._kbGuard() end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local v = hrp.Velocity
                if v.Y > 0 then hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
            end)
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
        end

        local SCALE_VALUES = { "BodyHeightScale", "BodyWidthScale", "BodyDepthScale", "HeadScale" }

        local function undoTiny(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            local shrunk = false
            for _, n in ipairs(SCALE_VALUES) do
                local v = hum:FindFirstChild(n)
                if v and v:IsA("NumberValue") and v.Value < 0.999 then
                    shrunk = true
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); v.Value = 1 end)
                end
            end
            if not shrunk then return end
            local sc = char:GetAttribute("__HumanoidScale")
            local nh = char:GetAttribute("NewHipHeight")
            if type(sc) == "number" and sc > 0 and type(nh) == "number" then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum.HipHeight = nh / sc end)
            end
        end

        local function bind(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); c:Disconnect() end) end
            conns = {}
            if not char then return end
            conns[#conns + 1] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if S.ANTI_ADMIN and d:IsA("VectorForce") then task.defer(killRocket, char, d) end
            end)
            conns[#conns + 1] = char:GetAttributeChangedSignal("__HumanoidScale"):Connect(function()
                if S.ANTI_ADMIN then task.defer(undoTiny, char) end
            end)
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                if not hum or LP.Character ~= char then return end
                for _, n in ipairs(SCALE_VALUES) do
                    local v = hum:FindFirstChild(n)
                    if v and v:IsA("NumberValue") then
                        conns[#conns + 1] = v.Changed:Connect(function()
                            if S.ANTI_ADMIN then task.defer(undoTiny, char) end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(bind)
        if LP.Character then bind(LP.Character) end
        S._antiAdminUndoTiny = function() undoTiny(LP.Character) end

        
        
        
        local JAIL_RADIUS = 20
        local jailBatch, jailAt, jailUntil, jailCenter, jailPending = {}, 0, 0, nil, false
        local function dropPart(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if p.Parent then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); p:Destroy() end) end
        end
        local function checkJail() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            jailPending = false
            if not S.ANTI_ADMIN or #jailBatch < 4 then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local sum, n = Vector3.zero, 0
            for _, p in ipairs(jailBatch) do
                if p.Parent then sum, n = sum + p.Position, n + 1 end
            end
            if n < 4 then return end
            local center = sum / n
            if (center - hrp.Position).Magnitude > JAIL_RADIUS then return end
            jailCenter, jailUntil = center, tick() + 1
            for _, p in ipairs(jailBatch) do dropPart(p) end
            jailBatch = {}
        end
        workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if not S.ANTI_ADMIN or child.ClassName ~= "Part" or child.Name ~= "Part" then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now < jailUntil and jailCenter then
                task.delay(0.05, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    if child.Parent and (child.Position - jailCenter).Magnitude <= JAIL_RADIUS then dropPart(child) end
                end)
                return
            end
            if now - jailAt > 0.25 then jailBatch = {} end
            jailAt = now
            jailBatch[#jailBatch + 1] = child
            if not jailPending then
                jailPending = true
                task.delay(0.05, checkJail)
            end
        end)
    end

    do
        local KB_SPAN = 0.4
        local kbUntil, impulseConn, nextHookTry = 0, nil, 0

        local function guardOn() return S.ANTI_RAGDOLL == true or S.ANTI_ADMIN == true end

        function ENG._kbGuard() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            kbUntil = tick() + KB_SPAN
        end

        local function hookImpulse() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if impulseConn or tick() < nextHookTry then return end
            nextHookTry = tick() + 2
            local pk  = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            local net = pk and pk:FindFirstChild("Net")
            local re  = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/CombatService/ApplyImpulse")
            if re then impulseConn = re.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                if S.ANTI_RAGDOLL then ENG._kbGuard() end
            end) end
        end

        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not guardOn() then return end
            hookImpulse()
            if tick() >= kbUntil then return end
            if os.clock() < (tonumber(rawget(_G, "__SMVLL_RESETTING")) or 0) then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local v   = hrp.Velocity
            local md  = hum and hum.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
            local ws  = hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 0
            local y   = v.Y
            if y > 0 and not (hum and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) then y = 0 end
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(md.X * ws, y, md.Z * ws)
        end)
    end

    function S.startAntiAdmin()
        if S._antiAdminUndoTiny then pcall(S._antiAdminUndoTiny) end
        if _antiAdminConn then return end
        local acc = 0
        _antiAdminConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.ANTI_ADMIN then return end
            acc = acc + (dt or 0)
            if acc < 0.05 then return end
            acc = 0
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local onCarpet = hrp ~= nil and (hrp:FindFirstChild("FlightHold") ~= nil or hrp:FindFirstChild("FlightPower") ~= nil)
            local bad = (hum.PlatformStand == true and not onCarpet)
                or hum.Sit == true
            if bad then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _antiAdminRestore(char) end) end
        end))
    end

    function S.stopAntiAdmin()
        if _antiAdminConn then _antiAdminConn:Disconnect(); _antiAdminConn = nil end
    end

    local AD = { conns = {}, char = nil }

    local function _antiDieDrop()
        for _, c in ipairs(AD.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        AD.conns = {}
    end

    local function _antiDieArm()
        _antiDieDrop()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end

        AD.conns[#AD.conns + 1] =
            hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(function()
                if not S.ANTI_DIE then return end

                end

        AD.conns[#AD.conns + 1] = hum.Died:Connect(function()

                fresh.Name = "Humanoid"
                fresh.Parent = char
                if workspace.CurrentCamera then
                    workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = fresh
                end
                hum:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end

        _antiDieArm()
        if AD.char then return end
        AD.char = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            if S.ANTI_DIE then _antiDieArm() end
        end)
    end

    function S.stopAntiDie()
        S.ANTI_DIE = false
        _antiDieDrop()
        if AD.char then
            AD.char:Disconnect()
            AD.char = nil
        end
    end

    do 
    
    
    
    
    
    
    local AW = { conns = {}, charConn = nil, usedAt = 0, busy = false }

    local function _antiWebOnce(char)
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (hum and hrp) then return 0 end
        if LP:GetAttribute("Web") then LP:SetAttribute("Web", false) end
        if char:GetAttribute("Web") then char:SetAttribute("Web", false) end
        if LP:GetAttribute("BlockTools") then LP:SetAttribute("BlockTools", false) end
        local attach = hrp:FindFirstChild("WebTargetAttch")
        if attach then attach:Destroy() end
        local cut = 0
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local ok, joints = pcall(part.GetJoints, part)
                for _, j in ipairs(ok and joints or {}) do
                    if not j:IsA("Motor6D") and not j:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
                        local a, b
                        if j:IsA("Constraint") then
                            a = j.Attachment0 and j.Attachment0.Parent
                            b = j.Attachment1 and j.Attachment1.Parent
                        else
                            a, b = j.Part0, j.Part1
                        end
                        local out = (a and not a:IsDescendantOf(char)) or (b and not b:IsDescendantOf(char))
                            or not j:IsDescendantOf(char)
                        if out then cut = cut + 1; pcall(j.Destroy, j) end
                    end
                end
            elseif part:IsA("RopeConstraint") or part:IsA("SpringConstraint") then
                cut = cut + 1
                pcall(part.Destroy, part)
            end
        end
        local gb = workspace:FindFirstChild("GummyBear")
        if gb and gb:IsA("BasePart") and (gb.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 12 then pcall(gb.Destroy, gb) end
        if hum.PlatformStand then hum.PlatformStand = false end
        local s = hum:GetState()
        if s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
            or s == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
            pcall(hum.ChangeState, hum, Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
        end
        return cut
    end

    local function _antiWebFree(char)
        if not S.ANTI_WEB or not char or AW.busy then return end
        if os.clock() - AW.usedAt < 1.5 then return end
        AW.busy = true
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while S.ANTI_WEB and os.clock() - t0 < 6 do
            local c = _antiWebOnce(char) or 0
            local w = LP:GetAttribute("Web") or char:GetAttribute("Web")
            if not (w or c > 0) and os.clock() - t0 > 0.5 then break end
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        AW.busy = false
    end

    local function _antiWebHit(src)
        local v = src:GetAttribute("Web")
        if v ~= nil and v ~= false then task.spawn(_antiWebFree, LP.Character) end
    end

    local function _antiWebDrop()
        for _, c in ipairs(AW.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        AW.conns = {}
    end

    local function _antiWebHook(char)
        _antiWebDrop()
        AW.conns[#AW.conns + 1] = LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Web"):Connect(function() _antiWebHit(LP) end)
        if not char then return end
        AW.conns[#AW.conns + 1] = char:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Web"):Connect(function() _antiWebHit(char) end)
        local function ownTool(c)
            if c:IsA("Tool") and c.Name == "Web Slinger" then
                AW.conns[#AW.conns + 1] = c.Activated:Connect(function() AW.usedAt = os.clock() end)
            end
        end
        AW.conns[#AW.conns + 1] = char.ChildAdded:Connect(ownTool)
        local own = char:FindFirstChild("Web Slinger")
        if own then ownTool(own) end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            AW.conns[#AW.conns + 1] = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PlatformStand"):Connect(function()
                if hum.PlatformStand and (LP:GetAttribute("Web") or LP:GetAttribute("BlockTools")) then
                    task.spawn(_antiWebFree, char)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function S.startAntiWeb()
        S.ANTI_WEB = true
        _antiWebHook(LP.Character)
        if not AW.charConn then
            AW.charConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                if S.ANTI_WEB then _antiWebHook(char) end
            end)
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        if char and (LP:GetAttribute("Web") or char:GetAttribute("Web")) then
            task.spawn(_antiWebFree, char)
        end
    end

    function S.stopAntiWeb()
        S.ANTI_WEB = false
        _antiWebDrop()
        if AW.charConn then AW.charConn:Disconnect(); AW.charConn = nil end
    end

    
    
    
    
    
    
    local SW = { conn = nil, threat = {}, prevOthers = {}, prevSelf = nil, lastCounter = 0, nextAt = 0, remote = nil }
    local SWAP_POTION = "Body Swap Potion"

    local function _swapUseRemote()
        if SW.remote and SW.remote.Parent then return SW.remote end
        if S.NetResolve then
            local ok, r = pcall(S.NetResolve, "UseItem", "RemoteEvent")
            if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" then SW.remote = r; return r end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local net = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            net = net and net:FindFirstChild("Net")
            local direct = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/UseItem")
            if direct and direct:IsA("RemoteEvent") then SW.remote = direct; return end
            if net then
                local kids = net:GetChildren()
                for i, obj in ipairs(kids) do
                    if obj.Name == "RE/UseItem" and kids[i + 1] and kids[i + 1]:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        SW.remote = kids[i + 1]
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        return SW.remote
    end

    local function _swapMyPotion()
        local ch, bp = LP.Character, LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        return (ch and ch:FindFirstChild(SWAP_POTION)) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(SWAP_POTION))
    end

    -- Port d'Aurora (anti body swap) : tolérance de distance dynamique + confirmation du swap
    local function _swapBack(target)
        local ch = LP.Character
        local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local potion = _swapMyPotion()
        local remote = _swapUseRemote()
        if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" or not target.Parent then return end
        if not (hum and potion and remote) or potion:GetAttribute("CooldownTime") then return end
        local held = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if held == potion then held = nil end
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local p0 = hrp and hrp.Position
        -- re-swap direct : on tire dès que la potion est en main, sans aucun délai fixe
        pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(potion) end)
        if potion.Parent ~= ch then
            local t0 = os.clock()
            repeat task.wait() until potion.Parent == ch or os.clock() - t0 > 0.3
        end
        if potion.Parent ~= ch then return end
        pcall(function() remote:FireServer(target) end)
        -- attend que le swap soit réellement annulé (on bouge) au lieu d'un délai fixe
        if hrp and p0 then
            local t1 = os.clock()
            while hrp.Parent and (hrp.Position - p0).Magnitude < 3 and os.clock() - t1 < 0.8 do
                task.wait()
            end
        end
        if held and held.Parent then
            pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(held) end)
        else
            pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
        end
    end

    local _swapRemoving
    function S.startAntiSwap()
        S.ANTI_SWAP = true
        if SW.conn then return end
        SW.curOther = SW.curOther or {}
        if not _swapRemoving then
            _swapRemoving = game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
                SW.threat[p] = nil
            end)
        end
        SW.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local hrp = S.ANTI_SWAP and LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then
                if SW.prevSelf then SW.prevSelf = nil; table.clear(SW.prevOthers) end
                return
            end
            local now = tick()
            local me = hrp.Position
            local cur = SW.curOther
            table.clear(cur)
            for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP then
                    local ch = p.Character
                    local r = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if r then
                        cur[p] = r.Position
                        local tool = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                        if tool and tool.Name == SWAP_POTION then SW.threat[p] = now end
                    end
                end
            end
            local prevSelf = SW.prevSelf
            local moved = prevSelf and (me - prevSelf).Magnitude or 0
            if prevSelf and moved >= 3 and now - SW.lastCounter >= 0.5 then
                local step = (SW.prevStep or 0) + 1
                local culprit
                for p, was in pairs(SW.prevOthers) do
                    local nowPos = cur[p]
                    if nowPos then
                        local tol = math.clamp((was - prevSelf).Magnitude * 0.25, 1.5, 5) + step
                        local t = SW.threat[p]
                        if (me - was).Magnitude <= tol
                            and (nowPos - was).Magnitude >= 3
                            and (nowPos - prevSelf).Magnitude <= tol
                            and t and now - t <= 6 then
                            culprit = p
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if culprit then
                    SW.lastCounter = now
                    SW.threat[culprit] = nil
                    task.spawn(_swapBack, culprit)
                end
            end
            SW.prevSelf = me
            SW.prevStep = math.min(moved, 15)
            SW.prevOthers, SW.curOther = cur, SW.prevOthers
        end)
    end

    function S.stopAntiSwap()
        S.ANTI_SWAP = false
        if SW.conn then SW.conn:Disconnect(); SW.conn = nil end
        if _swapRemoving then _swapRemoving:Disconnect(); _swapRemoving = nil end
        SW.prevSelf = nil
        table.clear(SW.prevOthers)
        table.clear(SW.threat)
    end

    
    if S.ANTI_WEB ~= false then pcall(S.startAntiWeb) end
    if S.ANTI_SWAP ~= false then pcall(S.startAntiSwap) end
    end

    local _ijConns = {}
    local JUMP_FORCE = 50
    local HOLD_CLIMB = 45
    function S.startInfinityJump()
        if _ijConns.jump then return end
        _ijConns.jump = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
            if not S.INFINITY_JUMP then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(hrp.Velocity.X, JUMP_FORCE, hrp.Velocity.Z)
            end
        end)
        _ijConns.hold = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.INFINITY_JUMP then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp and hum.Jump then
                local vel = hrp.Velocity
                if vel.Y < HOLD_CLIMB then
                    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, HOLD_CLIMB, vel.Z)
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopInfinityJump()
        for k, c in pairs(_ijConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end); _ijConns[k] = nil end
    end

    do
    local function _turretEquipBat() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = LP.Character
        for _, src in ipairs({char, LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")}) do
            if src then
                local bat = src:FindFirstChild("Bat")
                if bat and bat:IsA("Tool") then return bat end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function _isEnemyTurret(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not obj or not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local ownerId = obj.Name:match("^Sentry_(%d+)$")
        return ownerId ~= nil and ownerId ~= tostring(LP.UserId)
    end
    local function _turretNoClip(turret) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not _isEnemyTurret(turret) then return end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); turret.CanCollide = false end)
    end
    local function _turretTimeLabel(turret) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not turret or not turret.Parent then return nil end
        local sf = turret:FindFirstChild("SetupFrame")
        local mf = sf and sf:FindFirstChild("MainFrame")
        local tl = mf and mf:FindFirstChild("Time")
        if tl and tl:IsA("TextLabel") then return tl end
        return nil
    end
    local function _shouldAttackTurret(turret) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") ~= nil then return false end
        if not _isEnemyTurret(turret) then return false end
        _turretNoClip(turret)
        local tl = _turretTimeLabel(turret)
        if not tl then return false end
        local ok, text = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return tl.Text end)
        if not ok then return false end
        text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
        return text ~= "" and string.find(text, "^%d+s!$") ~= nil
    end
    local _turretBusy = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local _turretQueued = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local _turretCooldown = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local _turretActive = false
    local function _bringTurretInFront(turret, hrp) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not turret or not hrp then return end
        local forward = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        local targetPos = hrp.Position + forward * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
        local targetCf = CFrame.lookAt(targetPos, targetPos + forward)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            turret.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            turret.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); turret.CFrame = targetCf end)
    end
    local function attackSentry(turret) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local now = os.clock()
        if _turretBusy[turret] or _turretQueued[turret] or _turretActive or not _shouldAttackTurret(turret) then return end
        if (_turretCooldown[turret] or 0) > now then return end
        _turretQueued[turret] = true
        _turretCooldown[turret] = now + 0.3
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            _turretQueued[turret] = nil
            if _turretActive or _turretBusy[turret] or not _shouldAttackTurret(turret) then return end
            _turretActive = true
            _turretBusy[turret] = true
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local attempts = 0
                while attempts < 12 and S.AUTO_TURRET do
                    if not turret or not turret.Parent or not _shouldAttackTurret(turret) then break end
                    local char = LP.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then break end
                    local okD, dist = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return (turret.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude end)
                    if okD and dist > 220 then break end
                    _turretNoClip(turret)
                    _bringTurretInFront(turret, hrp)
                    if not turret or not turret.Parent or not _shouldAttackTurret(turret) then break end
                    local bat = _turretEquipBat()
                    if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
                    bat = (char and char:FindFirstChild("Bat")) or bat
                    if bat then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); bat:Activate() end) end
                    task.wait(0.03)
                    if turret and turret.Parent and _shouldAttackTurret(turret) then
                        _turretNoClip(turret); _bringTurretInFront(turret, hrp)
                    end
                    attempts = attempts + 1
                    task.wait(0.09)
                end
            end)
            _turretBusy[turret] = nil
            _turretActive = false
        end)
    end
    local autoTurretRunning = false
    function S.startAutoTurret()
        if autoTurretRunning then return end
        autoTurretRunning = true
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while S.AUTO_TURRET do
                for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if _isEnemyTurret(obj) then attackSentry(obj) end
                end
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
            autoTurretRunning = false
        end)
    end
    function S.stopAutoTurret()
        S.AUTO_TURRET = false
    end
    end

    do
    -- ── Aimbot v2 — PlayerMouse + AIM_ITEMS whitelist ──────────────────────
    -- Fonctionne uniquement quand un outil de la liste est équipé (sinon inactif).
    -- Heartbeat  = logique de scan + mise à jour PlayerMouse
    -- PreRender  = re-pointe la souris juste avant le rendu (les outils lisent
    --              PlayerMouse.Hit sur leur propre frame)

    local AIM_ITEMS = {}
    for _, n in ipairs({
        "Web Slinger", "Laser Cape", "Paintball Gun", "Body Swap Potion",
    }) do
        AIM_ITEMS[n] = true
    end

    -- Résolution lazy du module PlayerMouse du jeu
    local _pmouse = nil
    local function _getPlayerMouse()
        if _pmouse then return _pmouse end
        pcall(function()
            _pmouse = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.PlayerMouse)
        end)
        return _pmouse
    end

    local aimbotConns     = {}
    local aimbotRange     = 350
    local _aimTarget      = nil   -- BasePart HumanoidRootPart de la cible courante
    local _aimLastScan    = 0

    -- Scan du joueur le plus proche et mise à jour de PlayerMouse
    local function _aimStep()
        if not S.AIMBOT then _aimTarget = nil return end
        local ch  = LP.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tool = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        -- Condition : outil équipé ET dans la whitelist
        if not (hrp and tool and AIM_ITEMS[tool.Name]) then
            _aimTarget = nil
            return
        end
        local mouse = _getPlayerMouse()
        if not mouse then _aimTarget = nil return end
        -- Re-scan toutes les 0.05s ou si la cible a disparu
        if not _aimTarget or not _aimTarget.Parent
            or os.clock() - _aimLastScan >= 0.05 then
            _aimLastScan = os.clock()
            local best, bestD = nil, aimbotRange
            for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local r = pl ~= LP and pl.Character
                    and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h = r and pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestD then best, bestD = r, d end
                end
            end
            _aimTarget = best
        end
        if _aimTarget then
            pcall(function()
                mouse.Hit    = CFrame.new(_aimTarget.Position)
                mouse.Target = _aimTarget
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Re-pointe la souris juste avant le rendu (les outils lisent Hit ici)
    local function _aimPreRender()
        if not (_aimTarget and _aimTarget.Parent) then return end
        local mouse = _pmouse
        if not mouse then return end
        pcall(function()
            mouse.Hit    = CFrame.new(_aimTarget.Position)
            mouse.Target = _aimTarget
        end)
    end

    -- Compatibilité API existante (_aimbotGetNearest utilisé ailleurs dans ENG)
    function ENG._aimbotGetNearest()
        if not S.AIMBOT then return nil end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local myHRP = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHRP then return nil end
        local nearest, shortest = nil, aimbotRange
        for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if pl ~= LP and pl.Character and pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local dist = (pl.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < shortest then shortest = dist; nearest = pl end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end

    -- Stub pour l'ancienne API de hook (non utilisé dans la nouvelle logique
    -- mais préservé pour éviter toute erreur dans le reste du script)
    function ENG._aimbotHookAllInChar(_char) end

    function S.startAimbot()
        -- Nettoyage des connexions précédentes
        for _, c in ipairs(aimbotConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        aimbotConns = {}
        _aimTarget   = nil
        _aimLastScan = 0
        -- Pré-charger le module PlayerMouse dès l'activation
        task.spawn(_getPlayerMouse)
        -- Heartbeat : logique de scan + première mise à jour de la souris
        aimbotConns[#aimbotConns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(_aimStep)
        -- PreRender (ou RenderStepped en fallback) : re-pointe juste avant le rendu
        local preRenderSignal = RunService.PreRender or RunService.RenderStepped
        aimbotConns[#aimbotConns + 1] = preRenderSignal:Connect(_aimPreRender)
    end

    function S.stopAimbot()
        for _, c in ipairs(aimbotConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        aimbotConns = {}
        _aimTarget   = nil
    end
    end

    local unlockGui = nil
    local function isOwnPlot(obj)
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return false end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local isOwned = plot.Name == LP.Name
            if not isOwned then
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase") and sign.YourBase.Enabled then isOwned = true end
            end
            if isOwned and obj:IsDescendantOf(plot) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isNearOther(part, yLevel, threshold)
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                local char = p.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local yD = math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - yLevel)
                    local d = (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                    if yD <= threshold and d <= 60 then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function triggerClosestUnlock(yLevel, maxY)
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local pY = yLevel or hrp.Position.Y
        local TH = 5
        local bestSame, bestSameD = nil, math.huge
        local bestFB, bestFBD = nil, math.huge
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(plots:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and obj.Enabled and not isOwnPlot(obj) then
                local part = obj.Parent
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if not maxY or part.Position.Y <= maxY then
                        local dist = (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                        local yD = math.abs(pY - part.Position.Y)
                        local near = isNearOther(part, pY, TH)
                        if yD <= TH then
                            if near then
                                if dist < bestSameD then bestSameD = dist; bestSame = obj end
                            elseif bestSame == nil and dist < bestFBD then
                                bestFBD = dist; bestFB = obj
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local target = bestSame or bestFB
        if target then
            local orig = target.MaxActivationDistance
            target.MaxActivationDistance = 9999
            pcall(fireproximityprompt, target)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                pcall(function() target.MaxActivationDistance = orig end)
            end)
        end
    end
    function S.showUnlockBase()
        if unlockGui then unlockGui.Enabled = true; return end
        unlockGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", (ok and cg) or LP.PlayerGui)
        unlockGui.Name = PREFIX .. "_UnlockUI"
        unlockGui.Archivable = false
        unlockGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

        local isHorizontal = true
        local BTN_SIZE = 38
        local PADDING = 6
        local H_W = 4 * BTN_SIZE + 5 * PADDING
        local H_H = BTN_SIZE + 2 * PADDING
        local V_W = BTN_SIZE + 2 * PADDING
        local V_H = 4 * BTN_SIZE + 5 * PADDING

        local frame = Instance.new("Frame", unlockGui)
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, H_W, 0, H_H)
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -H_W/2, 0.78, 0)
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
        _paintAs(frame, "panelBg")
        frame.BorderSizePixel = 0; frame.Active = true
        Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.lg)
        local strk = addSmvllStroke(frame, 1)
        strk.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        strk.Color = WHITE
        strk.Transparency = 0.45

        do
            local sheen = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
            sheen.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
            sheen.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            sheen.BorderSizePixel = 0
            sheen.ZIndex = 0
            local sg2 = Instance.new("UIGradient", sheen)
            sg2.Rotation = 90
            sg2.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.9),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
            })
            Instance.new("UICorner", sheen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.lg)
        end

        local oriBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
        oriBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_SIZE, 0, BTN_SIZE)
        oriBtn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
        oriBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
        oriBtn.Text = "↔"
        oriBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
        oriBtn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        oriBtn.TextSize = 18
        oriBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        oriBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", oriBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
        local oriStk = addSmvllStroke(oriBtn, 1)
        oriStk.Color = WHITE
        oriStk.Transparency = 0.78

        local floorBtns = {}
        local floors = {[1]={yLevel=-2, maxY=19},[2]={yLevel=15},[3]={yLevel=32}}
        for i = 1, 3 do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BTN_SIZE, 0, BTN_SIZE)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
            btn.Text = tostring(i)
            btn.TextColor3 = WHITE
            btn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
            btn.TextSize = 16
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
            local bs = addSmvllStroke(btn, 1)
            bs.Color = WHITE
            bs.Transparency = 0.78
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local f = floors[i]
                triggerClosestUnlock(f.yLevel, f.maxY)
                _G_Tween:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.72}):Play()
                task.delay(0.18, function()
                    _G_Tween:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.93}):Play()
                end)
            end)
            floorBtns[i] = btn
        end

        local function applyLayout()
            if isHorizontal then
                frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, H_W, 0, H_H)
                oriBtn.Text = "↔"
                oriBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, PADDING, 0.5, -BTN_SIZE/2)
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    floorBtns[i].Position = UDim2.new(0, PADDING + i * (BTN_SIZE + PADDING), 0.5, -BTN_SIZE/2)
                end
            else
                frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, V_W, 0, V_H)
                oriBtn.Text = "↕"
                oriBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -BTN_SIZE/2, 0, PADDING)
                for i = 1, 3 do
                    floorBtns[i].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -BTN_SIZE/2, 0, PADDING + i * (BTN_SIZE + PADDING))
                end
            end
        end
        applyLayout()
        oriBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            isHorizontal = not isHorizontal
            applyLayout()
        end)

        makeDraggable(frame, frame)
        trackPos(frame, "POS_UNLOCK")
    end
    function S.hideUnlockBase()
        if unlockGui then unlockGui.Enabled = false end
    end

    _G.PotionActive = _G.PotionActive or false
    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() _G.PotionActive = false end)
    local POTION_PROX_RANGE = 8
    local function isPromptInRange(prompt)
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return false end
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end
        local part = prompt.Parent
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part = prompt:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart") or prompt.Parent.Parent
        end
        if not part or not part.Position then return false end
        local d = (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
        return d <= POTION_PROX_RANGE
    end

    local GIANT_THRESHOLD = 1.3
    local HITBOX_NORMAL_Y = 2
    local function _isCurrentlyGiant()
        local c = LP.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return hrp ~= nil and hrp.Size.Y >= HITBOX_NORMAL_Y * GIANT_THRESHOLD
    end
    S._isGiant = _isCurrentlyGiant
    function S.activatePotion(force)
        if not force and not S.AUTO_POTION then return end
        if _isCurrentlyGiant() then return end
        local lp = LP
        local char = lp.Character
        local bp = lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if not char or not bp then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        local potionNames = {"Giant Potion", "Giant", "Grow Potion", "Super Grow", "Potion"}
        local potion
        for _, nm in ipairs(potionNames) do
            local t = bp:FindFirstChild(nm) or char:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if t and t:IsA("Tool") then potion = t break end
        end
        if not potion then return end

        if S.suspendBackpackLock then pcall(S.suspendBackpackLock, 1) end
        pcall(function()
            if potion.Parent ~= char then hum:EquipTool(potion) end
            potion:Activate()
        end)
        _G.PotionActive = true
    end

    local origExecuteSteal = executeSteal
    executeSteal = function(prompt)
        if isStealing or not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return end
        isStealing = true
        pcall(firePromptConn, prompt, "PromptButtonHoldBegan")
        if stealBarFill then
            stealBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
            _G_Tween:Create(stealBarFill, TweenInfo.new(STEAL_DELAY, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)}):Play()
        end
        local POTION_LEAD = 0.1
        task.delay(STEAL_DELAY - POTION_LEAD, function()
            if S.AUTO_POTION and isPromptInRange(prompt) then
                S.activatePotion()
            end
        end)
        task.wait(STEAL_DELAY)
        if prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then
            pcall(firePromptConn, prompt, "Triggered")
        end
        if stealBarFill then stealBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0,0,1,0) end
        task.wait(0.05)
        isStealing = false
    end

    do
        local PPS = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
        local held = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        local function isStealPrompt(p)
            if not p or not p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return false end
            local st = p:GetAttribute("State")
            local at = p.ActionText
            if st == "Steal" or st == "Grab" or at == "Steal" or at == "Grab" then return true end
            return false
        end
        S.isStealPrompt = isStealPrompt
        local function cancelPending(prompt)
            local st = held[prompt]
            if not st then return end
            st.n = st.n + 1
            if st.t then pcall(function() task.cancel(st.t) end); st.t = nil end
        end
        PPS.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr ~= LP or not isStealPrompt(prompt) then return end
            S.HOLDING_STEAL = true
            if not (S.AUTO_POTION and not S.AUTO_STEAL) then return end
            local st = held[prompt]
            if not st then st = {t = nil, n = 0}; held[prompt] = st end
            cancelPending(prompt)
            local myToken = st.n
            local LEAD = 0.1
            st.t = task.delay(math.max(0, (prompt.HoldDuration or 1.0) - LEAD), function()
                st.t = nil
                if myToken ~= st.n then return end
                if not S.AUTO_POTION then return end
                if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then return end
                S.activatePotion()
            end)
        end)
        PPS.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr ~= LP then return end
            if held[prompt] then cancelPending(prompt) end
            S.HOLDING_STEAL = false
        end)
        PPS.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, plr)
            if plr == LP then S.HOLDING_STEAL = false end
        end)
    end

    local boosterConn = nil
    local _origGravity = workspace.Gravity
    local function boosterApply()
        local grav = S.BOOSTER_GRAVITY
        if not grav or grav < 1 then grav = 196.2 end
        workspace.Gravity = grav
    end
    local function boosterRemove()
        workspace.Gravity = _origGravity
    end

    function S.startBooster()
        S.BOOSTER_ENABLED = true
        boosterApply()
        if _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_START then _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_START() end
    end
    function S.stopBooster()
        S.BOOSTER_ENABLED = false
        if boosterConn then boosterConn:Disconnect(); boosterConn = nil end
        boosterRemove()
        if _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_STOP then _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_STOP() end
    end

    function S.desyncReset()
        if _G._SMVLL_InstaReset then
            _G._SMVLL_InstaReset()
        else

            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight - 50, root.Position.Z)
            end
        end
    end
    local balloonConns = {}
    local balloonChildConn = nil
    local function balloonLaunch()
        if _G._SMVLL_InstaReset then
            _G._SMVLL_InstaReset()
        else
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight - 50, root.Position.Z)
            end
        end
    end
    local function hasBalloonText(t)
        if typeof(t) ~= "string" then return false end
        local l = string.lower(t)
        return l:find('ran "balloon" on you!') ~= nil or l:find("jump higher") ~= nil
    end
    local function checkBalloon(t)
        if S.AUTO_RESET_BALLOON and hasBalloonText(t) then balloonLaunch() end
    end
    local function scanBalloonGui(parent)
        for _, obj in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                checkBalloon(obj.Text)
                local c = obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() checkBalloon(obj.Text) end)
                table.insert(balloonConns, c)
            end
        end
    end
    local function setupBalloonWatcher(gui)
        local c = gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
            if desc:IsA("TextLabel") or desc:IsA("TextButton") or desc:IsA("TextBox") then
                checkBalloon(desc.Text)
                local tc = desc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() checkBalloon(desc.Text) end)
                table.insert(balloonConns, tc)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(balloonConns, c)
    end
    function S.startBalloonReset()
        for _, c in ipairs(balloonConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        balloonConns = {}
        if balloonChildConn then pcall(function() balloonChildConn:Disconnect() end) end
        local PG = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        for _, gui in ipairs(PG:GetChildren()) do
            scanBalloonGui(gui); setupBalloonWatcher(gui)
        end
        balloonChildConn = PG.ChildAdded:Connect(function(gui)
            setupBalloonWatcher(gui); scanBalloonGui(gui)
        end)
        for _, obj in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                local c = obj.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
                    if not S.AUTO_RESET_BALLOON then return end
                    for _, arg in ipairs({...}) do
                        if type(arg) == "string" and arg:lower():find("jump higher") then
                            balloonLaunch()
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)
                table.insert(balloonConns, c)
            end
        end
    end
    function S.stopBalloonReset()
        for _, c in ipairs(balloonConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        balloonConns = {}
        if balloonChildConn then pcall(function() balloonChildConn:Disconnect() end); balloonChildConn = nil end
    end

    local autoBlockTask = nil
    local function blockPlayer(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not plr or plr == LP then return end

        if _G.SMVLL_BLOCK_PLAYER then
            pcall(_G.SMVLL_BLOCK_PLAYER, plr)
            return
        end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); StarterGui:SetCore("PromptBlockPlayer", plr) end)
    end
    -- Faster auto block: reacts the instant a steal tool appears in a character
    -- (ChildAdded), with a 0.1s sweep as backup (was: 1.5s poll + 1.5s wait per hit).
    local _blockConns = {}
    local _blockedAt = {}
    local function _isStealTool(it)
        if not it:IsA("Tool") then return false end
        local n = it.Name:lower()
        return n:find("animal") ~= nil or n:find("monkey") ~= nil or n:find("brainrot") ~= nil
    end
    local function _blockIfStealing(p)
        if p == LP or not p.Character then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - (_blockedAt[p] or 0) < 3 then return end
        for _, it in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if _isStealTool(it) then
                _blockedAt[p] = now
                blockPlayer(p)
                return
            end
        end
    end
    local function _hookBlockChar(p, ch)
        if p == LP or not ch then return end
        _blockConns[#_blockConns + 1] = ch.ChildAdded:Connect(function(it)
            if S.AUTO_BLOCK_STEAL and _isStealTool(it) then _blockIfStealing(p) end
        end)
    end
    local function _hookBlockPlayer(p)
        if p == LP then return end
        _hookBlockChar(p, p.Character)
        _blockConns[#_blockConns + 1] = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch) _hookBlockChar(p, ch) end)
    end
    function S.startAutoBlockSteal()
        if autoBlockTask then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do _hookBlockPlayer(p) end
        _blockConns[#_blockConns + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(_hookBlockPlayer)
        _blockConns[#_blockConns + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) _blockedAt[p] = nil end)
        autoBlockTask = task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while S.AUTO_BLOCK_STEAL do
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    _blockIfStealing(p)
                end
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(_blockConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            table.clear(_blockConns)
            table.clear(_blockedAt)
            autoBlockTask = nil
        end)
    end
    function S.stopAutoBlockSteal()
        S.AUTO_BLOCK_STEAL = false
    end

    local invFrame = nil
    local function invisibleClonerCombo()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        local bp = LP:WaitForChild("Backpack")
        if not hum then return end
        local cloak = bp:FindFirstChild("Invisibility Cloak")
        if cloak then
            hum:UnequipTools(); task.wait(0.05)
            hum:EquipTool(cloak); task.wait(0.05)
            pcall(function() cloak:Activate() end)
            task.wait(1)
        end
        local cloner = bp:FindFirstChild("Quantum Cloner")
        if cloner then
            hum:EquipTool(cloner)
            pcall(function() cloner:Activate() end)
        end
    end

    local grappleFrame = nil
    local grappleConns = {}
    local grappleActive = false
    local grappleLastAct = 0
    local GSPD = 60
    local function gEquip() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if not bp then return nil end
        local hook = bp:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook") or char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook")
        if not hook then
            for _, it in ipairs(bp:GetDescendants()) do
                if it.Name == "Grapple Hook" and it:IsA("Tool") then hook = it; break end
            end
            if not hook then return nil end
        end
        if hook.Parent == bp then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum:EquipTool(hook) end
        end
        return hook
    end
    local function gActivate() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if tick() - grappleLastAct < 0.1 then return end
        local re = S.NetResolve and S.NetResolve("UseItem", "RemoteEvent")
        if not re then
            local pkg = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            local net = pkg and pkg:FindFirstChild("Net")
            re = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/UseItem")
        end
        if re then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                re:FireServer(0.33)
                grappleLastAct = tick()
            end)
            return
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hook = char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook")
        if hook and hook:IsA("Tool") then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                hook:Activate(); task.wait(0.05); hook:Deactivate()
                grappleLastAct = tick()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function gMove() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or not hrp:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
        local md = hum.MoveDirection
        if md.Magnitude > 0 then
            local v = md * GSPD
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(v.X, hrp.Velocity.Y, v.Z)
        end

        grappleActive = true
        grappleConns.eq = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if grappleActive then gEquip() end end))
        grappleConns.act = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if grappleActive then gActivate() end end))
        grappleConns.mov = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if grappleActive then gMove() end end))
    end
    local function gStop()
        grappleActive = false
        for _, c in pairs(grappleConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        grappleConns = {}
        local char = LP.Character
        if char then
            local g = char:FindFirstChild("Grapple Hook")
            if g and g:IsA("Tool") then
                local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                if bp then g.Parent = bp end
            end
        end
    end

    local flashToggles = {AutoPotion=false, SpeedBoost=false}

    function ENG.findStealPrompt()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local nearest, dist = nil, 25
        for _, c in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and c.ActionText:lower():find("steal") then
                local part = c.Parent
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local d = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < dist then dist = d; nearest = c end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end
