function S.SyncUI()
    local CLIENT_ONLY = {
        UI_MODE = true, SIMPLE_THEME = true, THEME_PRESET = true, HIDE_WATERMARK = true,
        PLAYER_ESP = true, BRAINROT_ESP = true, CLONE_ESP = true, TIMER_ESP = true,
        MINE_ESP = true, SLOT_ESP = true, NEXT_BASE_ESP = true, LINE_TO_BASE = true, LINE_TO_BEST = true,
        FPS_BOOST = true, FAST_LOAD = true, REMOVE_ANIM_BR = true, STREAMPROOF_TOOL = true,
        FOV_ENABLED = true, HIDE_TRADE_PLAZA = true, BLOCK_PANEL_VISIBLE = true,
        SHOW_PRIORITY_PANEL = true, SHOW_ACTION_PANEL = true, SHOW_BOOSTER_PANEL = true,
        SHOW_GRAPPLE = true, SHOW_INV_CLONER = true,
        SHOW_ALLOW = true, SHOW_EXIT = true,
    }

    local FRAME_BUDGET = 0.004
    local _mark = os.clock()
    local function _breathe() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if os.clock() - _mark >= FRAME_BUDGET then
            task.wait()
            _mark = os.clock()
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local pending, clientOnly = {}, {}
        for _, entry in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_SYNCS) do
            if entry.key and S[entry.key] == true and entry.setter then
                if CLIENT_ONLY[entry.key] then
                    clientOnly[#clientOnly + 1] = entry
                else
                    pcall(entry.setter, true, false, true)
                    pending[#pending + 1] = entry
                    _breathe()
                end
            end
        end

        if #clientOnly > 0 then
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local _m = os.clock()
                for _, entry in ipairs(clientOnly) do
                    pcall(entry.setter, true, true, true)
                    if os.clock() - _m >= FRAME_BUDGET then
                        task.wait()
                        _m = os.clock()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if #pending == 0 then return end

        local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while os.clock() - t0 < 60 do
            local ch  = LP.Character
            local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp and hum.Health > 0 then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        _mark = os.clock()
        for _, entry in ipairs(pending) do
            if S[entry.key] == true then
                pcall(entry.setter, true, true, true)
                _breathe()
            end
        end
    end)
end
end

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    if not S then return end
    local LP = _G_Players.LocalPlayer
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")

    local PREFIX_BB = _G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG 
    local bestBeam, bestBeamA0, bestBeamA1 = nil, nil, nil
    local function _resetBestBeam() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if bestBeam then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); bestBeam:Destroy() end) end
        if bestBeamA0 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); bestBeamA0:Destroy() end) end
        if bestBeamA1 then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); bestBeamA1:Destroy() end) end
        bestBeam, bestBeamA0, bestBeamA1 = nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function _updateBestBeam() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.LINE_TO_BEST then _resetBestBeam(); return end
        if not _G.SMVLL_STEAL then return end
        local list = _G.SMVLL_STEAL.getAllStealables()
        local best, bestN = nil, -1
        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if item.incomeN > bestN then bestN = item.incomeN; best = item end
        end
        if not best or not best.prompt or not best.prompt.Parent then _resetBestBeam(); return end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local targetPart = best.prompt.Parent
        if not targetPart then _resetBestBeam(); return end
        if not bestBeam or not bestBeam.Parent then
            _resetBestBeam()
            bestBeamA0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            bestBeamA0.Name = PREFIX_BB .. "_BestA0"; bestBeamA0.Parent = hrp
            bestBeamA1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            bestBeamA1.Name = PREFIX_BB .. "_BestA1"; bestBeamA1.Parent = targetPart
            bestBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
            bestBeam.Name = PREFIX_BB .. "_BestBeam"
            bestBeam.Attachment0 = bestBeamA0; bestBeam.Attachment1 = bestBeamA1
            bestBeam.FaceCamera = true; bestBeam.LightEmission = 1
            bestBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0))
            bestBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2)
            bestBeam.Width0 = 0.6; bestBeam.Width1 = 0.6
            bestBeam.Parent = hrp
        else
            if bestBeamA1.Parent ~= targetPart then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); bestBeamA1.Parent = targetPart end)
            end
        end
    end
    function S.startLineToBest()
        S.LINE_TO_BEST = true
        pcall(_updateBestBeam)
    end
    function S.stopLineToBest()
        S.LINE_TO_BEST = false
        _resetBestBeam()
    end
    do
        local cnt = 0
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect((function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not S.LINE_TO_BEST then return end
            cnt = cnt + 1
            if cnt >= 20 then
                cnt = 0
                pcall(_updateBestBeam)
            end
        end))
    end

    do
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        local STEAL_MIN, STEAL_MAX, STEAL_DEPTH, STEAL_RATE = 20, 29, 0.5, 2
        local osc, oscDir = nil, 1

        local function stealTop() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            return math.clamp(tonumber(S.BOOSTER_STEAL_SPEED) or 28, STEAL_MIN, STEAL_MAX)
        end

        local function stealReset() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            osc, oscDir = math.max(STEAL_MIN, stealTop() - STEAL_DEPTH), 1
        end
        LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Stealing"):Connect(stealReset)

        local function stealTarget(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local top = stealTop()
            local low = math.max(STEAL_MIN, top - STEAL_DEPTH)
            if top <= low then osc = top return top end
            osc = osc or low
            osc = osc + oscDir * STEAL_RATE * dt
            if osc >= top then osc, oscDir = top, -1
            elseif osc <= low then osc, oscDir = low, 1 end
            return osc
        end

        function S.speedTarget(mount, dt)
            if mount then return tonumber(S.CARPET_SPEED_VALUE) or 75 end
            
            if LP:GetAttribute("GiantPotion") ~= nil or (S._isGiant and S._isGiant()) then
                return S.GP_SPEED and (tonumber(S.GP_SPEED_VALUE) or 37) or nil
            end
            if LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
                if not S.BOOSTER_ON_STEAL then return nil end
                return stealTarget(dt or 0)
            end
            if S.BOOSTER_ENABLED then return tonumber(S.BOOSTER_SPEED) or 60 end
            return nil
        end

        
        
        local _ctrls, _ctrlsTried = nil, false
        local function holdingMove(hum) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not _ctrlsTried then
                _ctrlsTried = true
                pcall(function()
                    _ctrls = require(LP:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 5):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 5)):GetControls()
                end)
            end
            if _ctrls then
                local ok, v = pcall(function() return _ctrls:GetMoveVector() end)
                if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" then return v.Magnitude > 0.05 end
            end
            return hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
        end

        
        
        function S.speedStep(dt, hrp, hum, mount, spoof)
            if S.__DELIVERY_BRAKING then return false end
            local target = S.speedTarget(mount, dt)
            if not target then return false end

            -- Mount (carpet / broom / grapple) — AssemblyLinearVelocity inchangé
            if mount then
                local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                local md = hum.MoveDirection
                local h = md.Magnitude > 0.001 and md.Unit * target or Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(h.X, v.Y, h.Z)
                return true
            end

            -- Cas spoof (steal / GP) — Velocity spoofée côté serveur
            local st = hum:GetState()
            local free = not hum.PlatformStand
                and st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                and st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
                and st ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
            if spoof then
                local v = hrp.Velocity
                if holdingMove(hum) then
                    local md = hum.MoveDirection
                    local unit = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z)
                    if free and unit.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                        unit = unit.Unit
                        hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(unit.X * target, v.Y, unit.Z * target)
                    end
                elseif free and Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude > 0.05 then
                    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, v.Y, 0)
                end
                return true
            end

            -- Cas booster standard — logique directe via Velocity (état Running uniquement)
            if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running and free then
                local moveDirection = hum.MoveDirection
                if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                    hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(
                        moveDirection.X * target,
                        hrp.Velocity.Y,
                        moveDirection.Z * target
                    )
                end
            end
            return true
        end
    end

    
    
    
    
    
    local _velChecked = {}
    local _velHookInstalled = false
    local _hookVelSupported = nil

    
    
    local function _spoofWanted()
        if (LP:GetAttribute("GiantPotion") ~= nil or (S._isGiant and S._isGiant())) and S.GP_SPEED then
            return true
        end
        if LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true and S.BOOSTER_ON_STEAL then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function _installVelHook(hrp)
        if _velHookInstalled or not hrp then return end
        if _hookVelSupported == nil then
            _hookVelSupported = (type(getrawmetatable) == "function")
                and (type(setreadonly) == "function")
                and (type(newcclosure) == "function")
                and (type(checkcaller) == "function")
        end
        if not _hookVelSupported then return end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local mt = getrawmetatable(hrp)
            if not mt then return end
            setreadonly(mt, false)
            local originalVelIndex = rawget(mt, "__index")
            mt.__index = newcclosure(function(self, key)
                if not checkcaller() and _velChecked[self]
                   and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity") then
                    local real
                    if type(originalVelIndex) == "function" then
                        real = originalVelIndex(self, key)
                    elseif type(originalVelIndex) == "table" then
                        real = originalVelIndex[key]
                    end
                    if real and real.Magnitude > 20 then return real.Unit * 20 end
                    return real
                end
                if type(originalVelIndex) == "function" then
                    return originalVelIndex(self, key)
                elseif type(originalVelIndex) == "table" then
                    return originalVelIndex[key]
                end
            end)
            setreadonly(mt, true)
        end)
        if ok then _velHookInstalled = true else _hookVelSupported = false end
    end

    local toolSpeedConn = nil
    local MOUNT_KEYWORDS = {"flying", "carpet", "witch", "broom", "angel", "wing", "sleigh", "santa", "waverider", "cupid", "grapple", "hook"}
    local function _isMountHeld() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return false end
        for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then
                local n = t.Name:lower()
                for _, kw in ipairs(MOUNT_KEYWORDS) do
                    if n:find(kw) then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local _tsDriving = false

    local function _startToolSpeedLoop()
        if toolSpeedConn then return end
        toolSpeedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect((function(_time, dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if os.clock() < (tonumber(rawget(_G, "__SMVLL_RESETTING")) or 0) then
                _tsDriving = false
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then return end
            
            
            local spoof = _spoofWanted()
            if spoof then
                if not _velChecked[hrp] then _velChecked = { [hrp] = true }; _installVelHook(hrp) end
            elseif next(_velChecked) ~= nil then
                _velChecked = {}
            end
            local mount = S.CARPET_SPEED_ENABLED and _isMountHeld()
            local ok, drove = pcall(S.speedStep, dt, hrp, hum, mount, spoof)
            _tsDriving = ok and drove and true or false
        end))
    end
    local function _tsHalt()
        _tsDriving = false
    end

    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() _tsDriving = false end)
    local function _stopToolSpeedLoop()
        if not S.CARPET_SPEED_ENABLED and not S.BOOSTER_ENABLED and not S.BOOSTER_ON_STEAL and not S.GP_SPEED then
            if toolSpeedConn then toolSpeedConn:Disconnect(); toolSpeedConn = nil end
            _tsHalt()
            _velChecked = {}
        end
    end

        _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_START = _startToolSpeedLoop
    _G.__SMVLL_TOOLSPEED_STOP = _stopToolSpeedLoop

    function S.startCarpetSpeed() S.CARPET_SPEED_ENABLED = true; _startToolSpeedLoop() end
    function S.stopCarpetSpeed() S.CARPET_SPEED_ENABLED = false; _stopToolSpeedLoop() end
    function S.startGpSpeed() S.GP_SPEED = true; _startToolSpeedLoop() end
    function S.startStealBoost() S.BOOSTER_ON_STEAL = true; _startToolSpeedLoop() end
    function S.stopStealBoost() S.BOOSTER_ON_STEAL = false; _stopToolSpeedLoop() end

    function S.stopGpSpeed() S.GP_SPEED = false; _stopToolSpeedLoop() end
    function S.setCarpetSpeed(v) S.CARPET_SPEED_VALUE = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 75, 16, 300); S.SaveConfig() end
end)()

    local _adminCmdCache = {}

    local function _adminCacheActivated(guiObject) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local cached = {}
        local ok, conns = pcall(getconnections, guiObject.Activated)
        if ok and type(conns) == "table" then
            for _, conn in ipairs(conns) do
                if type(conn.Function) == "function" then
                    table.insert(cached, conn.Function)
                end
            end
        end
        return cached
    end
    local function _adminFireActivated(cached) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

    end
    local function _adminGetFrames() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ap = LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")

        local inner = ap:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")
        if not inner then return end

        if not content or not profiles then return end
        return content:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame"), profiles:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame")

    local _ADMIN_PLOT_KEY = "f888ee6e-c86d-46e1-93d7-0639d6635d42"
    local _adminRemote = nil

    local function _adminRunCommand(cmdName, target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        _execCommand(cmdName, target)

    local _lastFiredStamp = {}

    local function _adminGetAdminSF() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ok, sf = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            return LP.PlayerGui.AdminPanel.AdminPanel.Content.ScrollingFrame
        end)

    end

    local function _adminIsOnCooldown(cmdName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if tick() - (_lastFiredStamp[cmdName] or 0) < 0.5 then return true end
        local sf = _adminGetAdminSF()
        if not sf then return false end
        local f = sf:FindFirstChild(cmdName)
        if not f then return false end
        local t = f:FindFirstChild("Timer")
        return t and t.Visible == true
    end

    local function _adminGetCooldownText(cmdName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local sf = _adminGetAdminSF()
        if not sf then return nil end
        local f = sf:FindFirstChild(cmdName)
        if not f then return nil end
        local t = f:FindFirstChild("Timer")
        if not t or not t.Visible then return nil end
        return t.Text or ""
    end

    local function _adminSetCooldown(cmdName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        _lastFiredStamp[cmdName] = tick()
    end

    local function _isAdminUUID(s) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return type(s) == "string" and #s == 36
            and s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x$") ~= nil
    end

    S.AllowReflect = false
    _resolveAdminRemote = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _adminRemote then return _adminRemote end

        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local pkgs = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            local net = pkgs and pkgs:FindFirstChild("Net")
            if not net then return end
            local children = net:GetChildren()
            local byIdx, byName = {}, {}
            for i, obj in ipairs(children) do byIdx[i] = obj; byName[obj.Name] = i end
            local anchorIdx = byName["RF/a0e78691-cb9b-4efc-ac08-9c06fea70059"]
            if anchorIdx then
                local actual = byIdx[anchorIdx + 1]
                if actual and actual:IsA("RemoteFunction") then _adminRemote = actual end
            end
        end)
        if _adminRemote or not S.AllowReflect then return _adminRemote end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local pkgs = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
            local net = pkgs and pkgs:FindFirstChild("Net")
            if not net then return end
            local getupvals = (debug and debug.getupvalues) or getupvalues
            local getconsts = (debug and debug.getconstants) or getconstants
            local controllers = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
            local apc = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("AdminPanelController")
            if apc and getupvals and getconsts then
                local okm, mod = pcall(require, apc)
                if okm then
                    local seen, queue = {}, {}
                    if type(mod) == "table" then for _, v in pairs(mod) do if type(v) == "function" then queue[#queue+1] = v end end
                    elseif type(mod) == "function" then queue[1] = mod end
                    local depth = 0
                    while #queue > 0 and depth < 8000 and not _adminRemote do
                        depth = depth + 1
                        local fn = table.remove(queue, 1)
                        if type(fn) == "function" and not seen[fn] then
                            seen[fn] = true
                            local o1, u = pcall(getupvals, fn)
                            if o1 and type(u) == "table" then for _, x in pairs(u) do
                                if type(x) == "function" then queue[#queue + 1] = x
                                elseif typeof(x) == "Instance" and x:IsA("RemoteFunction") and x:IsDescendantOf(net) then _adminRemote = _adminRemote or x
                                elseif _isAdminUUID(x) then _ADMIN_PLOT_KEY = x end
                            end end
                            local o2, cst = pcall(getconsts, fn)
                            if o2 and type(cst) == "table" then for _, x in pairs(cst) do
                                if type(x) == "function" then queue[#queue + 1] = x
                                elseif typeof(x) == "Instance" and x:IsA("RemoteFunction") and x:IsDescendantOf(net) then _adminRemote = _adminRemote or x
                                elseif _isAdminUUID(x) then _ADMIN_PLOT_KEY = x end
                            end end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        return _adminRemote
    end
    _resolvePlayerInst = function(who) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if typeof(who) == "Instance" and who:IsA("Player") then return who end
        return Players:FindFirstChild(tostring(who))
    end
    local _apLastUse = {}
    local _apDelay = 0

    local function _apGap() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return 0.12 + math.random() * 0.10
    end
    local _AP_COOLDOWNS = {
        ragdoll = 30, jail = 60, rocket = 120, balloon = 30, inverse = 30,
        jumpscare = 30, tiny = 30, morph = 30, nightvision = 30, control = 30,
    }

    local function _apReadRealTimer(cmd)
        local g = LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")
        if not g then return nil end
        local ok, content = pcall(function() return g.AdminPanel.Content.ScrollingFrame end)
        if not ok or not content then return nil end
        local cmdBtn = content:FindFirstChild(cmd)
        if not cmdBtn then return nil end
        local timer = cmdBtn:FindFirstChild("Timer")
        if not timer then return 0 end
        if timer:IsA("GuiObject") and not timer.Visible then return 0 end
        return tonumber(tostring(timer.Text):match("%d+")) or 0
    end

    local function _apRemaining(cmd)
        local rt = _apReadRealTimer(cmd)
        if rt ~= nil then return rt end
        local l = _apLastUse[cmd]
        if not l then return 0 end
        return math.max(0, (_AP_COOLDOWNS[cmd] or 0) - (tick() - l))
    end

    local function _apOnCooldown(cmd) return _apRemaining(cmd) > 0 end
    S.AdminOnCooldown = _apOnCooldown
    S.AdminRemaining  = _apRemaining

    local _apAvailCache, _apAvailAt = false, 0
    local function _apAvailable()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - _apAvailAt < 1 then return _apAvailCache end
        _apAvailAt = now
        local g = LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")
        if not g then _apAvailCache = false; return false end
        local ok, content = pcall(function() return g.AdminPanel.Content.ScrollingFrame end)
        _apAvailCache = (ok and content ~= nil) and true or false
        return _apAvailCache
    end
    S.AdminAvailable = _apAvailable

    local function _apFireClick(btn) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not btn then return end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections and getconnections(btn.MouseButton1Click) or {}) do conn:Fire() end
        end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections and getconnections(btn.Activated) or {}) do conn:Fire() end
        end)
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); btn.MouseButton1Click:Fire() end)
    end

    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    local _adminTokCache, _adminTokPV
    local function _resolveAdminToken() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local pv = game.PlaceVersion
        if _adminTokCache and _adminTokPV == pv then return _adminTokCache end
        local tok
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local dec = decompile or (syn and syn.decompile)
            if type(dec) ~= "function" then return end
            local ctrls = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
            local ic = ctrls and ctrls:FindFirstChild("ItemController")
            if not ic then return end
            local ok, src = pcall(dec, ic)
            if not ok or type(src) ~= "string" then return end
            local _rf, _tok = src:match('Net:RemoteFunction%("([%w%-]+)"%):InvokeServer%("([%w%-]+)"')
            if _tok then tok = _tok end
        end)
        _adminTokCache = tok or "fcec6acb-8d1e-4fa1-8d84-fbe0f52f5f0c"
        _adminTokPV = pv
        return _adminTokCache
    end

    _execCommand = function(cmd, who) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local targetPlayer = _resolvePlayerInst(who)
        if not targetPlayer or not cmd then return false end
        if _apOnCooldown(cmd) then return false end

        local directRemote = _resolveAdminRemote()
        local adminTok = _resolveAdminToken()
        if directRemote and adminTok then
            _apLastUse[cmd] = tick()
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    directRemote:InvokeServer(adminTok, targetPlayer, cmd)
                end)
            end)
            return true
        end

        local g = LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel") or LP.PlayerGui:WaitForChild("AdminPanel", 3)
        if not g then
            return false
        end

        local wasEnabled = g.Enabled
        g.Enabled = true

        local okC, content = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return g.AdminPanel.Content.ScrollingFrame end)
        if not okC or not content then g.Enabled = wasEnabled; return false end
        local cmdBtn = content:FindFirstChild(cmd)
        if not cmdBtn then g.Enabled = wasEnabled; return false end
        _apFireClick(cmdBtn)
        if _apDelay > 0 then task.wait(_apDelay) end

        local okP, profiles = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return g.AdminPanel.Profiles.ScrollingFrame end)
        if not okP or not profiles then g.Enabled = wasEnabled; return false end
        local pBtn = profiles:FindFirstChild(targetPlayer.Name)
        if not pBtn then
            for _, ch in ipairs(profiles:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("GuiButton") then
                    local nl = ch:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                    if nl and (nl.Text == targetPlayer.Name or nl.Text == targetPlayer.DisplayName) then pBtn = ch; break end
                end
            end
        end
        if not pBtn then g.Enabled = wasEnabled; return false end
        _apFireClick(pBtn)
        _apLastUse[cmd] = tick()
        task.delay(0.05, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); if g and g.Parent then g.Enabled = wasEnabled end end)
        return true
    end
    S.ExecuteAdminCommand = _execCommand

    local function fireAdmin(...) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local args = { ... }
        local target, cmd = args[2], args[3]
        if type(cmd) == "string" then
            _execCommand(cmd, target)
            return
        end
        local remote = _resolveAdminRemote()
        if not remote then return end
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end) end)
    end

    do

        local function getH() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local cnt = #Players:GetPlayers() - 1

        local function runCooldownLoop() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if cooldownLoopRunning then return end
            cooldownLoopRunning = true
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                while quickAdminFrame and quickAdminFrame.Parent and quickAdminFrame.Visible do
                    for _, cmd in ipairs(adminCmds) do
                        local cdText = _adminGetCooldownText(cmd.name)
                        for _, e in ipairs(cooldownBtns[cmd.name]) do
                            local b, emoji = e[1], e[2]
                            if b and b.Parent then
                                if cdText then
                                    b.Text = cdText; b.TextSize = 9
                                    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160,160,160)
                                    b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
                                else
                                    b.Text = emoji; b.TextSize = 14
                                    b.TextColor3 = WHITE
                                    b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(1)
                end
                cooldownLoopRunning = false
            end)
        end

        function S.showQuickAdminPanel()
            if quickAdminFrame and quickAdminFrame.Parent then
                quickAdminFrame.Visible = true
                return
            end
            local f, tb, mBtn, content = buildSmvllPanel({
                name = PREFIX .. "_QuickAdminPanel", title = "Quick Admin Panel",

            layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()

            noLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120); noLbl.TextSize = 12
            noLbl.Visible = true

            local minimized = false

            local function refresh() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                for _, c in ipairs(adminCmds) do cooldownBtns[c.name] = {} end
                for _, child in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
                end
                local order = 1
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= LP then
                        makeRow(sf, plr, order)
                        order = order + 1
                    end
                end
                noLbl.Visible = (order == 1)
                if not minimized then
                    TweenService:Create(f, TW_FAST, {Size=UDim2.new(0,PW,0,getH())}):Play()
                end
                runCooldownLoop()
            end

            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.3)
                if quickAdminFrame and quickAdminFrame.Parent then refresh() end
            end)
            Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
                _adminProfileCache[plr.Name] = nil
                task.wait(0.3)
                if quickAdminFrame and quickAdminFrame.Parent then refresh() end
            end)
            task.defer(refresh)

            mBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                minimized = not minimized
                if minimized then
                    content.Visible = false
                    TweenService:Create(f, TW_FAST, {Size=UDim2.new(0,PW,0,26)}):Play()
                else
                    TweenService:Create(f, TW_FAST, {Size=UDim2.new(0,PW,0,getH())}):Play()
                    task.wait(0.15); content.Visible = true
                    refresh()
                end
                S.MIN_QUICK_ADMIN = minimized; S.SaveConfig()
            end)
            if S.MIN_QUICK_ADMIN then
                minimized = true
                content.Visible = false
                f.Size = UDim2.new(0,PW,0,26)
            end

            makeDraggable(tb, f)
            trackPos(f, "POS_QUICK_ADMIN")
            quickAdminFrame = f
        end

            if quickAdminFrame then quickAdminFrame.Visible = false end
        end

    local adminSpammerFrame = nil
    local _adminSpamListenersSet = false
    local spamCooldown = {}
    local function spamPlayer(p) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not S.AdminAvailable() then return end
        if not p or p == LP then return end
        local uid = p.UserId
        if spamCooldown[uid] and tick() - spamCooldown[uid] < 1.5 then return end
        spamCooldown[uid] = tick()
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, c in ipairs({ "balloon", "ragdoll", "jumpscare", "rocket", "jail" }) do
                fireAdmin(_ADMIN_PLOT_KEY, p, c)
                task.wait(_apGap())
            end
        end)
    end
    local function getClosestPlayerAdmin()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local closest, minD = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local pHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if pHrp then
                    local d = (hrp.Position - pHrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minD then minD = d; closest = p end
                end
            end
        end
        return closest
    end

    local nextPack = "1st"
    local function doSpamClosest()
        local closest = getClosestPlayerAdmin()
        if not closest or not S.AdminAvailable() then return end
        local pack = (nextPack == "1st") and S.SPAM_PACK_1 or S.SPAM_PACK_2
        if type(pack) ~= "table" or #pack == 0 then return end
        local char = closest.Character
        if char then
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 10000, 0) end
        end
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, c in ipairs(pack) do
                fireAdmin(_ADMIN_PLOT_KEY, closest, c)
                task.wait(_apGap())
            end
        end)
        nextPack = (nextPack == "1st") and "2st" or "1st"
    end

    function S.showAdminSpammer()
        if adminSpammerFrame and adminSpammerFrame.Parent then
            adminSpammerFrame.Visible = true

        end
        local PW = 240

        })

        local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", content)
        sf.Size = UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-(6 + BOTTOM_RESERVED))
        sf.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,6)
        sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1; sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
        sf.ScrollBarThickness = 3; sf.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)

        layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()

        end)

        local function makeCard(plr, order) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local isSelf = (plr == LP)
            local card = Instance.new("TextButton", sf)

            nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-44,0,14); nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,40,0,6)
            nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            -- Si c'est toi : affiche "YOU" en vert, sinon DisplayName en blanc
            if isSelf then

            sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1; sub.Text = "@" .. plr.Name
            sub.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; sub.TextColor3 = GREEN
            _paintAs(sub, "accentText")
            sub.TextSize = 10; sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        end

        local function refresh() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, child in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
            end
            -- Tri par distance (nearest first), LP excluded
            local myHRP = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local others = {}
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LP then
                    local dist = math.huge
                    if myHRP then
                        local hrp2 = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp2 then dist = (myHRP.Position - hrp2.Position).Magnitude end
                    end
                    others[#others+1] = {plr = plr, dist = dist}
                end
            end
            table.sort(others, function(a,b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
            for i, entry in ipairs(others) do
                makeCard(entry.plr, i)
            end
        end
        refresh()
        -- Connexions créées une seule fois (guard _adminSpamListenersSet)
        -- pour éviter les doubles refresh si showAdminSpammer est rappelé plusieurs fois
        if not _adminSpamListenersSet then
            _adminSpamListenersSet = true
            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                if adminSpammerFrame and adminSpammerFrame.Parent then refresh() end
            end)
            Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
                task.wait(0.5)
                if adminSpammerFrame and adminSpammerFrame.Parent then refresh() end
            end)
        end

        local bottomBar = Instance.new("Frame", content)
        bottomBar.Name = "BottomBar"
        bottomBar.Size = UDim2.new(1,-12,0,BTN_H)
        bottomBar.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,1,-(BTN_H + 6))
        bottomBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        local spamBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", bottomBar)
        spamBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-32,1,0); spamBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
        spamBtn.Text = "Spam Closest [→ 1st]"; spamBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
        spamBtn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; spamBtn.TextSize = 11
        spamBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        styleActionButton(spamBtn)

        local arrowBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", bottomBar)
        arrowBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,26,1,0); arrowBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-26,0,0)
        arrowBtn.Text = "⚙"; arrowBtn.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(arrowBtn, "accentText")
        arrowBtn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; arrowBtn.TextSize = 14
        arrowBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        styleActionButton(arrowBtn)

        local function updateBtnText() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local kb = _G.SMVLL_HUB and _G.SMVLL_HUB.KEYBINDS and _G.SMVLL_HUB.KEYBINDS.kb_spam
            spamBtn.Text = "Spam Closest [→ " .. nextPack .. "]" .. (kb and ("  [" .. kb .. "]") or "")
        end
        updateBtnText()

        spamBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            doSpamClosest()
            updateBtnText()
        end)
        if _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND then
            _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.register("kb_spam", function() doSpamClosest(); updateBtnText() end, nil, "Spam Closest")
            _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.attachLongPress(spamBtn, "kb_spam")
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local last = nil
                while spamBtn.Parent do
                    local cur = _G.SMVLL_HUB and _G.SMVLL_HUB.KEYBINDS and _G.SMVLL_HUB.KEYBINDS.kb_spam
                    if cur ~= last then last = cur; updateBtnText() end
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end

        local AVAIL = {"balloon","ragdoll","rocket","jail","jumpscare","tiny","inverse","morph"}
        local function isIn(packKey, cmd)
            local p = S[packKey]
            if type(p) ~= "table" then return false end
            for _, c in ipairs(p) do if c == cmd then return true end end
            return false
        end
        local function toggleIn(packKey, cmd)
            local p = S[packKey]
            if type(p) ~= "table" then p = {}; S[packKey] = p end
            for i, c in ipairs(p) do
                if c == cmd then
                    table.remove(p, i)
                    if S.SaveConfig then S.SaveConfig() end
                    return false
                end
            end
            table.insert(p, cmd)
            if S.SaveConfig then S.SaveConfig() end
            return true
        end

        local pTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", pTb)
        pTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,0); pTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1,-12,1,0)
        pTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        pTitle.Text = "Pack Picker"; pTitle.TextColor3 = WHITE
        pTitle.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; pTitle.TextSize = 12
        pTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        pTitle.ZIndex = 52

        local headY = PICK_TITLE_H + 2

        head.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,headY)

        head.ZIndex = 51
        local hCmd = Instance.new("TextLabel", head)
        hCmd.Size = UDim2.new(0,100,1,0); hCmd.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0)
        hCmd.BackgroundTransparency = 1; hCmd.Text = "Command"
        hCmd.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; hCmd.TextColor3 = WHITE; hCmd.TextSize = 11
        hCmd.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        hCmd.ZIndex = 52
        local h1 = Instance.new("TextLabel", head)
        h1.Size = UDim2.new(0,30,1,0); h1.Position = UDim2.new(1,-76,0,0)
        h1.BackgroundTransparency = 1; h1.Text = "1st"
        h1.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; h1.TextColor3 = GREEN; h1.TextSize = 11
        _paintAs(h1, "accentText")
        h1.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        h1.ZIndex = 52
        local h2 = Instance.new("TextLabel", head)
        h2.Size = UDim2.new(0,30,1,0); h2.Position = UDim2.new(1,-38,0,0)
        h2.BackgroundTransparency = 1; h2.Text = "2st"
        h2.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; h2.TextColor3 = GREEN; h2.TextSize = 11
        _paintAs(h2, "accentText")
        h2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        h2.ZIndex = 52

        local function makeBox(parent, packKey, cmd, posX)
            local box = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)

        for i, cmd in ipairs(AVAIL) do

            nl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; nl.Text = cmd
            nl.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; nl.TextColor3 = WHITE; nl.TextSize = 11

            local x1 = PICK_W - 12 - 70

        arrowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            pickerFrame.Visible = not pickerFrame.Visible

            minimized = not minimized

    local defenseFrame = nil
    local _defensePlot = nil
    local _myStealHitbox = nil
    local _defensePunishDebounce = {}
    local _hitboxStates = {}
    local _defLastCmdUsed = nil
    local _findDefensePlot
    local _getDefensePodiums
    local _defensePodiums = {}

    local _isPlayerInHitbox = (function(plr, hitbox) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not plr.Character then return false end
        local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end
        local rel = hitbox.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
        local half = hitbox.Size / 2
        return math.abs(rel.X) <= half.X and math.abs(rel.Y) <= half.Y and math.abs(rel.Z) <= half.Z
    end)

    local _isStealing = (function(plr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ok, attr = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return plr:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
        return ok and attr ~= nil
    end)

    _findDefensePlot = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        local myName = LP.DisplayName
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            if plot:IsA("Model") then
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign then
                    local sg = sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
                    local fr = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
                    local tl = fr and fr:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
                    if tl and tl.Text == (myName .. "'s Base") then return plot end
                end
            end
        end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            if plot:IsA("Model") then
                local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
                if sign then
                    local yb = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
                    if yb and yb:IsA("BillboardGui") and yb.Enabled then return plot end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _getDefensePodiums = function(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local pos = {}
        local folder = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if not folder then return pos end
        for i = 1, 10 do
            local p = folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(i))
            if p then table.insert(pos, p:GetPivot().Position) end
        end
        return pos
    end

    local function _resolveDefenseTargets() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not _defensePlot or not _defensePlot.Parent then
            _defensePlot = _findDefensePlot()
            _myStealHitbox = nil
            _defensePodiums = {}
        end
        if _defensePlot then
            if not _myStealHitbox or not _myStealHitbox.Parent then
                _myStealHitbox = _defensePlot:FindFirstChild("StealHitbox", true)
            end
            if #_defensePodiums == 0 then
                _defensePodiums = _getDefensePodiums(_defensePlot)
            end
        end
    end

    _G.SMVLL_DEF = {
        isPlayerInHitbox = _isPlayerInHitbox,
        isStealing = _isStealing,
        getStealHitbox = function() _resolveDefenseTargets(); return _myStealHitbox end,
        resolveTargets = _resolveDefenseTargets,
    }

    local _hitboxStates = {}

    local function _adminCmdAvailable(cmdName)
        local cf = _adminGetFrames()
        if not cf then return false end
        local cb = cf:FindFirstChild(cmdName)
        if not cb then return false end
        for _, d in ipairs(cb:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local t = tostring(d.Text or ""):gsub("%s","")
                if t:match("^%d+s$") or t:match("^%d+%.%d+s$") then
                    return false
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local _defensePrecached = false
    local function _defensePrecache() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local cf = _adminGetFrames()
        if not cf then return end
        for _, c in ipairs({"balloon", "ragdoll", "laser", "jail"}) do
            local cb = cf:FindFirstChild(c)
            if cb and not _adminCmdCache[c] then
                _adminCmdCache[c] = _adminCacheActivated(cb)
            end
        end
        _defensePrecached = true
    end
    local function _defenseFireCmds(target, cmds) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not target or target.Parent ~= Players then return end
        do
            local name = (typeof(target) == "Instance" and target.Name) or tostring(target)
            task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                for _, c in ipairs(cmds) do S.ExecuteAdminCommand(c, name) end
            end)
            return
        end
        local cf, pf = _adminGetFrames()
        if not cf or not pf then
            for _, c in ipairs(cmds) do task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _adminRunCommand(c, target) end) end
            return
        end
        local pb = pf:FindFirstChild(target.Name)
        if not pb then return end
        if not _adminProfileCache[target.Name] then
            _adminProfileCache[target.Name] = _adminCacheActivated(pb)
        end
        local profileConns = _adminProfileCache[target.Name]
        for _, c in ipairs(cmds) do
            local cb = cf:FindFirstChild(c)
            if cb then
                if not _adminCmdCache[c] then
                    _adminCmdCache[c] = _adminCacheActivated(cb)
                end
                _adminFireActivated(profileConns)
                _adminFireActivated(_adminCmdCache[c])
            end
        end
    end
    local function _skIsCmdAvailable(cmdName) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        -- Only report "unavailable" when a cooldown Timer is really visible.
        -- Unknown / missing frames count as available so defense never gets stuck.
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            local cf = _adminGetFrames()
            if not cf then return true end
            local btn = cf:FindFirstChild(cmdName)
            if not btn then return true end
            local t = btn:FindFirstChild("Timer")
            if t and t.Visible == true then return false end
            return true
        end)
        if not ok then return true end
        return res
    end

    local _defenseStealCount = {}
    local _defenseLastPunishTime = {}
    local _laserCapeRemote = nil
    local _laserCapeCooldownUntil = 0

    local function _resolveLaserCapeRemote() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _laserCapeRemote and _laserCapeRemote.Parent then return _laserCapeRemote end
        -- try NetResolve first
        if S.NetResolve then
            local ok, r = pcall(S.NetResolve, "UseItem", "RemoteEvent")
            if ok and typeof(r) == "Instance" then _laserCapeRemote = r; return r end
        end
        -- fallback: PaintballHitted constant scan (same as aimbot)
        local pkg = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
        local net = pkg and pkg:FindFirstChild("Net")
        if not net then return nil end
        local getconns = (debug and debug.getconnections) or getconnections
        local getconsts = (debug and debug.getconstants) or getconstants
        if getconns and getconsts then
            for _, r in ipairs(net:GetChildren()) do
                if r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    local ok, conns = pcall(getconns, r.OnClientEvent)
                    if ok and conns then
                        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
                            if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                                local okc, consts = pcall(getconsts, c.Function)
                                if okc and consts then
                                    for _, k in ipairs(consts) do
                                        if k == "PaintballHitted" then
                                            _laserCapeRemote = r; return r
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- Equip Laser Cape and fire it at the target's HumanoidRootPart
    local function _fireLaserCapeAt(target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if tick() < _laserCapeCooldownUntil then return false end
        if not target or not target.Character then return false end
        local tHRP = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHRP then return false end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local cape = (char:FindFirstChild("Laser Cape")) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Laser Cape"))
        if not cape then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and cape.Parent == bp then hum:EquipTool(cape) end
        task.wait(0.05)
        local re = _resolveLaserCapeRemote()
        if re then
            local pos = tHRP.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); re:FireServer(pos, tHRP) end)
            _laserCapeCooldownUntil = tick() + 1.5
            warn("[DEF] laser cape → " .. target.Name)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    local function _defensePunish(target) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not target then return end
        local uid = target.UserId

        if _defensePunishDebounce[uid] then return end
        _defensePunishDebounce[uid] = true
        task.delay(2, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _defensePunishDebounce[uid] = nil end)

        if _defenseLastPunishTime[uid] and (tick() - _defenseLastPunishTime[uid]) >= 30 then
            _defenseStealCount[uid] = nil
            _defenseLastPunishTime[uid] = nil
        end

        _defenseStealCount[uid] = (_defenseStealCount[uid] or 0) + 1
        if _defenseStealCount[uid] == 1 then
            _defenseLastPunishTime[uid] = tick()
        end

        local hasAdmin = S.AdminAvailable and S.AdminAvailable()

        if not hasAdmin then
            -- No admin panel: always laser the thief with Laser Cape
            if S.AP_DEF_LASER_NO_ADMIN ~= false then
                _fireLaserCapeAt(target)
            end
            return
        end

        -- Has admin panel: use whichever enabled command is NOT on cooldown
        -- (balloon on cooldown -> ragdoll, ragdoll on cooldown -> balloon).
        -- Fixed: the old `x and f() or true` always evaluated to true, so cooldowns were never seen.
        local balloonOK = S.DEF_USE_BALLOON ~= false and (not _skIsCmdAvailable or _skIsCmdAvailable("balloon"))
        local ragdollOK = S.DEF_USE_RAGDOLL ~= false and (not _skIsCmdAvailable or _skIsCmdAvailable("ragdoll"))

        local cmd
        if balloonOK then
            cmd = "balloon"
        elseif ragdollOK then
            cmd = "ragdoll"
        else
            -- both on cooldown (or disabled): laser with Laser Cape if DEF_USE_LASER enabled
            if S.DEF_USE_LASER ~= false then
                _fireLaserCapeAt(target)
            end
            return
        end

        warn("[DEF] " .. target.Name .. " (hit #" .. _defenseStealCount[uid] .. ") → " .. cmd)
        _defenseFireCmds(target, {cmd})
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while true do
            task.wait(1.5)
            if S.DEF_SAFETY_KICK and S.AUTO_DEFENSE then
                local balloonOK = _skIsCmdAvailable("balloon")
                local ragdollOK = _skIsCmdAvailable("ragdoll")
                if (not balloonOK) and (not ragdollOK) then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); game:Shutdown() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local _defenseScan = (function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.AUTO_DEFENSE and S.AdminAvailable() then
                if not _defensePrecached then _defensePrecache() end
                _resolveDefenseTargets()
                if _myStealHitbox then
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr ~= LP then
                            local uid = plr.UserId
                            local insideNow = _isPlayerInHitbox(plr, _myStealHitbox)
                            local prev = _hitboxStates[uid]
                            if insideNow then
                                if prev == nil then
                                    if _isStealing(plr) then
                                        _hitboxStates[uid] = "in"
                                        _defensePunish(plr)
                                    end
                                elseif prev == "out" then
                                    if _isStealing(plr) then
                                        _hitboxStates[uid] = "in"
                                        _defensePunish(plr)
                                    end
                                elseif prev == "in" then
                                    if _isStealing(plr) then
                                        _defensePunish(plr)
                                    end
                                end
                            else
                                if prev == "in" then
                                    _hitboxStates[uid] = "out"
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
    end)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while true do
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            _defenseScan()
        end
    end)

    local _wasOnPodium = {}
    local _antiTpScan = (function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if S.ANTI_TP_SCAM and S.AdminAvailable() then
                _resolveDefenseTargets()
                if _defensePlot and #_defensePodiums > 0 then
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                            local uid = plr.UserId
                            local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            local onPodium = false
                            if root then
                                for _, p in ipairs(_defensePodiums) do
                                    if (root.Position - p).Magnitude < 12 then
                                        onPodium = true; break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if onPodium and not _wasOnPodium[uid] then
                                _defenseFireCmds(plr, {"balloon","tiny","rocket","inverse","jumpscare","morph"})
                            end
                            _wasOnPodium[uid] = onPodium
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
    end)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while true do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            _antiTpScan()
        end
    end)

    -- LASER PROTECTOR: auto-fire Laser Cape at anyone stealing from your base
    local _laserProtectDebounce = {}
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while true do
            task.wait(0.15)
            if S.LASER_PROTECT then
                _resolveDefenseTargets()
                if _myStealHitbox then
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                            local uid = plr.UserId
                            if _isPlayerInHitbox(plr, _myStealHitbox) and _isStealing(plr) then
                                if not _laserProtectDebounce[uid] then
                                    _laserProtectDebounce[uid] = true
                                    _fireLaserCapeAt(plr)
                                    task.delay(2, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); _laserProtectDebounce[uid] = nil end)
                                end
                            else
                                _laserProtectDebounce[uid] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        _hitboxStates[plr.UserId] = nil
        _defenseStealCount[plr.UserId] = nil
        _defenseLastPunishTime[plr.UserId] = nil
        _wasOnPodium[plr.UserId] = nil
        _defensePunishDebounce[plr.UserId] = nil
    end)

    function S.showDefensePanel()
        if defenseFrame and defenseFrame.Parent then
            defenseFrame.Visible = true
            return
        end
        local PW = 220
        local FULL_H = 26 + 6 + 24*2 + 4 + 6
        local f, tb, mBtn, content = buildSmvllPanel({
            name = PREFIX .. "_DefensePanel", title = "AP Defense",
            width = PW, height = FULL_H,
            position = UDim2.new(1, -(PW+20), 0.5, -FULL_H/2),
        })

        if S.DEF_USE_BALLOON == nil then S.DEF_USE_BALLOON = true end
        if S.DEF_USE_RAGDOLL == nil then S.DEF_USE_RAGDOLL = true end
        if S.DEF_USE_LASER == nil then S.DEF_USE_LASER = true end
        if S.DEF_BALLOON_FIRST == nil then S.DEF_BALLOON_FIRST = true end
        if S.DEF_RAGDOLL_FIRST == nil then S.DEF_RAGDOLL_FIRST = false end
        if S.DEF_SAFETY_KICK == nil then S.DEF_SAFETY_KICK = false end

        local gearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", tb)
        gearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,20,0,18)
        gearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-52,.5,-9)
        gearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,40,15)
        _paintAs(gearBtn, "offBg")
        gearBtn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD; gearBtn.Text = "\226\154\153"
        gearBtn.TextColor3 = GREEN
        _paintAs(gearBtn, "accentText")
        gearBtn.TextSize = 14
        gearBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        gearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        gearBtn.ZIndex = 30
        Instance.new("UICorner", gearBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
        local gearStk = addSmvllStroke(gearBtn, 0.6); gearStk.Transparency = 0.5

        local settingsPopup = nil
        gearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if settingsPopup and settingsPopup.Parent then
                settingsPopup:Destroy(); settingsPopup = nil
                f.ClipsDescendants = true
                return
            end
            local opts = {
                {"Use Balloon",    "DEF_USE_BALLOON",         "toggle"},

                local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsPopup)

                row.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local RS  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    function AFX.ApplyMutation(model, animalName, mutName)
        if not mutName or mutName == "None" then return end

        local ok2, mutData = pcall(function() return require(RS.Datas.Mutations) end)
        local palette = MUT_PALETTES[mutName]
        if ok2 and mutData and mutData[mutName] and mutData[mutName].Palettes then
            palette = mutData[mutName].Palettes[1] or palette
        end
        if mutName == "Rainbow" then model:AddTag("RainbowModel"); return end

        local descendants = model:GetDescendants()
        for _, v in ipairs(descendants) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:GetAttribute("IgnoreColor") then
                pcall(function()
                    if palette then
                        local mv = v.MaterialVariant
                        if mv == "Strawberry Stud Light" or mv == "Strawberry Stud Dark" then
                            v.MaterialVariant = mutName .. " Strawberry Stud Light"
                        else
                            local colorIdx = tonumber(v:GetAttribute(mutName .. "*Color") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1) or 1
                            colorIdx = math.clamp(colorIdx, 1, #palette)
                            local col = palette[colorIdx] or palette[1]
                            if col then
                                local surfApp = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                                if surfApp then surfApp:Destroy() end
                                v.Color = col
                                if v:GetAttribute("Neon") then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if mutName == "Galaxy" then
                        if (v:GetAttribute("GalaxyColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1) == 1 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                        v.MaterialVariant = "Galaxy Stud"
                    elseif mutName == "Lava" then
                        if (v:GetAttribute("LavaColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1) == 1 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                    elseif mutName == "YinYang" then
                        local c = v:GetAttribute("YinYangColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1
                        if c == 3 or c == 4 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                    elseif mutName == "Divine" then
                        local c = v:GetAttribute("DivineColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1
                        if c == 2 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                        if v:GetAttribute("Divine*Stud") == false then
                            v.MaterialVariant = ""
                        elseif v.MaterialVariant == "Custom Stud" or v:GetAttribute("Divine*Stud") == true or (c ~= 2 and c ~= 6) then
                            v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            v.MaterialVariant = "Divine Stud"
                        end
                    elseif mutName == "Radioactive" then
                        local c = v:GetAttribute("RadioactiveColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1
                        if c == 2 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                        if v:GetAttribute("Radioactive*Stud") == false then
                            v.MaterialVariant = ""
                        elseif v.MaterialVariant == "Custom Stud" or v:GetAttribute("Radioactive*Stud") == true or (c ~= 2 and c ~= 6) then
                            v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            v.MaterialVariant = "Radioactive Stud"
                        end
                    elseif mutName == "Cursed" then
                        local c = v:GetAttribute("CursedColor") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1
                        if c == 2 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
                        if v:GetAttribute("Cursed*Stud") == false then
                            v.MaterialVariant = ""
                        elseif v.MaterialVariant == "Custom Stud" or v:GetAttribute("Cursed*Stud") == true or (c ~= 2 and c ~= 6) then
                            v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            v.MaterialVariant = "Cursed Stud"
                            v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 23, 23)
                        end
                        local sa2 = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                        if sa2 then
                            if not v:GetAttribute("Cursed*IgnoreSurfaceColor") then sa2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 23, 23) end
                            if v:GetAttribute("IgnoreSurface") then sa2:Destroy() end
                        end
                    elseif mutName == "Cyber" and v.Transparency ~= 1 then
                        local c = tonumber(v:GetAttribute("Cyber*Color") or v:GetAttribute("Color") or 1) or 1
                        local surfApp = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                        if v:GetAttribute("Eyes") then
                            v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 155, 255); v.Transparency = 0.25; v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; return
                        end
                        if c == 7 then v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        elseif c == 4 then
                            v.Transparency = 0.5; v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            v.MaterialVariant = "Tech Stud"; v.Color = Color3.fromRGB(62, 155, 255)
                        elseif c == 3 then
                            v.Material = Enum.Material.Glass; v.Transparency = 0.5
                            if not surfApp and v.ClassName == "MeshPart" then Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance").Parent = v end
                        elseif c == 1 then
                            v.Material = Enum.Material.Glass; v.Transparency = 0.25
                            if not surfApp and v.ClassName == "MeshPart" then Instance.new("SurfaceAppearance").Parent = v end
                        end
                        surfApp = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceAppearance")
                        if surfApp then
                            local vol = v.Size.X * v.Size.Y * v.Size.Z
                            v.Transparency = 0; v.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                            surfApp.AlphaMode = Enum.AlphaMode.Overlay
                            surfApp.EmissiveTint = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                            if vol > 3 then
                                surfApp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 75, 115); surfApp.EmissiveStrength = 50
                            else
                                surfApp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 25, 30); surfApp.EmissiveStrength = 25
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local vfxFolder = RS.Vfx:FindFirstChild(mutName)
            local vfxInst = model:FindFirstChild("VfxInstance")
            if vfxFolder and vfxInst then
                for _, vfx in ipairs(vfxFolder:GetChildren()) do
                    pcall(function() vfx:Clone().Parent = vfxInst end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function AttachViaRigidConstraint(clone, model)
        for _, part in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("MeshPart") or part:IsA("Model") then
                for _, att in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if att:IsA("Attachment") then
                        local target = model:FindFirstChild(att.Name, true)
                        if target and target:IsA("Attachment") then
                            local rc = Instance.new("RigidConstraint")
                            rc.Attachment0 = att; rc.Attachment1 = target; rc.Parent = part
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function alignTraitClone(clone, model)
        for _, att in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if att:IsA("Attachment") then
                local target = model:FindFirstChild(att.Name, true)
                if target and target:IsA("Attachment") then
                    local t = target.WorldCFrame * att.WorldCFrame:Inverse()
                    if clone:IsA("Model") then
                        pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(t * clone:GetPivot()) end)
                    elseif clone:IsA("BasePart") then
                        clone.CFrame = t * clone.CFrame
                    end
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function anchorClone(clone)
        for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true; d.CanCollide = false end
        end
        if clone:IsA("BasePart") then clone.Anchored = true; clone.CanCollide = false end
    end

    function AFX.traitNames(traitList) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local list = {}
        if typeof(traitList) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(traitList) do
                if type(k) == "number" then list[#list + 1] = tostring(v) else list[#list + 1] = tostring(k) end
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    function AFX.ApplyTraits(model, animalName, traitList)
        if not traitList then return end
        local list = AFX.traitNames(traitList)
        if #list == 0 then return end

        local tap       = RS.Models and RS.Models:FindFirstChild("TraitsPerAnimal")
        local modTraits = RS.Models and RS.Models:FindFirstChild("Traits")
        local vfxTraits = RS.Vfx and RS.Vfx:FindFirstChild("Traits")
        local rootPart  = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
            or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        for _, traitName in ipairs(list) do
            pcall(function()
                if model:FindFirstChild("_Trait." .. traitName) then return end
                local source
                if tap then
                    local tf = tap:FindFirstChild(traitName)
                    source = tf and tf:FindFirstChild(animalName)
                end
                if not source and modTraits then source = modTraits:FindFirstChild(traitName) end
                local vfxSource
                if not source and vfxTraits then vfxSource = vfxTraits:FindFirstChild(traitName) end
                if source then
                    local clone = source:Clone()
                    clone.Name = "_Trait." .. traitName
                    local aligned = alignTraitClone(clone, model)
                    clone.Parent = model
                    if not aligned then AttachViaRigidConstraint(clone, model) end
                    anchorClone(clone)
                elseif vfxSource then
                    local clone = vfxSource:Clone()
                    clone.Name = "_Trait." .. traitName
                    local aligned = alignTraitClone(clone, model)
                    if not aligned and rootPart then
                        local vfxPart = clone:FindFirstChild("VfxInstance") or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if vfxPart and vfxPart:IsA("BasePart") then vfxPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame end
                    end
                    clone.Parent = model
                    anchorClone(clone)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
