    local _templateCache = {}
    local _templateIndex = _G._FH_TEMPLATE_INDEX or {}
    local _templateIndexBuilt = _G._FH_TEMPLATE_INDEX_BUILT or false
    local function _buildTemplateIndex() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _templateIndexBuilt then return end
        _templateIndexBuilt = true
        _G._FH_TEMPLATE_INDEX_BUILT = true
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local animalsFolder = RS:FindFirstChild("Models") and RS.Models:FindFirstChild("Animals")
            if not animalsFolder then return end
            for _, d in ipairs(animalsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if d:IsA("Model") then
                    local key = string.lower(d.Name)
                    if _templateIndex[key] == nil then
                        _templateIndex[key] = d
                    end
                end
            end
            _G._FH_TEMPLATE_INDEX = _templateIndex
        end)
    end
    function AFX.getTemplate(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _templateCache[name] ~= nil then
            local v = _templateCache[name]
            return v ~= false and v or nil
        end
        local ok, v = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return RS.Models.Animals[name] end)
        if ok and v then _templateCache[name] = v; return v end
        local lower = string.lower(name)
        _buildTemplateIndex()
        local found = _templateIndex[lower]
        _templateCache[name] = found or false
        return found
    end
    function AFX.getAnimFolder(name)
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return RS.Animations.Animals[name] end); return ok and v or nil
    end

    function AFX.makeViewport(parent, opts) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        opts = opts or {}
        local name    = opts.name or "?"
        local zIdx    = opts.zindex or 54
        local boxSize = opts.size   or UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 58)
        local boxPos  = opts.pos    or UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, -29)

        local box = Instance.new("Frame")
        box.Name                   = "AnimalBadge"
        box.Size                   = boxSize
        box.Position               = boxPos
        box.BackgroundColor3       = T.BgDeep
        box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        box.BorderSizePixel        = 0
        box.ZIndex                 = zIdx
        box.ClipsDescendants       = true
        box.Parent                 = parent
        Corner(box, opts.corner or 6)
        addSmvllStroke(box, 1).Transparency = 0.3

        local initials = name:match("%S") or "?"
        local main = Lbl(box, string.upper(initials), 24, T.TextDim, Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
        main.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        main.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        main.TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        main.ZIndex                 = zIdx + 1

        if opts.mutation and opts.mutation ~= "None" then
            local badge = Lbl(box, tostring(opts.mutation):sub(1, 2):upper(), 8, T.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
            badge.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 12)
            badge.Position               = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 4)
            badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            badge.BackgroundColor3       = T.Card
            badge.ZIndex                 = zIdx + 4
            Corner(badge, 4)
        end

        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local template = opts.model or AFX.getTemplate(name)
            if not (template and box.Parent) then return end
            local ok, clone = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return template:Clone() end)
            if not ok or not clone then return end

            for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    d.CanCollide = false
                    d.Anchored   = false
                    d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    if d.Transparency < 0.95 then d.Transparency = 0 end
                elseif d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d:Destroy() end)
                end
            end

            local root = clone.PrimaryPart
                or clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if not root then clone:Destroy(); return end
            clone.PrimaryPart = root
            root.Anchored = true

            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)) end)

            if not opts.model then
                if opts.mutation and opts.mutation ~= "None" then
                    pcall(AFX.ApplyMutation, clone, name, tostring(opts.mutation))
                end
                if opts.traits then
                    local list = AFX.traitNames(opts.traits)
                    if #list > 0 then pcall(AFX.ApplyTraits, clone, name, list) end
                end
                
                
                for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then
                        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); d:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end

            local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
            vp.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            vp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            vp.BorderSizePixel        = 0
            vp.ZIndex                 = zIdx + 2
            vp.Ambient                = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            vp.LightColor             = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            vp.LightDirection         = Vector3.new(-0.5, -1, -0.6)

            local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
            world.Parent = vp
            clone.Parent = world

            local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
            cam.FieldOfView = 40
            vp.CurrentCamera = cam
            cam.Parent = vp

            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local _, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
                local radius = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.6
                local dist   = radius / math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView / 2))
                local rc     = root.CFrame
                local dir    = (rc.LookVector + rc.RightVector * 0.7).Unit
                cam.CFrame   = CFrame.new(rc.Position + dir * dist + Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.12, 0), rc.Position)
            end)

            if not box.Parent then vp:Destroy(); clone:Destroy(); return end
            vp.Parent    = box
            main.Visible = false

            if opts.model then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    local host = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        or clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
                    if not host then host = Instance.new("AnimationController"); host.Parent = clone end
                    local animator = host:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", host)
                    local anim = clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
                    if not anim then
                        local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
                        local afa = RS:FindFirstChild("Animations") and RS.Animations:FindFirstChild("Animals")
                        local folder = afa and afa:FindFirstChild(name)
                        anim = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild("Walk") or folder:FindFirstChild("Move")
                            or folder:FindFirstChild("Idle") or folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true))
                    end
                    if anim and anim:IsA("Animation") then
                        local tr = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
                        tr.Looped = true
                        tr:Play()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        return box
    end

    return AFX
end)()

    local _qgLastSig = nil
    local function _refreshQuickGrabList() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not quickGrabContentList or not quickGrabContentList.Parent then return end

        if S.getScanList then list = S.getScanList() end
        if #list == 0 and _G.SMVLL_STEAL then
            local vlist = _G.SMVLL_STEAL.getAllStealables()
            table.sort(vlist, function(a, b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return a.incomeN > b.incomeN end)
            for _, item in ipairs(vlist) do
                list[#list+1] = { name=item.name, gen=item.incomeN, mutation=item.mutation, income=item.income,
                    getPrompt=function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); return item.prompt end }
            end
        end

        local query = tostring(_G._SMVLL_QGSearch or "")
        if query ~= "" then
            local kept = {}
            for _, it in ipairs(list) do
                local hay = string.lower(tostring(it.name or "") .. " " .. tostring(it.mutation or ""))
                if string.find(hay, query, 1, true) then kept[#kept+1] = it end
            end
            list = kept
        end

        local sp = {}
        for _, it in ipairs(list) do sp[#sp+1] = tostring(it.plot)..":"..tostring(it.slot)..":"..tostring(it.name)..":"..tostring(it.mutation) end

        local sig = query .. "#" .. table.concat(sp, "|")
        if sig == _qgLastSig then return end
        _qgLastSig = sig
        for _, c in ipairs(quickGrabContentList:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
        end

            n = tonumber(n) or 0
            local s,i = {"","K","M","B","T","Qa"},1
            while n>=1000 and i<#s do n=n/1000;i=i+1 end
            return string.format(i==1 and "$%d%s/s" or "$%.1f%s/s", n, s[i])
        end

    end

local function b64decode(data) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local natives = {}
    local function try(fn) if type(fn) == "function" then table.insert(natives, fn) end end
    if type(crypt) == "table" then
        try(crypt.base64decode)
        try(crypt.base64_decode)
        if type(crypt.base64) == "table" then try(crypt.base64.decode) end
    end
    try(base64decode)
    try(base64_decode)
    if type(base64) == "table" then try(base64.decode) end
    for _, fn in ipairs(natives) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn, data)
        if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then return res end
    end

    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local map = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do map[alphabet:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end
    local out, bits, nbits = {}, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #data do
        local v = map[data:sub(i, i)]
        if v then
            bits, nbits = bits * 64 + v, nbits + 6
            if nbits >= 8 then
                nbits = nbits - 8
                out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(bits / 2 ^ nbits) % 256)
                bits = bits % (2 ^ nbits)
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local HUB_FOLDER = "SMVLL HUB"
local CONFIG_FOLDER = HUB_FOLDER .. "/Config"
local FONT_FOLDER = HUB_FOLDER .. "/Fonts"

pcall(function()
    if not isfolder(HUB_FOLDER) then
        makefolder(HUB_FOLDER)
    end
    if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then
        makefolder(CONFIG_FOLDER)
    end
    if not isfolder(FONT_FOLDER) then
        makefolder(FONT_FOLDER)
    end
end)




pcall(function()
    local old = HUB_FOLDER .. "/Icons"
    if type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder(old) then
        if type(listfiles) == "function" and type(delfile) == "function" then
            local ok, files = pcall(listfiles, old)
            if ok and type(files) == "table" then
                for _, f in ipairs(files) do pcall(delfile, f) end
            end
        end
        if type(delfolder) == "function" then pcall(delfolder, old) end
    end
end)

local function embeddedAsset(fileName, payload) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local ok, id = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end

        
        local folder = FONT_FOLDER

        
        
        
        
        local fp = tostring(#payload) .. "_" .. (payload:sub(1, 6) .. payload:sub(-6)):gsub("%W", "")
        local path = folder .. "/" .. fp .. "_" .. fileName

        if type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(path) then
            local cok, cid = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
            if cok and type(cid) == "string" and cid ~= "" then return cid end
        end

        writefile(path, b64decode(payload:gsub("%s", "")))

        return getcustomasset(path)
    end)

    if ok and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
        return id
    end

    return nil
end

local MOTION = { speed = 0.22, style = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad }
local TW_FAST   = TweenInfo.new(0.15, MOTION.style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local TW_SPRING = TweenInfo.new(0.22, MOTION.style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function refreshMotion()
    TW_FAST   = TweenInfo.new(MOTION.speed * 0.68, MOTION.style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TW_SPRING = TweenInfo.new(MOTION.speed,        MOTION.style, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end

local SURFACE_IDLE  = 0.94
local SURFACE_HOVER = 0.88
local SURFACE_ON    = 0.90

local function surface(obj, level) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    obj.BackgroundTransparency = level or SURFACE_IDLE
    obj.BorderSizePixel = 0
end

local ROLE_SLOT = {
    accentText = "RoleText", whiteText = "RoleText", dimText = "RoleText",
    onBg = "RoleBg", offBg = "RoleBg", tabBg = "RoleBg",
    panelBg = "RoleBg", accentBg = "RoleBg",
    scrollBar = "RoleScroll",
}
local function paintAs(obj, role) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj then return end
    obj:SetAttribute(ROLE_SLOT[role] or "Role", role)
end

local function applyRole(obj, role, p)
    if role == "accentText" then obj.TextColor3 = p.accent
    elseif role == "whiteText" then obj.TextColor3 = WHITE
    elseif role == "dimText" then obj.TextColor3 = p.dim
    elseif role == "onBg" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.on
    elseif role == "offBg" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.off
    elseif role == "tabBg" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.tabAct
    elseif role == "panelBg" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.bg
    elseif role == "accentBg" then obj.BackgroundColor3 = p.accent
    elseif role == "scrollBar" then obj.ScrollBarImageColor3 = p.accent
    end
end

local allStrokes = {}

local function strokeSeq() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local pal = THEME.livePal or _tp
    if (THEME.simpleLive or _tp.simpleMode) and pal.stkDim then
        return ColorSequence.new(pal.stkDim)
    end

    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(pal.accent)
    local mid = pal.accent2 or Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.85, math.max(v * 0.78, 0))
    return ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   pal.accent),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, mid),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   pal.accent),
    })
end


THEME.titles = {}
function THEME.titleSeq() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local pal = THEME.livePal or _tp
    local a = pal.accent
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(a)
    local b = pal.accent2 or Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.55, math.min(1, v * 0.7 + 0.3))
    return ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, a),
    })
end
function THEME.flowTitle(lbl) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", lbl)
    g.Color = THEME.titleSeq()
    table.insert(THEME.titles, g)
    return g
end




THEME.main  = Color3.fromRGB(120, 92, 255)
THEME.grad  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
THEME.speed = 90
function THEME.buildCustom() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(THEME.main)
    v = math.max(v, 0.45)
    THEME_PRESETS[4] = {
        accent  = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v),
        accent2 = THEME.grad,
        bg      = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.3, 0.05),
        text    = WHITE,
        dim     = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.9, v * 0.82),
        on      = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.9, v * 0.72),
        off     = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, 0.16),
        knobOff = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.35, 0.7),
        tabAct  = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.8, v * 0.4),
        stkDim  = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.5, 0.25),
    }
end
THEME.buildCustom()

THEME.glassLive = false
THEME.glassAlpha = 0.55
THEME.glassOutline = true
THEME.shells = {}
THEME.presetNames = { "Green", "Grey", "Rose", "Custom", "Glass" }
function THEME.buildGlass() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(THEME.main)
    v = math.max(v, 0.55)
    THEME_PRESETS[5] = {
        accent  = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v),
        accent2 = THEME.grad,
        bg      = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14),
        text    = WHITE,
        dim     = Color3.fromRGB(196, 196, 204),
        on      = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.9, v * 0.82),
        off     = Color3.fromRGB(72, 72, 80),
        knobOff = Color3.fromRGB(228, 228, 234),
        tabAct  = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.8, v * 0.4),
        stkDim  = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 88),
        glass   = true,
    }
end
THEME.buildGlass()
function THEME.shell(obj, t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj then return end
    obj:SetAttribute("GlassShell", t)
    table.insert(THEME.shells, obj)
    if THEME.glassLive then obj.BackgroundTransparency = THEME.glassAlpha end
end
function THEME.shellT(obj, t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if THEME.glassLive and obj and obj:GetAttribute("GlassShell") ~= nil then return THEME.glassAlpha end
    return t
end
function THEME.setShell(obj, t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj then return end
    obj:SetAttribute("GlassShell", t)
    if not THEME.glassLive then obj.BackgroundTransparency = t end
end
function THEME.reshell() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not THEME.glassLive then return end
    for i = #THEME.shells, 1, -1 do
        local o = THEME.shells[i]
        if not (o and o.Parent) then table.remove(THEME.shells, i)
        else pcall(function() o.BackgroundTransparency = THEME.glassAlpha end) end
    end
end
function THEME.line(obj, t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj then return obj end
    obj:SetAttribute("GlassLine", t or obj.BackgroundTransparency)
    if THEME.glassLive then obj.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
    return obj
end
function THEME.lineT(obj, t) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if THEME.glassLive and obj and obj:GetAttribute("GlassLine") ~= nil then return 1 end
    return t
end
function THEME.only(obj, glassOnly) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not obj then return end
    if glassOnly then
        obj:SetAttribute("GlassOnly", true)
        obj.Visible = THEME.glassLive
    else
        obj:SetAttribute("GlassHide", true)
        if THEME.glassLive then
            obj:SetAttribute("GlassVis", obj.Visible)
            obj.Visible = false
        end
    end
end
function THEME.strokeOn(parent) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if not THEME.glassLive then return true end
    return THEME.glassOutline == true and parent ~= nil and parent:GetAttribute("GlassShell") ~= nil
end
function THEME.glassObj(obj, a) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local g = THEME.glassLive
    if a.GlassShell ~= nil then obj.BackgroundTransparency = g and THEME.glassAlpha or a.GlassShell end
    if a.GlassLine ~= nil then obj.BackgroundTransparency = g and 1 or a.GlassLine end
    if a.GlassOnly then obj.Visible = g end
    if a.GlassHide then
        if g then
            if a.GlassVis == nil then obj:SetAttribute("GlassVis", obj.Visible) end
            obj.Visible = false
        elseif a.GlassVis ~= nil then
            obj.Visible = a.GlassVis
            obj:SetAttribute("GlassVis", nil)
        end
    end
    if (not g) and a.GlassFullH then
        obj.Size = UDim2.new(obj.Size.X.Scale, obj.Size.X.Offset, 0, a.GlassFullH)
        obj:SetAttribute("GlassFullH", nil)
    end
end

local function addStroke(parent, thickness) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", parent)
    stk.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."Stroke")
    stk.Color = WHITE
    stk.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stk.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stk.Enabled = THEME.strokeOn(parent)
    local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient", stk)
    grad.Color = strokeSeq()
    grad.Rotation = 0
    table.insert(allStrokes, grad)
    return stk, grad
end

function THEME.restroke() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    for i = #allStrokes, 1, -1 do
        local g = allStrokes[i]
        local stk = g and g.Parent
        if stk then pcall(function() stk.Enabled = THEME.strokeOn(stk.Parent) end) end
    end
end

local function refreshStrokes()
    local seq = strokeSeq()
    for i = #allStrokes, 1, -1 do
        local g = allStrokes[i]
        if not (g and g.Parent) then table.remove(allStrokes, i)
        else pcall(function() g.Color = seq end) end
    end
    seq = THEME.titleSeq()
    for i = #THEME.titles, 1, -1 do
        local g = THEME.titles[i]
        if not (g and g.Parent) then table.remove(THEME.titles, i)
        else pcall(function() g.Color = seq end) end
    end
end

local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos, clickStartPos, isDragging = false, nil, nil, nil, false
    local dragInput = nil
    handle.Active = true

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, dragStart, clickStartPos = true, input.Position, input.Position
            startPos, isDragging = target.Position, false
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
            end)
        end
    end)
    handle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
            if dragging and clickStartPos and (input.Position - clickStartPos).Magnitude > 5 then
                isDragging = true
            end
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging and isDragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            target.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)
end

local SNOW = { on = true }

local function makeSnow(parent)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while parent.Parent do
            if not (SNOW.on and parent.Visible) then task.wait(0.4) continue end
            local s = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
            s.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(2,3), 0, math.random(2,3))
            s.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, -0.05, 0)
            s.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
            s.BackgroundTransparency = math.random(3,7)/10
            s.BorderSizePixel = 0; s.ZIndex = 1
            Instance.new("UICorner", s).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
            local dur = math.random(15,30)/10
            TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                Position = UDim2.new(s.Position.X.Scale + math.random(-2,2)/10, 0, 1.1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            }):Play()
            Debris:AddItem(s, dur)
            task.wait(0.14)
        end
    end)
end

end

_G.SMVLL_HIDE_GUI(screenGui)

if _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND and _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.attachTree then
    for i, r in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_UI_ROOTS or { screenGui }) do pcall(_G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.attachTree, r, "r" .. i) end
end

screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false



do
    local rot, acc = 0, 0
    local rootOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function spin(list)
        for i = 1, #list do
            local g = list[i]
            local r = rootOf[g]
            if r == nil and g.Parent then
                local o = g.Parent
                while o.Parent and o.Parent ~= screenGui do o = o.Parent end
                if o.Parent == screenGui and o:IsA("GuiObject") then r = o
                elseif o == game then r = false end
                rootOf[g] = r
            end
            if r and r.Visible and g.Parent then g.Rotation = rot end
        end
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        local sp = tonumber(THEME.speed) or 0
        if sp <= 0 then return end
        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < 1 / 30 then return end
        rot = (rot + sp * acc) % 360
        acc = 0
        spin(allStrokes)
        spin(THEME.titles)
    end)
end

end

    px = px or 150
    return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. tostring(id):match("%d+") .. "&w=" .. px .. "&h=" .. px
end

local _iconCache = {}

local function icon(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if _iconCache[name] ~= nil then
        return _iconCache[name] or nil
    end
    local id = ICON_ASSET[name] and decalImage(ICON_ASSET[name])
    _iconCache[name] = id or false
    return id
end

local function familyFromTTF(ttfFile, descFile, familyName)
    local ok, id = pcall(function()
        if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" or not isfile(ttfFile) then return nil end
        local ttf = getcustomasset(ttfFile)
        writefile(descFile, string.format(
            '{"name":"%s","faces":['
            .. '{"name":"Regular","weight":400,"style":"normal","assetId":"%s"},'
            .. '{"name":"Bold","weight":700,"style":"normal","assetId":"%s"},'
            .. '{"name":"Heavy","weight":900,"style":"normal","assetId":"%s"}]}',
            familyName, ttf, ttf, ttf))
        return getcustomasset(descFile)
    end)
    if ok and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then return id end
    return nil
end

local WM = {
    mode    = 1,
    refresh = 0.5,
    tint    = Color3.fromRGB(226, 226, 232),
}
local WM_MODES = { "Name, FPS, Ping", "Name, FPS", "Name only", "FPS, Ping" }

local wmLastFps, wmLastPing = 0, 0

local function setWmText(fps, ping) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    wmLastFps, wmLastPing = fps, ping
    local c = string.format("%02X%02X%02X",
        math.floor(WM.tint.R * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(WM.tint.G * 255 + 0.5),
        math.floor(WM.tint.B * 255 + 0.5))
    local name = 'SmvllHub <font color="#B9B9C2">v3.0</font>'
    local f = string.format('<font color="#%s">%d</font> <font color="#9C9CA4">FPS</font>', c, fps)
    local p = string.format('<font color="#%s">%d</font> <font color="#9C9CA4">ms</font>', c, ping)
    local gap = '<font color="#6E6E76">    </font>'
    local dot = '<font color="#6E6E76">  ·  </font>'

    local m = WM.mode
    if m == 2 then
        wmTop.Text = name .. gap .. f
    elseif m == 3 then
        wmTop.Text = name
    elseif m == 4 then
        wmTop.Text = f .. dot .. p
    else
        wmTop.Text = name .. gap .. f .. dot .. p
    end
end
setWmText(0, 0)

makeDraggable(wmFrame, wmFrame)

task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    while wmTop.Parent do
        local fps = math.floor(workspace:GetRealPhysicsFPS())
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())
        end)

        if fps ~= wmLastFps or ping ~= wmLastPing then
            setWmText(fps, ping)
        end
        task.wait(math.clamp(WM.refresh, 0.5, 5))
    end
end)

local function makeIcon(parent, name, size, colour) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", parent)
    img.Name = "Icon_" .. name
    img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    img.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
    img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    img.Image = icon(name) or ""
    img.ImageColor3 = colour or WHITE
    img.ZIndex = 8
    return img
end

local TW_POP = TweenInfo.new(0.13, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local function popIcon(img, spin)
    local base = UDim2.new(0, img.Size.X.Offset, 0, img.Size.Y.Offset)
    if img:GetAttribute("BaseW") then
        base = UDim2.new(0, img:GetAttribute("BaseW"), 0, img:GetAttribute("BaseW"))
    else
        img:SetAttribute("BaseW", img.Size.X.Offset)
    end
    TweenService:Create(img, TW_POP, { Size = base + UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5) }):Play()
    task.delay(0.13, function()
        if img.Parent then
            TweenService:Create(img, TW_SPRING, { Size = base }):Play()
        end
    end)
    if spin then
        img.Rotation = 0
        TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { Rotation = 140 }):Play()
    end
end

    local img = makeIcon(b, iconName, 13, Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 172))
    img.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    img.ZIndex = 7

        THEME.only(img, false)
    else
        THEME.only(b, false)
    end

    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = THEME.glassLive and 1 or (danger and 0.15 or 0.88)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(img, TW_FAST, {ImageColor3 = WHITE}):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(img, TW_FAST, {ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 172)}):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        popIcon(img)
        onClick(img)
    end)
    return b, img
end

local DISCORD = "discord.gg/SmvllHub"

local function copyToClipboard(text)
    local fns = {}
    if type(setclipboard)  == "function" then table.insert(fns, setclipboard)  end
    if type(toclipboard)   == "function" then table.insert(fns, toclipboard)   end
    if type(set_clipboard) == "function" then table.insert(fns, set_clipboard) end
    for _, fn in ipairs(fns) do
        if pcall(fn, text) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local DRAG = { fn = nil, inp = nil }

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if not DRAG.fn then return end

    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        DRAG.fn(i.Position)
    elseif i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        if DRAG.inp and i ~= DRAG.inp then return end
        DRAG.fn(i.Position)
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if DRAG.inp and i ~= DRAG.inp then return end
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        DRAG.fn = nil
        DRAG.inp = nil
    end
end)

local function addResizeGrip(frame, minW, minH)
    local HANDLE, ICON = (uiIsMobile() and 34 or 20), 60

    local grip = Instance.new("TextButton")
    grip.Name = "Resize_" .. frame.Name
    grip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    grip.Size = UDim2.new(0, HANDLE, 0, HANDLE)
    grip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    grip.Text = ""
    grip.AutoButtonColor = false
    grip.Active = true
    grip.Parent = frame.Parent

    local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", grip)
    icon.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    icon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(ICON / 6), 0.5, -(ICON / 6))
    icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, ICON, 0, ICON)
    icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    icon.Image = "rbxassetid://120997033468887"
    icon.ImageTransparency = 0.8

    local function syncZ() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        grip.ZIndex = frame.ZIndex + 1
        icon.ZIndex = grip.ZIndex
    end
    syncZ()
    frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ZIndex"):Connect(syncZ)

    local function follow() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local p, s = frame.Position, frame.Size

        local sc = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        local k = (sc and sc.Scale > 0) and sc.Scale or 1
        grip.Position = UDim2.new(
            p.X.Scale + s.X.Scale * k, p.X.Offset + s.X.Offset * k,
            p.Y.Scale + s.Y.Scale * k, p.Y.Offset + s.Y.Offset * k)
    end
    follow()
    frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(follow)
    frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(follow)

    local scaleConn = nil
    local function watchScale() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local sc = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        if sc then
            if scaleConn then scaleConn:Disconnect() end
            scaleConn = sc:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(follow)
        end
        follow()
    end
    watchScale()
    frame.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if c:IsA("UIScale") then watchScale() end
    end)

    local function place() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not grip.Parent then return end
        grip.Visible = frame.Visible
            and frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") ~= true
    end
    place()
    frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(place)
    frame:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SmvllCollapsed"):Connect(place)

    frame.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not frame.Parent then
            grip:Destroy()
        elseif grip.Parent ~= frame.Parent then
            grip.Parent = frame.Parent
            follow()
        end
    end)

    local dragging, armed, startPos, startW, startH = false, false, nil, 0, 0

    local function fade(a, dur)
        TweenService:Create(icon,
            TweenInfo.new(dur or 0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            { ImageTransparency = a }):Play()
    end
    grip.MouseEnter:Connect(function() fade(0.35, 0.1) end)
    grip.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if not dragging then fade(0.8, 0.17) end end)

    local function scaleOf()
        local k = 1
        local node = frame
        while node and node ~= screenGui do
            local sc = node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
            if sc then k = k * sc.Scale end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return (k > 0) and k or 1
    end

    local function onMove(pos)
        if not dragging then return end
        local d = pos - startPos

        if not armed then

            if math.abs(d.X) < 10 and math.abs(d.Y) < 10 then return end
            armed = true
        end
        local k = scaleOf()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vs = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(
            0, math.clamp(startW + d.X / k, frame:GetAttribute("SmvllMinW") or minW, vs.X / k - 16),
            0, math.clamp(startH + d.Y / k, minH, vs.Y / k - 16))
    end

    grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, armed = true, false
            startPos = i.Position

            startW = frame.Size.X.Offset
            startH = frame.Size.Y.Offset

            if startW <= 0 or startH <= 0 then
                local k = scaleOf()
                startW = frame.AbsoluteSize.X / k
                startH = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y / k
            end

            DRAG.fn = onMove
            DRAG.inp = i
            fade(0.35, 0.1)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            dragging, armed = false, false
            if DRAG.fn == onMove then DRAG.fn = nil; DRAG.inp = nil end
            fade(0.8, 0.17)
        end
    end)
    return grip
end

addResizeGrip(panel, 330, 230)

local themeDots = {}
local function applyTheme(idx)
    if idx == 4 then THEME.buildCustom() elseif idx == 5 then THEME.buildGlass() end
    THEME.preset = idx
    local p = themeGetPreset()
    THEME.livePal = p
    THEME.simpleLive = (p.simpleMode == true)
    THEME.glassLive = (p.glass == true)

    GREEN, BG = p.accent, p.bg
    ON_COLOR, OFF_COLOR, KNOB_OFF = p.on, p.off, p.knobOff

    refreshStrokes()
    THEME.restroke()
    for _, obj in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        pcall(function()
            local attrs = obj:GetAttributes()
            if next(attrs) == nil then return end
            for _, key in ipairs({"RoleText", "RoleBg", "RoleScroll", "Role"}) do
                local r = attrs[key]
                if r then applyRole(obj, r, p) end
            end
            THEME.glassObj(obj, attrs)
        end)
    end
    for i, d in ipairs(themeDots) do
        d.stroke.Transparency = (i == idx) and 0 or 0.6
    end
    if themeDots[4] then themeDots[4].btn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.main end
    if THEME.presetLbl then
        THEME.presetLbl.Text = "Theme  \u{00B7}  " .. (THEME.presetNames[idx] or "")
    end
end

local currentFont = 1

local textScale = 100

local function scaleText(obj)
    local base = obj:GetAttribute("SmvllBaseTextSize")
    if not base then
        base = obj.TextSize
        obj:SetAttribute("SmvllBaseTextSize", base)
    end
    obj.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(base * textScale / 100 + 0.5), 6, 60)
end

local PREV = {}

function PREV.applyTextScale(pct)
    textScale = pct
    for _, obj in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
            pcall(scaleText, obj)
        end
    end
end

screenGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    if textScale == 100 then return end
    if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
        task.defer(function() pcall(scaleText, obj) end)
    end
end)

function PREV.applyFontFamily(family)
    if not family then return end
    if _G.SMVLL_THEME then _G.SMVLL_THEME.fontFamily = family end
    FONT_BOLD  = Font.new(family, Enum.FontWeight.Bold,  Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    FONT_HEAVY = Font.new(family, Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    for _, obj in ipairs(screenGui:GetDescendants()) do
        if (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox"))
            and not obj:GetAttribute("SmvllKeepFont") then
            pcall(function()
                local cur = obj.FontFace
                obj.FontFace = Font.new(family, cur.Weight, cur.Style)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function makeNavItem(i, def, yTop)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame", rail)
    holder.Name = "Nav_" .. def.key
    holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, yTop)
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, NAV_H)
    holder.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.ZIndex = 6
    Instance.new("UICorner", holder).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm + 1)

    local img = makeIcon(holder, def.icon, 15, DIM_TXT)
    img.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.5, 0)
    img.ZIndex = 7

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", holder)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 0)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    lbl.Text = def.name
    lbl.TextColor3 = DIM_TXT
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.ZIndex = 7

    local mark = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
    mark.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    mark.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    mark.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
    mark.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
    mark.BorderSizePixel = 0
    mark.ZIndex = 8
    paintAs(mark, "accentBg")
    Instance.new("UICorner", mark).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", holder)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.ZIndex = 9

    local item = { holder = holder, img = img, lbl = lbl, mark = mark, btn = btn, def = def }
    navItems[i] = item

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if currentPage == i then return end
        TweenService:Create(holder, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.93}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(lbl, TW_FAST, {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 212)}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(img, TW_FAST, {ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 212)}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if currentPage == i then return end
        TweenService:Create(holder, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(lbl, TW_FAST, {TextColor3 = DIM_TXT}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(img, TW_FAST, {ImageColor3 = DIM_TXT}):Play()
    end)
    return item
end

function PREV.newScroll()
    local wrap = Instance.new("CanvasGroup", contentHolder)
    wrap.Name = "PageWrap"
    wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    wrap.GroupTransparency = 0
    wrap.Visible = false
    wrap.ZIndex = 6

    local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", wrap)
    sf.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    sf.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5
    sf.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    sf.ScrollBarImageColor3 = GREEN
    paintAs(sf, "scrollBar")
    sf.ZIndex = 6

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", sf)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout", sf)
    ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    return sf, wrap
end

local pages, pageWraps = {}, {}
for i = 1, #NAV do
    pages[i], pageWraps[i] = PREV.newScroll()
end
pageWraps[1].Visible = true

function PREV.selectPage(i)
    if currentPage == i then return end
    local prev = currentPage
    currentPage = i

    for j, it in ipairs(navItems) do
        local on = (j == i)
        local pal = THEME.livePal or _tp
        TweenService:Create(it.holder, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = on and SURFACE_ON or 1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(it.lbl, TW_FAST, {TextColor3 = on and WHITE or DIM_TXT}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(it.img, TW_FAST, {ImageColor3 = on and pal.accent or DIM_TXT}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(it.mark, TW_SPRING, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, on and 16 or 0),
        }):Play()
        if on then popIcon(it.img, it.def.spin) end
    end

    local outgoing, incoming = pageWraps[prev], pageWraps[i]
    if outgoing then
        TweenService:Create(outgoing, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {GroupTransparency = 1}):Play()
        task.delay(0.16, function()
            if currentPage ~= prev then
                outgoing.Visible = false
                outgoing.GroupTransparency = 0
            end
        end)
    end
    if incoming then
        incoming.GroupTransparency = 1
        incoming.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(incoming, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {GroupTransparency = 0}):Play()
    end
end

for i, it in ipairs(navItems) do
    it.btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() PREV.selectPage(i) end)
end

end)()

local ROW_H     = 26
local SETTINGS  = {}
local LIVE_KEYS = {}

local CFG_PENDING = {}
local CFG_LOADING = 0

local NOTIFY = { enabled = true }

local AUTOSAVE

do
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/autosave.json"))
    end)
    if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        local eng = data.__engine
        data.__engine = nil
        if type(eng) == "table" then
            local hub = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
            if type(hub) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(eng) do pcall(function() hub[k] = v end) end
            end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(data) do CFG_PENDING[k] = v end
        CFG_LOADING = CFG_LOADING + 1
    end
end

local function hubTable() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local h = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
    return (type(h) == "table") and h or nil
end

local function hubHas(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local h = hubTable()
    return (h and type(h[name]) == "function") and h[name] or nil
end

local function hubCall(name, ...)
    local fn = hubHas(name)
    if not fn then return false end
    local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
    if not ok then warn("[MENU_UI] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
    return ok
end

local function hubSet(field, value)
    local h = hubTable()
    if h then h[field] = value end
end

local function hubGet(field, fallback) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local h = hubTable()
    if h and h[field] ~= nil then return h[field] end
    return fallback
end

function PREV.hubUI(on)
    local roots = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_UI_ROOTS")
    if type(roots) ~= "table" then return false end
    local hit = false
    for _, g in ipairs(roots) do
        pcall(function() g.Enabled = on and true or false; hit = true end)
    end
    return hit
end

local function register(key, get, set)
    if not key then return end
    SETTINGS[key] = { get = get, set = set }

    local pend = CFG_PENDING[key]
    if pend ~= nil then
        CFG_PENDING[key] = nil
        pcall(set, pend)
    end
end

local function touched()
    if AUTOSAVE then AUTOSAVE() end
end

function PREV.uiInsetTop()
    local ok, inset = pcall(function()
        return game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
    end)
    if ok and typeof(inset) == "Vector2" then
        return math.max(0, inset.Y)
    end
    return 36
end

local function trackLayout(frame, key)
    if not key then return end
    register("pos_" .. key,
        function()
            return {
                x = frame.Position.X.Offset, y = frame.Position.Y.Offset,
                xs = frame.Position.X.Scale,  ys = frame.Position.Y.Scale,
                w = frame.Size.X.Offset,
                h = tonumber(frame:GetAttribute("GlassFullH"))
                    or (frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true
                    and tonumber(frame:GetAttribute("SmvllOpenH")))
                    or frame.Size.Y.Offset,

                c = (frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") ~= nil)
                    and (frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true) or nil,
            }
        end,
        function(v)
            if type(v) ~= "table" then return end
            local xs = tonumber(v.xs) or 0
            local ys = tonumber(v.ys) or 0
            local x = tonumber(v.x) or 0
            local y = tonumber(v.y) or 0
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(xs, x, ys, y)

            local w, h = tonumber(v.w), tonumber(v.h)
            if w and h and w > 40 and h > 20
                and frame.AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
                if frame:GetAttribute("SmvllOpenH") ~= nil then
                    frame:SetAttribute("SmvllOpenH", h)
                end
                if frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true then
                    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, frame.Size.Y.Offset)
                else
                    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
                end
            end

            if v.c ~= nil and frame:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") ~= nil then
                frame:SetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed", v.c and true or false)
            end
        end)
end

local function makeGroup(parent, title, order)
    local outer = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    outer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    outer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    outer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    outer.LayoutOrder = order or 1
    outer.ZIndex = 8
    local ol = Instance.new("UIListLayout", outer)
    ol.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ol.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local head = Instance.new("TextLabel", outer)
    head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13)
    head.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    head.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    head.Text = string.upper(title or "")
    head.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(112, 112, 120)
    head.TextSize = 9
    head.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    head.LayoutOrder = 0
    head.ZIndex = 8
    local hp = Instance.new("UIPadding", head)
    hp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)

    local card = Instance.new("Frame", outer)
    card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    card.LayoutOrder = 1
    card.ZIndex = 8
    surface(card)
    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.md)
    local st = addStroke(card, 1)
    st.Transparency = 0.6
    local cp = Instance.new("UIPadding", card)
    cp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 3)
    cp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 3)
    local cl = Instance.new("UIListLayout", card)
    cl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    card:SetAttribute("Rows", 0)
    return card
end

local function groupRow(card, height)
    local n = (card:GetAttribute("Rows") or 0) + 1
    card:SetAttribute("Rows", n)

    local row = Instance.new("Frame", card)
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or ROW_H)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.LayoutOrder = n * 10
    row.ZIndex = 9

    if n > 1 then
        local hr = Instance.new("Frame", row)
        hr.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
        hr.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
        hr.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
        hr.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
        hr.BorderSizePixel = 0
        hr.ZIndex = 9
        THEME.line(hr)
    end
    return row, n
end

local function rowLabel(row, text, rightGap)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(12 + (rightGap or 76)), 1, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    lbl.Text = text
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 226, 232)
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    lbl.ZIndex = 10
    return lbl
end

local function hoverRow(row, btn)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(row, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.95}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(row, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    end)
end

local function makeToggleRow(card, label, onEnable, onDisable, startOn, key, onExpand)
    local row = groupRow(card)
    local lbl = rowLabel(row, label, onExpand and 76 or 52)

    if onExpand then
        local more = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        more.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        more.Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0.5, 0)
        more.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 16)
        more.FontFace = FONT_HEAVY
        more.Text = "\u{2026}"
        more.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
        more.TextSize = 13
        more.AutoButtonColor = false
        more.ZIndex = 13
        surface(more, 0.9)
        Instance.new("UICorner", more).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
        local ms = addStroke(more, 1)
        ms.Transparency = 0.68
        more.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(more, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.8}):Play()
        end)
        more.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(more, TW_FAST, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.9}):Play()
        end)
        more.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onExpand)
    end

    local pill = Instance.new("Frame", row)
    pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
    pill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 15)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = OFF_COLOR
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.ZIndex = 10
    paintAs(pill, "offBg")
    Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame", pill)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0)
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 11, 0, 11)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = KNOB_OFF
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.ZIndex = 12
    hoverRow(row, btn)

    local on = false
    local function set(state, fire)
        on = state and true or false
        btn:SetAttribute("SmvllOn", on)
        TweenService:Create(pill, TW_FAST, {
            BackgroundColor3 = on and ON_COLOR or OFF_COLOR,
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(knob, TW_SPRING, {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, on and 15 or 2, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = on and KNOB_ON or KNOB_OFF,
        }):Play()
        pill:SetAttribute(on and "RoleBgSkip" or "RoleBgSkip", nil)
        paintAs(pill, on and "onBg" or "offBg")
        if fire ~= false then
            if on and onEnable then onEnable() end
            if not on and onDisable then onDisable() end
        end
    end

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not on, true); touched() end)
    set(startOn == true, false)
    if key then LIVE_KEYS[key] = true end
    register(key, function() return on end, function(v) set(v == true, true) end)
    if key and _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND then
        _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.register("kb_" .. key, function() set(not on, true); touched() end, lbl, label)
        _G.SMVLL_KEYBIND.attachLongPress(btn, "kb_" .. key)
    end
    return row, set
end

local function hubToggle(card, label, startName, stopName, flag, key)
    return makeToggleRow(card, label, function()
        if flag then hubSet(flag, true) end
        hubCall(startName)
    end, function()
        if flag then hubSet(flag, false) end
        hubCall(stopName)
    end, false, key)
end

local function makeSliderRow(card, label, min, max, default, fmt, onChange, key)
    local row = groupRow(card)
    rowLabel(row, label, 132)

    local val = Instance.new("TextBox", row)
    val.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    val.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0)
    val.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 16)
    val.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 0.94
    val.BorderSizePixel = 0
    val.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    val.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(178, 178, 186)
    val.TextSize = 10
    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    val.ZIndex = 14
    Instance.new("UICorner", val).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs - 1)
    do
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", val)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
    end

    local track = Instance.new("Frame", row)
    track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0.5, 0)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 3)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 10
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.ZIndex = 11
    paintAs(fill, "accentBg")
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame", track)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local value = default
    local function render() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local a = (value - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
        val.Text = (fmt or "%.0f"):format(value)
    end
    local function apply(v, fire) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        value = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        render()
        if fire ~= false and onChange then onChange(value) end
    end
    render()

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    hit.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, 0)
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 1, 0)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.ZIndex = 13

    local originX, width = 0, 1
    local function fromX(pos)
        local a = math.clamp((pos.X - originX) / width, 0, 1)
        apply(min + a * (max - min), true)
        touched()
    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if DRAG.fn then return end
            originX = track.AbsolutePosition.X
            width = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
            DRAG.fn = fromX
            DRAG.inp = i
            fromX(i.Position)
        end
    end)

    val.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local n = tonumber(val.Text:match("%-?%d+%.?%d*"))
        if n then apply(n, true); touched() else render() end
    end)
    val:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        if #val.Text > 12 then val.Text = val.Text:sub(1, 12) end
    end)

    register(key, function() return value end, function(v) apply(tonumber(v) or default, true) end)
    return row, function() return value end, apply
end

local function makeDropdownRow(card, label, options, initial, onPick, key)
    local row, n = groupRow(card)
    rowLabel(row, label, 108)

    local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
    val.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    val.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
    val.Size = UDim2.new(0, 92, 1, 0)
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    val.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    val.Text = options[initial] and options[initial].name or "-"
    val.TextColor3 = GREEN
    paintAs(val, "accentText")
    val.TextSize = 10
    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    val.ZIndex = 10

    local chev = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
    chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    chev.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
    chev.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, 0)
    chev.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    chev.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    chev.Text = "\u{25BE}"
    chev.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 138)
    chev.TextSize = 9
    chev.ZIndex = 10
    chev.Visible = false

    local menu = Instance.new("Frame", card)
    menu.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
    menu.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    menu.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    menu.Visible = false
    menu.LayoutOrder = n * 10 + 1
    menu.ZIndex = 9
    local ml = Instance.new("UIListLayout", menu)
    ml.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    local mp = Instance.new("UIPadding", menu)
    mp.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)

    local picked = initial
    local optBtns = {}
    local function paint()
        for i, b in ipairs(optBtns) do
            b.TextColor3 = (i == picked) and WHITE or Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 148)
            b.BackgroundTransparency = (i == picked) and 0.94 or 1
        end
    end
    local function choose(i, fire)
        picked = i
        val.Text = options[i] and options[i].name or "-"
        paint()
        menu.Visible = false
        chev.Text = "\u{25BE}"
        if fire ~= false and onPick then onPick(i, options[i]) end
    end

    for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton", menu)
        b.LayoutOrder = i
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 22)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        b.Text = opt.name
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 148)
        b.TextSize = 10
        b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.ZIndex = 10
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs + 1)
        local bp = Instance.new("UIPadding", b)
        bp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
        optBtns[i] = b
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() choose(i, true) end)
    end

    local mlp = Instance.new("UIPadding", menu)
    mlp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
    mlp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
    for _, b in ipairs(optBtns) do
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    end
    paint()

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = ""
    btn.ZIndex = 12
    hoverRow(row, btn)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
        chev.Text = menu.Visible and "\u{25B4}" or "\u{25BE}"
    end)

    if key then LIVE_KEYS[key] = true end
    register(key, function() return picked end, function(v) choose(tonumber(v) or initial, true) end)
    return row, function() return picked end, choose
end

local function makeKeybindRow(card, label, default, onSet, key)
    local row = groupRow(card)
    rowLabel(row, label, 62)

    local chip = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    chip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    chip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
    chip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 18)
    chip.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    chip.Text = default and default.Name or "None"
    chip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 198)
    chip.TextSize = 10
    chip.AutoButtonColor = false
    chip.ZIndex = 11
    surface(chip, 0.9)
    Instance.new("UICorner", chip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs + 1)
    local cs = addStroke(chip, 1)
    cs.Transparency = 0.65

    local current, listening, conn = default, false, nil
    local function setKey(k, fire)
        current = k
        chip.Text = k and k.Name or "None"
        chip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 198)
        if fire ~= false and onSet then onSet(k) end
    end
    chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if listening then return end
        listening = true
        chip.Text = "..."
        chip.TextColor3 = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
        conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, busy)
            if busy or i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
            listening = false
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
            setKey(i.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape and i.KeyCode or nil, true)
        end)
    end)
    register(key,
        function() return current and current.Name or "" end,
        function(v)
            local k = (type(v) == "string" and v ~= "" and Enum.KeyCode[v]) or nil
            setKey(k, true)
        end)
    return row
end

function PREV.makeColorRow(card, label, swatches, initial, onPick, key)
    local row = groupRow(card)
    rowLabel(row, label, 18 + #swatches * 20)

    local picked, dots = initial, {}
    local function paint()
        for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
            d.Transparency = (i == picked) and 0 or 0.7
        end
    end
    local function choose(i, fire)
        picked = i
        paint()
        if fire ~= false and onPick then onPick(i, swatches[i]) end
    end
    for i, c in ipairs(swatches) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(11 + (#swatches - i) * 20), 0.5, 0)
        b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 13)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = c
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.Text = ""
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.ZIndex = 11
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local stk = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
        stk.Color = WHITE
        stk.Thickness = 1
        dots[i] = stk
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() choose(i, true) end)
    end
    paint()
    register(key, function() return picked end, function(v) choose(tonumber(v) or initial, true) end)
    return row
end

local function makeColorPicker(card, label, default, onPick, key)
    local row, n = groupRow(card)
    rowLabel(row, label, 46)

    local chip = Instance.new("Frame", row)
    chip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    chip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, 0)
    chip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 14)
    chip.BackgroundColor3 = default
    chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
    chip.ZIndex = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", chip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs - 1)
    local chipStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", chip)
    chipStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    chipStroke.Thickness = 1
    chipStroke.Transparency = 0.4

    local panel = Instance.new("Frame", card)
    panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 92)
    panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    panel.Visible = false
    panel.LayoutOrder = n * 10 + 1
    panel.ZIndex = 10

    local sv = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
    sv.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 4)
    sv.Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0, 72)
    sv.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sv.ZIndex = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", sv).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
    local svSat = Instance.new("UIGradient", sv)
    svSat.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), default)

    local svVal = Instance.new("Frame", sv)
    svVal.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    svVal.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    svVal.BorderSizePixel = 0
    svVal.ZIndex = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", svVal).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
    local svValGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", svVal)
    svValGrad.Rotation = 90
    svValGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })

    local svDot = Instance.new("Frame", sv)
    svDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    svDot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    svDot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    svDot.ZIndex = 14
    local svDotStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", svDot)
    svDotStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    svDotStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    Instance.new("UICorner", svDot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hue = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
    hue.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    hue.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
    hue.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 72)
    hue.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hue.ZIndex = 11
    Instance.new("UICorner", hue).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
    local hueGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", hue)
    hueGrad.Rotation = 90
    do
        local keys = {}
        for i = 0, 6 do
            table.insert(keys, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6,
                Color3.fromHSV(i / 6 % 1, 1, 1)))
        end
        hueGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
    end

    local hueDot = Instance.new("Frame", hue)
    hueDot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    hueDot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
    hueDot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, 3)
    hueDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hueDot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hueDot.ZIndex = 13

    local h, sat, val = Color3.toHSV(default)

    local function apply(fire) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local c = Color3.fromHSV(h, sat, val)
        chip.BackgroundColor3 = c
        svSat.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
        svDot.Position = UDim2.new(sat, 0, 1 - val, 0)
        hueDot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, h, 0)
        if fire ~= false and onPick then onPick(c, fire == "user") end
    end
    apply(false)

    local function dragSurface(frame, onMove)
        local ox, oy, w, ht = 0, 0, 1, 1
        local dragging = false

        local function at(px, py)
            onMove(math.clamp((px - ox) / w, 0, 1), math.clamp((py - oy) / ht, 0, 1))
        end

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.ZIndex = 15
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                ox, oy = frame.AbsolutePosition.X, frame.AbsolutePosition.Y
                w = math.max(frame.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
                ht = math.max(frame.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
                dragging = true
                at(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                at(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(i)
            if dragging then at(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y) end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end

    dragSurface(sv, function(u, v)
        sat, val = u, 1 - v
        apply("user")
    end)
    dragSurface(hue, function(_, v)
        h = v
        apply("user")
    end)

    local open = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    open.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    open.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    open.Text = ""
    open.ZIndex = 12
    hoverRow(row, open)
    open.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        panel.Visible = not panel.Visible
    end)

    register(key,
        function() return { h, sat, val } end,
        function(v)
            if type(v) == "table" and #v == 3 then
                h, sat, val = v[1], v[2], v[3]
                apply(true)
            end
        end)
    return row
end

local DISCORD_GUILD_ID = "1279794919262916682"
local DISCORD_STATS_URL = ""
local WEBSITE = "smvll.xyz"

function PREV.httpGet(url)
    local fns = {}
    if type(request) == "function" then table.insert(fns, request) end
    if type(http_request) == "function" then table.insert(fns, http_request) end
    if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then table.insert(fns, syn.request) end
    if type(http) == "table" and type(http.request) == "function" then table.insert(fns, http.request) end
    for _, fn in ipairs(fns) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        if ok and type(res) == "table" and type(res.Body) == "string" and #res.Body > 0 then
            return res.Body
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function PREV.fetchDiscord()
    local url = DISCORD_STATS_URL
    if url == "" and DISCORD_GUILD_ID ~= "" then
        url = "https://discord.com/api/guilds/" .. DISCORD_GUILD_ID .. "/widget.json"
    end
    if url == "" then return nil end
    local body = PREV.httpGet(url)
    if not body then return nil end
    local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil end
    return {
        name    = data.name,
        online  = data.online or data.presence_count,

        members = data.member_count or data.memberCount or data.members_total or data.total,
    }
end

local function dismiss(pill)
    if pill:GetAttribute("Going") then return end
    pill:SetAttribute("Going", true)
    live = math.max(live - 1, 0)
    local out = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
    TweenService:Create(pill, out, {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, -20, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    for _, d in ipairs(pill:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(d, out, { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(d, out, { ImageTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
            TweenService:Create(d, out, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        elseif d:IsA("Frame") then
            TweenService:Create(d, out, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        end
    end
    task.delay(0.2, function() if pill.Parent then pill:Destroy() end end)
end

function PREV.makeSpark(parent, count, x, y, w, h)
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
    holder.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(x * 2), 0, h)
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.ZIndex = 9

    local bars, vals = {}, {}
    for i = 1, count do
        local b = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
        b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
        b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / count, 0, 1, 0)
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -1, 0, 2)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.ZIndex = 9
        paintAs(b, "accentBg")
        bars[i] = b
        vals[i] = 0
    end

    local function push(v, ceiling) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        table.remove(vals, 1)
        vals[count] = v
        local top = math.max(ceiling or 0, 1)
        for i = 1, count do
            local a = math.clamp(vals[i] / top, 0, 1)
            bars[i].Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -1, 0, math.max(2, math.floor(a * h)))
            bars[i].BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + (1 - a) * 0.45
        end
    end
    return push, vals
end

local _toolIconCache = {}

local function toolIcon(name)
    if _toolIconCache[name] ~= nil then return _toolIconCache[name] or nil end
    local id
    pcall(function()
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            for _, where in ipairs({ p.Character, p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
                if where then
                    local t = where:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if t and t:IsA("Tool") and t.TextureId ~= "" then
                        id = t.TextureId
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    _toolIconCache[name] = id or false
    return id
end

    RIG.cam = cam

    function RIG.frame() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not (RIG.cam and RIG.size) then return end
        local vs = vp.AbsoluteSize
        local aspect = math.max(vs.X, 1) / math.max(vs.Y, 1)
        local half = math.tan(math.rad(RIG.cam.FieldOfView) / 2)

        local visH = RIG.size.Y * 1.55
        local visW = visH * aspect
        local needW = math.max(RIG.size.X, RIG.size.Z) * 1.7
        if needW > visW then
            visW = needW
            visH = visW / aspect
        end
        RIG.fit = (visH / 2) / half
        RIG.dist = RIG.fit * (RIG.zoom or 1)

        local yaw, pitch = RIG.yaw or 0, RIG.pitch or 0
        RIG.cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(RIG.centre)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
            * CFrame.new(0, 0, RIG.dist)

        RIG.box = UDim2.new(
            math.clamp(RIG.size.X / visW, 0.05, 0.95), 0,
            math.clamp(RIG.size.Y / visH, 0.05, 0.95), 0)
        if RIG.onFrame then RIG.onFrame() end
    end

    function RIG.project(pos) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local cam = RIG.cam
        local vs = vp.AbsoluteSize
        if not cam or vs.X <= 0 or vs.Y <= 0 then return nil end
        local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
        if rel.Z > -0.05 then return nil end
        local half = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
        local aspect = vs.X / vs.Y
        local nx = (rel.X / -rel.Z) / (half * aspect)
        local ny = (rel.Y / -rel.Z) / half
        return Vector2.new((nx * 0.5 + 0.5) * vs.X, (0.5 - ny * 0.5) * vs.Y)
    end

    function RIG.screenBox() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not (RIG.model and RIG.cam) then return nil end
        local root = RIG.model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if E.dynamicBox or not root then
            local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
            local any = false
            for _, v in ipairs(RIG.model:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
                    and v.Transparency ~= 1 then
                    local sz = v.Size / 2
                    for i = 0, 7 do
                        local c = v.CFrame * CFrame.new(
                            (i % 2 == 0) and -sz.X or sz.X,
                            (math.floor(i / 2) % 2 == 0) and -sz.Y or sz.Y,
                            (i < 4) and -sz.Z or sz.Z)
                        local pt = RIG.project(c.Position)
                        if pt then
                            any = true
                            minX, maxX = math.min(minX, pt.X), math.max(maxX, pt.X)
                            minY, maxY = math.min(minY, pt.Y), math.max(maxY, pt.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not any then return nil end
            return minX, minY, maxX - minX, maxY - minY
        end

        local r6 = RIG.model:FindFirstChild("Torso") ~= nil
        local topOff = r6 and 2.8 or 3.0
        local botOff = r6 and 3.0 or 3.5
        local cPt = RIG.project(root.Position)
        local tPt = RIG.project(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, topOff, 0))
        local bPt = RIG.project(root.Position - Vector3.new(0, botOff, 0))
        if not (cPt and tPt and bPt) then return nil end
        local h = math.abs(tPt.Y - bPt.Y)
        local w = h * 0.65
        return cPt.X - w / 2, math.min(tPt.Y, bPt.Y), w, h
    end

    function RIG.imageBox() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local vs = stage.AbsoluteSize
        if vs.X <= 0 or vs.Y <= 0 then return UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.56, 0) end
        local sq = math.min(vs.X, vs.Y) * 0.92
        return UDim2.new((sq * 0.46) / vs.X, 0, (sq * 0.8) / vs.Y, 0)
    end
