    end)

    local SWING = {
        ["LeftUpperArm"]  =  1, ["RightUpperArm"]  = -1,
        ["LeftUpperLeg"]  = -1, ["RightUpperLeg"]  =  1,
        ["Left Arm"]      =  1, ["Right Arm"]      = -1,
        ["Left Leg"]      = -1, ["Right Leg"]      =  1,
    }

    local BEND = {
        ["LeftLowerLeg"]  = -1, ["RightLowerLeg"]  =  1,
        ["LeftLowerArm"]  =  1, ["RightLowerArm"]  = -1,
    }

    local function jointOffset(name, mode, phase)
        local swing = SWING[name]
        local bend = BEND[name]
        local arm = name:find("Arm") ~= nil

        if mode == 2 then
            if swing then
                return CFrame.Angles(math.sin(phase) * 0.6 * swing, 0, 0)
            end
            if bend then

                local t = math.sin(phase + (bend > 0 and 0 or math.pi))
                local amount = math.max(t, 0) * (arm and 0.35 or 0.75)
                return CFrame.Angles(arm and -amount or -amount, 0, 0)
            end
            return nil
        elseif mode == 3 then
            if arm then return CFrame.Angles(-2.4, 0, 0) end
            if swing then return CFrame.Angles(0.8 * swing + 0.5, 0, 0) end
            if bend then return CFrame.Angles(-1.1, 0, 0) end
            return nil
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function assembleRig(rig, mode, phase)
        local root = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or rig.PrimaryPart
        if not root then return false end

        local bob = (mode == 2) and math.sin(phase * 2) * 0.07 or 0
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, bob, 0)

        local byPart0 = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part0 and d.Part1 then
                byPart0[d.Part0] = byPart0[d.Part0] or {}
                table.insert(byPart0[d.Part0], d)
            end
        end

        local queue, seen = { root }, { [root] = true }
        while #queue > 0 do
            local p0 = table.remove(queue, 1)
            for _, j in ipairs(byPart0[p0] or {}) do
                local p1 = j.Part1
                if p1 and not seen[p1] then
                    seen[p1] = true
                    local off = mode and mode > 1 and jointOffset(p1.Name, mode, phase)
                    local c0 = off and (j.C0 * off) or j.C0
                    p1.CFrame = p0.CFrame * c0 * j.C1:Inverse()
                    table.insert(queue, p1)
                end
            end
        end

        for _, acc in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
            if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
                local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                local a1 = handle and handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                if a1 then
                    for _, part in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") and seen[part] then
                            local a0 = part:FindFirstChild(a1.Name)
                            if a0 and a0:IsA("Attachment") then
                                handle.CFrame = a0.WorldCFrame * a1.CFrame:Inverse()
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    do
        local grab = Instance.new("TextButton", stage)
        grab.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        grab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        grab.Text = ""
        grab.AutoButtonColor = false
        grab.ZIndex = 33

        local dragging, last = false, nil

        UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(i)
            if not (dragging and last) then return end
            local d = i.Position - last
            last = i.Position
            RIG.yaw = (RIG.yaw or 0) - d.X * 0.012
            RIG.pitch = (RIG.pitch or 0) + d.Y * 0.010
            RIG.frame()
        end)
        UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(function() dragging = false end)

        grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, last = true, i.Position
            elseif i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                RIG.zoom = math.clamp((RIG.zoom or 1) - i.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.45, 2.2)
                RIG.frame()
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and grab.Parent then

                local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
                local a, b = stage.AbsolutePosition, stage.AbsoluteSize
                if m.X >= a.X and m.X <= a.X + b.X and m.Y >= a.Y and m.Y <= a.Y + b.Y then
                    RIG.zoom = math.clamp((RIG.zoom or 1) - i.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.45, 2.2)
                    RIG.frame()
                end
                return
            end
            if not dragging then return end
            if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local d = i.Position - last
            last = i.Position
            RIG.yaw = (RIG.yaw or 0) - d.X * 0.012

            RIG.pitch = (RIG.pitch or 0) + d.Y * 0.010
            RIG.frame()
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local rig, how
        pcall(function()
            rig = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(player.UserId)
            how = "userid"
        end)
        if not rig then
            pcall(function()
                local c = player.Character
                if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    rig = c:Clone()
                    how = "clone"
                end
            end)
        end
        if not rig then
            RIG.how = "image"
            if RIG.onFrame then RIG.onFrame() end
            return
        end
        if not vp.Parent then rig:Destroy() return end

        for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("Sound")
                or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail")
                or d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        local hum = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            hum.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
        end

        rig.Parent = world
        assembleRig(rig, 1, 0)
        RIG.assemble = assembleRig

        local cf, size = rig:GetBoundingBox()

        local sane = size.Y > 3 and size.Y < 14
            and size.X < 14 and size.Z < 14
            and #rig:GetChildren() > 4
        if not sane then
            rig:Destroy()
            RIG.how = "image"
            RIG.note = string.format("rig %.0fx%.0fx%.0f rejete", size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
            if RIG.onFrame then RIG.onFrame() end
            return
        end

        RIG.baseT = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.Anchored = true
                d.CanCollide = false
                d.CastShadow = false

                RIG.baseT[d] = d.Transparency
                table.insert(RIG.parts, d)
            end
        end

        RIG.model = rig
        RIG.how = how
        RIG.centre = cf.Position
        RIG.size = size
        bust.Visible = false
        RIG.frame()
    end)

        { name = "Head only",  keys = { "head" } },
        { name = "Torso only", keys = { "torso" } },
        { name = "Limbs only", keys = { "arms", "legs" } },

    local function partSelected(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local mode = PART_MODES[E.chamsParts or 1]
        if not (mode and mode.keys) then return true end
        for _, k in ipairs(mode.keys) do
            if PART_GROUPS[k][name] then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function setRigTransparency(t, tint) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, d in ipairs(RIG.parts) do
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

                if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                    d.ImageTransparency = t
                    return
                end

                local pick = (tint == nil) or partSelected(d.Name)

                local base = (RIG.baseT and RIG.baseT[d]) or 0
                local want = pick and t or 0
                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(base, want)
                d.Transparency = math.max(base, want)
                if tint and pick then d.Color = tint end
            end)
        end
    end

        return l
    end

    local function drawSkeleton(show, colour) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for i, def in ipairs(SKELETON) do
            local b, drawn = bones[i], false
            if show and RIG.model then
                local p0 = RIG.model:FindFirstChild(def[1])
                local p1 = RIG.model:FindFirstChild(def[2])
                if p0 and p1 then
                    local a0, a1 = RIG.project(p0.Position), RIG.project(p1.Position)
                    if a0 and a1 then
                        local d = a1 - a0
                        b.Position = UDim2.new(0, (a0.X + a1.X) / 2, 0, (a0.Y + a1.Y) / 2)
                        b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, d.Magnitude)
                        b.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X)) - 90
                        b.BackgroundColor3 = colour
                        drawn = true
                    end
                end
            end
            b.Visible = drawn
        end

        local head = RIG.model and RIG.model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hp = head and RIG.project(head.Position)
        headDot.Visible = (E.headDot and hp) and true or false
        if hp then
            headDot.Position = UDim2.new(0, hp.X, 0, hp.Y)
            headDot.BackgroundColor3 = colour
        end
    end

    local function ramp(c) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local h, sat, v = Color3.toHSV(c)
        local dark = Color3.fromHSV(h, sat, math.max(v * 0.35, 0.05))
        return ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    c),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,  dark),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    c),
        })
    end

    local function redraw() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local on = E.enabled
        local c = E.colour
        local invis = E.previewInvis
        local usingInv = invis and E.invDetect
        local off = E.previewOff

        local wantBox   = on and not off and (usingInv and (E.invMode == 2 or E.invMode == 3) or (not usingInv and E.box))
        local wantChams = on and not off and (usingInv and (E.invMode == 1 or E.invMode == 3) or (not usingInv and E.chams))

        target.Visible = on and not off

        local seq = ramp(c)

        box.Visible = wantBox
        boxStroke.Enabled = wantBox and E.boxType == 1
        for _, cc in ipairs(corners) do
            cc.Visible = wantBox and E.boxType == 2
            cc.BackgroundColor3 = c
        end
        boxOut.Visible = wantBox and E.boxOutline and E.boxType == 1
        boxStroke.Color = WHITE
        boxGrad.Color = seq
        boxGrad.Rotation = E.boxRot

        glow.Visible = on and not off and E.glow and wantBox
        glow.ImageColor3 = c
        glow.ImageTransparency = 1 - (E.glowA / 100)
        glowGrad.Color = seq
        glowGrad.Rotation = E.glowRot

        fillGrad.Color = seq
        fillGrad.Rotation = E.fillRot
        boxFill.Visible = wantBox and (usingInv or E.boxFill)
        boxFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
        boxFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ((usingInv and 45 or E.boxFillA) / 100)

        local pad = usingInv and E.invPad * 3 or 0
        local bx, by, bw, bh = RIG.screenBox()
        if bx then
            target.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            target.Position = UDim2.new(0, bx - pad, 0, by - pad)
            target.Size = UDim2.new(0, bw + pad * 2, 0, bh + pad * 2)
        else
            local base = RIG.imageBox()
            target.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            target.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0)
            target.Size = UDim2.new(base.X.Scale, 0, base.Y.Scale, 0)
        end

        box3d.Visible = on and not off and E.box3d
        for _, d in ipairs(box3d:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("UIStroke") then d.Color = c end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(box3d:GetChildren()) do
            if d:GetAttribute("Edge") and d:IsA("Frame") then d.BackgroundColor3 = c end
        end

        hpTrack.Visible = on and not off and E.healthBar
        hpOut.Visible   = hpTrack.Visible and E.healthBarOutline
        local a = E.health / 100
        hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, a, 0)
        hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 110), a)
        hpText.Visible = on and not off and E.healthText
        hpText.Text = tostring(E.health)
        hpText.TextColor3 = hpFill.BackgroundColor3

        setRigTransparency(fade, tint)

    end)

    do
        local phase = 0
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not stage.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
            if not (RIG.model and RIG.assemble and espWindow and espWindow.Visible) then return end
            if (E.anim or 1) <= 1 then return end
            phase = phase + dt * (E.anim == 2 and 6.5 or 2.2)
            RIG.assemble(RIG.model, E.anim, phase)
            redraw()
        end)
    end

    do
        local a = 0
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not stage.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
            if not (RIG.spin and RIG.cam and RIG.centre and espWindow
                and espWindow.Visible) then return end
            RIG.yaw = (RIG.yaw or 0) + dt * 0.7
            RIG.frame()
            redraw()
        end)
    end

    do
        local a = 0
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not stage.Parent then conn:Disconnect() return end
            if not (E.spin and espWindow.Visible) then return end
            a = (a + dt * E.spinSpeed) % 360
            fillGrad.Rotation = a
            glowGrad.Rotation = (a * 0.5) % 360
        end)
    end

    return espWindow
end)

if not espOk then

    espWindow = nil
end

function PREV.findAnimalModel(name)
    local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local models = rs:FindFirstChild("Models")
    local animals = models and models:FindFirstChild("Animals")
    local function norm(t) return (t:lower():gsub("[%s_%-\']", "")) end
    local want = norm(name)

    if animals then
        local direct = animals:FindFirstChild(name)
        if direct and direct:IsA("Model") then return direct, direct.Name end
        for _, c in ipairs(animals:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Model") and norm(c.Name) == want then return c, c.Name end
        end
    end

    if models then
        local deep = models:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if deep and deep:IsA("Model") then return deep, deep.Name end
    end

    for _, folderName in ipairs({ "RenderedMovingAnimals", "Plots" }) do
        local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
        if folder then
            for _, a in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if a:IsA("Model") and norm(a.Name) == want then return a, a.Name end
                for _, b in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
                    if b:IsA("Model") and norm(b.Name) == want then return b, b.Name end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function PREV.playIdle(model, name)
    pcall(function()
        local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local anims = rs:FindFirstChild("Animations")
        anims = anims and anims:FindFirstChild("Animals")
        local set = anims and anims:FindFirstChild(name)
        local idle = set and set:FindFirstChild("Idle")
        if not idle then return end
        local ctrl = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
            or Instance.new("AnimationController", model)
        local animator = ctrl:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            or Instance.new("Animator", ctrl)
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(idle)
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play(0)
    end)
end

    cardValue.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    cardValue.ZIndex = 37

    local baseColour = {}

    function P.frame() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not P.size then return end
        local vs = vp.AbsoluteSize
        local aspect = math.max(vs.X, 1) / math.max(vs.Y, 1)
        local half = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)

        local visH = P.size.Y * 1.7
        local visW = visH * aspect
        local needW = math.max(P.size.X, P.size.Z) * 1.6
        if needW > visW then
            visW = needW
            visH = visW / aspect
        end
        local dist = ((visH / 2) / half) * (P.zoom or 1)

        cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(P.centre)
            * CFrame.Angles(0, P.yaw or 0, 0)
            * CFrame.Angles(P.pitch or 0, 0, 0)
            * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)

        local bw = math.clamp(math.max(P.size.X, P.size.Z) / visW, 0.06, 0.94)
        local bh = math.clamp(P.size.Y / visH, 0.06, 0.94)
        box.Size = UDim2.new(bw, 0, bh, 0)
        stack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - bh / 2, -4)
    end

    function P.apply() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

        local rar = BR_RARITY[1]
        local orig = (B.style == 1)
        local c = orig
            and (B.origFollow and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent or B.origColour)
            or (B.byRarity and rar.colour or (B.colourFollow and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent or B.colour))

        local corners = (B.boxStyle ~= 2)
        box.Visible = (not orig) and (B.box or B.boxFill)
        boxFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
        boxFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (B.boxFillA / 100)
        boxFill.Visible = B.boxFill
        boxOut.Enabled = B.box and not corners
        boxOut.Color = c
        boxOut.Transparency = 0
        boxOut.Thickness = 1.5
        for k = 1, 8 do
            corner[k].BackgroundColor3 = c
            corner[k].Visible = B.box and corners
            cornerOut[k].Visible = B.box and corners
        end

        lRarity.Text = rar.name:upper()
        lRarity.TextColor3 = c
        lRarity.Visible = (not orig) and B.rarityTag
        lName.Text = P.name:upper()
        lName.TextSize = B.textSize
        lName.Visible = (not orig) and B.name
        lValue.Text = "1.2M/s"
        lValue.TextColor3 = c
        lValue.TextSize = math.max(9, B.textSize - 1)
        lValue.Visible = (not orig) and B.value
        lDist.Text = "128st"
        lDist.Visible = (not orig) and B.distance

        card.Visible = orig
        if orig then
            cardName.Text = P.name:upper()
            cardValue.Text = "1.2M/s"
            cardValue.TextColor3 = c
            cardStroke.Color = c
            card.Position = stack.Position
            box.Visible = false
        end

        local tint = orig and math.clamp(B.origFill / 100, 0, 1)
            or math.clamp(B.hlFill / 100, 0, 1)
        local on = orig or B.highlight
        for part, base in pairs(baseColour) do
            if part.Parent then
                part.Color = on and base:Lerp(c, tint) or base
            end
        end
    end

    local function adopt(m, wantedName)
        table.clear(baseColour)
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then baseColour[d] = d.Color end
        end
        local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
        P.centre, P.size = cf.Position, size
        P.name = wantedName
        note.Visible = false
        cap.Text = "PREVIEW · " .. P.name:upper()
        P.frame()
        P.apply()
    end

    local function loadTemplate(name)
        local src, realName = PREV.findAnimalModel(name)
        if not src then return false end
        local okc = pcall(function()
            local m = src:Clone()

            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then d:Destroy() end
            end
            m.Parent = world
            PREV.playIdle(m, realName or name)
            adopt(m, realName or name)
        end)
        return okc and P.size ~= nil
    end

    local loadSeq = 0

    function P.load(name)
        loadSeq = loadSeq + 1
        local mySeq = loadSeq

        for _, c in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
        table.clear(baseColour)
        P.size = nil
        note.Text = "loading " .. name .. "…"
        note.Visible = true

        
        
        task.spawn(function()
            if mySeq ~= loadSeq then return end

            if not loadTemplate(name) then
                note.Text = "waiting for " .. name
                note.Visible = true
                cap.Text = "PREVIEW"
            end
        end)
        return true
    end

    do
        local grab = Instance.new("TextButton", stage)
        grab.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        grab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        grab.Text = ""
        grab.AutoButtonColor = false
        grab.ZIndex = 33

        local dragging, last = false, nil

        UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(i)
            if not (dragging and last) then return end
            local d = i.Position - last
            last = i.Position
            P.yaw = (P.yaw or 0) - d.X * 0.012
            P.pitch = (P.pitch or 0) + d.Y * 0.010
            P.frame()
        end)
        UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(function() dragging = false end)

        grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, last = true, i.Position
                P.spin = false
            elseif i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                P.zoom = math.clamp((P.zoom or 1) - i.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.45, 2.2)
                P.frame()
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if not dragging then return end
            if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
            local d = i.Position - last
            last = i.Position
            P.yaw = (P.yaw or 0) - d.X * 0.012
            P.pitch = (P.pitch or 0) + d.Y * 0.010
            P.frame()
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)

        local spinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", stage)
        spinBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        spinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 6)
        spinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 15)
        spinBtn.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        spinBtn.Text = "SPIN"
        spinBtn.TextSize = 8
        spinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 218)
        spinBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        spinBtn.ZIndex = 41
        surface(spinBtn, 0.86)
        Instance.new("UICorner", spinBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
        spinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            P.spin = not P.spin
            spinBtn.TextColor3 = P.spin and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                                        or Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 148)
        end)
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not (stage.Parent and stage.Visible and stage.Parent.Visible) then return end
        if P.spin and P.size then
            P.yaw = (P.yaw or 0) + dt * 0.5
            P.frame()
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        task.wait(1)
        while stage.Parent do
            if not P.size or P.name ~= P.wanted then
                pcall(P.load, P.wanted)
            end
            task.wait(4)
        end
    end)

    return P
end

            l.Adornee = workspace.Terrain
            l.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a, b)
            l.Length = len
            l.Color3 = colour
            l.Transparency = 0
            l.Thickness = thickness or 3
            l.Visible = true
        end

            d.boxBB = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

            d.boxBB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 6.5)
            d.boxBB.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, -0.25, 0)
            d.boxBB.AlwaysOnTop = true
            d.boxBB.Enabled = false
            d.boxBB.Parent = holder

            local function frame(z) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local f = Instance.new("Frame", d.boxBB)
                f.BorderSizePixel = 0
                f.Visible = false
                f.ZIndex = z
                return f
            end
            d.fill = frame(2)
            d.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

            d.box = frame(3)
            d.box.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            d.box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            d.boxS = Instance.new("UIStroke", d.box)
            d.boxS.Thickness = 1

            d.boxOutS = Instance.new("UIStroke", d.box)
            d.boxOutS.Thickness = 3
            d.boxOutS.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            d.boxOutS.Transparency = 0.35

                local L, T = 0.18, 1
                local defs = {
                    { 0, 0, 0, 0, L, 0 }, { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, L },
                    { 1, 0, 1, 0, L, 0 }, { 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, L },
                    { 0, 1, 0, 1, L, 0 }, { 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, L },
                    { 1, 1, 1, 1, L, 0 }, { 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, L },
                }
                for i, b in ipairs(defs) do
                    local out = frame(3)
                    out.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    out.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(b[3], b[4])
                    out.Position = UDim2.fromScale(b[1], b[2])

        local function hide(d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            d.boxBB.Enabled = false
            d.edge.Visible = false
            d.adorn.Visible = false
            d.dot.Visible = false
            d.tracer.Visible = false
            d.hl.Enabled = false
            d.body.Enabled = false
            d.bb.Enabled = false
            d.bbLow.Enabled = false
            for _, set in ipairs({ d.bones, d.bonesOut }) do
                for _, o in ipairs(set) do o.Visible = false end
            end
        end

        local function isInvisible(char) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local hidden, total = 0, 0
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    total = total + 1
                    if part.Transparency > 0.8 then hidden = hidden + 1 end
                end
            end
            if total < 2 or hidden < total * 0.5 then return false end
            for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if item:IsA("Tool") then
                    local n = item.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("invisib") or n:find("cloak")
                        or n:find("cupid") or n:find("wing") then return true end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function render(plr, d) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local E = ESP_CFG
            local char = plr.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not (E and E.enabled and char and root and hum and hum.Health > 0) then
                hide(d) return
            end

            local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local studs = myRoot and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
            if E.limitDist and studs > E.maxDist then hide(d) return end

            local invis = E.invDetect and isInvisible(char)
            local c = E.colour
            local r6 = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
            local wantBox = invis and (E.invMode == 2 or E.invMode == 3) or (not invis and E.box)
            local wantChams = invis and (E.invMode == 1 or E.invMode == 3) or (not invis and E.chams)

            local normal = wantBox and E.boxType == 1
            local corner = wantBox and E.boxType == 2
            local hitbox = wantBox and E.boxType == 3

            d.boxBB.Adornee = root
            d.boxBB.MaxDistance = E.limitDist and E.maxDist or 1e9
            d.boxBB.Enabled = normal or corner

            d.box.Visible = normal
            d.boxS.Color = c
            d.boxOutS.Enabled = E.boxOutline

            d.fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
            d.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ((invis and 45 or E.boxFillA) / 100)
            d.fill.Visible = (normal or corner) and (invis or E.boxFill)

            for i, f in ipairs(d.brackets) do
                f.BackgroundColor3 = c
                f.Visible = corner
                d.bracketsOut[i].Visible = corner and E.boxOutline
            end

            d.edge.Adornee = root
            d.edge.Color3 = c
            d.edge.Visible = hitbox

            d.adorn.Adornee = root
            d.adorn.Size = root.Size + Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
            d.adorn.Color3 = c
            d.adorn.Transparency = 1 - ((invis and 45 or E.boxFillA) / 100)
            d.adorn.Visible = hitbox and (invis or E.boxFill)

            for i, defn in ipairs(SKEL) do
                local l, o = d.bones[i], d.bonesOut[i]
                local p0 = E.skeleton and char:FindFirstChild(defn[1])
                local p1 = E.skeleton and char:FindFirstChild(defn[2])
                if p0 and p1 then
                    aim(o, p0.Position, p1.Position, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 5)
                    aim(l, p0.Position, p1.Position, E.skelColour, 3)
                else
                    l.Visible = false
                    o.Visible = false
                end
            end

            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if E.headDot and head then
                d.dot.Adornee = head
                d.dot.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                d.dot.Color3 = E.skelColour
                d.dot.Visible = true
            else
                d.dot.Visible = false
            end

            if E.tracer and myRoot then
                aim(d.tracer, myRoot.Position, root.Position, c, 2)
            else
                d.tracer.Visible = false
            end

            if wantChams then
                d.hl.Adornee = char
                d.hl.FillColor = E.chamsColour
                d.hl.OutlineColor = E.chamsColour
                d.hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
                d.hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                d.hl.DepthMode = E.chamsVisibleOnly
                    and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
                    or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                d.hl.Enabled = true
            else
                d.hl.Enabled = false
            end

            if E.highlightBody then
                d.body.Adornee = char
                d.body.FillColor = E.chamsColour
                d.body.OutlineColor = c
                d.body.FillTransparency = 1 - (E.highlightFill / 100)
                d.body.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
                d.body.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                d.body.Enabled = true
            else
                d.body.Enabled = false
            end

            d.bb.Adornee = head or root
            d.bb.MaxDistance = E.limitDist and E.maxDist or 1e9
            d.bb.Enabled = true
            d.bbLow.Adornee = root
            d.bbLow.MaxDistance = d.bb.MaxDistance
            d.bbLow.Enabled = E.weapon or E.distance or E.healthText

            d.name.Text = plr.DisplayName .. (invis and E.invTag and "  [INVIS]" or "")
            d.name.TextColor3 = E.textColour
            d.name.TextSize = E.textSize
            d.name.Visible = E.name

            local a = math.clamp(hum.Health / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
            local hpCol = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 110), a)
            d.hpText.Text = string.format("%d hp", math.floor(hum.Health))
            d.hpText.TextColor3 = hpCol
            d.hpText.Visible = E.healthText

            local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            d.weapon.Text = tool and tool.Name or "none"
            d.weapon.TextColor3 = E.textColour
            d.weapon.Visible = E.weapon

            d.dist.Text = string.format("%d studs", math.floor(studs))
            d.dist.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 188)
            d.dist.Visible = E.distance

            local admin = GAMEPASSES[1]
            local hasAdmin = plr:GetAttribute(admin.attr) ~= nil
            d.badge.Image = admin.icon
            d.badge.Visible = E.badges and admin.on and hasAdmin

            local anyTool = false
            for i, bpk in ipairs(BACKPACK) do
                local t = d.tools[i]
                local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                local found = char:FindFirstChild(bpk.name)
                    or (bag and bag:FindFirstChild(bpk.name))
                if E.backpack and bpk.on and found and found:IsA("Tool")
                    and found.TextureId ~= "" then
                    t.Image = found.TextureId
                    t.Visible = true
                    anyTool = true
                else
                    t.Visible = false
                end
            end
            d.badges.Visible = d.badge.Visible or anyTool

            d.hpTrack.Visible = E.healthBar
            d.hpOut.Visible = E.healthBar and E.healthBarOutline
            d.hpFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, a, 0)
            d.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = hpCol

            if E.healthBar and not d.boxBB.Enabled then
                d.boxBB.Adornee = root
                d.boxBB.MaxDistance = E.limitDist and E.maxDist or 1e9
                d.boxBB.Enabled = true
            end
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

            if not (ESP_CFG and ESP_CFG.enabled) then
                if next(drawn) then for _p, _d in pairs(drawn) do hide(_d) end end
                return
            end
            cam = workspace.CurrentCamera or cam
            local seen = {}
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= player then
                    seen[plr] = true
                    drawn[plr] = drawn[plr] or build(plr)
                    if not pcall(render, plr, drawn[plr]) then hide(drawn[plr]) end
                end
            end
            for plr, d in pairs(drawn) do
                if not seen[plr] then
                    for _, o in pairs(d) do
                        if typeof(o) == "Instance" then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); o:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                    for _, set in ipairs({ d.bones, d.bonesOut }) do
                        for _, o in ipairs(set) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); o:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                    drawn[plr] = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("[MENU_UI] live ESP failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end)()

        local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
        holder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."BRESP")

        local function fmtGen(n)
            n = tonumber(n) or 0
            local suf, i = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa" }, 1
            while n >= 1000 and i < #suf do n = n / 1000; i = i + 1 end
            if i == 1 then return string.format("$%d/s", math.floor(n)) end
            return string.format("$%.1f%s/s", n, suf[i])
        end

        local rarityCache = {}
        local function rarityOf(name, sg) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local key = name or ""
            local hit = rarityCache[key]
            if hit then return hit end
            local hay = key:lower()
            if type(sg) == "string" then
                hay = hay .. " " .. sg:lower()
            end
            hay = hay:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
            local out = BR_RARITY[#BR_RARITY]
            for _, r in ipairs(BR_RARITY) do
                if hay:find(r.key, 1, true) then out = r break end
            end
            rarityCache[key] = out
            return out
        end

        local nameIndex, indexStamp = {}, 0

        local function buildIndex() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            table.clear(nameIndex)
            for _, folderName in ipairs({ "Plots", "RenderedMovingAnimals" }) do
                local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(folderName)
                if folder then
                    for _, a in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                        if a:IsA("Model") and nameIndex[a.Name] == nil then
                            nameIndex[a.Name] = a
                        end
                        for _, b in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
                            if b:IsA("Model") and nameIndex[b.Name] == nil then
                                nameIndex[b.Name] = b
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            indexStamp = os.clock()
        end

        local function modelFor(part, name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local hit = nameIndex[name]
            if hit and hit.Parent then return hit end

            if os.clock() - indexStamp > 0.5 then
                buildIndex()
                hit = nameIndex[name]
                if hit and hit.Parent then return hit end
            end
            local par = part
            while par and par ~= workspace do
                if par:IsA("Model") then return par end
                par = par.Parent
            end
            return part
        end

        local drawn = {}

        local scanning = false
        local function scan() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local B = BRAINROT_CFG
            if not (B and B.enabled) then hideAll(1) return end

            
            local get = hubHas("getScanList")
            local okL, list = false, nil
            if get then okL, list = pcall(get) end
            if not (okL and type(list) == "table") then hideAll(1) return end
            local getModel = hubHas("getAgModel")

            local myRoot = player.Character
                and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            local found = {}
            local best, bestVal = nil, -1
            local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position
            for _, it in ipairs(list) do
                local model = getModel and select(2, pcall(getModel, it)) or nil
                local part = typeof(model) == "Instance" and (model:IsA("BasePart") and model
                    or model:FindFirstChild("RootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
                    or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)) or nil
                if part then
                    local v = tonumber(it.gen) or 0
                    local name = tostring(it.name or "Unknown")
                    local dist = myPos and (part.Position - myPos).Magnitude or 0
                    local r = rarityOf(name, it.rarityName)
                    local entry = {
                        part = part, model = model, name = name, raw = it.income or fmtGen(v),
                        value = v, dist = dist, rar = r, rank = BR_RANK[r.key] or 0,
                        mut = (it.mutation and it.mutation ~= "None") and tostring(it.mutation) or nil,
                    }
                    if v > bestVal then best, bestVal = entry, v end
                    if v >= B.minValue and not (B.limitDist and dist > B.maxDist) then
                        table.insert(found, entry)
                    end
                end
            end

            table.sort(found, function(a, b) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if a.rank ~= b.rank then return a.rank > b.rank end
                return a.value > b.value
            end)

            local draw = found
            if B.mode == 1 then
                draw = best and { best } or {}
            end

            local orig = (B.style == 1)

            local acc = B.origFollow and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
                or B.origColour
            local acc2 = B.origFollow and Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 200)
                or B.origOutline

            for i, f in ipairs(draw) do
                drawn[i] = drawn[i] or build()
                local d = drawn[i]
                local c = orig and acc or (B.byRarity and f.rar.colour or (B.colourFollow and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent or B.colour))
                local model = f.model or modelFor(f.part, f.name)

                local anchor, bcentre, bsize
                if model and model:IsA("Model") then
                    anchor = model.PrimaryPart
                        or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    local okb, bcf, bsz = pcall(model.GetBoundingBox, model)
                    if okb and bcf then bcentre, bsize = bcf.Position, bsz end
                elseif model and model:IsA("BasePart") then
                    anchor, bcentre, bsize = model, model.Position, model.Size
                end
                if not anchor then anchor = f.part end
                bcentre = bcentre or anchor.Position
                bsize = bsize or anchor.Size

                d.hl.Adornee = model
                d.hl.FillColor = c
                d.hl.OutlineColor = c
                if orig then
                    d.hl.FillTransparency = 1 - (B.origFill / 100)
                    d.hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    d.hl.Enabled = true
                    d.hl2.Adornee = model
                    d.hl2.FillColor = acc2
                    d.hl2.OutlineColor = acc2
                    d.hl2.Enabled = true
                else
                    d.hl.FillTransparency = 1 - (B.hlFill / 100)
                    d.hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    d.hl.Enabled = B.highlight
                    d.hl2.Enabled = false
                end

                d.boxBB.Adornee = anchor
                d.boxBB.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = bcentre - anchor.Position
                d.boxBB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(
                    math.max(bsize.X, bsize.Z) * 1.1, bsize.Y * 1.1)
                d.boxBB.Enabled = (not orig) and B.box

                local corners = (B.boxStyle ~= 2)
                for k = 1, 8 do
                    d.corner[k].BackgroundColor3 = c
                    d.corner[k].Visible = corners
                    d.cornerOut[k].Visible = corners
                end
                d.boxS.Enabled = not corners
                d.boxOutS.Enabled = not corners
                d.boxS.Color = c

                d.fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
                d.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (B.boxFillA / 100)
                d.fill.Visible = B.boxFill

                d.origBB.Adornee = f.part
                d.origBB.Enabled = orig
                if orig then
                    d.origName.Text = (f.mut and ("[" .. f.mut:upper() .. "] ") or "") .. f.name:upper()
                    d.origValue.Text = f.raw
                    d.origValue.TextColor3 = acc
                    d.origStroke.Color = acc
                end

                d.bb.Adornee = f.part
                d.bb.Enabled = (not orig)
                    and (B.name or B.value or B.distance or B.rarityTag)

                d.rarity.Text = f.rar.name:upper()
                d.rarity.TextColor3 = c
                d.rarity.Visible = B.rarityTag

                d.name.Text = (f.mut and ("[" .. f.mut:upper() .. "] ") or "") .. f.name:upper()
                d.name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                d.name.TextSize = B.textSize
                d.name.Visible = B.name

                d.value.Text = f.raw
                d.value.TextColor3 = c
                d.value.TextSize = math.max(9, B.textSize - 1)
                d.value.Visible = B.value

                d.dist.Text = string.format("%dst", math.floor(f.dist))
                d.dist.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178)
                d.dist.Visible = B.distance
            end
            hideAll(#draw + 1)

            if B.setFeed then
                local rows = {}
                for i = 1, math.min(#found, 14) do
                    local f = found[i]
                    rows[i] = {
                        name = (f.mut and (f.mut .. " ") or "") .. f.name, raw = f.raw, dist = f.dist,
                        rarity = f.rar.name, best = (f == best),
                        colour = B.byRarity and f.rar.colour or (B.colourFollow and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent or B.colour),
                    }
                end
                pcall(B.setFeed, rows)
            end
        end

        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while holder.Parent do
                if not scanning then
                    scanning = true
                    pcall(scan)
                    scanning = false
                end
                task.wait(math.clamp((BRAINROT_CFG and BRAINROT_CFG.refresh) or 0.1, 0.05, 3))
            end
        end)
    end)

    if not ok then
        warn("[MENU_UI] brainrot ESP failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local _blConns = {}
    local _blUserSwitching = false
    local _blSwitchEnds = 0
    local _blSuspended = false
    local _blSuspendUntil = 0
    local STEAL_ATTRS = {"Stealing","steal","stolen","isStealing"}
    local function _blIsSteal()
        for _, attr in ipairs(STEAL_ATTRS) do
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return LP:GetAttribute(attr) end)
            if ok and v ~= nil and v ~= false and v ~= 0 then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function _blClear()
        for _, c in ipairs(_blConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        _blConns = {}
    end
    local function _blMoveTools(char)
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not hum or not bp then return end
        if _blUserSwitching or tick() < _blSwitchEnds then return end
        if _blIsSteal() then return end
        if _blSuspended or tick() < _blSuspendUntil then return end
        local keepCarpet = S.CARPET_SPEED_ENABLED == true
        if not keepCarpet then
            pcall(function() hum:UnequipTools() end)
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then
                if keepCarpet and t.Name:lower():find("carpet") then continue end
                pcall(function() t.Parent = bp end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function _blHookChar(char)
        if not char then return end
        task.delay(0.05, function() if S.BACKPACK_LOCK then _blMoveTools(char) end end)
        table.insert(_blConns, char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not S.BACKPACK_LOCK or not obj:IsA("Tool") then return end
            task.defer(function()
                task.wait()
                if not S.BACKPACK_LOCK then return end
                if _blUserSwitching or tick() < _blSwitchEnds then return end
                if _blIsSteal() then return end
                if _blSuspended or tick() < _blSuspendUntil then return end
                if obj.Parent == char then
                    local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                    if bp then pcall(function() obj.Parent = bp end) end
                end
            end)
        end))
    end
    function S.startBackpackLock()
        _blClear()
        if LP.Character then _blHookChar(LP.Character) end
        table.insert(_blConns, LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(_blHookChar))
        table.insert(_blConns, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp, gpe)
            local kc = inp.KeyCode
            local isHotbar = kc and (kc.Value >= Enum.KeyCode.One.Value and kc.Value <= Enum.KeyCode.Nine.Value)
            local isClick = inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            if isHotbar or isClick then
                _blUserSwitching = true
                _blSwitchEnds = tick() + 1.5
                task.delay(1.5, function() _blUserSwitching = false end)
            end
        end))
    end
    function S.stopBackpackLock() _blClear() end
    function S.suspendBackpackLock(dur)
        _blSuspendUntil = tick() + (tonumber(dur) or 5)
        _blSuspended = true
        task.delay(tonumber(dur) or 5, function()
            if tick() >= _blSuspendUntil then _blSuspended = false end
        end)
    end
    function S.unsuspendBackpackLock() _blSuspended = false; _blSuspendUntil = 0 end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _mwConns = {}
    local NAME_HINTS = {"running","footstep","footsteps","walk","step","movement"}
    local function _mwLooksWalk(name)
        name = string.lower(name or "")
        for _, h in ipairs(NAME_HINTS) do if name:find(h, 1, true) then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local function _mwMute(s)
        if not (S.MUTE_WALK and s and s:IsA("Sound") and _mwLooksWalk(s.Name)) then return end
        pcall(function() s.Volume = 0 end)
        table.insert(_mwConns, s:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Volume"):Connect(function()
            if S.MUTE_WALK and s.Volume ~= 0 then pcall(function() s.Volume = 0 end) end
        end))
    end
    local function _mwHookChar(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do _mwMute(d) end
        table.insert(_mwConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if S.MUTE_WALK and d:IsA("Sound") then task.defer(_mwMute, d) end
        end))
    end
    function S.startMuteWalk()
        for _, c in ipairs(_mwConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _mwConns = {}
        if LP.Character then _mwHookChar(LP.Character) end
        table.insert(_mwConns, LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            if not S.MUTE_WALK then return end; task.wait(0.3); _mwHookChar(char)
        end))
    end
    function S.stopMuteWalk()
        for _, c in ipairs(_mwConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _mwConns = {}
    end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local _htpConns = {}
    local _htpOrigText, _htpOrigColor = {}, {}
    local _htpOrigPrompt, _htpOrigGrad = {}, {}
    local REGION_TEXT = "Trading Plaza Isnt Available In Your Current Region"
    local REGION_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    local function _htpApply(obj)
        if not S.HIDE_TRADE_PLAZA then return end
        if obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
            if _htpOrigText[obj] == nil then _htpOrigText[obj] = obj.Text; _htpOrigColor[obj] = obj.TextColor3 end
            pcall(function() obj.Text = REGION_TEXT; obj.TextColor3 = REGION_COLOR end)
            table.insert(_htpConns, obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if S.HIDE_TRADE_PLAZA and obj.Text ~= REGION_TEXT then
                    pcall(function() obj.Text = REGION_TEXT; obj.TextColor3 = REGION_COLOR end)
                end
            end))
        elseif obj:IsA("UIGradient") then
            if _htpOrigGrad[obj] == nil then _htpOrigGrad[obj] = obj.Enabled end
            pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end)
        elseif obj:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
            if _htpOrigPrompt[obj] == nil then _htpOrigPrompt[obj] = obj.Enabled end
            pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end)
        end
    end
    function S.startHideTradePlaza()
        local portal = workspace:FindFirstChild("TradePlazaPortal")
        if portal then
            for _, obj in ipairs(portal:GetDescendants()) do _htpApply(obj) end
            table.insert(_htpConns, portal.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if S.HIDE_TRADE_PLAZA then task.defer(_htpApply, obj) end
            end))
        else
            table.insert(_htpConns, workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if S.HIDE_TRADE_PLAZA and child.Name == "TradePlazaPortal" then
                    for _, obj in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do _htpApply(obj) end
                end
            end))
        end
    end
    function S.stopHideTradePlaza()
        for _, c in ipairs(_htpConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _htpConns = {}
        for obj, t in pairs(_htpOrigText) do if obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj.Text = t end) end end
        for obj, c in pairs(_htpOrigColor) do if obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj.TextColor3 = c end) end end
        for obj, e in pairs(_htpOrigPrompt) do if obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj.Enabled = e end) end end
        for obj, e in pairs(_htpOrigGrad) do if obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj.Enabled = e end) end end
        _htpOrigText, _htpOrigColor, _htpOrigPrompt, _htpOrigGrad = {}, {}, {}, {}
    end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _spTool, _spRespawnConn = nil, nil
    local _spHidden = false

    local function _setGuiRootsEnabled(on)
        for _, sg in ipairs(_G.SMVLL_UI_ROOTS or {}) do
            pcall(function() sg.Enabled = on end)
        end
        local function sweep(container) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for _, sg in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if sg:IsA("ScreenGui") and (sg.Name:find("SMVLL", 1, true) or sg.Name:find("_ESPTop", 1, true)) then
                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); sg.Enabled = on end)
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function() sweep(LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")) end)
        pcall(function() sweep(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    end

    local function _setWorldEspEnabled(on)
        pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Highlight") then
                    obj.Enabled = on
                elseif obj:IsA("BillboardGui") and (obj.Name:find("SMVLL", 1, true) or obj.Name:find("_Plr", 1, true) or obj.Name:find("_Pet", 1, true)) then
                    obj.Enabled = on
                elseif obj:IsA("BoxHandleAdornment") and obj.Name:find("_PlrHitbox", 1, true) then
                    obj.Visible = on
                elseif obj:IsA("Beam") and (obj.Name:find("SMVLL", 1, true) or obj.Name:find("PlotBeam", 1, true) or obj.Name:find("_BestBeam", 1, true)) then
                    obj.Enabled = on
                elseif obj:IsA("SelectionBox") and obj:GetAttribute("SmvllMineBox") then
                    obj.Visible = on
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    function S.setStreamproofHidden(hidden)
        _spHidden = hidden
        _setGuiRootsEnabled(not hidden)
        _setWorldEspEnabled(not hidden)
    end

    local function _giveTool()
        if _spTool and _spTool.Parent then return end
        local t = Instance.new("Tool")
        t.Name = "Streamproof"
        t.RequiresHandle = false
        t.CanBeDropped = false
        t.ToolTip = "Hide / show SMVLL HUB"
        t.Activated:Connect(function()
            S.setStreamproofHidden(not _spHidden)
        end)
        t.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("Backpack")
        _spTool = t
    end

    function S.startStreamproofTool()
        _giveTool()
        if not _spRespawnConn then
            _spRespawnConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if S.STREAMPROOF_TOOL then task.wait(0.5); _giveTool() end
            end)
        end
    end
    function S.stopStreamproofTool()
        if _spHidden then S.setStreamproofHidden(false) end
        if _spRespawnConn then _spRespawnConn:Disconnect(); _spRespawnConn = nil end
        if _spTool then pcall(function() _spTool:Destroy() end); _spTool = nil end
    end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _trbConns = {}
    local _trbOverlays = {}
    local UNAVAIL = "\240\159\148\146 Unavailable"
    local function _trbFindSend(frame) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local fill = frame:FindFirstChild("Fill")
        return fill and fill:FindFirstChild("Send")
    end
    local function _trbBuild(playerFrame, sendBtn) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _trbOverlays[playerFrame] then return end
        local origColor = sendBtn.BackgroundColor3
        local data = { sendBtn = sendBtn, origColor = origColor, origActive = sendBtn.Active, origAuto = sendBtn.AutoButtonColor }
        local lbl = sendBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true)
        if lbl then data.origText = lbl.Text; data.origTcol = lbl.TextColor3 end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            sendBtn.AutoButtonColor = false; sendBtn.Active = false
            local h, s, v = Color3.toHSV(origColor)
            sendBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.15, math.min(v * 0.55, 0.32))
        end)
        if lbl then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); lbl.Text = UNAVAIL; lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 170) end) end
        local blocker = Instance.new("TextButton")
        blocker.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); blocker.BackgroundTransparency = 1; blocker.Text = ""
        blocker.ZIndex = sendBtn.ZIndex + 50; blocker.Active = true; blocker.Parent = sendBtn
        data.blocker = blocker
        _trbOverlays[playerFrame] = data
    end
    local function _trbRemove(playerFrame)
        local data = _trbOverlays[playerFrame]; if not data then return end
        pcall(function() data.sendBtn.BackgroundColor3 = data.origColor; data.sendBtn.Active = data.origActive; data.sendBtn.AutoButtonColor = data.origAuto end)
        if data.origText then pcall(function() local l = data.sendBtn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel", true); if l then l.Text = data.origText; l.TextColor3 = data.origTcol end end) end
        pcall(function() data.blocker:Destroy() end)
        _trbOverlays[playerFrame] = nil
    end
    local function _trbRemoveAll() for pf in pairs(_trbOverlays) do _trbRemove(pf) end end
    function S.startTradeRegionBlock()
        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
            if not pg then return end
            while S.TRADE_REGION_BLOCK do
                local tpl = pg:FindFirstChild("TradePlayerList")
                local inner = tpl and tpl:FindFirstChild("TradePlayerList")
                local sections = inner and inner:FindFirstChild("Sections")
                local players = sections and sections:FindFirstChild("Players")
                local list = players and players:FindFirstChild("List")
                if list then
                    for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                        if child:IsA("GuiObject") and not _trbOverlays[child] then
                            local send = _trbFindSend(child)
                            if send then task.spawn(_trbBuild, child, send) end
                        end
                    end
                    table.insert(_trbConns, list.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        if not S.TRADE_REGION_BLOCK then return end; task.wait(0.1)
                        local send = _trbFindSend(child)
                        if send then task.spawn(_trbBuild, child, send) end
                    end))
                    list.AncestryChanged:Wait()
                    _trbRemoveAll()
                end
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end)
    end
    function S.stopTradeRegionBlock()
        for _, c in ipairs(_trbConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _trbConns = {}
        _trbRemoveAll()
    end
end)()

;(function()
    local S = _G.SMVLL_HUB
    local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _akConns = {}
    local KW = "you stole"
    local _akKicking = false
    local _akStartTime = tick()
    local _akGRACE = 12
    local AK_REASON = "SMVLL HUB \226\128\162 Vol d\195\169tect\195\169 \226\128\148 auto-kick pour prot\195\169ger ton compte"
    local function _akHasKW(t) return type(t) == "string" and t:lower():find(KW, 1, true) ~= nil end
    local function _akDoKick()
        if _akKicking then return end; _akKicking = true
        pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId, LP) end)
        pcall(function() LP:Kick(AK_REASON) end)
        pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end)
        task.delay(0.4, function()
            pcall(function() game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(game.PlaceId, LP) end)
            pcall(function() LP:Kick(AK_REASON) end)
            _akKicking = false
        end)
    end
    local function _akOnDetected()
        if tick() - _akStartTime < _akGRACE then return end
        _akDoKick()
    end
    local function _akWatch(obj)
        if not (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) then return end
        pcall(function() if _akHasKW(obj.Text) then _akOnDetected() end end)
        table.insert(_akConns, obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
            if S.AUTO_KICK_ON_STEAL and _akHasKW(obj.Text) then _akOnDetected() end
        end))
    end
    function S.startAutoKickOnSteal()
        for _, c in ipairs(_akConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _akConns = {}
        _akStartTime = tick()
        task.spawn(function()
            local pg = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10); if not pg then return end
            for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do pcall(_akWatch, d) end
            table.insert(_akConns, pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if S.AUTO_KICK_ON_STEAL then pcall(_akWatch, d) end
            end))
        end)
    end
    function S.stopAutoKickOnSteal()
        for _, c in ipairs(_akConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end; _akConns = {}
    end
end)()

local FEAT = { cfg = {}, win = {} }

;(function()

local function panelShell(title, w, h, withStage)
    local win = makeWindow(title, w, h)
    local listW = withStage and 0.50 or 1

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", win)
    list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38)
    list.Size = UDim2.new(listW, withStage and -14 or -20, 1, -48)
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    list.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5
    list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = GREEN
    paintAs(list, "scrollBar")
    list.ZIndex = 31
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", list)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout", list)
    ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local stage
    if withStage then
        stage = Instance.new("Frame", win)
        stage.Position = UDim2.new(0.50, 4, 0, 38)
        stage.Size = UDim2.new(0.50, -14, 1, -48)
        stage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 17, 20)
        stage.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        THEME.line(stage, 0.25)
        stage.BorderSizePixel = 0
        stage.ClipsDescendants = true
        stage.ZIndex = 31
        Instance.new("UICorner", stage).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.md)
        addStroke(stage, 1).Transparency = 0.6
    end
    return win, list, stage
end
PREV.panelShell = panelShell

FEAT.cfg.fps = {
    enabled = false,
    live = true,

    lightShadows = true, lightFog = true, lightEnv = true,
    killPost = true, killAtmos = true,
    dark = false, darkAmount = 55,

    particles = true, explosions = true,
    decals = false, meshTextures = false,
    materials = false, reflectance = true, shadows = true,

    accessories = false, clothing = false, toolMeshes = true,
    otherAnims = false,
}

pcall(function()
    local C = FEAT.cfg.fps
    local win, list, stage = panelShell("FPS Boost", 470, 372, true)
    FEAT.win.fps = win

    local conns = {}
    local touched = {}
    local lightSaved = nil

    local function isPlayerModel(model) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not model then return false end
        return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) ~= nil
    end

    local function strip(obj) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.enabled then return end
        local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if isPlayerModel(model) then

            if not (C.accessories or C.clothing or C.otherAnims) then return end
        end

        if C.particles and (obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail")
            or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire")
            or obj:IsA("Sparkles")) then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj.Enabled = false end)
            return
        end
        if C.explosions and obj:IsA("Explosion") then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj:Destroy() end)
            return
        end
        if C.decals and (obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture")
            or obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")) then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj:Destroy() end)
            return
        end
        if C.meshTextures and obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj.TextureID = "" end)
        end
        if C.accessories and obj:IsA("Accessory") then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj:Destroy() end)
            return
        end
        if C.clothing and obj:IsA("Clothing") then
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); obj:Destroy() end)
            return
        end

        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

            if touched[obj] == nil then
                touched[obj] = {
                    m = obj.Material, r = obj.Reflectance, s = obj.CastShadow,
                }
            end
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                if C.materials then obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic end
                if C.reflectance then obj.Reflectance = 0 end
                if C.shadows then obj.CastShadow = false end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function restoreParts() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for part, old in pairs(touched) do
            if part.Parent then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    part.Material = old.m
                    part.Reflectance = old.r
                    part.CastShadow = old.s
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(touched)
    end

    local function applyLighting() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local L = game:GetService("Lighting")
        if not lightSaved then
            lightSaved = {
                gs = L.GlobalShadows, fe = L.FogEnd, fs = L.FogStart,
                ed = L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale, es = L.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
                br = L.Brightness, amb = L.Ambient, out = L.OutdoorAmbient,
            }
        end
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if C.enabled and C.lightShadows then L.GlobalShadows = false
            else L.GlobalShadows = lightSaved.gs end

            if C.enabled and C.lightFog then
                L.FogEnd = 1000000
                L.FogStart = 0
            else
                L.FogEnd = lightSaved.fe
                L.FogStart = lightSaved.fs
            end

            if C.enabled and C.lightEnv then
                L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
                L.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
            else
                L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = lightSaved.ed
                L.EnvironmentSpecularScale = lightSaved.es
            end

            if C.enabled and C.dark then
                local k = 1 - math.clamp(C.darkAmount / 100, 0, 0.95)
                L.Brightness = lightSaved.br * k
                local a = math.floor(60 * k)
                L.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(a, a, a)
                L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(a, a, a)
            else
                L.Brightness = lightSaved.br
                L.Ambient = lightSaved.amb
                L.OutdoorAmbient = lightSaved.out
            end
        end)

        if C.enabled then
            for _, v in ipairs(L:GetChildren()) do
                local post = v:IsA("BloomEffect") or v:IsA("BlurEffect")
                    or v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or v:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
                    or v:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
                if (C.killPost and post) or (C.killAtmos and v:IsA("Atmosphere")) then

                    pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        if v:IsA("Atmosphere") then v.Density = 0 else v.Enabled = false end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function sweep() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.enabled then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            pcall(strip, obj)
        end
    end

    local function apply() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        applyLighting()
        for _, c in pairs(conns) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); c:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(conns)
        if not C.enabled then
            restoreParts()
            return
        end
        sweep()
        if C.live then
            conns.added = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                pcall(strip, o)
            end)
        end
    end
    C.apply = apply

    ;(function()
        local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame", stage)
        vp.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        vp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 160, 210)
        vp.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
        vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
        vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -0.9, -0.4)
        vp.ZIndex = 32

        local cap = Instance.new("TextLabel", stage)
        cap.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7)
        cap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 11)
        cap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        cap.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        cap.Text = "PREVIEW"
        cap.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 228)
        cap.TextSize = 8
        cap.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        cap.ZIndex = 40

        local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        world.Parent = vp

        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 40
        cam.Parent = vp
        vp.CurrentCamera = cam

        local scene = { parts = {}, fx = {} }

        local function block(size, cf, colour, mat)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored = true
            p.Size = size
            p.CFrame = cf
            p.Color = colour
            p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Grass
            p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            p.Parent = world
            scene.parts[#scene.parts + 1] = { p = p, m = p.Material, r = 0 }
            return p
        end

        local ground = block(Vector3.new(22, 1, 22), CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0),
                             Color3.fromRGB(88, 150, 80), Enum.Material.Grass)

        block(Vector3.new(24, 0.6, 3), CFrame.new(0, -0.6, 11.5),
              Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 145), Enum.Material.Slate)

        block(Vector3.new(1.4, 6, 1.4), CFrame.new(-5.5, 3, -2),
              Color3.fromRGB(110, 78, 48), Enum.Material.Wood)
        block(Vector3.new(6, 3, 6), CFrame.new(-5.5, 7, -2),
              Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 70), Enum.Material.LeafyGrass)
        block(Vector3.new(4.4, 2.4, 4.4), CFrame.new(-5.5, 9.2, -2),
              Color3.fromRGB(84, 158, 84), Enum.Material.LeafyGrass)

        local gem = block(Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6),
                          CFrame.new(4.5, 0.8, 2) * CFrame.Angles(0.4, 0.6, 0),
                          Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255), Enum.Material.Glass)
        gem.Reflectance = 0.4
        scene.parts[#scene.parts].r = 0.4

        local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", gem)
        emitter.Rate = 14
        emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.2, 1.8)
        emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
        emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35)
        emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
        })
        emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255))
        emitter.LightEmission = 0.6
        scene.fx[#scene.fx + 1] = emitter

        local rig
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, model = pcall(function()
                return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(player.UserId)
            end)
            if not (ok and model) then return end
            for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then d:Destroy() end
            end
            model.Parent = world
            pcall(function()
                model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(2, 3, 3) * CFrame.Angles(0, -0.5, 0))
            end)
            rig = model
        end)

        local yaw = 0.5
        local function frame() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
                * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(-0.22, 0, 0)
                * CFrame.new(0, 0, 24)
        end
        frame()

        local function refresh() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local on = C.enabled
            for _, e in ipairs(scene.fx) do
                e.Enabled = not (on and C.particles)
            end
            for _, rec in ipairs(scene.parts) do
                local p = rec.p
                if p.Parent then
                    p.Material = (on and C.materials) and Enum.Material.Plastic or rec.m
                    p.Reflectance = (on and C.reflectance) and 0 or rec.r
                    p.CastShadow = not (on and C.shadows)
                end
            end
            if rig then
                for _, d in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Accessory") then
                        d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    end
                end
            end

            local k = (on and C.dark) and (1 - math.clamp(C.darkAmount / 100, 0, 0.9)) or 1
            vp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                math.floor(120 * k), math.floor(160 * k), math.floor(210 * k))
            local a = math.floor(150 * k)
            vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(a, a, a)
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not (win.Parent and win.Visible) then return end
            yaw = yaw + dt * 0.18
            frame()
        end)

        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while win.Parent do
                if win.Visible then pcall(refresh) end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end)()

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true; apply() end,

                                 false, "fpsOn")

        function() C.live = true; apply() end,
        function() C.live = false; apply() end, true, "fpsLive")
    makeButtonStrip(g1, {
        { "Re-sweep now", function()

            NOTIFY.push("FPS Boost swept the map", nil, "ok")
        end },
    })

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Lighting", 2)
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Kill shadows", function() C.lightShadows = true; apply() end,
                                      function() C.lightShadows = false; apply() end,
                                      true, "fpsShadowsGlobal")
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Kill fog", function() C.lightFog = true; apply() end,
                                  function() C.lightFog = false; apply() end,
                                  true, "fpsFog")
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Kill ambient light", function() C.lightEnv = true; apply() end,
                                            function() C.lightEnv = false; apply() end,
                                            true, "fpsEnv")

        applyLighting()

    local g3 = makeGroup(list, "World", 3)
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Particles & trails", function() C.particles = true; apply() end,
                                            function() C.particles = false; apply() end,
                                            true, "fpsParticles")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Explosions", function() C.explosions = true; apply() end,
                                    function() C.explosions = false; apply() end,
                                    true, "fpsExplosions")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Decals & textures", function() C.decals = true; apply() end,
                                           function() C.decals = false; apply() end,
                                           false, "fpsDecals")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Mesh textures", function() C.meshTextures = true; apply() end,
                                       function() C.meshTextures = false; apply() end,
                                       false, "fpsMeshTex")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Flatten materials", function() C.materials = true; apply() end,
                                           function() C.materials = false; apply() end,
                                           false, "fpsMaterials")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Kill reflections", function() C.reflectance = true; apply() end,
                                          function() C.reflectance = false; apply() end,
                                          true, "fpsReflect")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Kill cast shadows", function() C.shadows = true; apply() end,
                                           function() C.shadows = false; apply() end,
                                           true, "fpsCastShadow")

    local g4 = makeGroup(list, "Characters", 4)
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Remove accessories", function() C.accessories = true; apply() end,

                                         false, "fpsCloth")
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Strip tool meshes", function() C.toolMeshes = true; apply() end,
