FEAT.cfg.slot = {
    enabled = false, walkable = true, boxes = true,
    thickness = 1, opacity = 72, follow = true,
}

;(function()
    local C = FEAT.cfg.slot
    local win, list = panelShell("Slot ESP", 330, 280, false)
    FEAT.win.slot = win

    local plats, boxes = {}, {}
    local conns = {}
    local holder = nil

    local function clear() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, p in ipairs(plats) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); p:Destroy() end) end
        for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); b:Destroy() end) end
        table.clear(plats)
        table.clear(boxes)
    end

    local function ensureHolder() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if holder and holder.Parent then return holder end
        holder = Instance.new("Folder")
        holder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."Slots")
        holder.Parent = workspace
        return holder
    end

    local SLOT_TEMPLATE = {
        {18.500,1.531,-14.476,90},{18.500,1.531,-6.976,90},{18.500,1.531,0.524,90},
        {18.500,1.531,8.024,90},{18.500,1.531,15.524,90},{-18.536,1.531,15.524,-90},
        {-18.536,1.531,8.024,-90},{-18.536,1.531,0.524,-90},{-18.536,1.531,-6.976,-90},
        {-18.536,1.531,-14.476,-90},{18.500,19.531,-14.476,90},{18.500,19.531,-6.976,90},
        {18.500,19.531,0.524,90},{18.500,19.531,8.024,90},{18.500,19.531,15.524,90},
        {-18.380,19.531,-14.452,-90},{-18.380,19.531,-6.952,-90},{-18.380,19.531,0.548,-90},
        {18.500,36.531,-12.476,90},{18.500,36.531,-4.976,90},{18.500,36.531,2.524,90},
        {18.500,36.531,10.024,90},{18.500,36.531,17.524,90},{-18.472,36.531,-12.501,-90},
        {-18.471,36.531,-5.001,-90},{-18.471,36.531,2.499,-90},{-18.471,36.531,9.999,-90},
        {-18.471,36.531,17.499,-90},
    }
    local SLOT_PAD = Vector3.new(6, 0.25, 6)

    local function slotTint() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
    end

    local function makeOutline(cf, size, ghost) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.boxes then return end
        local h = ensureHolder()
        local acc = slotTint()
        local a = Instance.new("Part")
        a.Anchored = true
        a.CanCollide = false
        a.CanQuery = false
        a.CanTouch = false
        a.Massless = true
        a.Locked = true
        a.Transparency = 1
        a.Size = size
        a.CFrame = cf
        a.Parent = h
        local box = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
        box.Adornee = a
        box.Color3 = acc
        box.SurfaceColor3 = acc
        box.LineThickness = ghost and 0.05 or 0.06
        box.Transparency = 0
        box.SurfaceTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(C.opacity / 100, 0, 1) * (ghost and 0.35 or 0.25)
        box.Parent = a
        boxes[#boxes + 1] = a
    end

    local function makeFloor(cf, size) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.walkable then return end
        local h = ensureHolder()
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."SlotFloor")
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Color = slotTint()
        p.Transparency = 1 - math.clamp(C.opacity / 100, 0, 1) * 0.35
        p.Size = Vector3.new(size.X, C.thickness, size.Z)
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(cf.Position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + C.thickness / 2, 0))
        p.Parent = h
        plats[#plats + 1] = p
    end

    local function makeSlot(cf, size)
        makeOutline(cf, size, false)
        makeFloor(cf, size)
    end

    local lastY = nil
    local nextFloorTick = 0
    RunService.Stepped:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if #plats == 0 or not C.enabled then return end
        local nowT = os.clock()
        if nowT < nextFloorTick then return end
        nextFloorTick = nowT + 0.066
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local y = hrp.Position.Y
        if not lastY then lastY = y end
        local dy = y - lastY
        local rising = (hrp.Velocity.Y > 1) or (dy > 0.01 and dy < 5)
        lastY = y
        local pos = hrp.Position

        for _, p in ipairs(plats) do
            if p.Parent then

                if (p.Position - pos).Magnitude > 40 then
                    p.CanCollide = false
                elseif rising then
                    p.CanCollide = false
                else
                    p.CanCollide = (y > p.Position.Y + p.Size.Y / 2 + 2.6)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local function bounds(slot)
        local ok, cf, size = pcall(function()
            if slot:IsA("Model") then return slot:GetBoundingBox() end
            if slot:IsA("BasePart") then return slot.CFrame, slot.Size end
            return nil
        end)
        if ok and cf then return cf, size end
        return nil
    end

    local function rebuild() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        clear()
        if not C.enabled then return end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local root = plot:FindFirstChild("MainRoot")
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if root and pods then
                for idx, e in ipairs(SLOT_TEMPLATE) do
                    local sl = pods:FindFirstChild(tostring(idx))
                    local base = sl and (sl:FindFirstChild("Base") or sl)
                    local decos = base and base:FindFirstChild("Decorations")
                    local parts = {}
                    if decos then
                        for _, d in ipairs(decos:GetChildren()) do
                            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
                                parts[#parts + 1] = d
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if #parts > 0 then
                        for _, d in ipairs(parts) do
                            makeOutline(d.CFrame, d.Size + Vector3.new(0.03, 0.03, 0.03), false)
                        end
                    else
                        local local_cf = CFrame.new(e[1], e[2], e[3])
                            * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(e[4]), 0)
                        local cf = root.CFrame * local_cf
                        makeOutline(cf, SLOT_PAD, true)
                        makeFloor(cf, SLOT_PAD)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    C.rebuild = rebuild

    local function watch() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); c:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(conns)
        if not C.enabled then return end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local pods = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if pods then
                conns[#conns + 1] = pods.ChildAdded:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    task.delay(0.2, rebuild)
                end)
                conns[#conns + 1] = pods.ChildRemoved:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    task.delay(0.2, rebuild)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function apply() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        rebuild()
        watch()
    end

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true; apply() end,
                                 function() C.enabled = false; apply() end,
                                 false, "slotOn")
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Walkable", function() C.walkable = true; apply() end,
                                  function() C.walkable = false; apply() end,
                                  true, "slotWalk")
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Show boxes", function() C.boxes = true; apply() end,
                                    function() C.boxes = false; apply() end,
                                    true, "slotBoxes")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Opacity", 10, 100, 72, "%.0f%%", function(v)
        C.opacity = v
        if C.enabled then apply() end
    end, "slotOpacity")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Floor thickness", 0.4, 3, 1, "%.1f", function(v)
        C.thickness = v
        if C.enabled then apply() end
    end, "slotThick")
    makeButtonStrip(g1, {
        { "Rebuild", function()
            apply()
            NOTIFY.push("Slot ESP rebuilt", nil, "ok")
        end },
    })

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Notes", 2)
    makeInfoRow(g2, "Colour", "follows the theme")
    makeInfoRow(g2, "Floors", "one-way, jump up through")
end)()

end)()

local function panelShell(title, w, h, withStage)
    local win = makeWindow(title, w, h)
    local listW = withStage and 0.50 or 1

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", win)
    list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38)
    list.Size = UDim2.new(listW, withStage and -14 or -20, 1, -48)
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    list.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5
    list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = GREEN
    paintAs(list, "scrollBar")
    list.ZIndex = 31
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", list)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout", list)
    ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
    ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local stage
    if withStage then
        stage = Instance.new("Frame", win)
        stage.Position = UDim2.new(0.50, 4, 0, 38)
        stage.Size = UDim2.new(0.50, -14, 1, -48)
        stage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 17, 20)
        stage.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        THEME.line(stage, 0.25)
        stage.BorderSizePixel = 0
        stage.ClipsDescendants = true
        stage.ZIndex = 31
        Instance.new("UICorner", stage).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.md)
        addStroke(stage, 1).Transparency = 0.6
    end
    return win, list, stage
end

        local function frame() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not P.size then return end
            local vs = vp.AbsoluteSize
            local aspect = math.max(vs.X, 1) / math.max(vs.Y, 1)
            local half = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2)
            local visH = P.size.Y * 1.6
            local visW = visH * aspect
            local needW = math.max(P.size.X, P.size.Z) * 1.7
            if needW > visW then visW = needW; visH = visW / aspect end
            local dist = ((visH / 2) / half) * P.zoom
            cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(P.centre)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, P.yaw, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(P.pitch, 0, 0)
                * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
            P.visW, P.visH = visW, visH
        end

            local orig = (C.style == 1)
            local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
            local bc = orig and acc or C.boxColour
            local cc = orig and acc or C.chamsColour

            local corners = (C.boxStyle ~= 2)

            for part, col in pairs(base) do

                    part.Color = on and col:Lerp(cc, k) or col
                end

            grab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            grab.Text = ""

            grab.ZIndex = 33
            local dragging, last = false, nil
            UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(i)
                if not (dragging and last) then return end
                local d = i.Position - last
                last = i.Position
                P.yaw = P.yaw - d.X * 0.012
                P.pitch = P.pitch + d.Y * 0.010
                frame()
            end)
            UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(function() dragging = false end)
            grab.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
                if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging, last = true, i.Position
                    P.spin = false
                elseif i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                    P.zoom = math.clamp(P.zoom - i.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.45, 2.2)
                    frame()
                end
            end)
            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
                if not dragging then return end
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                local d = i.Position - last
                last = i.Position
                P.yaw = P.yaw - d.X * 0.012
                P.pitch = P.pitch + d.Y * 0.010
                frame()
            end)
            UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
                if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end

    ;(function()

        local holder = Instance.new("Folder")

        holder.Parent = screenGui.Parent

        local function hideAll(from) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            for i = from, #drawn do
                local d = drawn[i]
                d.hl.Enabled = false
                d.bb.Enabled = false
                d.boxBB.Enabled = false
                for j = 1, #BONES do
                    d.bones[j].Visible = false
                    d.bonesOut[j].Visible = false
                end
            end
        end

        local function ownerOf(model) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return nil end
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local ch = p.Character
                local h2 = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h2 and h2.DisplayName == hum.DisplayName then return p end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function drawBones(d, model, colour, thick) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local n = 0
            for i, pair in ipairs(BONES) do
                local a = model:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
                local b = model:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
                local line, back = d.bones[i], d.bonesOut[i]
                if a and b and a:IsA("BasePart") and b:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local delta = b.Position - a.Position
                    local len = delta.Magnitude
                    if len > 0.01 then
                        local cf = CFrame.lookAt(a.Position, b.Position)
                        back.Adornee = a
                        back.CFrame = a.CFrame:Inverse() * cf
                        back.Length = len
                        back.Thickness = thick + 2
                        back.Visible = true
                        line.Adornee = a
                        line.CFrame = back.CFrame
                        line.Length = len
                        line.Thickness = thick
                        line.Color3 = colour
                        line.Visible = true
                        n = n + 1
                    else
                        line.Visible = false; back.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    line.Visible = false; back.Visible = false
                end
            end
            return n
        end

        local function scan() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if not C.enabled then hideAll(1) return end
            local orig = (C.style == 1)
            local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
            local myRoot = player.Character
                and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local myPos = myRoot and myRoot.Position

            local found = {}
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name:find("_Clone") then
                    local root = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if root then
                        local dist = myPos and (root.Position - myPos).Magnitude or 0
                        if not (C.limitDist and dist > C.maxDist) then
                            found[#found + 1] = { m = obj, root = root, dist = dist }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            for i, f in ipairs(found) do
                drawn[i] = drawn[i] or build()
                local d = drawn[i]
                local bc = orig and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or C.boxColour
                local cc = orig and Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) or C.chamsColour
                local oc = orig and Color3.fromRGB(139, 0, 0) or C.chamsColour

                d.hl.Adornee = f.m
                d.hl.FillColor = cc
                d.hl.OutlineColor = oc
                d.hl.FillTransparency = orig and 0.35
                    or (1 - (C.chamsFill / 100))
                d.hl.OutlineTransparency = (orig or C.outline) and 0 or 1
                d.hl.Enabled = orig or C.chams

                d.boxBB.Adornee = f.root
                d.boxBB.Enabled = (not orig) and (C.box or C.fill)
                local corners = (C.boxStyle ~= 2)
                for k = 1, 8 do
                    d.corner[k].BackgroundColor3 = bc
                    d.corner[k].Visible = C.box and corners
                    d.cornerOut[k].Visible = C.box and corners
                end
                d.boxS.Enabled = C.box and not corners
                d.boxOutS.Enabled = C.box and not corners
                d.boxS.Color = bc
                d.fill.BackgroundColor3 = bc
                d.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (C.fillA / 100)
                d.fill.Visible = C.fill

                if (not orig) and C.skeleton then
                    drawBones(d, f.m, C.skelColour, C.skelThick)
                else
                    for j = 1, #BONES do
                        d.bones[j].Visible = false
                        d.bonesOut[j].Visible = false
                    end
                end

                local plr = ownerOf(f.m)
                d.bb.Adornee = f.root
                d.bb.Enabled = true
                d.name.Text = orig and ((plr and plr.Name or "") .. " CLONE"):gsub("^%s+", "")
                    or "CLONE"
                d.name.TextColor3 = orig and WHITE or C.textColour
                d.name.TextSize = C.textSize
                d.name.Visible = orig or C.name
                d.owner.Text = plr and plr.Name or "?"
                d.owner.TextColor3 = orig and acc or C.textColour
                d.owner.Visible = (not orig) and C.owner
                d.dist.Text = string.format("%dst", math.floor(f.dist))
                d.dist.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 178)
                d.dist.Visible = (not orig) and C.distance
            end
            hideAll(#found + 1)
        end

        task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            while holder.Parent do
                if C.enabled then pcall(scan) end
                task.wait(math.clamp(C.refresh, 0.15, 2))
            end
        end)
    end)()

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true end,
                                 function() C.enabled = false end, false, "cloneOn")
    makeDropdownRow(g1, "ESP style", {
        { name = "Smvll Hub Original" }, { name = "Prism" },
    }, 2, function(i) C.style = i end, "cloneStyle")
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Limit distance", function() C.limitDist = true end,
                                        function() C.limitDist = false end,
                                        false, "cloneLimit")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Max distance", 50, 2000, 500, "%.0f", function(v)
        C.maxDist = v
    end, "cloneDist")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Refresh", 0.05, 1, 0.25, "%.2fs", function(v)
        C.refresh = v
    end, "cloneRefresh")

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Box", 2)
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Box", function() C.box = true end,
                             function() C.box = false end, true, "cloneBox")
    makeDropdownRow(g2, "Box style", {
        { name = "Corners" }, { name = "Full" },
    }, 1, function(i) C.boxStyle = i end, "cloneBoxStyle")
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Box fill", function() C.fill = true end,
                                  function() C.fill = false end, false, "cloneFill")
    makeSliderRow(g2, "Fill opacity", 0, 100, 30, "%.0f%%", function(v)
        C.fillA = v
    end, "cloneFillA")

    local g3 = makeGroup(list, "Chams", 3)
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Chams", function() C.chams = true end,
                               function() C.chams = false end, true, "cloneChams")
    makeSliderRow(g3, "Chams fill", 0, 100, 40, "%.0f%%", function(v)
        C.chamsFill = v
    end, "cloneChamsFill")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Outline", function() C.outline = true end,
                                 function() C.outline = false end, true, "cloneOutline")
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Skeleton", function() C.skeleton = true end,
                                  function() C.skeleton = false end, false, "cloneSkel")
    makeSliderRow(g3, "Bone thickness", 1, 6, 3, "%.0f", function(v)
        C.skelThick = v
    end, "cloneSkelThick")

    local g4 = makeGroup(list, "Labels", 4)
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Name", function() C.name = true end,
                              function() C.name = false end, true, "cloneName")
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Owner", function() C.owner = true end,
                               function() C.owner = false end, true, "cloneOwner")
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Distance", function() C.distance = true end,
                                  function() C.distance = false end, true, "cloneDistOn")
    makeSliderRow(g4, "Text size", 9, 18, 12, "%.0f", function(v)
        C.textSize = math.floor(v)
    end, "cloneTextSize")

    local g5 = makeGroup(list, "Colours", 5)
    makeColorPicker(g5, "Box", C.boxColour, function(c) C.boxColour = c end, "cloneColBox")
    makeColorPicker(g5, "Chams", C.chamsColour, function(c) C.chamsColour = c end, "cloneColChams")
    makeColorPicker(g5, "Skeleton", C.skelColour, function(c) C.skelColour = c end, "cloneColSkel")
    makeColorPicker(g5, "Text", C.textColour, function(c) C.textColour = c end, "cloneColText")
end)()

FEAT.cfg.timer = {
    enabled = false,
    style = 2,
    place = 1,

    followTheme = true,
    textSize = 12,
    refresh = 0.2,
}

;(function()
    local C = FEAT.cfg.timer
    local win, list = panelShell("Timer ESP", 340, 320, false)
    FEAT.win.timer = win

    local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
    holder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."TIMERESP")
    holder.Parent = screenGui.Parent

    local anchorFolder = nil
    local function anchors() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if anchorFolder and anchorFolder.Parent then return anchorFolder end
        anchorFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        anchorFolder.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."TimerAnchors")
        anchorFolder.Parent = workspace
        return anchorFolder
    end

    local cards = {}

    local function makeCard() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local d = {}
        d.anchor = Instance.new("Part")
        d.anchor.Anchored = true
        d.anchor.CanCollide = false
        d.anchor.CanQuery = false
        d.anchor.CanTouch = false
        d.anchor.Transparency = 1

        d.bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

        d.bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        d.bb.LightInfluence = 0
        d.bb.Adornee = d.anchor
        d.bb.Enabled = false
        d.bb.Parent = holder

        d.card = Instance.new("Frame", d.bb)
        d.card.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        d.card.BackgroundColor3 = BG
        d.card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
        d.card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        d.card.ZIndex = 1
        Instance.new("UICorner", d.card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
        d.stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", d.card)
        d.stroke.Thickness = 1

        local col = Instance.new("UIListLayout", d.bb)
        col.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
        col.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        col.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        col.Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)

        d.timer = Instance.new("TextLabel", d.bb)
        d.timer.LayoutOrder = 1
        d.timer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 15)
        d.timer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        d.timer.FontFace = FONT_HEAVY
        d.timer.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
        d.timer.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        d.timer.TextColor3 = WHITE
        d.timer.ZIndex = 3
        d.timer.Text = "60s"

        d.allow = Instance.new("TextLabel", d.bb)
        d.allow.LayoutOrder = 2
        d.allow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 12)
        d.allow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        d.allow.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
        d.allow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
        d.allow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
        d.allow.ZIndex = 3
        d.allow.Text = "-"

        d.state, d.stateCol = "-", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        return d
    end

    local function cardFor(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not cards[name] then cards[name] = makeCard() end
        return cards[name]
    end

    local function update() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.enabled then
            for _, d in pairs(cards) do d.bb.Enabled = false end
            return
        end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return end
        local orig = (C.style == 1)
        local acc = C.followTheme and (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent or C.accentColour

        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local main
            pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); main = plot.Purchases.PlotBlock.Main end)
            if main then
                local d = cardFor(plot.Name)

                local at
                if C.place == 2 then

                    local ok, cf = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        if plot:IsA("Model") then return (plot:GetBoundingBox()) end
                        return nil
                    end)
                    at = (ok and cf) and cf or main.CFrame
                else
                    at = main.CFrame
                end
                d.anchor.CFrame = at + Vector3.new(0, C.height, 0)

                local timerGui, prompt
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); timerGui = main.BillboardGui.RemainingTime end)
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    prompt = plot.FriendPanel.Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
                end)
                if prompt then
                    local act = (prompt.ObjectText or ""):lower()
                    if act:find("disallow") then
                        d.state, d.stateCol = "ALLOW", Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 130)
                    elseif act:find("allow") then
                        d.state, d.stateCol = "DISALLOW", Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
                    end
                end

                d.bb.Enabled = true

                d.card.Visible = orig
                d.card.BackgroundColor3 = BG
                d.card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
                d.stroke.Enabled = orig
                d.stroke.Color = acc
                d.stroke.Transparency = 0.15

                d.timer.Text = (timerGui and timerGui.Text ~= "" and timerGui.Text) or "60s"
                d.timer.TextColor3 = C.followTheme and WHITE or C.textColour
                d.timer.TextSize = C.textSize
                d.timer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, C.textSize + 3)
                d.timer.TextStrokeTransparency = orig and 1 or 0.25
                d.timer.Visible = C.showTimer

                d.allow.Text = d.state

                d.allow.TextColor3 = d.stateCol
                d.allow.TextSize = math.max(9, C.textSize - 2)
                d.allow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, math.max(9, C.textSize - 2) + 3)
                d.allow.TextStrokeTransparency = orig and 1 or 0.25
                d.allow.Visible = C.showAllow

                local _fam = _G.SMVLL_THEME and _G.SMVLL_THEME.fontFamily
                if _fam and d.fontFam ~= _fam then
                    d.fontFam = _fam
                    d.timer.FontFace = Font.new(_fam, Enum.FontWeight.Heavy, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
                    d.allow.FontFace = Font.new(_fam, Enum.FontWeight.Bold, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
                end

                d.bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.max(66, C.textSize * 6), 0,
                    (C.showTimer and C.textSize + 3 or 0)
                    + (C.showAllow and math.max(9, C.textSize - 2) + 3 or 0)
                    + (orig and 10 or 0))
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while holder.Parent do
            pcall(update)
            task.wait(math.clamp(C.refresh, 0.15, 2))
        end
    end)

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true end,
                                 function() C.enabled = false end, false, "timerOn")
    makeDropdownRow(g1, "ESP style", {
        { name = "Smvll Hub Original" }, { name = "Prism" },
    }, 2, function(i) C.style = i end, "timerStyle")
    makeDropdownRow(g1, "Position", {
        { name = "Original" }, { name = "Base centre" },
    }, 1, function(i) C.place = i end, "timerPlace")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Height", 0, 30, 8, "%.0f", function(v)
        C.height = v
    end, "timerHeight")
    makeSliderRow(g1, "Refresh", 0.05, 1, 0.2, "%.2fs", function(v)
        C.refresh = v
    end, "timerRefresh")

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Show", 2)
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Timer", function() C.showTimer = true end,
                               function() C.showTimer = false end, true, "timerShowT")
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Allow state", function() C.showAllow = true end,
                                     function() C.showAllow = false end, true, "timerShowA")
    makeSliderRow(g2, "Text size", 9, 20, 12, "%.0f", function(v)
        C.textSize = math.floor(v)
    end, "timerTextSize")

    local g3 = makeGroup(list, "Colours", 3)
    makeToggleRow(g3, "Follow theme", function() C.followTheme = true end,
                                      function() C.followTheme = false end,
                                      true, "timerFollow")
    makeColorPicker(g3, "Text", C.textColour, function(c) C.textColour = c end, "timerColText")
    makeColorPicker(g3, "Accent", C.accentColour, function(c) C.accentColour = c end, "timerColAcc")
end)()

FEAT.cfg.aim = {
    enabled = false,
    -- Whitelist réduite : seulement ces 4 objets
    tools = {
        ["Web Slinger"] = true, ["Laser Cape"] = true,
        ["Paintball Gun"] = true, ["Body Swap Potion"] = true,
    },
    autoShoot = false, rate = 4,
    range = math.huge, pick = 2,   -- range illimité
    visibleOnly = false,
    marker = true, markerColour = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90),
}

;(function()
    local C = FEAT.cfg.aim
    local win, list = panelShell("Aimbot", 340, 340, false)
    FEAT.win.aim = win

    -- Logique remote aimbot.lua
    local cachedUseItem = nil
    local remIndex = {}
    local remObjs = {}

    local function findUseItemOnce()
        if cachedUseItem then return cachedUseItem end
        local net = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Packages")
        if net then net = net:FindFirstChild("Net") end
        if not net then return nil end
        for _, child in ipairs(net:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                local ok, cs = pcall(getconnections, child.OnClientEvent)
                if ok and cs then
                    for _, c in ipairs(cs) do
                        if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                            local ok2, consts = pcall(debug.getconstants, c.Function)
                            if ok2 and consts then
                                for _, k in ipairs(consts) do
                                    if k == "PaintballHitted" then
                                        cachedUseItem = child
                                        return child
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function initRems()
        local ok, children = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Packages"):WaitForChild("Net"):GetChildren()
        end)
        if not ok or not children then return end
        remIndex = {}
        remObjs = {}
        for i, obj in ipairs(children) do
            if obj:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                local nextObj = children[i + 1]
                if nextObj then
                    remIndex[obj.Name] = i + 1
                    remObjs[i + 1] = nextObj
                end
            end
        end
        findUseItemOnce()
    end

    local function fireRem(name, ...)
        if name == "RE/UseItem" or name == "UseItem" then
            local r = findUseItemOnce()
            if r then r:FireServer(...); return true end
        end
        local idx = remIndex[name]
        if idx and remObjs[idx] then
            remObjs[idx]:FireServer(...)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    initRems()

    local mk = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    mk.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
    mk.AlwaysOnTop = true
    mk.LightInfluence = 0
    mk.Enabled = false
    mk.Parent = screenGui.Parent
    do
        local f = Instance.new("Frame", mk)
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
        st.Thickness = 2
        st.Name = "MK"
        Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    end

    local target = nil
    C.getTarget = function() return target end

    -- Résolution lazy du module PlayerMouse
    local _pm = nil
    local function _getpm()
        if _pm then return _pm end
        pcall(function()
            _pm = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.PlayerMouse)
        end)
        return _pm
    end
    task.spawn(_getpm)

    local function heldTool() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ch = player.Character
        return ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or nil
    end

    local function toolAllowed(tool) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not tool then return false end
        return C.tools[tool.Name] == true
    end

    -- Scan le joueur le plus proche — range illimité (C.range = math.huge)
    local function pickTarget() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ch = player.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= player and p.Character then
                local t = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if t and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local d = (t.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then bestDist = d; best = t end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    -- Écrit PlayerMouse.Hit/Target vers la cible
    local function _applyMouse(tgt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local pm = _getpm()
        if not (pm and tgt and tgt.Parent) then return end
        pcall(function()
            pm.Hit    = CFrame.new(tgt.Position)
            pm.Target = tgt
        end)
    end

    local lastShot = 0
    local _amAcc   = 0

    -- Heartbeat : scan + mise à jour PlayerMouse
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not C.enabled then
            if mk.Enabled then mk.Enabled = false end
            target = nil
            return
        end
        local tool = heldTool()
        if not toolAllowed(tool) then
            mk.Enabled = false
            target = nil
            return
        end

        _amAcc = _amAcc + (dt or 0)
        if _amAcc >= 0.05 then
            _amAcc = 0
            target = pickTarget()
        end

        -- Met à jour PlayerMouse à chaque frame
        _applyMouse(target)

        mk.Adornee = target
        mk.Enabled = C.marker and target ~= nil
        if target then
            local st = mk:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            st = st and st:FindFirstChild("MK")
            if st then st.Color = C.markerColour end
        end

        if not (C.autoShoot and target) then return end

        local interval = 1 / math.clamp(C.rate, 0.5, 12)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastShot < interval then return end

        local gate = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_FIRE_GATE")
        if type(gate) == "function" and not gate("menu_aimbot", interval) then
            return
        end
        lastShot = now

        local pos = target.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
        local ok = fireRem("RE/UseItem", pos, target)
        if not ok then
            initRems()
            fireRem("RE/UseItem", pos, target)
        end
    end)

    -- PreRender : re-pointe la souris juste avant chaque frame de rendu
    -- (les outils lisent PlayerMouse.Hit sur leur propre frame)
    local _preR = RunService.PreRender or RunService.RenderStepped
    _preR:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if C.enabled and target then
            _applyMouse(target)
        end
    end)

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true end,
                                 function() C.enabled = false end, false, "aimOn")

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Auto shoot", 2)
    makeToggleRow(g2, "Auto shoot", function() C.autoShoot = true end,
                                    function() C.autoShoot = false end,
                                    false, "aimAuto")
    makeSliderRow(g2, "Clicks per second", 0.5, 12, 4, "%.1f/s", function(v)
        C.rate = v
    end, "aimRate")

    local g3 = makeGroup(list, "Tool list", 3)
    for _, name in ipairs({
        "Web Slinger", "Laser Cape", "Paintball Gun", "Body Swap Potion",
    }) do
        makeToggleRow(g3, name,
            function() C.tools[name] = true end,
            function() C.tools[name] = false end,
            true, "aimTool_" .. name:gsub("%s", ""))
    end

    local g4 = makeGroup(list, "Protection", 4)
    makeToggleRow(g4, "Anti Body Swap",
        function() hubSet("ANTI_SWAP", true);  hubCall("startAntiSwap") end,
        function() hubSet("ANTI_SWAP", false); hubCall("stopAntiSwap") end,
        true, "antiSwap")
end)()

end)()

FEAT.cfg.intruder = {
    enabled = false,
    colour = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    notify = true,
    banner = true,
    top = 96,
}

pcall(function()
    local C = FEAT.cfg.intruder
    local win, list = (function()
        local w = makeWindow("Intruder Alert", 320, 250)
        local l = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", w)
        l.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 38)
        l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -48)
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.BorderSizePixel = 0
        l.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        l.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        l.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        l.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.5
        l.ScrollBarImageColor3 = GREEN
        paintAs(l, "scrollBar")
        l.ZIndex = 31
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", l)
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2)
        pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout", l)
        ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
        ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        return w, l
    end)()
    FEAT.win.intruder = win

    local banner = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
    banner.Name = "IntruderBanner"
    banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, C.top)
    banner.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
    banner.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 15, 18)
    banner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    THEME.shell(banner, 0.1)
    banner.BorderSizePixel = 0
    banner.Visible = false
    banner.ZIndex = 190
    Instance.new("UICorner", banner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.md)
    local bStroke = addStroke(banner, 1)
    bStroke.Transparency = 0.3
    do
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", banner)
        pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 9)
        pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local row = Instance.new("UIListLayout", banner)
        row.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        row.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        row.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        row.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    end

    local bIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel", banner)
    bIcon.LayoutOrder = 1
    bIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
    bIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    bIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    bIcon.Image = icon("triangle-alert") or ""
    bIcon.Visible = false
    bIcon.ZIndex = 191

    local bRule = Instance.new("Frame", banner)
    bRule.LayoutOrder = 2
    bRule.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 15)
    bRule.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    bRule.BackgroundTransparency = 0.82
    bRule.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bRule.ZIndex = 191

    local bText = Instance.new("TextLabel", banner)
    bText.LayoutOrder = 3
    bText.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    bText.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    bText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    bText.FontFace = FONT_HEAVY
    bText.Text = ""
    bText.TextColor3 = WHITE
    bText.TextSize = 12
    bText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    bText.ZIndex = 191

    local seen = {}

    local function hitbox() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local def = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_DEF")
        if type(def) ~= "table" or type(def.getStealHitbox) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local ok, box = pcall(def.getStealHitbox)
        if ok and box and box.Parent then return box end
        return nil
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while banner.Parent do
            if not C.enabled then
                banner.Visible = false
                if next(seen) then table.clear(seen) end
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                local box = hitbox()
                local names = {}
                if box then
                    local cf, size = box.CFrame, box.Size
                    local hx, hz = size.X * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                    for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        local ch = pl ~= player and pl.Character
                        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if hrp then
                            local rel = cf:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
                            if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                                names[#names + 1] = pl.Name
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local now = {}
                for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                    now[n] = true
                    if not seen[n] and C.notify then
                        NOTIFY.push(n .. " is in your base", nil, "warn", 6)
                    end
                end
                seen = now

                if #names > 0 and C.banner then
                    bIcon.ImageColor3 = C.colour
                    bStroke.Color = C.colour
                    bText.Text = #names .. (#names > 1 and " players" or " player")
                        .. " in your base  ·  " .. table.concat(names, ", ")
                    banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, C.top)
                    banner.Visible = true
                else
                    banner.Visible = false
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end
    end)

    local g1 = makeGroup(list, "General", 1)
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Enabled", function() C.enabled = true end,

                                 false, "intruderOn")
    makeToggleRow(g1, "Banner", function() C.banner = true end,

        C.top = v

    local g2 = makeGroup(list, "Colour", 2)
    makeColorPicker(g2, "Alert colour", C.colour, function(c) C.colour = c end,
                    "intruderColour")
end)

do
local _qpOK = pcall(function()
    local S = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
    if type(S) ~= "table" then return end

    local _qpOrig = {}
    local _qpEnabled = false
    local function _qpIsMyPlot(plot)
        if not plot or not plot:IsA("Model") then return false end
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        return sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase") and sign.YourBase.Enabled
    end
    local function _qpInMyPlot(inst)
        if not inst or not inst.Parent then return false end
        local node = inst.Parent
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            if not node then return false end
            if node:IsA("Model") and node.Parent and node.Parent.Name == "Plots" then
                return _qpIsMyPlot(node)
            end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local _qpConn = nil
    
    
    local _qpPromptConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function _qpApply(d)
        if not _qpEnabled then return end
        if not (d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and _qpInMyPlot(d)) then return end
        if _qpOrig[d] == nil then _qpOrig[d] = d.HoldDuration end
        pcall(function() d.HoldDuration = 0.1 end)
        if not _qpPromptConns[d] then
            _qpPromptConns[d] = d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("HoldDuration"):Connect(function()
                if _qpEnabled and d.HoldDuration ~= 0.1 then
                    pcall(function() d.HoldDuration = 0.1 end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function _startQP()
        _qpEnabled = true
        local root = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") or workspace
        if not _qpConn then
            _qpConn = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
                if not _qpEnabled then return end
                task.defer(_qpApply, d)
            end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if not _qpEnabled then return end
                _qpApply(d)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _stopQP()
        _qpEnabled = false
        if _qpConn then _qpConn:Disconnect(); _qpConn = nil end
        for p, c in pairs(_qpPromptConns) do
            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
            _qpPromptConns[p] = nil
        end
        for p, o in pairs(_qpOrig) do
            if p and p.Parent then pcall(function() p.HoldDuration = o end) end
        end
        _qpOrig = {}
    end

    S.startQuickPickup = _startQP
    S.stopQuickPickup = _stopQP
end)
if not _qpOK then warn("[MENU_UI] quick pickup failed to install") end
end

    local hr = Instance.new("Frame", f)

    local openH, collapsed = h, false
    f:SetAttribute("SmvllOpenH", h)

        collapsed = not collapsed
        f:SetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed", collapsed)
        if collapsed then
            openH = f.Size.Y.Offset
            f:SetAttribute("SmvllOpenH", openH)
            body.Visible = false
            hr.Visible = false
            plus.Text = "+"
            TweenService:Create(f, TW_SPRING,

                { Size = UDim2.new(0, f.Size.X.Offset, 0, openH) })

                body.Visible = true
                hr.Visible = true
            end)
        end

        if (not collapsed) and onCollapse then onCollapse(false) end

    f:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SmvllCollapsed"):Connect(function()
        if (f:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true) ~= collapsed then
            toggleCollapse()
        end
    end)

    local shown = false
    f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
        if f.Visible == shown then return end
        shown = f.Visible
        if not f.Visible then return end

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vs = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local sz = f.AbsoluteSize
        local topLimit = -PREV.uiInsetTop()

        local py = math.clamp(f.Position.Y.Offset, topLimit, math.max(topLimit, vs.Y - sz.Y - 8))
        if px ~= f.Position.X.Offset or py ~= f.Position.Y.Offset then
            f.Position = UDim2.new(0, px, 0, py)
        end

    end)

    trackLayout(f, "hud_" .. title:gsub("%W", ""))

function PREV.hudField(row, default, onCommit)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox", row)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0.5, 0)
    box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 18)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    box.Text = tostring(default)
    box.TextColor3 = WHITE
    box.TextSize = 11
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.ZIndex = 33
    Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local n = tonumber(box.Text:match("%-?%d+%.?%d*"))
        if n then
            box.Text = tostring(math.floor(n * 10 + 0.5) / 10)
            onCommit(n)
        else
            box.Text = tostring(default)
        end
    end)
    return box
end

local function hudSwitch(row, startOn, onChange)
    local sw = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
    sw.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    sw.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
    sw.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 16)
    sw.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    sw.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    sw.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sw.Text = ""
    sw.AutoButtonColor = false
    sw.ZIndex = 33
    Instance.new("UICorner", sw).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local st = addStroke(sw, 1)
    st.Transparency = 0.7

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame", sw)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 34
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local on = startOn and true or false
    local function paint()
        local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, on and 18 or 2, 0.5, 0)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = on and WHITE or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
        sw.BackgroundColor3 = on and acc or WHITE
        sw.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.25 or 0.9
    end
    paint()
    sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        on = not on
        paint()
        onChange(on)
        touched()
    end)
    return sw, function() return on end, function(v) on = v and true or false; paint() end
end

local MUT_COLORS = {
    Gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),      Diamond = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    Rainbow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 200), Lava = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 20),
    Candy = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),   Cursed = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0),
    Divine = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),  YinYang = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220),
    Galaxy = Color3.fromRGB(150, 80, 255),   Bloodrot = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0),
}

local function fmtGen(n) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    n = tonumber(n) or 0
    local suf, i = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa" }, 1
    while n >= 1000 and i < #suf do n = n / 1000; i = i + 1 end
    return string.format(i == 1 and "$%d%s/s" or "$%.1f%s/s", n, suf[i])
end

local function traitNames(tr) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local out = {}
    if type(tr) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(tr) do
            out[#out + 1] = (type(k) == "number") and tostring(v) or tostring(k)
        end
    end
    return out
end

local marker = { hl = nil, bb = nil, model = nil }

local function clearMarker() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    if marker.hl then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); marker.hl:Destroy() end) end
    if marker.bb then pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); marker.bb:Destroy() end) end
    marker.hl, marker.bb, marker.model = nil, nil, nil
end

local function setMarker(model) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    clearMarker()
    if not model then return end
    local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
    marker.model = model

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.FillColor = acc
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.35
    hl.OutlineColor = acc
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Adornee = model
    hl.Parent = screenGui.Parent
    marker.hl = hl

    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = (_G.SMVLL_NAME_TAG.."PrioTarget")
    bb.Adornee = model
    bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 92, 0, 34)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.LightInfluence = 0
    bb.Parent = screenGui.Parent
    marker.bb = bb

    local bg = Instance.new("Frame", bb)
    bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14)
    bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
    bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", bg)
    st.Thickness = 1
    st.Color = acc
    st.Transparency = 0.2

    local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
    tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 15)
    tl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
    tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tl.FontFace = FONT_HEAVY
    tl.Text = "TARGET"
    tl.TextColor3 = WHITE
    tl.TextSize = 11

    local dl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
    dl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 12)
    dl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 18)
    dl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    dl.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    dl.Text = "..."
    dl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
    dl.TextSize = 9

    local function lbl(y, h, size, colour, font) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", r.f)
        t.Position = UDim2.new(0, 68, 0, y)

    r.mut  = lbl(4, 12, 10, WHITE, FONT_HEAVY)

    r.traits = Instance.new("Frame", r.f)

local function paintSel(r, on) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
    r.stroke.Transparency = on and 0.1 or 0.72
    r.stroke.Color = on and acc or WHITE
    r.f.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.86 or 0.94
    r.f.BackgroundColor3 = on and acc or WHITE
end

local function repaintAll() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local isP = hubHas("isPriority")
    for i, r in ipairs(rows) do
        if r.f.Visible then
            local on = false
            if isP and rowSig[i] then
                local ok, v = pcall(isP, rowSig[i])
                on = ok and v == true
            end
            paintSel(r, on)
        end
    end
end

local shown = {}
local function showModel(r, item) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));

    local key = table.concat({
        tostring((item.raw and item.raw.uid) or ""),
        tostring(item.slot or ""),
        tostring(item.name or ""),
        tostring(item.mutation or ""),
    }, "|")
    if shown[r] == key then return end
    shown[r] = key
    for _, c in ipairs(r.vp:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end

    local getModel = hubHas("getAgModel")
    local src = getModel and select(2, pcall(getModel, item.raw)) or nil
    if typeof(src) ~= "Instance" then shown[r] = nil return end

    local okc = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local m = src:Clone()
        for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Light")
                or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") then
                d:Destroy()
            elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.CanCollide = false
                d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
        end
        local world = Instance.new("WorldModel")
        world.Parent = r.vp
        m.Parent = world
        
        pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); m:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(55), 0)) end)
        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 40
        cam.Parent = r.vp
        r.vp.CurrentCamera = cam
        local cf, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local n = math.max(math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.3, 3)
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + Vector3.new(0, n * 0.1, -n), cf.Position)

        local host = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController")
        if not host then host = Instance.new("AnimationController"); host.Parent = m end
        local animator = host:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", host)
        local anim
        local afa = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Animations")
        afa = afa and afa:FindFirstChild("Animals")
        local folder = afa and afa:FindFirstChild(tostring(item.name or ""))
        anim = folder and (folder:FindFirstChild("Walk") or folder:FindFirstChild("Move")
            or folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true))
        if not (anim and anim:IsA("Animation")) then
            
            local sh = src:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or src:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController")
            local sa = sh and sh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            local tr = sa and sa:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()[1]
            if tr and tr.Animation then
                anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                anim.AnimationId = tr.Animation.AnimationId
            end
        end
        if anim then
            local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
            track.Looped = true
            track:Play(0)
        end
    end)
    if not okc then shown[r] = nil end
end

local function refresh() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    local get = hubHas("getScanList")
    if not get then
        count.Text = "engine not up"
        return
    end
    local ok, all = pcall(get)
    if not (ok and type(all) == "table") then return end

    local sigOf = hubHas("getAgSig")
    local q = search.Text:lower()
    local items = {}
    for _, it in ipairs(all) do
        local hay = (tostring(it.name or "") .. " " .. tostring(it.mutation or "")):lower()
        if q == "" or hay:find(q, 1, true) then
            local sig = ""
            if sigOf then
                local oks, v = pcall(sigOf, it)
                sig = oks and tostring(v) or ""
            end
            items[#items + 1] = {
                name = tostring(it.name or "?"),
                gen = it.gen, income = it.income,
                mutation = tostring(it.mutation or "None"),
                owner = it.owner, slot = it.slot,
                traits = it.traits, sig = sig, raw = it,
            }
        end
    end

    count.Text = #items .. (#items == 1 and " brainrot nearby" or " brainrots nearby")

    for i = 1, math.max(#items, #rows) do
        local r = rows[i]
        if i <= #items then
            r = r or makeRow(i)
            local it = items[i]
            r.f.Visible = true
            rowSig[i] = it.sig

            local user = tostring(it.owner or "?")
            for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if pl.DisplayName == user or pl.Name == user then user = pl.Name break end
            end
            local mc = MUT_COLORS[it.mutation]
            local mutTxt = (it.mutation ~= "None" and it.mutation ~= "") and it.mutation or "Normal"
            local hex = mc and string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", mc.R * 255, mc.G * 255, mc.B * 255) or "#9A9AA2"
            r.mut.Text = '<font color="' .. hex .. '">' .. mutTxt .. '</font>'
                .. '<font color="#6E6E76">  @' .. user .. '</font>'
            r.name.Text = it.name

            local names = traitNames(it.traits)
            local tail = #names > 0 and (" - " .. table.concat(names, ", ")) or ""
            r.gen.Text = '<font color="#5BE37A">' .. tostring(it.income or fmtGen(it.gen)) .. '</font>'
                .. '<font color="#8A8A92">' .. tail:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;") .. '</font>'
            r.traits.Visible = #names > 0
            if #names > 0 then
                for _, c in ipairs(r.traits:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
                end
                for k, tn in ipairs(names) do
                    if k > 8 then break end
                    local ic = TRAIT_ICONS[tn]
                    local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", r.traits)
                    img.Size = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
                    img.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    img.BackgroundTransparency = ic and 1 or 0.5
                    img.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    img.Image = ic or ""
                    img.ZIndex = 34
                    if not ic then
                        Instance.new("UICorner", img).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
                        local t2 = Instance.new("TextLabel", img)
                        t2.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                        t2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        t2.Text = tn:sub(1, 2)
                        t2.TextSize = 7
                        t2.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
                        t2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
                        t2.ZIndex = 35
                    end
                end
            end

            showModel(r, it)

            if r.conn then r.conn:Disconnect() end
            r.conn = r.f.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                local h = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
                if type(h) ~= "table" or type(h.PRIORITY) ~= "table" then return end

                local wasOn = (h.PRIORITY[it.sig] == true)
                for k in pairs(h.PRIORITY) do h.PRIORITY[k] = nil end
                if not wasOn then h.PRIORITY[it.sig] = true end
                repaintAll()
                clearMarker()
                if not wasOn then
                    local gm = hubHas("getAgModel")
                    local okm, m = pcall(gm, it.raw)
                    if okm and typeof(m) == "Instance" then setMarker(m) end
                    NOTIFY.push("Priority: " .. it.name, nil, "ok", 3)
                end
            end)
        elseif r then
            r.f.Visible = false
            rowSig[i] = nil
        end
    end
    repaintAll()
end

search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refresh)

task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
    while win.Parent do
        if win.Visible then pcall(refresh) end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

                    r.pfp.Image = ""
                    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        local ok, url = pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                            return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(pl.UserId,
                                Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
                                Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48)
                        end)
                        if ok and url and r.uid == pl.UserId then r.pfp.Image = url end
                    end)
                end
                for k, c in ipairs(CMDS) do
                    local b = r.btns[k]
                    if r.conns and r.conns[k] then r.conns[k]:Disconnect() end
                    r.conns = r.conns or {}
                    r.conns[k] = b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                        local exec = hubHas("ExecuteAdminCommand")
                        if not exec then
                            NOTIFY.push("Admin path not resolved", nil, "error")
                            return
                        end
                        if remaining(c.name) then
                            NOTIFY.push(c.name .. " on cooldown", nil, "warn", 2)
                            return
                        end
                        local acc = (THEME.livePal or _tp).accent
                        b.BackgroundColor3 = acc
                        b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
                        task.delay(0.2, function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                            if b.Parent then
                                b.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
                                b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.93
                            end
                        end)
                        pcall(exec, c.name, pl)
                        NOTIFY.push(c.name .. " -> " .. pl.Name, nil, "ok", 2.5)
                    end)
                end
            elseif r then
                r.f.Visible = false
                r.uid = nil
            end
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then
                for _, c in ipairs(CMDS) do
                    local left = remaining(c.name)
                    for k, cc in ipairs(CMDS) do
                        if cc.name == c.name then
                            for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
                                local b = r.btns[k]
                                if b and b.Parent and r.f.Visible then
                                    local gi = r.icons and r.icons[k]
                                    if left then
                                        b.Text = string.format("%.0fs", left)
                                        if gi then gi.Visible = false end
                                    else
                                        b.Text = ""
                                        if gi then gi.Visible = true end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end)

    local rosterPending = false
    local function rosterChanged()
        if rosterPending then return end
        rosterPending = true
        task.delay(1.2, function()
            rosterPending = false
            if f.Visible then pcall(refresh) end
        end)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(rosterChanged)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(rosterChanged)
    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then pcall(refresh) end
            task.wait(2)
        end
    end)
end)

pcall(function()
    local f, body = hudPanel("Block panel", "shield", 179, 56, 130, 130, nil, "blockPanel")
    FEAT.win.block = f
    f.Visible = false

    local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", body)
    scroll.LayoutOrder = 1
    scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -4)
    scroll.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
    scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 0.97
    scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    scroll.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 1
    scroll.ZIndex = 31
    Instance.new("UICorner", scroll).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
    addStroke(scroll, 1).Transparency = 0.82
    do
        local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout", scroll)
        ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
        ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        local lp = Instance.new("UIPadding", scroll)
        lp.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
        lp.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
        lp.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
    end

    local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel", body)
    empty.LayoutOrder = 2
    empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
    empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    empty.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    empty.Text = "no one else here"
    empty.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 128)
    empty.TextSize = 9
    empty.Visible = false
    empty.ZIndex = 31

    local userSized, lastAutoH = false, nil
    local function fit() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local n = 0
        for _, c in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Frame") then n = n + 1 end
        end
        empty.Visible = (n == 0)
        scroll.Visible = (n > 0)
        if n < 1 then n = 0 end
        if f:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true then return end
        -- if the height isn't what we set last time, the user resized it: stop auto-fitting
        if lastAutoH and math.abs(f.Size.Y.Offset - lastAutoH) > 1 then userSized = true end
        if userSized then return end
        local listH = math.clamp(8 + n * 34 + math.max(n - 1, 0) * 4, 22, 56)
        lastAutoH = listH + 34
        f.Size = UDim2.new(0, f.Size.X.Offset, 0, lastAutoH)
    end

    _G.SMVLL_V3_BLOCKPANEL = function(on)
        f.Visible = on and true or false
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then
                local fn = hubHas("_refreshBlockList")
                if fn then
                    local cp = scroll.CanvasPosition
                    pcall(fn, scroll, nil)
                    pcall(fit)
                    scroll.CanvasPosition = cp
                    task.defer(function() scroll.CanvasPosition = cp end)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)

    trackLayout(f, "hud_BlockPanel")
end)

pcall(function()
    local f, body = hudPanel("My base panel", "shield", 172, 76, 24, 300, nil, "myBaseEsp")
    FEAT.win.myBase = f

    local GREEN_OK  = Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 175)
    local RED_LOCK  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 105)

    local status = Instance.new("TextLabel", body)
    status.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    status.LayoutOrder = 1
    status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    status.FontFace = FONT_HEAVY
    status.Text = "UNLOCKED"
    status.TextColor3 = GREEN_OK
    status.TextSize = 16
    status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    status.ZIndex = 33

    local friend = Instance.new("TextLabel", body)
    friend.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13)
    friend.LayoutOrder = 2
    friend.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    friend.FontFace = FONT_BOLD
    friend.Text = "FRIEND ALLOWED"
    friend.TextColor3 = GREEN_OK
    friend.TextSize = 10
    friend.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    friend.Visible = false
    friend.ZIndex = 33

    local myPlot, timeGui, friendPmt = nil, nil, nil

    local function findMyPlot() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if myPlot and myPlot.Parent then return myPlot end
        myPlot = nil
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then return nil end
        local me = tostring(player.DisplayName)
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local sg = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
            local fr = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
            local tl = fr and fr:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
            if tl and tl.Text == (me .. "'s Base") then myPlot = plot return plot end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function parseTime(txt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not txt then return nil end
        local total, any = 0, false
        for d in tostring(txt):gmatch("%d+") do
            any = true
            total = total * 60 + (tonumber(d) or 0)
        end
        return any and total or nil
    end

    local function findTimeGui(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if timeGui and timeGui.Parent and timeGui:FindFirstChild("RemainingTime") then
            return timeGui
        end
        timeGui = nil
        local lowest = math.huge
        for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BillboardGui") and d:FindFirstChild("RemainingTime") then
                local part = d.Adornee or d.Parent
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Position.Y < lowest then
                    lowest = part.Position.Y
                    timeGui = d
                end
            end
        end
        return timeGui
    end

    local function findFriendPrompt(plot) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if friendPmt and friendPmt.Parent then return friendPmt end
        friendPmt = nil
        for _, d in ipairs(plot:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                local txt = (tostring(d.ObjectText) .. tostring(d.ActionText)):lower()
                if txt:find("friend", 1, true) or txt:find("ami", 1, true) then
                    friendPmt = d
                    return d
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function fmt(sec) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        sec = math.max(0, math.floor(sec))
        local m = math.floor(sec / 60)
        if m > 0 then return string.format("%dm %02ds", m, sec % 60) end
        return string.format("%ds", sec)
    end

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then
                pcall(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
                    local plot = findMyPlot()
                    if not plot then
                        status.Text = "NO BASE"
                        status.TextColor3 = RED_LOCK
                        friend.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local gui = findTimeGui(plot)
                    local left = gui and parseTime(gui:FindFirstChild("RemainingTime").Text)
                    if left and left > 0 then
                        status.Text = "LOCKED  " .. fmt(left)
                        status.TextColor3 = RED_LOCK
                    else
                        status.Text = "UNLOCKED"
                        status.TextColor3 = GREEN_OK
                    end

                    local pmt = findFriendPrompt(plot)
                    local allowed = false
                    if pmt then
                        allowed = tostring(pmt.ObjectText or ""):lower()
                            :find("disallow", 1, true) ~= nil
                    end
                    friend.Visible = allowed
                end)
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    local hub = hubTable()
    if hub then
        hub.showMyBaseESP = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); f.Visible = true end
        hub.hideMyBaseESP = function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE)); f.Visible = false end
    end
end)

    local _friendCache = nil
    local function friendPrompt() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if _friendCache and _friendCache.Parent then return _friendCache end
        _friendCache = nil
        local char = player.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local target, minDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, v in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                local txt = (tostring(v.ObjectText) .. tostring(v.ActionText)):lower()
                if txt:find("friend", 1, true) or txt:find("ami", 1, true) then
                    local part = v.Parent
                    if part and part:IsA("Attachment") then part = part.Parent end
                    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local d = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < minDist then minDist, target = d, v end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        _friendCache = target
        return target
    end

    local CAT = {
        { id = "allow", name = "Allow", live = true, run = function()

        { id = "none", name = "-", run = function() end },
    }
    local function catIndex(id) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        for i, e in ipairs(CAT) do if e.id == id then return i end end
        return #CAT
    end

    FEAT.cfg.action = { slots = { "allow", "reset", "rejoin", "exit" }, count = 4 }
    local AC = FEAT.cfg.action

    local slotBtns = {}
    local liveBtn = nil

    
    local function keyTag(id)
        local h = rawget(_G, "SMVLL_HUB")
        local k = type(h) == "table" and h.KEYBINDS and h.KEYBINDS["kb_act_" .. tostring(id)]
        return k and ("  [" .. k .. "]") or ""
    end

    local function applySlot(n) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local b = slotBtns[n]
        if not b then return end
        local e = CAT[catIndex(AC.slots[n] or "none")]
