    AC.style = 1

    function AC.paintBtn(b)
        local st = AC.style
        local stk = b:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
        local cr = b:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UICorner")
        local rad = (st == 3) and 10 or R.sm
        if st == 3 then
            b.BackgroundColor3, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(24, 25, 31), 0.05, 11
        elseif st == 2 then
            b.BackgroundColor3, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.TextSize = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 39), 0, 10
        else
            b.BackgroundColor3, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.TextSize = WHITE, 0.93, 10
        end
        if cr then cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, rad); cr:SetAttribute("BaseRadius", rad) end
        if stk then
            stk.Thickness = (st == 3) and 1.3 or 1
            stk.Transparency = (st == 3) and 0 or (st == 2 and 0.9 or 0.75)
        end
    end

    local function applyPanelH()
        local c = AC.count or 4
        local h
        if AC.style == 3 then
            h = 44 + c * BH + (c - 1) * GAP
        else
            local rows = math.ceil(c / 2)
            h = 44 + rows * 26 + (rows - 1) * 5
        end
        f:SetAttribute("SmvllOpenH", h)
        if f:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true then return end
        f.Size = UDim2.new(0, f.Size.X.Offset, 0, h)
    end

    local function applyStyle(i, user)
        AC.style = math.clamp(tonumber(i) or 1, 1, 3)
        local pill = AC.style == 3
        f.BackgroundColor3 = (AC.style == 1) and Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 14) or Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
        if sheen then sheen.Visible = AC.style == 1 end
        if pill and f:GetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed") == true then f:SetAttribute("SmvllCollapsed", false) end
        for _, bn in ipairs({ "Collapse", "Close" }) do
            local hb = title.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild(bn)
            if hb then hb.Visible = not pill end
        end
        f:SetAttribute("SmvllMinW", pill and 110 or nil)
        if user then f.Size = UDim2.new(0, pill and 140 or 214, 0, f.Size.Y.Offset) end
        body:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout").Padding = UDim.new(0, pill and GAP or 5)
        for _, o in ipairs(title.Parent:GetChildren()) do
            if o ~= title and o:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if THEME.glassLive and o:GetAttribute("GlassHide") then o:SetAttribute("GlassVis", not pill)
                else o.Visible = not pill end
            end
        end
        title.Text = pill and "Actions" or "Action panel"
        title.TextXAlignment = pill and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Size = pill and UDim2.new(1, 47, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0)
        for _, st in ipairs(strips) do
            local l = st:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIListLayout")
            l.FillDirection = pill and Enum.FillDirection.Vertical or Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
            l.Padding = UDim.new(0, pill and GAP or 5)
            st.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, pill and (BH * 2 + GAP) or 26)
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(slotBtns) do
            b.Size = pill and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, BH) or UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 1, 0)
            AC.paintBtn(b)
        end
        applyPanelH()
    end

    local function applyCount()
        local c = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(AC.count) or 4), 2, MAX_SLOTS)
        c = c - c % 2
        AC.count = c
        for n = 1, MAX_SLOTS do
            if slotBtns[n] then slotBtns[n].Visible = n <= c end
            if slotRows[n] then slotRows[n].Visible = n <= c end
        end
        for i = 1, MAX_SLOTS / 2 do
            if strips[i] then strips[i].Visible = (i * 2 - 1) <= c end
        end
        if countPick then countPick(c / 2, false) end
        applyPanelH()
    end

    do
        local win, list = PREV.panelShell("Action Panel", 300, 330, false)
        FEAT.win.actionCfg = win

        local gL = makeGroup(list, "Look", 1)
        local _, stylePick
        _, _, stylePick = makeDropdownRow(gL, "Style", { { name = "Glass" }, { name = "Normal" }, { name = "Pill" } }, 1,
            function(i) applyStyle(i, true); touched() end)
        register("actionStyle", function() return AC.style end, function(v)
            applyStyle(v)
            stylePick(AC.style, false)
        end)
        _, _, countPick = makeDropdownRow(gL, "Buttons",
            { { name = "2" }, { name = "4" }, { name = "6" }, { name = "8" } }, 2,
            function(i) AC.count = i * 2; applyCount(); touched() end)
        register("actionCount", function() return AC.count end, function(v)
            local n = tonumber(v)
            if n then AC.count = n; applyCount() end
        end)

        local gB = makeGroup(list, "Buttons", 2)
        local names = {}
        for i, e in ipairs(CAT) do names[i] = { name = e.name } end
        for n = 1, MAX_SLOTS do
            local row, _, pick = makeDropdownRow(gB, "Slot " .. n, names, catIndex(AC.slots[n] or "none"),
                function(i) AC.slots[n] = CAT[i].id; applySlot(n); touched() end)
            slotRows[n] = row
            applySlot(n)
            register("actionSlot" .. n, function() return AC.slots[n] end, function(v)
                if type(v) == "string" then
                    AC.slots[n] = v
                    applySlot(n)
                    pick(catIndex(v), false)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    applyCount()
    applyStyle(AC.style)

    task.spawn(function() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then
                local prompt = friendPrompt()
                if prompt then
                    local txt = tostring(prompt.ObjectText or ""):lower()
                    if liveBtn and liveBtn.Parent then
                        if txt:find("disallow") then
                            liveBtn.Text = "Disallow" .. keyTag("allow")
                        elseif txt:find("allow") then
                            liveBtn.Text = "Allow" .. keyTag("allow")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end)

    local shownUid = nil

                whoName.Text = "-"

        end)
    end

    -- ===== live full-body cam: shows the target's whole body + the effects (balloon / ragdoll / rocket / jail) =====
    local VIEW_H, FX_RADIUS, FX_CAP, FX_MAX_SIZE = 150, 18, 60, 40
    local view = Instance.new("ViewportFrame", f)
    view.Name = "BodyCam"
    view.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 33)
    view.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 63)
    view.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 17, 20)
    view.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    view.BorderSizePixel = 0
    view.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205)
    view.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    view.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)
    view.ZIndex = 31
    Instance.new("UICorner", view).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.sm)
    local vcam = Instance.new("Camera")
    vcam.FieldOfView = 45
    vcam.Parent = view
    view.CurrentCamera = vcam
    local stage = Instance.new("Folder", view)

    local camTarget, camChar, cloneChar = nil, nil, nil
    local partPairs, fxMap, fxCount = {}, {}, 0
    local camPos, camLook, lastYaw, fxAcc = nil, nil, Vector3.new(0, 0, -1), 0

    local fxParams = OverlapParams.new()
    fxParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    fxParams.MaxParts = 120

    local function isJunk(d)
        return d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint")
            or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") or d:IsA("Sound")
    end

    local function clearCam()
        if cloneChar then cloneChar:Destroy(); cloneChar = nil end
        for _, c in pairs(fxMap) do c:Destroy() end
        table.clear(fxMap); table.clear(partPairs)
        fxCount, camChar = 0, nil
    end

    -- walk real + clone trees in parallel (skips anything that did not clone) and pair up the BaseParts
    local function mapTree(r, c)
        local rc, cc = r:GetChildren(), c:GetChildren()
        local j = 1
        for i = 1, #rc do
            local rr, cj = rc[i], cc[j]
            if cj and cj.Name == rr.Name and cj.ClassName == rr.ClassName then
                if rr:IsA("BasePart") then
                    cj.Anchored = true
                    cj.CanCollide = false
                    partPairs[#partPairs + 1] = { real = rr, clone = cj }
                end
                mapTree(rr, cj)
                j = j + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function buildCam(char)
        clearCam()
        if not char then return false end
        pcall(function() char.Archivable = true end)
        local ok, clone = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
        if not ok or not clone then return false end
        mapTree(char, clone)
        for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if isJunk(d) then d:Destroy() end   -- no joints: every part follows the real CFrame (ragdoll, fling, ...)
        end
        clone.Parent = stage
        cloneChar, camChar = clone, char
        return true
    end

    local function scanFx(center)
        local ex = {}
        for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if pl.Character then ex[#ex + 1] = pl.Character end
        end
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if plots then ex[#ex + 1] = plots end
        fxParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ex
        local okH, hits = pcall(workspace.GetPartBoundsInRadius, workspace, center, FX_RADIUS, fxParams)
        if not okH then return end
        local seen = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(hits) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and not p:IsA("Terrain") and p.Transparency < 1 and p.Size.Magnitude < FX_MAX_SIZE then
                seen[p] = true
                if not fxMap[p] and fxCount < FX_CAP then
                    local okC, c = pcall(function() return p:Clone() end)
                    if okC and c then
                        for _, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                            if isJunk(d) then d:Destroy() end
                        end
                        c.Anchored = true
                        c.CanCollide = false
                        c.Parent = stage
                        fxMap[p] = c
                        fxCount = fxCount + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for p, c in pairs(fxMap) do
            if not seen[p] or not p.Parent then
                c:Destroy()
                fxMap[p] = nil
                fxCount = fxCount - 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function stepCam(dt)
        local t = camTarget
        local ch = t and t.Character
        if not ch then
            if camChar then clearCam() end
            return
        end
        if ch ~= camChar or not cloneChar then
            if not buildCam(ch) then return end
            camPos, camLook = nil, nil
        end
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        -- player only: nearby effect parts are no longer copied into the cam

        local minV, maxV = nil, nil
        local function grow(p)
            local pos = p.Position
            local h = math.min(p.Size.Magnitude * 0.5, 6)
            local lo = pos - Vector3.new(h, h, h)
            local hi = pos + Vector3.new(h, h, h)
            if not minV then
                minV, maxV = lo, hi
            else
                minV = Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X, lo.X), math.min(minV.Y, lo.Y), math.min(minV.Z, lo.Z))
                maxV = Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X, hi.X), math.max(maxV.Y, hi.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, hi.Z))
            end
        end

        for i = #partPairs, 1, -1 do
            local e = partPairs[i]
            local rp, cp = e.real, e.clone
            if rp.Parent and cp.Parent then
                cp.CFrame = rp.CFrame
                if cp.Transparency ~= rp.Transparency then cp.Transparency = rp.Transparency end
                grow(rp)
            else
                table.remove(partPairs, i)
            end
        end
        for p, c in pairs(fxMap) do
            if p.Parent then
                c.CFrame = p.CFrame
                grow(p)
            end
        end
        if not minV then return end

        -- keep the WHOLE person (and what is happening around them) inside the frame
        local center = (minV + maxV) * 0.5
        local ext = math.max((maxV - minV).Magnitude * 0.5, 3.4)
        local fov = math.rad(vcam.FieldOfView)
        local aspect = view.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(view.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
        local hfov = 2 * math.atan(math.tan(fov * 0.5) * aspect)
        local dist = ext / math.tan(math.min(fov, hfov) * 0.5) * 1.12

        local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude > 0.25 then lastYaw = flat.Unit end
        local wantPos = center + (lastYaw + Vector3.new(0, 0.22, 0)).Unit * dist

        local a = math.clamp(dt * 12, 0, 1)
        camPos = camPos and camPos:Lerp(wantPos, a) or wantPos
        camLook = camLook and camLook:Lerp(center, a) or center
        vcam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camLook)
    end

    local camConn
    camConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not f.Parent then
            camConn:Disconnect()
            clearCam()
            return
        end
        local vis = f.Visible and body.Visible
        if view.Visible ~= vis then view.Visible = vis end
        if not vis then return end
        pcall(stepCam, dt)
    end)

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame", body)

    label()

    local function closestPlayer() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ch = player.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local lockTarget, lockUntil, LOCK_TIME = nil, 0, 8
    local function pickTarget() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if lockTarget and tick() < lockUntil and lockTarget.Parent == Players and lockTarget.Character then
            return lockTarget
        end
        lockTarget = nil
        return closestPlayer()
    end

        while f.Parent do
            if f.Visible then
                local tg = pickTarget()
                camTarget = tg
                pcall(refreshWho, tg)
            end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)

    spamBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        end

    do

            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
            box.ZIndex = 14
            box.ClipsDescendants = true
            Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, R.xs)
            do
                local p2 = Instance.new("UIPadding", box)
                p2.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)

                    if i == 1 then h.SPAM_PACK_1 = out else h.SPAM_PACK_2 = out end

            end)

            function() return hubGet("AUTO_DEFENSE", false) == true end,
            function(v)

                hubSet("AUTO_DEFENSE", on)

            end)
    end

    gateFill.Visible = false
    gateFill.ZIndex = 184
    Instance.new("UICorner", gateFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local function stealingName() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        local ch = player.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local debris = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
        if not debris then return nil end
        local best, bestD = nil, 30
        for _, item in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do
            if item.Name == "FastOverheadTemplate" then
                local sg = item:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
                local part = sg and sg.Adornee
                if part then
                    local d = (part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestD then
                        local nm = sg:FindFirstChild("DisplayName", true)
                        if nm and nm.Text ~= "" then bestD, best = d, nm.Text end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local shown, visible = 0, false
    local overStart = nil
    local lastMode = nil

    local function armed() LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        return hubGet("AUTO_GRAB_NEAREST", false) == true
            or hubGet("AUTO_GRAB_BEST", false) == true
            or hubGet("AUTO_GRAB_PRIORITY", false) == true
            or hubGet("AUTO_GRAB_V2", false) == true
            or hubGet("AUTO_STEAL", false) == true
    end

    local _barNext = 0
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
        if not bar.Parent then return end
        local _barNow = os.clock()
        if _barNow < _barNext then return end
        dt = dt + (_barNow - _barNext + 0.033)
        _barNext = _barNow + 0.033

        local src = rawget(_G, "__SMVLL_STEALBAR")
        local target, name = 0, nil
        if type(src) == "table" then
            if src.fill and src.fill.Parent then target = src.fill.Size.X.Scale end
            if src.name and src.name.Parent then
                local t = tostring(src.name.Text or "")
                if t ~= "" and t ~= "-" then name = t end
            end
        end

        local holding = hubGet("HOLDING_STEAL", false) == true
            or (target > 0.001 and target < 0.999)
        if not name and holding then name = stealingName() end

        local isArmed = armed()
        local want = isArmed or holding or (not C.autoHide) or shown > 0.02
        if want ~= visible then
            visible = want
            bar.Visible = want
        end
        if not want then return end

        local gMode, gKind, gLeft, gProg
        if isArmed then
            local h = hubTable()
            local viewFn = h and h._agGateView
            if type(viewFn) == "function" then
                local okV, m, k, l, p = pcall(viewFn)
                if okV then gMode, gKind, gLeft, gProg = m, k, l, p end
            end
        end
        if gMode ~= lastMode then
            local pal = THEME.livePal or _tp
            gateFill.Visible = (gMode == "gate")
            pct.TextColor3 = (gMode == "gate") and GATE_C or pal.accent
            label.TextColor3 = (gMode == "tech") and pal.accent
                or (pal.text or WHITE)
            if gMode ~= "bypass" then fill.BackgroundColor3 = pal.accent end
            lastMode = gMode
        end
        if gMode == "bypass" then fill.BackgroundColor3 = BYPASS_C end

        if gMode == "gate" then
            shown = 0
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            gateFill.Size = UDim2.new(gProg or 0, 0, 1, 0)
            pct.Text = string.format("%.1fs", math.max(gLeft or 0, 0))
            if tm.Visible or overStart then
                overStart = nil
                tm.Text = ""
                tm.Visible = false
                pct.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, -2)
            end
            label.Text = ((gKind == "gummy") and "Gummy" or "Ragdolled") .. "  ·  regrab in"
            return
        end
        if gMode == "tech" then target = 1 end

        shown = shown + (target - shown) * math.clamp(dt * 12, 0, 1)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(shown, 0, 1, 0)
        pct.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(shown * 100 + 0.5))
        if shown >= 0.995 and gMode ~= "tech" then
            if not overStart then overStart = os.clock() end
            tm.Text = string.format("+%.1fs", os.clock() - overStart)
            if not tm.Visible then
                tm.Visible = true
                pct.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0.5, -2)
            end
        elseif tm.Visible or overStart then
            overStart = nil
            tm.Text = ""
            tm.Visible = false
            pct.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, -2)
        end
        label.Text = (gMode == "tech") and (gKind or "Ragdoll Tech")
            or holding and (name and ("Stealing  " .. name) or "Stealing")
            or "Auto grab"
    end)
end)

end)()
end)()

-- Global fix: scroll lists clip their content, which cut the outline / rounded corners of cards at the edges.
-- Every ScrollingFrame in every hub ScreenGui (also ones created later) gets a small safe margin.
;(function()
    local EDGE = 3
    local function fixScroll(sf)
        if not sf:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or sf:GetAttribute("SmvllEdgePad") then return end
        sf:SetAttribute("SmvllEdgePad", true)
        local pad = sf:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
        if not pad then
            pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
            pad.Parent = sf
        end
        if pad.PaddingLeft.Offset < EDGE then pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(pad.PaddingLeft.Scale, EDGE) end
        if pad.PaddingTop.Offset < EDGE then pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(pad.PaddingTop.Scale, EDGE) end
        if pad.PaddingBottom.Offset < EDGE then pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(pad.PaddingBottom.Scale, EDGE) end
        if pad.PaddingRight.Offset < EDGE then pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(pad.PaddingRight.Scale, EDGE) end
    end
    local watched = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
    local function watch(root)
        if not root or watched[root] then return end
        watched[root] = true
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do pcall(fixScroll, d) end
        root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then task.defer(function() pcall(fixScroll, d) end) end
        end)
    end
    watch(screenGui)
    for _, r in ipairs(rawget(_G, "SMVLL_UI_ROOTS") or {}) do pcall(watch, r) end
    -- roots added later (late-built panels)
    task.spawn(function()
        for _ = 1, 20 do
            task.wait(1)
            for _, r in ipairs(rawget(_G, "SMVLL_UI_ROOTS") or {}) do pcall(watch, r) end
        end
    end)
end)()

local function dummy(name)
    return function() print("[MENU_UI] " .. name .. " ON") end,
           function() print("[MENU_UI] " .. name .. " OFF") end
end

            hubCall("stopAutoGrabPriority")

            hubCall("stopAutoGrabNearest")

            if instant then

            end

    do
        local on, minV, seen, primed = false, 10e6, {}, false
        local function money(n)
            n = tonumber(n) or 0
            local suf, i = { "", "K", "M", "B", "T" }, 1
            while n >= 1000 and i < #suf do n = n / 1000; i = i + 1 end
            if i == 1 then return string.format("$%d/s", math.floor(n)) end
            return string.format("$%.1f%s/s", n, suf[i])
        end
        makeToggleRow(g4, "Brainrot Notifications",
            function() on = true end, function() on = false; primed = false end, false, "brNotify")
        makeSliderRow(g4, "Notify min $/s", 0, 500, 10, "%.0fM", function(v) minV = v * 1e6 end, "brNotifyMin")
        task.spawn(function()

                local fn = on and hubHas("getScanList")
                local ok, list = false, nil
                if fn then ok, list = pcall(fn) end
                if ok and type(list) == "table" then
                    local now = {}
                    for _, a in ipairs(list) do
                        local k = tostring(a.uid) .. "|" .. tostring(a.name) .. "|" .. tostring(a.mutation)
                        now[k] = true
                        if primed and not seen[k] and (tonumber(a.gen) or 0) >= minV then
                            local mut = (a.mutation and a.mutation ~= "None") and ("  \u{00B7}  " .. a.mutation) or ""
                            NOTIFY.push(tostring(a.name) .. mut,
                                money(a.gen) .. "  \u{00B7}  @" .. tostring(a.owner or "?"), "info", 6)
                        end
                    end
                    seen, primed = now, true
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)()

    local SLOTS = {
        { "idle", "Animation1", "idle1" }, { "idle", "Animation2", "idle2" },
        { "walk", "WalkAnim", "walk" }, { "run", "RunAnim", "run" },
        { "jump", "JumpAnim", "jump" }, { "fall", "FallAnim", "fall" },

    local orig, active, conn = nil, nil, nil

    local function slotObj(animate, sl)
        local f = animate:FindFirstChild(sl[1])
        return f and f:FindFirstChild(sl[2])
    end
    local function write(char, ids)
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if not (animate and ids) then return end
        for _, sl in ipairs(SLOTS) do
            local o, id = slotObj(animate, sl), ids[sl[3]]
            if o and id and o.AnimationId ~= id then o.AnimationId = id end
        end
    end
    local function snapshot(char)
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if not animate then return end
        local ids = {}
        for _, sl in ipairs(SLOTS) do
            local o = slotObj(animate, sl)
            ids[sl[3]] = o and o.AnimationId or nil
        end
        if ids.walk and not packIds[ids.walk] then orig = ids end
    end
    
    local function refresh(char)
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end) end
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
    end

    local function setPack(i)
        local p = PACKS[i]
        local char = player.Character
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
        if not (p and p.ids) then
            active = nil
            if orig and char then write(char, orig); refresh(char) end
            return
        end
        if char then snapshot(char) end
        active = p.ids
        if char then write(char, active); refresh(char) end
        conn = RunSvc.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local c = player.Character
            if c and active then write(c, active) end
        end)
    end

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        orig = nil
        local animate = char:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
        if not animate then return end
        snapshot(char)
        if active then write(char, active); refresh(char) end
    end)

    local g = makeGroup(pages[4], "Animations")
    makeDropdownRow(g, "Animation pack", PACKS, 1, function(i) setPack(i) end, "animPack")

;(function()
    
    
    local LP = player
    local _CFnew, _V3new = CFrame.new, Vector3.new

    local HOMERO_CFG = {
        body = { 10725826963, 86500008, 86500054, 86500036, 86500064, 86500078 },
        aplicarCuerpo = true,
        items = {
            { id = 103227869700418, offset = _CFnew(0,0,0) },
            { id = 84952305140948,   offset = _CFnew(0,0,0) },
            { id = 122465238537030,  offset = _CFnew(0,0,0) },
        },
        shirt = nil,
        pants = "rbxassetid://78591690208112",
        skinColor = Color3.fromRGB(234,184,146),
        headColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),
    }

    local TAG = "LocalOutfit_"

    local function loadObjects(id)
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id))
        end)
        if ok and typeof(res) == "table" and #res > 0 then return res end
        ok, res = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id)
        end)
        if ok and res then return { res } end
        return nil
    end

    local function collectParts(objs)
        local out = {}
        for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
            if o:IsA("BasePart") then out[#out + 1] = o end
            for _, d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then out[#out + 1] = d end
            end
        end
        return out
    end

    local function findAtt(char, name)
        for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("Attachment") and p.Name == name and p.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                return p
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyBody(char)
        local total = 0
        for _, id in ipairs(HOMERO_CFG.body) do
            local objs = loadObjects(id)
            if objs then
                for _, mp in ipairs(collectParts(objs)) do
                    local orig = char:FindFirstChild(mp.Name)
                    if orig and orig:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local c = mp:Clone()
                        c.Name = TAG .. "body_" .. mp.Name
                        c.CanCollide = false
                        c.Anchored = false
                        c.Massless = true
                        c.Size = orig.Size
                        c.CFrame = orig.CFrame
                        c.Parent = char
                        local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                        w.Part0 = orig
                        w.Part1 = c
                        w.Parent = c
                        orig.Transparency = 1
                        total = total + 1
                    end
                end
                for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
        return total
    end

    local function attachItem(char, entry)
        local objs = loadObjects(entry.id)
        if not objs then return false end

        local handle
        for _, p in ipairs(collectParts(objs)) do
            if p.Name == "Handle" then handle = p; break end
            if not handle then handle = p end
        end
        if not handle then
            for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
            return false
        end

        local H = handle:Clone()
        for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end

        H.Name = TAG .. "item_" .. tostring(entry.id)
        H.CanCollide = false
        H.Anchored = false
        H.Massless = true

        local wrap = H:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer")
        local target, c0, c1

        if wrap then
            target = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                  or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                  or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            c0 = entry.offset or _CFnew()
            c1 = _CFnew()
        else
            local hAtt = H:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
            local bAtt = hAtt and findAtt(char, hAtt.Name)
            if bAtt then
                target = bAtt.Parent
                c0 = bAtt.CFrame * (entry.offset or _CFnew())
                c1 = hAtt.CFrame
            else
                target = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                c0 = entry.offset or _CFnew(0, 1.4, 0)
                c1 = _CFnew()
            end
        end

        if not target then H:Destroy(); return false end

        H.CFrame = target.CFrame * c0 * c1:Inverse()
        H.Parent = char

        local w = Instance.new("Weld")
        w.Part0 = target
        w.Part1 = H
        w.C0 = c0
        w.C1 = c1
        w.Parent = H
        return true
    end

    local function applyHomeroOutfit(char)
        if not char then char = LP.Character end
        if not char then return end
        char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        char:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
        task.wait(0.4)

        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if d.Name:sub(1, #TAG) == TAG then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
        end

        if HOMERO_CFG.skinColor then
            local bc = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BodyColors") or Instance.new("BodyColors")
            bc.HeadColor3 = HOMERO_CFG.headColor or HOMERO_CFG.skinColor
            bc.TorsoColor3 = HOMERO_CFG.skinColor
            bc.LeftArmColor3, bc.RightArmColor3 = HOMERO_CFG.skinColor, HOMERO_CFG.skinColor
            bc.LeftLegColor3, bc.RightLegColor3 = HOMERO_CFG.skinColor, HOMERO_CFG.skinColor
            bc.Parent = char
        end

        for _, a in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if a:IsA("Accessory") then
                local h = a:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if h then h.Transparency = 1 end
            end
        end

        if HOMERO_CFG.shirt then
            local s = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt") or Instance.new("Shirt")
            s.Name = "Shirt"
            s.ShirtTemplate = HOMERO_CFG.shirt
            s.Parent = char
        end
        if HOMERO_CFG.pants then
            local p = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants") or Instance.new("Pants")
            p.Name = "Pants"
            p.PantsTemplate = HOMERO_CFG.pants
            p.Parent = char
        end
        if HOMERO_CFG.aplicarCuerpo then applyBody(char) end
        for _, e in ipairs(HOMERO_CFG.items) do attachItem(char, e) end
    end

    local function applyNoOutfit(char)
        if not char then char = LP.Character end
        if not char then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if d.Name:sub(1, #TAG) == TAG then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end

        local oldAcc = char:FindFirstChild("AuFfitAccessory")

        local oldKorblox = char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_RightLeg")

        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("CharacterMesh") and d.BodyPart == Enum.BodyPart.Head then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            head.Transparency = 0
            head.CanCollide = true
            head.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
            if face then face.Transparency = 0 end
            local sm = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
            if sm then pcall(function() sm:Destroy() end) end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck")
            if neck then neck.Enabled = true end
        end)
        for _, partName in ipairs({"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}) do
            local limb = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
            if limb then limb.Transparency = 0 end
        end
        local shirt = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt")
        if shirt then pcall(function() shirt:Destroy() end) end
        local pants = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants")
        if pants then pcall(function() pants:Destroy() end) end
        for _, a in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if a:IsA("Accessory") then
                local h = a:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if h then h.Transparency = 0 end
            end
        end
    end

    local function loadObjectsStd(id)

    local function applyHeadlessKorblox(char)
        if not char then return end
        pcall(function() LP.CharacterAvatarType = Enum.AvatarType.R6 end)
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if head then
            head.Transparency = 1
            head.CanCollide = false
            head.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
            if face then face.Transparency = 1 end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck")
            if neck then neck.Enabled = false end
        end)
        for _, v in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Accessory") then
                local w = v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WeldConstraint") or v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D")
                local vh = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if not w and vh then
                    w = vh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld") or vh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WeldConstraint") or vh:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D")
                end
                if w then
                    local p0, p1 = w.Part0, w.Part1
                    if (p0 and p0.Name == "Head") or (p1 and p1.Name == "Head") then
                        v.Parent = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local rightLegConfig = {
            id = "rbxassetid://139607718",
            targetBodyPart = "RightUpperLeg",
            partsToHide = {"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"},
            scale = _V3new(1, 1, 1),
            offset = _CFnew(0, 0, 0)
        }
        local targetPart = char:FindFirstChild(rightLegConfig.targetBodyPart)
        if targetPart then
            local oldAsset = char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_RightLeg")
            if oldAsset then oldAsset:Destroy() end
            for _, partName in ipairs(rightLegConfig.partsToHide) do
                local limb = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
                if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then limb.Transparency = 1 end
            end
            local success, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(rightLegConfig.id) end)
            if success and objects and #objects > 0 then
                local assetModel = objects[1]
                assetModel.Name = "Korblox_RightLeg"
                local mainMesh = assetModel:IsA("BasePart") and assetModel or assetModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                if mainMesh then
                    mainMesh.Size = mainMesh.Size * rightLegConfig.scale
                    mainMesh.CanCollide = false
                    mainMesh.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame * rightLegConfig.offset

                    weld.Part0 = targetPart
                    weld.Part1 = mainMesh
                    weld.Parent = mainMesh
                    assetModel.Parent = char
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyOutfitByIndex(index)
        local cfg = OUTFITS[index]
        if not cfg then return end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then return end

        if cfg.customApply then
            cfg.customApply(char)
            if outfitSelectorLabel then outfitSelectorLabel.Text = cfg.label end
            return
        end

        char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if d:IsA("CharacterMesh") and d.BodyPart == Enum.BodyPart.Head then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        local done = false
        if head:IsA("MeshPart") then
            done = pcall(function()
                head.MeshId = cfg.headMesh
                if cfg.headTexture then head.TextureID = cfg.headTexture end
            end)
        end
        if not done then
            local sm = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") or Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            sm.Parent = head
            sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            sm.MeshId = cfg.headMesh
            sm.TextureId = cfg.headTexture or ""
        end
        if cfg.shirt then
            local s = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Shirt") or Instance.new("Shirt")
            s.Name = "Shirt"
            s.ShirtTemplate = cfg.shirt
            s.Parent = char
        end
        if cfg.pants then
            local p = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants") or Instance.new("Pants")
            p.Name = "Pants"
            p.PantsTemplate = cfg.pants
            p.Parent = char
        end
        local old = char:FindFirstChild("AuFfitAccessory")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if cfg.accessory and head then
            local objs = loadObjectsStd(cfg.accessory)
            if objs then
                local handle
                for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
                    if o:IsA("BasePart") then handle = o; break end
                    local f = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    if f then handle = f; break end
                end
                if handle then
                    local h = handle:Clone()
                    h.Name = "AuFfitAccessory"
                    h.CanCollide = false
                    h.Anchored = false
                    h.Massless = true
                    h.Parent = char
                    local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                    weld.Part0 = head
                    weld.Part1 = h
                    weld.C0 = _CFnew(cfg.offset)
                    weld.Parent = h
                end
                for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
        if cfg.headlessKorblox then
            applyHeadlessKorblox(char)
        else
            if char then
                local head2 = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if head2 then
                    head2.Transparency = 0
                    head2.CanCollide = true
                    head2.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    local face2 = head2:FindFirstChild("face")
                    if face2 then face2.Transparency = 0 end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local neck = char:FindFirstChild("Neck")
                    if neck then neck.Enabled = true end
                end)
                for _, partName in ipairs({"RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot"}) do
                    local limb = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
                    if limb then limb.Transparency = 0 end
                end
                local oldKorblox = char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_RightLeg")
                if oldKorblox then oldKorblox:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        if outfitSelectorLabel then outfitSelectorLabel.Text = cfg.label end
    end

    local applied = false
    local opts = {}
    for i, o in ipairs(OUTFITS) do opts[i] = { name = o.label } end
    currentOutfitIndex = NO_INDEX

    local function apply()
        local i = currentOutfitIndex
        if i == NO_INDEX and not applied then return end
        applied = i ~= NO_INDEX
        task.spawn(function() pcall(applyOutfitByIndex, i) end)
    end

    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if currentOutfitIndex == NO_INDEX then applied = false return end
        local deadline = tick() + 5
        while not (char.Parent and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                   and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do
            if tick() > deadline or LP.Character ~= char then return end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
        if LP.Character == char then apply() end
    end)

    makeDropdownRow(g, "Outfit", opts, NO_INDEX, function(i)
        currentOutfitIndex = i
        apply()
    end, "skinOutfit")

local function cfgPath(name)
    return CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. name:gsub("[^%w_%-]", "") .. ".json"
end

    local writeConfig, readConfig, applyConfig
    local AUTO_NAME = "autosave"
    local autoOn = true
    local autoPending = false
    local queueAuto

    local function listConfigs()
        local out = {}
        pcall(function()
            if type(listfiles) ~= "function" then return end
            for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(CONFIG_FOLDER)) do
                local n = tostring(f):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                if n and n ~= AUTO_NAME then table.insert(out, n) end
            end
        end)
        table.sort(out)
        return out
    end

    function writeConfig(name)
        local data = {}
        for k, entry in pairs(SETTINGS) do
            local ok, v = pcall(entry.get)
            if ok then data[k] = v end
        end

        for k, v in pairs(CFG_PENDING) do
            if data[k] == nil then data[k] = v end
        end
        local hub = hubTable()
        local keys = hub and hub.SAVE_KEYS
        if type(keys) == "table" then
            local eng = {}
            for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
                local v = hub[k]
                local t = type(v)
                if t == "number" or t == "string" or t == "boolean" or t == "table" then
                    eng[k] = v
                end
            end
            data.__engine = eng
        end
        return pcall(function()
            writefile(cfgPath(name), HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
        end)
    end

    local cfgGen = 0

    function readConfig(name)
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(cfgPath(name)))
        end)
        if not (ok and type(data) == "table") then return false end
        return applyConfig(data)
    end

    function applyConfig(data)
        cfgGen = cfgGen + 1
        local myGen = cfgGen
        CFG_LOADING = CFG_LOADING + 1
        local done = false
        local function finish()
            if done then return end
            done = true
            CFG_LOADING = math.max(0, CFG_LOADING - 1)

            if CFG_LOADING == 0 then queueAuto() end
        end

        local eng = data.__engine
        data.__engine = nil
        if type(eng) == "table" then
            local hub = hubTable()
            if hub then
                for k, v in pairs(eng) do pcall(function() hub[k] = v end) end
                if type(hub.UI_REFRESHERS) == "table" then
                    for _, fn in ipairs(hub.UI_REFRESHERS) do pcall(fn) end
                end
            end
        end

        local heavy = {}
        for k, v in pairs(data) do
            local entry = SETTINGS[k]
            if entry then
                if LIVE_KEYS[k] then
                    heavy[#heavy + 1] = { entry = entry, v = v }
                else
                    pcall(entry.set, v)
                end
            else

                CFG_PENDING[k] = v
            end
        end
        if #heavy > 0 then
            task.spawn(function()

                local BUDGET = 0.004
                local t = os.clock()
                for _, h in ipairs(heavy) do
                    if cfgGen ~= myGen then break end
                    pcall(h.entry.set, h.v)
                    if os.clock() - t > BUDGET then
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                        t = os.clock()
                    end
                end
                finish()
            end)
        else
            finish()
        end
        return true
    end

    function queueAuto()

        if CFG_LOADING > 0 then return end
        if not autoOn or autoPending then return end
        autoPending = true
        task.delay(1, function()
            autoPending = false
            if autoOn then writeConfig(AUTO_NAME) end
        end)
    end
    AUTOSAVE = queueAuto
    _G.SMVLL_V3_AUTOSAVE = queueAuto

        local function status(text, kind) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if statusLbl then statusLbl.Text = text end
            NOTIFY.push(text, nil, kind or "ok", 2.5)

        local function rawOf(name) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            if name == SMVLL_NAME then return PRESET end
            local ok, raw = pcall(function() return readfile(cfgPath(name)) end)
            return ok and raw or nil
        end

        local function decode(raw) LPH_ATTRIBUTES(VM(NONE));
            local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
            return (ok and type(data) == "table") and data or nil
        end

        local function choose(name)
            selected = name
            if pickVal then pickVal.Text = name or "select..." end
        end
